function CodingSystemExplainer({
  fowls,
  codes,
}: {
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
}) {
  const sires = fowls
    .filter(isSireGender)
    .filter((f) => classifyBirdCode(codeOf(f, codes)) === 'sire');
  const dams = fowls
    .filter((f) => isFemale(f.gender))
    .filter((f) => classifyBirdCode(codeOf(f, codes)) === 'dam');
  const offspring = fowls.filter((f) => classifyBirdCode(codeOf(f, codes)) === 'offspring');

  return (
    <div className="bg-card border-border overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border shadow-sm">
      <div className="border-border border-b px-6 pt-6 pb-4">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-violet-200 bg-violet-100 dark:border-violet-800 dark:bg-violet-950/50">
            <Hash className="h-5 w-5 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">Coding System</h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
              Standardized tagging scheme for every chicken
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-6 md:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Sire */}
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 p-4 dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-sky-600">
              <Hash className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">SIRE</p>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-600/70 dark:text-sky-500">
                Male chicken
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'].map((n) => (
              <span
                key={n}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-sky-600 text-xs font-black text-white shadow-sm"
              >
                {n}
              </span>
            ))}
            <span className="text-xs font-black text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">···</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
            <strong>Numbers</strong> are used to identify sires
          </p>
          {sires.length > 0 && (
            <div className="border-t border-sky-200 pt-2 dark:border-sky-800">
              <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-sky-600 uppercase dark:text-sky-400">
                On your farm:
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                {sires.slice(0, 6).map((f) => (
                  <span
                    key={f.id}
                    className="rounded-md border border-sky-200 bg-sky-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-sky-700 dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-900/40 dark:text-sky-400"
                  >
                    {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')} ·{' '}
                    {f.name.length > 8 ? f.name.slice(0, 8) + '…' : f.name}
                  </span>
                ))}
                {sires.length > 6 && (
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-sky-500">+{sires.length - 6} more</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Dam */}
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-200 bg-pink-50 p-4 dark:border-pink-800 dark:bg-pink-950/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-pink-600">
              <Type className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400">DAM</p>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-pink-600/70 dark:text-pink-500">
                Female chicken
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'].map((l) => (
              <span
                key={l}
                className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-pink-600 text-xs font-black text-white shadow-sm"
              >
                {l}
              </span>
            ))}
            <span className="text-xs font-black text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">···</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400">
            <strong>Letters</strong> are used to identify dams
          </p>
          {dams.length > 0 && (
            <div className="border-t border-pink-200 pt-2 dark:border-pink-800">
              <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-pink-600 uppercase dark:text-pink-400">
                On your farm:
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                {dams.slice(0, 6).map((f) => (
                  <span
                    key={f.id}
                    className="rounded-md border border-pink-200 bg-pink-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-pink-700 dark:border-pink-800 dark:bg-pink-900/40 dark:text-pink-400"
                  >
                    {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')} ·{' '}
                    {f.name.length > 8 ? f.name.slice(0, 8) + '…' : f.name}
                  </span>
                ))}
                {dams.length > 6 && (
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-pink-500">+{dams.length - 6} more</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Offspring */}
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-emerald-600">
              <Combine className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">OFFSPRING</p>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600/70 dark:text-emerald-500">
                Sire + Dam combined
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {[
              { code: '1A₁', label: 'Sire 1 × Dam A · 1st' },
              { code: '1A₂', label: 'Sire 1 × Dam A · 2nd' },
              { code: '2B₁', label: 'Sire 2 × Dam B · 1st' },
            ].map((ex) => (
              <div key={ex.code} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-10 font-mono text-sm font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  {ex.code}
                </span>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">{ex.label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {offspring.length > 0 && (
            <div className="border-t border-emerald-200 pt-2 dark:border-emerald-800">
              <p className="mb-1.5 text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-emerald-600 uppercase dark:text-emerald-400">
                On your farm:
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                {offspring.slice(0, 6).map((f) => (
                  <span
                    key={f.id}
                    className="rounded-md border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-400"
                  >
                    {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')}
                  </span>
                ))}
                {offspring.length > 6 && (
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500">
                    +{offspring.length - 6} more
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Example diagram */}
      <div className="bg-muted/40 border-border mx-6 mb-6 rounded-2xl border p-4">
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-3 text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
          Pairing Example
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-100 px-3 py-2 text-center dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/50">
              <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-sky-600 uppercase dark:text-sky-400">
                Sire
              </p>
              <p className="font-mono text-base font-black text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">1</p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Lemon 84</p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-black">×</span>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-pink-100 px-3 py-2 text-center dark:border-pink-800 dark:bg-pink-950/50">
              <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-pink-600 uppercase dark:text-pink-400">
                Dam
              </p>
              <p className="font-mono text-base font-black text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-300">A</p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Ground Red</p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-black">→</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {['1A₁', '1A₂', '1A₃'].map((code, i) => (
              <div
                key={code}
                className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-100 px-3 py-2 text-center dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50"
              >
                <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-emerald-600 uppercase dark:text-emerald-400">
                  Offspring {i + 1}
                </p>
                <p className="font-mono text-base font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  {code}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">···</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-3 text-xs font-semibold">
          💡 You may also add a descriptive name:{' '}
          <strong className="text-card-foreground">Lemon Ground Red · 1A₁</strong>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BREEDING PAIR CARD
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function BreedingPairCard({
  pair,
  fowls,
  codes,
  matchHistory,
  onRemove,
  onOutcomeChange,
  setSelectedFowlForDetails,
}: {
  pair: BreedingPairRecord;
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  matchHistory: MatchRecord[];
  onRemove: () => void;
  onOutcomeChange: (outcome: PairingOutcome) => void;
  setSelectedFowlForDetails: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const sire =
    fowls.find((f) => f.id === pair.sire_id) ||
    (pair.sire_name
      ? fowls.find((f) => f.name.toLowerCase() === pair.sire_name.toLowerCase())
      : undefined);
  const dam =
    fowls.find((f) => f.id === pair.dam_id) ||
    (pair.dam_name
      ? fowls.find((f) => f.name.toLowerCase() === pair.dam_name.toLowerCase())
      : undefined);
  const relatedness = useMemo(
    () => classifyPairingRelatedness(sire, dam, fowls),
    [sire, dam, fowls],
  );

  const offspring = offspringForPairing(pair, fowls);

  const offspringMatchStats = offspring.map((o) => {
    const matches = matchHistory.filter(
      (m) => m.entry_name?.toLowerCase() === o.name.toLowerCase(),
    );
    const wins = matches.filter((m) => m.outcome?.toLowerCase() === 'win').length;
    const losses = matches.filter((m) => m.outcome?.toLowerCase() === 'loss').length;
    const decided = wins + losses;
    return {
      fowl: o,
      wins,
      losses,
      decided,
      winRate: decided > 0 ? Math.round((wins / decided) * 100) : 0,
    };
  });

  const totalWins = offspringMatchStats.reduce((a, s) => a + s.wins, 0);
  const totalLosses = offspringMatchStats.reduce((a, s) => a + s.losses, 0);
  const totalDecided = totalWins + totalLosses;
  const combinedWinRate = totalDecided > 0 ? Math.round((totalWins / totalDecided) * 100) : 0;

  const outCfg = OUTCOME_CONFIG[pair.outcome];
  const offspringBaseCode = buildOffspringBaseCode(pair.sire_code, pair.dam_code) || '—';

  return (
    <div className="bg-card border-border overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border shadow-sm">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <div className="border-border flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-100 to-pink-100 dark:from-sky-950/50 dark:to-pink-950/50">
              <Heart className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">
                  <span className="font-mono text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{pair.sire_code}</span>
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1">×</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">
                    {pair.dam_code}
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <span className="rounded-md border border-violet-200 bg-violet-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-800 dark:bg-violet-950/50 dark:text-violet-400">
                  → {offspringBaseCode}₁, {offspringBaseCode}₂···
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-xs font-semibold">
                {pair.sire_name} × {pair.dam_name}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
            <RelatednessBadge classification={relatedness} compact />
            <span
              className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black ${outCfg.bg} ${outCfg.text} ${outCfg.border}`}
            >
              {pair.outcome}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onRemove}
              className="text-muted-foreground flex h-7 w-7 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-500 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30"
              aria-label="Remove pairing"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Stats row */}
        <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <div className="bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
            <p className="text-card-foreground text-lg font-black">{offspring.length}</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">
              Offspring
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
            <p
              className={`text-lg font-black ${combinedWinRate >= 50 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : totalDecided > 0 ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}
            >
              {totalDecided > 0 ? `${combinedWinRate}%` : '—'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">
              Win Rate
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
            <p className="text-card-foreground text-lg font-black">
              {totalWins}W-{totalLosses}L
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">
              Record
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Parent info */}
        <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => sire && setSelectedFowlForDetails(sire)}
            disabled={!sire}
            className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 p-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-sky-100 disabled:cursor-default dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/30 dark:hover:bg-sky-950/50"
          >
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-sky-600 uppercase dark:text-sky-400">
              🐓 Sire
            </p>
            <p className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs font-black">{pair.sire_name}</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
              {sire?.breed || '—'} · Code:{' '}
              <span className="font-mono text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{pair.sire_code}</span>
            </p>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => dam && setSelectedFowlForDetails(dam)}
            disabled={!dam}
            className="cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-pink-50 p-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-pink-100 disabled:cursor-default dark:border-pink-800 dark:bg-pink-950/30 dark:hover:bg-pink-950/50"
          >
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-pink-600 uppercase dark:text-pink-400">
              🐔 Dam
            </p>
            <p className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs font-black">{pair.dam_name}</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
              {dam?.breed || '—'} · Code:{' '}
              <span className="font-mono text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">{pair.dam_code}</span>
            </p>
          </button>
        </div>

        {pair.notes && (
          <p className="text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 mb-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold">
            📝 {pair.notes}
          </p>
        )}

        {offspring.length > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-card-foreground flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between py-1 text-xs font-black transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="tracking-widest uppercase">Offspring ({offspring.length})</span>
            {expanded ? <ChevronUp className="h-3 w-3" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />}
          </button>
        )}

        {expanded && (
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
            {offspringMatchStats.map(({ fowl, wins, losses, decided, winRate }) => {
              const code = codes.get(String(fowl.id)) || fowl.bird_code || '';
              return (
                <button
                  key={fowl.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl)}
                  className="group bg-muted/30 border-border flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 transition-all hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:border-emerald-700 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/30"
                >
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground bg-card border-border shrink-0 rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black">
                      {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs font-black group-hover:text-emerald-700 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400">
                        {fowl.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-xs font-semibold">
                        {sexLabel(fowl)} · {fowl.breed}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {decided > 0 ? (
                    <span
                      className={`shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${winRate >= 50 ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400'}`}
                    >
                      {winRate}% · {wins}W-{losses}L
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground/50 shrink-0 text-xs font-bold">
                      No fights
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-muted/30 border-border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t px-5 py-2.5">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
          Pairing Date: {pair.pairing_date || 'Not set'}
        </span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <label
            htmlFor={`pair-outcome-${pair.id}`}
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Status
          </label>
          <select
            id={`pair-outcome-${pair.id}`}
            value={pair.outcome}
            onChange={(e) => onOutcomeChange(e.target.value as PairingOutcome)}
            className={`bg-card cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/40 focus:outline-none ${outCfg.bg} ${outCfg.text} ${outCfg.border}`}
          >
            {PAIRING_OUTCOMES.map((option) => (
              <option key={option} value={option}>
                {option}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400">
            Base Code: {offspringBaseCode}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ADD PAIRING FORM
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AddPairingForm({
  fowls,
  codes,
  pairs,
  onAdd,
  onCancel,
}: {
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  pairs: BreedingPairRecord[];
  onAdd: (payload: Partial<BreedingPairRecord>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [sireId, setSireId] = useState('');
  const [damId, setDamId] = useState('');
  const [pairingDate, setPairingDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<PairingOutcome>('Active');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [confirmCloseBreeding, setConfirmCloseBreeding] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setConfirmCloseBreeding(false);
  }, [sireId, damId]);

  const males = fowls.filter(isSireGender);
  const females = fowls.filter((f) => isFemale(f.gender));

  const selectedSire = fowls.find((f) => f.id === Number(sireId));
  const selectedDam = fowls.find((f) => f.id === Number(damId));

  const sireCode = selectedSire ? codeOf(selectedSire, codes) : '';
  const damCode = selectedDam ? codeOf(selectedDam, codes) : '';
  const previewCode = buildOffspringBaseCode(sireCode, damCode);

  const conflict = useMemo(
    () => pairingConflict(pairs, selectedSire, selectedDam),
    [pairs, selectedSire, selectedDam],
  );

  const expectedComposition = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedSire || !selectedDam) return null;
    const sireComp = computeBloodlineComposition(selectedSire, fowls);
    const damComp = computeBloodlineComposition(selectedDam, fowls);
    return blendCompositions(sireComp, damComp, 0.5, 0.5);
  }, [selectedSire, selectedDam, fowls]);

  const expectedBreedMix = useMemo(() => {
    if (!expectedComposition || !selectedSire || !selectedDam) return null;
    const syntheticChild = {
      id: -999,
      name: 'Preview Offspring',
      breed: '',
      bloodline_composition: expectedComposition,
    } as unknown as FowlRecord;
    return getBreedingClassification(syntheticChild, fowls);
  }, [expectedComposition, selectedSire, selectedDam, fowls]);

  const relatedness = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedSire || !selectedDam) return null;
    return classifyPairingRelatedness(selectedSire, selectedDam, fowls);
  }, [selectedSire, selectedDam, fowls]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const problem = validatePairing(selectedSire, selectedDam);
    if (problem) {
      setError(problem);
      return;
    }
    if (conflict?.kind === 'occupied') {
      setError(
        `${conflict.bird === 'sire' ? 'Sire' : 'Dam'} "${
          conflict.bird === 'sire' ? selectedSire?.name : selectedDam?.name
        }" ay may Active partner na si ${conflict.partnerName} (pairing ${
          conflict.pairing.pairing_code || `#${conflict.pairing.id}`
        }).`,
      );
      return;
    }
    if (relatedness?.isCloseBreeding && !confirmCloseBreeding) {
      setError('Please confirm the close breeding warning before recording this pairing.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    onAdd({
      sire_id: selectedSire!.id,
      dam_id: selectedDam!.id,
      sire_name: selectedSire!.name,
      dam_name: selectedDam!.name,
      sire_code: sireCode || null,
      dam_code: damCode || null,
      pairing_code: pairingCodeFor(sireCode, damCode),
      pairing_date: pairingDate || null,
      notes: notes.trim() || null,
      outcome,
    });
  };

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="bg-card space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-emerald-800"
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-emerald-600">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">Record a New Pairing</h3>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="pair-sire"
            className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-sky-600 uppercase dark:text-sky-400"
          >
            🐓 Sire
          </label>
          <select
            id="pair-sire"
            value={sireId}
            onChange={(e) => setSireId(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100 dark:focus:ring-emerald-900/30"
          >
            <option value="">Select a sire...</option>
            {males.map((f) => (
              <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')} · {f.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="pair-dam"
            className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-pink-600 uppercase dark:text-pink-400"
          >
            🐔 Dam
          </label>
          <select
            id="pair-dam"
            value={damId}
            onChange={(e) => setDamId(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100 dark:focus:ring-emerald-900/30"
          >
            <option value="">Select a dam...</option>
            {females.map((f) => (
              <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')} · {f.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {conflict?.kind === 'occupied' && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/40">
          <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-sm leading-none text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
            ⛔
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-rose-600 uppercase dark:text-rose-400">
              Already Has an Active Partner
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
              {conflict.bird === 'sire' ? selectedSire?.name : selectedDam?.name} is currently
              paired with {conflict.partnerName} (pairing{' '}
              {conflict.pairing.pairing_code || `#${conflict.pairing.id}`}). Set that pairing to
              Completed before recording a new one.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {conflict?.kind === 'couple' && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 p-3 dark:border-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/40">
          <span className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-sm leading-none text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">
            ℹ️
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-sky-600 uppercase dark:text-sky-400">
              This Pairing Is Already Recorded
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">
              {conflict.pairing.sire_name || 'Sire'} × {conflict.pairing.dam_name || 'Dam'} — code{' '}
              {conflict.pairing.pairing_code || `#${conflict.pairing.id}`}, status{' '}
              {conflict.pairing.outcome}. Submitting will update the existing record; no duplicate
              will be created.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Live Preview: Breed mix + Relatedness */}
      {selectedSire && selectedDam && (
        <div className="dark:bg-card/70 border-border space-y-3 rounded-xl border bg-slate-50 p-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Dna className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <p className="text-card-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
              Offspring & Lineage Live Preview
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {/* Expected Offspring Breed Mix */}
            <div className="bg-card border-border space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-wider uppercase">
                Expected Offspring Breed Mix
              </p>
              {expectedBreedMix ? (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <BreedingTypeBadge classification={expectedBreedMix} />
                    <span className="text-card-foreground text-xs font-black">
                      {expectedBreedMix.type === 'Crossbred'
                        ? expectedBreedMix.derivedBreed
                        : expectedBreedMix.dominantBreed}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                    {expectedBreedMix.summary}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Calculating breed mix...</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Pairing Relatedness */}
            <div className="bg-card border-border space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border p-3">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-wider uppercase">
                Pairing Relatedness
              </p>
              {relatedness ? (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <RelatednessBadge classification={relatedness} showSecondary />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                    {relatedness.relationship}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Evaluating relatedness...</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Close Breeding Warning + Confirmation */}
          {relatedness?.isCloseBreeding && (
            <div className="space-y-2.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 p-3.5 dark:border-amber-700/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-amber-800 uppercase dark:text-amber-300">
                      Close Breeding Warning
                    </p>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                      ({relatedness.secondaryLabel})
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200">
                    {relatedness.relationship}. Inbreeding can amplify undesirable recessive traits
                    and reduce vitality.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 border-t border-amber-200 pt-1.5 dark:border-amber-800/60">
                <input
                  id="confirm-close-breeding"
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={confirmCloseBreeding}
                  onChange={(e) => setConfirmCloseBreeding(e.target.checked)}
                  className="h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer rounded border-amber-400 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-500"
                />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 select-none dark:text-amber-200">
                  I understand the risks of close breeding and confirm this pairing
                </span>
              </label>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {previewCode && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-violet-200 bg-violet-50 p-3 dark:border-violet-800 dark:bg-violet-950/30">
          <Combine className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" />
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-violet-600 uppercase dark:text-violet-400">
              Offspring Code Preview
            </p>
            <p className="text-card-foreground font-mono text-sm font-black">
              {previewCode}₁, {previewCode}₂, {previewCode}₃···
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              Sire <span className="font-mono text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{sireCode}</span> +
              Dam <span className="font-mono text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">{damCode}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="pair-date"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Pairing Date
          </label>
          <input
            id="pair-date"
            type="date"
            value={pairingDate}
            onChange={(e) => setPairingDate(e.target.value)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="pair-status"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Status
          </label>
          <select
            id="pair-status"
            value={outcome}
            onChange={(e) => setOutcome(e.target.value as typeof outcome)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
          >
            <option value="Active">Active</option>
            <option value="Completed">Completed</option>
            <option value="Discontinued">Discontinued</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label
          htmlFor="pair-notes"
          className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
        >
          Notes / Observations
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="pair-notes"
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="e.g. Strong bloodline combination, promising offspring..."
          className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 w-full resize-none rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
        />
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-rose-600 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-400">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={
            !sireId ||
            !damId ||
            conflict?.kind === 'occupied' ||
            (relatedness?.isCloseBreeding && !confirmCloseBreeding)
          }
          className="flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {relatedness?.isCloseBreeding && !confirmCloseBreeding
            ? 'Confirm Close Breeding to Save'
            : 'Record Pairing'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/80 cursor-pointer rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-black transition-all"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// SAFETY INCIDENT CARD
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SafetyIncidentCard({
  incident,
  onRemove,
}: {
  incident: SafetyIncidentRecord;
  onRemove: () => void;
}) {
  const cfg = SEVERITY_CONFIG[incident.severity];
  const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
    Treated: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400',
    Monitoring: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
    Recovered: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
    Deceased: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-4 ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border}`}>
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${cfg.dot}`} />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <p className="text-card-foreground text-xs font-black">
                <span className={`font-mono ${cfg.text}`}>
                  {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(incident.fowl_code || '')}
                </span>{' '}
                · {incident.fowl_name}
              </p>
              <span
                className={`rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${cfg.bg} ${cfg.text} ${cfg.border} tracking-wider uppercase`}
              >
                {incident.severity}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">{incident.type}</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">·</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
                {incident.incident_date}
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">·</span>
              <span
                className={`text-xs font-black ${statusColors[incident.status] || 'text-muted-foreground'}`}
              >
                {incident.status}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRemove}
          className="text-muted-foreground flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-500 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-rose-500/50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30"
          aria-label={`Dismiss ${incident.type} incident`}
        >
          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
        </button>
      </div>
      {incident.description && (
        <p className="text-muted-foreground bg-background/60 mt-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
          {incident.description}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ADD INCIDENT FORM
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AddIncidentForm({
  fowls,
  codes,
  onAdd,
  onCancel,
}: {
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  onAdd: (payload: Partial<SafetyIncidentRecord>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [fowlId, setFowlId] = useState('');
  const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [type, setType] = useState<IncidentType>('Injury');
  const [severity, setSeverity] = useState<IncidentSeverity>('Minor');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<IncidentStatus>('Treated');

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const fowl = fowls.find((f) => f.id === Number(fowlId));
    if (!fowl) return;
    onAdd({
      fowl_id: fowl.id,
      fowl_name: fowl.name,
      fowl_code: codeOf(fowl, codes) || null,
      incident_date: date,
      type,
      severity,
      description: description.trim() || null,
      status,
    });
  };

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="bg-card space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-rose-800"
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-rose-600">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-white" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">Record a Safety Incident</h3>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="inc-fowl"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Chicken
          </label>
          <select
            id="inc-fowl"
            value={fowlId}
            onChange={(e) => setFowlId(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
          >
            <option value="">Select a chicken...</option>
            {fowls.map((f) => (
              <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                {formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code || '')} · {f.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="inc-date"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Date
          </label>
          <input
            id="inc-date"
            type="date"
            value={date}
            onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="inc-type"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Incident Type
          </label>
          <select
            id="inc-type"
            value={type}
            onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as IncidentType)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
          >
            {INCIDENT_TYPES.map((t) => (
              <option key={t} value={t}>
                {t}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="inc-severity"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Severity
          </label>
          <select
            id="inc-severity"
            value={severity}
            onChange={(e) => setSeverity(e.target.value as IncidentSeverity)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
          >
            {INCIDENT_SEVERITIES.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <label
            htmlFor="inc-status"
            className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
          >
            Status
          </label>
          <select
            id="inc-status"
            value={status}
            onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as IncidentStatus)}
            className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground w-full cursor-pointer rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
          >
            {INCIDENT_STATUSES.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label
          htmlFor="inc-description"
          className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase"
        >
          Description
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="inc-description"
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="e.g. Injured during handling, fever, etc..."
          className="border-border bg-card text-card-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 w-full resize-none rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!fowlId}
          className="flex-1 cursor-pointer rounded-xl bg-rose-600 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white transition-all hover:bg-rose-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          Record Incident
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/80 cursor-pointer rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-black transition-all"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// BIRD IDENTITY CARD
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function BirdIdentityCard({
  fowl,
  fowls,
  codes,
  matchHistory,
  setSelectedFowlForDetails,
}: {
  fowl: FowlRecord;
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  matchHistory: MatchRecord[];
  setSelectedFowlForDetails: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
}) {
  const code = codeOf(fowl, codes);
  const displayCode = formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code);
  const codeType = classifyBirdCode(code);
  const sireBreed = parentBreedOf(fowl.sire, fowls);
  const damBreed = parentBreedOf(fowl.dam, fowls);

  const matches = matchHistory.filter(
    (m) => m.entry_name?.toLowerCase() === fowl.name.toLowerCase(),
  );
  const wins = matches.filter((m) => m.outcome?.toLowerCase() === 'win').length;
  const losses = matches.filter((m) => m.outcome?.toLowerCase() === 'loss').length;
  const decided = wins + losses;
  const winRate = decided > 0 ? Math.round((wins / decided) * 100) : 0;

  const codeColorMap = {
    sire: {
      bg: 'bg-sky-100 dark:bg-sky-950/50',
      text: 'text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400',
      border: 'border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800',
      label: 'SIRE',
    },
    dam: {
      bg: 'bg-pink-100 dark:bg-pink-950/50',
      text: 'text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400',
      border: 'border-pink-200 dark:border-pink-800',
      label: 'DAM',
    },
    offspring: {
      bg: 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/50',
      text: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
      border: 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800',
      label: 'OFFSPRING',
    },
    custom: {
      bg: 'bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50',
      text: 'text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-400',
      border: 'border-violet-200 dark:border-violet-800',
      label: 'CUSTOM',
    },
  };
  const codeColor = codeColorMap[codeType];

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl)}
      className="group bg-card border-border w-full cursor-pointer rounded-2xl border p-4 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-md dark:hover:border-emerald-700"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <div
          className={`h-12 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-xl ${codeColor.bg} ${codeColor.border} flex flex-col items-center justify-center border`}
        >
          <span
            className={`text-xs font-black ${codeColor.text} leading-none tracking-widest uppercase`}
          >
            {codeColor.label}
          </span>
          <span className={`text-base font-black ${codeColor.text} mt-0.5 font-mono leading-none`}>
            {displayCode || '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs font-black group-hover:text-emerald-700 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400">
            {fowl.name}
          </p>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-xs font-semibold">
            {fowl.breed} · {sexLabel(fowl)}
          </p>
          {fowl.wing_band && (
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400">
              Wing Band: {fowl.wing_band}
            </p>
          )}
          {fowl.bloodline_composition && Object.keys(fowl.bloodline_composition).length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {Object.entries(fowl.bloodline_composition)
                .slice(0, 3)
                .map(([strain, pct]) => (
                  <span
                    key={strain}
                    className="rounded border border-teal-200 bg-teal-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-teal-700 dark:border-teal-800 dark:bg-teal-950/30 dark:text-teal-400"
                  >
                    {strain} {Math.round(pct as number)}%
                  </span>
                ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
          {decided > 0 ? (
            <span
              className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${winRate >= 50 ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400'}`}
            >
              {winRate}%
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50 text-xs font-bold">No fights</span>
          )}
          <p
            className={`mt-1 text-xs font-bold ${fowl.status === 'Active' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : fowl.status === 'Deceased' ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}
          >
            {fowl.status}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      {(fowl.sire || fowl.dam) && (
        <div className="border-border text-muted-foreground mt-2 flex items-center gap-3 border-t pt-2 text-xs font-semibold">
          {fowl.sire && (
            <span>
              🐓 Sire: <strong className="text-card-foreground">{fowl.sire}</strong>
              {sireBreed ? ` · ${sireBreed}` : ''}
            </span>
          )}
          {fowl.dam && (
            <span>
              🐔 Dam: <strong className="text-card-foreground">{fowl.dam}</strong>
              {damBreed ? ` · ${damBreed}` : ''}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MAIN COMPONENT
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type BreedingTab = 'coding' | 'pairs' | 'identity' | 'safety';

export default function BreedingHub({
  fowls,
  matchHistory,
  pairingAnalytics,
  setSelectedFowlForDetails,
}: BreedingHubProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useUrlTab<BreedingTab>({
    param: 'tab',
    values: BREEDING_TABS,
    defaultValue: 'coding',
  });
  const [breedingPairs, setBreedingPairs] = useState<BreedingPairRecord[]>([]);
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<SafetyIncidentRecord[]>([]);
  const [showAddPairing, setShowAddPairing] = useState(false);
  const [showAddIncident, setShowAddIncident] = useState(false);
  const [identitySearch, setIdentitySearch] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('');
  const [_saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const codes = useMemo(() => resolveBirdCodes(fowls), [fowls]);

  const loadRecords = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const [pairsResult, incidentsResult] = await Promise.all([
      fetchBreedingPairings(),
      fetchSafetyIncidents(),
    ]);
    setBreedingPairs(pairsResult.data);
    setIncidents(sortIncidents(incidentsResult.data));
    setLoadError(pairsResult.error || incidentsResult.error || '');
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRecords();
  }, [loadRecords]);

  const activePairs = useMemo(
    () => breedingPairs.filter((p) => p.outcome === 'Active').length,
    [breedingPairs],
  );

  const criticalIncidents = useMemo(() => countUrgentIncidents(incidents), [incidents]);

  const filteredFowls = useMemo(() => {
    if (!identitySearch.trim()) return fowls;
    const q = identitySearch.toLowerCase();
    return fowls.filter((f) => {
      const code = codeOf(f, codes).toLowerCase();
      return (
        f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        code.includes(q) ||
        (f.breed || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (f.wing_band || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [fowls, codes, identitySearch]);

  const addPair = useCallback(
    async (payload: Partial<BreedingPairRecord>) => {
      const conflict = pairingConflict(
        breedingPairs,
        fowls.find((f) => f.id === payload.sire_id),
        fowls.find((f) => f.id === payload.dam_id),
      );

      if (conflict?.kind === 'occupied') {
        showToastMessage(
          `${conflict.bird === 'sire' ? 'Sire' : 'Dam'} already has an Active partner (${conflict.partnerName}). End that pairing first.`,
          'error',
        );
        return;
      }

      // Same couple already on file: update that row instead of inserting a duplicate.
      if (conflict?.kind === 'couple') {
        const nextOutcome = (payload.outcome as PairingOutcome) || 'Active';
        if (conflict.pairing.outcome === nextOutcome) {
          setShowAddPairing(false);
          showToastMessage(
            `This pairing is already recorded as ${nextOutcome} (${conflict.pairing.pairing_code || `#${conflict.pairing.id}`}).`,
            'error',
          );
          return;
        }
        setSaving(true);
        const { record, error } = await updateBreedingPairingOutcome(
          conflict.pairing.id,
          nextOutcome,
        );
        setSaving(false);
        if (error || !record) {
          showToastMessage(`Failed to update pairing: ${error || 'no record returned'}`, 'error');
          return;
        }
        setBreedingPairs((prev) => prev.map((p) => (p.id === record.id ? record : p)));
        setShowAddPairing(false);
        showToastMessage(
          `Pairing ${record.sire_name} × ${record.dam_name} set to ${nextOutcome}.`,
          'success',
        );
        return;
      }

      setSaving(true);
      const { record, error } = await insertBreedingPairing(payload);
      setSaving(false);
      if (error || !record) {
        showToastMessage(`Failed to save pairing: ${error || 'no record returned'}`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      setBreedingPairs((prev) => [record, ...prev]);
      setShowAddPairing(false);
      showToastMessage(`${record.sire_name} × ${record.dam_name} pairing recorded.`, 'success');
    },
    [breedingPairs, fowls],
  );

  const changePairOutcome = useCallback(
    async (id: number, outcome: PairingOutcome) => {
      const previous = breedingPairs;
      setBreedingPairs((prev) => prev.map((p) => (p.id === id ? { ...p, outcome } : p)));
      const { record, error } = await updateBreedingPairingOutcome(id, outcome);
      if (error || !record) {
        setBreedingPairs(previous);
        showToastMessage(
          `Failed to update pairing status: ${error || 'no record returned'}`,
          'error',
        );
        return;
      }
      showToastMessage(`Pairing status set to ${outcome}.`, 'success');
    },
    [breedingPairs],
  );

  const addIncident = useCallback(async (payload: Partial<SafetyIncidentRecord>) => {
    setSaving(true);
    const { record, error } = await insertSafetyIncident(payload);
    setSaving(false);
    if (error || !record) {
      showToastMessage(`Failed to save incident: ${error || 'no record returned'}`, 'error');
      return;
    }
    setIncidents((prev) => sortIncidents([record, ...prev]));
    setShowAddIncident(false);
    showToastMessage(`Safety incident recorded for ${record.fowl_name}.`, 'success');
  }, []);

  const removePair = useCallback(
    async (id: number) => {
      const previous = breedingPairs;
      setBreedingPairs((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
      const { error } = await deleteBreedingPairing(id);
      if (error) {
        setBreedingPairs(previous);
        showToastMessage(`Failed to delete pairing: ${error}`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      showToastMessage('Pairing removed from history.', 'success');
    },
    [breedingPairs],
  );

  const removeIncident = useCallback(
    async (id: number) => {
      const previous = incidents;
      setIncidents((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.id !== id));
      const { error } = await deleteSafetyIncident(id);
      if (error) {
        setIncidents(previous);
        showToastMessage(`Failed to delete incident: ${error}`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      showToastMessage('Safety incident deleted.', 'success');
    },
    [incidents],
  );

  /** Save an auto-detected sire × dam combination into the pairing history. */
  const _recordDetectedPairing = useCallback(
    async (ps: PairingStats) => {
      const sireFowl = fowls.find((f) => f.name === ps.sire);
      const damFowl = fowls.find((f) => f.name === ps.dam);
      setSaving(true);
      const { record, error } = await insertBreedingPairing({
        sire_id: sireFowl?.id ?? null,
        dam_id: damFowl?.id ?? null,
        sire_name: ps.sire,
        dam_name: ps.dam,
        sire_code: sireFowl ? codeOf(sireFowl, codes) || null : null,
        dam_code: damFowl ? codeOf(damFowl, codes) || null : null,
        pairing_code: pairingCodeFor(
          sireFowl ? codeOf(sireFowl, codes) : '',
          damFowl ? codeOf(damFowl, codes) : '',
        ),
        pairing_date: null,
        notes: `Auto-detected from ${ps.members.length} registered offspring.`,
        outcome: 'Active',
      });
      setSaving(false);
      if (error || !record) {
        showToastMessage(`Failed to save pairing: ${error || 'no record returned'}`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      setBreedingPairs((prev) => [record, ...prev]);
      showToastMessage(`${ps.sire} × ${ps.dam} added to pairing history.`, 'success');
    },
    [fowls, codes],
  );

  const totalMales = fowls.filter(isSireGender).length;
  const totalFemales = fowls.length - totalMales;
  const totalOffspring = fowls.filter(
    (f) => classifyBirdCode(codeOf(f, codes)) === 'offspring',
  ).length;

  const TABS = [
    {
      id: 'coding' as BreedingTab,
      label: 'Coding System',
      icon: Hash,
      activeClass: 'bg-violet-600',
    },
    {
      id: 'pairs' as BreedingTab,
      label: 'Breeding Pairs',
      icon: Heart,
      activeClass: 'bg-rose-600',
    },
    {
      id: 'identity' as BreedingTab,
      label: 'Chicken Identity',
      icon: Eye,
      activeClass: 'bg-emerald-600',
    },
    {
      id: 'safety' as BreedingTab,
      label: 'Safety Incidents',
      icon: Shield,
      activeClass: 'bg-amber-600',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="bg-card border-border rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-7">
        <div className="mb-5 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-4">
            <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-violet-500/30 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-500/20 to-emerald-500/20">
              <Dna className="h-6 w-6 text-violet-500" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-card-foreground text-xl font-black tracking-tight sm:text-2xl">
                Breeding &amp; Lineage Hub
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 text-xs font-semibold sm:text-sm">
                Coding system, pairing history, bloodline monitoring, and safety incidents
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary stats */}
        <div className="mb-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          {[
            {
              label: 'Breeding Males',
              value: totalMales,
              color: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400',
              icon: '🐓',
              sub: 'Coded: 1, 2, 3...',
            },
            {
              label: 'Breeding Females',
              value: totalFemales,
              color: 'text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400',
              icon: '🐔',
              sub: 'Coded: A, B, C...',
            },
            {
              label: ROLE_LABEL['Non-Breeding'],
              value: totalOffspring,
              color: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
              icon: '🐥',
              sub: 'Coded: 1A₁, 1A₂...',
            },
            {
              label: 'Active Pairs',
              value: activePairs,
              color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
              icon: '❤️',
              sub: 'Breeding pairs',
            },
          ].map((s) => (
            <div key={s.label} className="bg-muted/40 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-4">
              <span className="shrink-0 text-2xl">{s.icon}</span>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className={`text-2xl font-black ${s.color} leading-none`}>{s.value}</p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 text-xs font-bold tracking-wide uppercase">
                  {s.label}
                </p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">{s.sub}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div
          role="tablist"
          aria-label="Breeding Hub Navigation"
          className="bg-muted/60 border-border flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded-2xl border p-1.5"
        >
          {TABS.map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                id={`breeding-tab-${tab.id}`}
                aria-selected={isActive}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isActive
                    ? `${tab.activeClass} text-white shadow-sm`
                    : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/80'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {tab.label}
                {tab.id === 'safety' && criticalIncidents > 0 && (
                  <span
                    className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${isActive ? 'bg-white/20' : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400'}`}
                  >
                    {criticalIncidents}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Load status */}
      {loading && (
        <div className="bg-card border-border flex items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-3xl border p-8 shadow-sm">
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-emerald-600" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
            Loading pairing history and safety records...
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && loadError && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/30">
          <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-amber-700 uppercase dark:text-amber-400">
              Unable to Load Breeding Records
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 text-xs font-semibold break-words">
              {loadError}
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-xs font-semibold">
              Run the migration first in the Supabase SQL editor{' '}
              <span className="text-card-foreground font-mono">
                20261004000000_breeding_pairings_safety_incidents.sql
              </span>
              .
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadRecords}
            className="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black text-amber-700 hover:underline dark:text-amber-400"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3" />
            Retry
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── CODING SYSTEM TAB ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {!loading && activeTab === 'coding' && (
        <section className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/50 dark:text-violet-400">
              <Hash className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-card-foreground text-base font-black">
                Coding System for Lineage
              </h2>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
                Standardized tagging to track every chicken and its family lineage
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <CodingSystemExplainer fowls={fowls} codes={codes} />

          {pairingAnalytics.ranked.length > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-card border-border overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border shadow-sm">
              <div className="border-border flex items-center gap-3 border-b px-6 pt-6 pb-4">
                <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-100 dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/50">
                  <BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">
                    Pairing Performance Analysis
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                    Best and worst combinations based on offspring win rate
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-3 p-6">
                {pairingAnalytics.ranked.slice(0, 8).map((ps, i) => {
                  const isElite = ps.decided >= 3 && ps.winRate >= 70;
                  const isWeak = ps.decided >= 3 && ps.winRate < 50;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={ps.key}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 ${
                        isElite
                          ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/30'
                          : isWeak
                            ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/30'
                            : 'bg-muted/30 border-border'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground/40 w-4 shrink-0 text-xs font-black">
                          #{i + 1}
                        </span>
                        {isElite && <Trophy className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-amber-500" />}
                        {isWeak && <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-rose-500" />}
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-card-foreground text-xs font-black">
                            <span className="text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{ps.sire}</span>
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1.5">×</span>
                            <span className="text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">{ps.dam}</span>
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                            {ps.members.length} offspring · {ps.totalFights} fights
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                        {ps.decided > 0 && (
                          <span
                            className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${ps.winRate >= 50 ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400'}`}
                          >
                            {ps.winRate}%
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
                          {ps.wins}W-{ps.losses}L
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {/* ── BREEDING PAIRS TAB ────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'pairs' && (
        <section className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400">
                <Heart className="h-5 w-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-card-foreground text-base font-black">Breeding Pairs</h2>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">
                  Record and monitor every pairing and the performance of their offspring
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              id="add-breeding-pair-btn"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAddPairing(true)}
              className="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white shadow-sm transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              New Pairing
            </button>
          </div>

          {showAddPairing && (
            <AddPairingForm
              fowls={fowls}
              codes={codes}
              pairs={breedingPairs}
              onAdd={addPair}
              onCancel={() => setShowAddPairing(false)}
            />
          )}

          {breedingPairs.length === 0 && !showAddPairing ? (
            <div className="bg-card border-border space-y-3 rounded-3xl border p-10 text-center shadow-sm">
              <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-100 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50">
                <Heart className="h-7 w-7 text-rose-500" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">No Breeding Pairs Yet</p>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground mx-auto mt-1 max-w-xs text-xs font-semibold">
                  Record breeding pairs to monitor pairing history and offspring performance.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowAddPairing(true)}
                className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Record a Pairing
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              {breedingPairs.map((pair) => (
                <BreedingPairCard
                  key={pair.id}
                  pair={pair}
                  fowls={fowls}
                  codes={codes}
                  matchHistory={matchHistory}
                  onRemove={() => removePair(pair.id)}
                  onOutcomeChange={(outcome) => changePairOutcome(pair.id, outcome)}
                  setSelectedFowlForDetails={setSelectedFowlForDetails}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {pairingAnalytics.ranked.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-3xl border border-sky-200/50 bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-50 to-violet-50 p-5 sm:p-6 dark:border-sky-800/50 dark:from-sky-950/20 dark:to-violet-950/20">
              <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-sky-600">
                  <Info className="h-5 w-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-card-foreground text-sm font-black">
                    Auto-Detected Pairings
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                    Based on sire/dam records of chickens in the registry
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {pairingAnalytics.ranked.slice(0, 5).map((ps) => (
                  <div
                    key={ps.key}
                    className="bg-card/60 border-border flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-card-foreground text-xs font-black">
                        <span className="text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{ps.sire}</span>

                      </p>
                      <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                        {ps.members.length} offspring · {ps.totalFights} recorded fights
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    {ps.decided > 0 && (
                      <span
                        className={`shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black ${ps.winRate >= 50 ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-400'}`}
                      >
                        {ps.winRate}% win rate
                      </span>

                  </div>

              </div>
            </div>

        </section>
      )}

      {/* ── BIRD IDENTITY TAB ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {activeTab === 'identity' && (

                health history can be traced within the family lineage.
              </p>
