import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import LandingPage from '@/app/page';
import LandingNavbar from './Navbar';

  useTheme: () => ({ resolvedTheme: 'dark', setTheme: vi.fn() }),

      username: '',

      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: /Review Performance & Insights/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe('Hero Preview Card Generic Sample Data', () => {

      // Badge
      expect(screen.getByText(/Sample Data/i)).toBeInTheDocument();

      expect(screen.getByText(/Sample Rooster/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/Sample Sire/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/Sample Dam/i)).toBeInTheDocument();

  describe('Logged-In CTA Adaptation', () => {

        username: 'breeder@example.com',

    it('adapts Navbar CTA to Open Dashboard for authenticated users', () => {

      expect(dashboardLinks[0]).toHaveAttribute('href', '/dashboard');
      expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /^Sign up$/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('adapts HeroSection CTA to Open Dashboard for authenticated users', () => {
      render(<HeroSection />);

      const dashboardLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Open Dashboard/i });
      expect(dashboardLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/dashboard');
      expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Get Started/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('adapts CtaSection CTA to Open Dashboard for authenticated users', () => {
      render(<CtaSection />);

      const dashboardLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Open Dashboard/i });
      expect(dashboardLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/dashboard');
      expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Create an Account/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe('Content Rules & Verification Safeguards', () => {
    it('does not display unverified claims or hardcoded stats from the old login panel', () => {
      const { container } = render(<LandingPage />);

      // Must NOT contain hardcoded "32+ chickens", "4+ active farms", or "100% open source"
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/32\+\s*chickens/i);
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/4\+\s*active farms/i);
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/100%\s*open source/i);

      // Must NOT contain exaggerated unsupported claims
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/unalterable generational records/i);
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/indisputable, digitized pedigree database/i);
      // Must NOT contain old CICT acronym
      expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(/\bCICT\b/);
    });
  });
});

'use client';
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
import { Sun, Moon, Menu, X, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/contexts/auth-context';
import { CompactLanguageSwitcher } from '@/components/i18n/LanguageSwitcher';

export default function LandingNavbar() {
  const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);

    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

    const sectionIds = ['features', 'how-it-works', 'about'];
    const elements = sectionIds
      .map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
      .filter((el): el is HTMLElement => el !== null);

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            setActiveSection(entry.target.id);
          }
        });
      },
      {
        rootMargin: '-20% 0px -60% 0px',
        threshold: 0,
      },
    );

    elements.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const isLoggedIn = !!auth.currentUserId;

  return (
    <header className="border-border/80 bg-background/85 sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b backdrop-blur-md transition-colors">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-2 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        {/* Brand Logo */}
        <Link href="/" className="group flex min-w-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-colors group-hover:bg-emerald-500">
            <svg
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
              width="20"
              height="20"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2.2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            >
              <path d="M12 1.8 20.5 5v6c0 5.2-3.5 8.5-8.5 11.2C7 19.5 3.5 16.2 3.5 11V5L12 1.8z" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="flex hidden items-baseline gap-2 sm:flex">
            <span className="text-foreground text-xl font-black tracking-tight">
              GALLO<span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">TRACK</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground hidden font-mono text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase sm:inline">
              v1.0.0
            </span>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop Navigation Links with Active Scroll Indicator */}
        <nav
          aria-label="Main Navigation"
          className="hidden items-center gap-8 text-sm font-bold md:flex"
        >
          <a
            href="#features"
            className={`relative py-1 transition-colors ${
              activeSection === 'features'
                ? 'font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
            }`}
          >
            Features
            {activeSection === 'features' && (
              <span className="absolute right-0 bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />
            )}
          </a>
          <a
            href="#how-it-works"
            className={`relative py-1 transition-colors ${
              activeSection === 'how-it-works'
                ? 'font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
            }`}
          >
            How it works
            {activeSection === 'how-it-works' && (
              <span className="absolute right-0 bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />
            )}
          </a>
          <a
            href="#about"
            className={`relative py-1 transition-colors ${
              activeSection === 'about'
                ? 'font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
            }`}
          >
            About
            {activeSection === 'about' && (
              <span className="absolute right-0 bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-400" />
            )}
          </a>
        </nav>

        {/* Desktop Action Area */}
        <div className="hidden items-center gap-3 md:flex">
          <CompactLanguageSwitcher />
          {mounted && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTheme(resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}
              aria-label={resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode'}
              title={resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode'}
              className="border-border bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground flex h-9 w-9 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-lg border transition-colors"
            >
              {resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? (
                <Sun className="h-4 w-4" />
              ) : (
                <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
            </button>
          )}

          {isLoggedIn ? (
            <Link
              href="/dashboard"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
            >
              <span>Open Dashboard</span>
              <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Link
                href="/login"
                className="text-foreground hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors"
              >
                Log in
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/register"
                className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
              >
                Sign up
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Mobile Hamburger & Theme Toggle */}
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 md:hidden">
          <CompactLanguageSwitcher />
          {mounted && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTheme(resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}
              aria-label="Toggle theme"
              className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground rounded-lg p-1.5 sm:p-2"
            >
              {resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? (
                <Sun className="h-4 w-4" />
              ) : (
                <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
            aria-label={mobileMenuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground rounded-lg p-1.5 focus:outline-none sm:p-2"
          >
            {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="h-6 w-6" /> : <Menu className="h-6 w-6" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Drawer Menu */}
      {mobileMenuOpen && (
        <div className="border-border bg-card animate-in slide-in-from-top space-y-4 border-b px-4 pt-3 pb-6 duration-200 md:hidden">
          <nav aria-label="Mobile Navigation" className="flex flex-col space-y-2 text-sm font-bold">
            <a
              href="#features"
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
              className={`rounded-md px-3 py-2 transition-colors ${
                activeSection === 'features'
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  : 'hover:bg-muted text-foreground'
              }`}
            >
              Features
            </a>
            <a
              href="#how-it-works"
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
              className={`rounded-md px-3 py-2 transition-colors ${

              }`}
            >
              About
            </a>
          </nav>

            {isLoggedIn ? (

                href="/dashboard"
                onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-extrabold text-white"
              >
                <span>Open Dashboard</span>
                <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Link
                  href="/login"
                  onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                  className="border-border text-foreground hover:bg-muted w-full rounded-lg border py-2.5 text-center text-sm font-bold"

                >
                  Sign up
                </Link>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import type { FowlRecord, MatchRecord } from '@/lib/types';
import LineageFlow from './LineageFlow';
import type { LineageDirection } from '@/lib/lineage-graph';

const bird = (partial: Partial<FowlRecord> & { id: number; name: string }): FowlRecord =>
  ({
    breed: 'Kelso',
    gender: 'Rooster',
    sire: '',
    dam: '',
    bird_code: '',
    bloodline_pct: 100,
    status: 'Active',
    ...partial,
  }) as FowlRecord;

const family: FowlRecord[] = [
  bird({ id: 1, name: 'Sire 1', gender: 'Rooster', bird_code: '1' }),
  bird({ id: 2, name: 'Dam A', gender: 'Hen', bird_code: 'A' }),
  bird({ id: 3, name: 'Offspring 1A1', gender: 'Rooster', sire: 'Sire 1', dam: 'Dam A', bird_code: '1A1' }),
  bird({ id: 4, name: 'Offspring 1A2', gender: 'Hen', sire: 'Sire 1', dam: 'Dam A', bird_code: '1A2' }),
  bird({ id: 5, name: 'Offspring 1A3', gender: 'Hen', sire: 'Sire 1', dam: 'Dam A', bird_code: '1A3' }),
  bird({ id: 6, name: 'Dam C', gender: 'Hen', bird_code: 'C' }),
  bird({ id: 7, name: 'Grandchild', gender: 'Rooster', sire: 'Offspring 1A1', dam: 'Dam C', bird_code: '1A1C1' }),
];

const match = (id: number, fowlId: number, entryName: string, outcome: 'Win' | 'Loss'): MatchRecord => ({
  id,
  fowl_id: fowlId,
  date: '2026-10-01',
  entry_name: entryName,
  breed: 'Kelso',
  opponent: 'Opponent',
  location: 'Arena',
  type: 'Derby',
  outcome,
  status: 'Verified',
});

interface HarnessProps {
  fowls?: FowlRecord[];
  matchHistory?: MatchRecord[];
  initialRoot?: string;
  initialDirection?: LineageDirection;
  query?: string;
  onPick?: (fowl: FowlRecord) => void;
  onShowFights?: (fowl: FowlRecord) => void;
  onOpenAsSire?: (fowl: FowlRecord) => void;
  onOpenAsDam?: (fowl: FowlRecord) => void;
}

function Harness({
  fowls = family,
  matchHistory = [],
  initialRoot,
  initialDirection = 'down',
  query = '',
  onPick = vi.fn(),
  onShowFights = vi.fn(),
  onOpenAsSire,
  onOpenAsDam,
}: HarnessProps) {
  const [rootName, setRootName] = useState<string | null>(initialRoot ?? null);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<LineageDirection>(initialDirection);
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  return (
    <LineageFlow
      fowls={fowls}
      codes={new Map()}
      matchHistory={matchHistory}
      query={query}
      rootName={rootName}
      onRootChange={setRootName}
      direction={direction}
      onDirectionChange={setDirection}
      collapsedNodes={collapsed}
      onToggleCollapsed={(id) =>
        setCollapsed((prev) => {
          const next = new Set(prev);
          if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
          else next.add(id);
          return next;
        })
      }
      onExpandAll={() => setCollapsed(new Set())}
      onCollapseAll={() => setCollapsed(new Set(['1', '3']))}
      onPick={onPick}
      onShowFights={onShowFights}
      onOpenAsSire={onOpenAsSire}
      onOpenAsDam={onOpenAsDam}
    />
  );
}

const cardFor = (name: string): HTMLElement => {
  const card = screen
    .getAllByTestId('lineage-bird-card')
    .find((el) => el.textContent?.includes(name));
  if (!card) throw new Error(`No bird card for ${name}`);
  return card;
};

describe('LineageFlow pedigree canvas', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
  });

  it('renders a layered pedigree with generation labels, bird cards and a pair hub', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    expect(screen.getByRole('region', { name: 'Pedigree canvas' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Generation 1 · Root')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Generation 2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Generation 3')).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(cardFor('Sire 1')).toHaveTextContent('Cock');
    expect(cardFor('Dam A')).toHaveTextContent('Hen');
    expect(cardFor('Offspring 1A1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(cardFor('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(
      screen.getByRole('button', {
        name: 'Breeding pair Sire 1 × Dam A, 3 offspring',
      })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows bird details, parents, offspring and record actions', () => {
    const onPick = vi.fn();
    const onShowFights = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onPick={onPick} onShowFights={onShowFights} matchHistory={[match(1, 3, 'Offspring 1A1', 'Win')]} />);

    fireEvent.click(cardFor('Offspring 1A1'));
    const details = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    expect(within(details).getByText('Offspring 1A1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText('Sire')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText('Dam')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByTitle('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText(/1W-0L/)).toBeInTheDocument();

    fireEvent.click(within(details).getByRole('button', { name: /View profile/i }));
    expect(onPick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Offspring 1A1' }));

    fireEvent.click(within(details).getByRole('button', { name: /Fight history/i }));
    expect(onShowFights).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Offspring 1A1' }));
  });

  it('collapses and expands a branch without duplicating nodes', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    expect(cardFor('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Collapse branch of Sire 1' }));

    expect(screen.queryAllByTestId('lineage-bird-card').some((el) => el.textContent?.includes('Grandchild'))).toBe(false);
    const expand = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Expand branch of Sire 1/ });
    expect(expand).toBeInTheDocument();

    fireEvent.click(expand);
    expect(cardFor('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getAllByTestId('lineage-bird-card')).toHaveLength(new Set(family.map((f) => f.id)).size);
  });

  it('reveals deeper generations from the depth control and the hidden-relative badge', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('Generation depth'), { target: { value: '2' } });
    expect(screen.queryAllByTestId('lineage-bird-card').some((el) => el.textContent?.includes('Grandchild'))).toBe(false);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Show 1 more relatives of Offspring 1A1/i }));
    expect(cardFor('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('walks ancestors above the selected bird', () => {
    render(<Harness initialRoot="Grandchild" />);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Ancestors' }));

    expect(cardFor('Grandchild')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(cardFor('Offspring 1A1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(cardFor('Dam C')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(cardFor('Sire 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Generation 3 · Root')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('finds a bird and re-roots the canvas, with a no-match state', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    const finder = screen.getByLabelText('Find a bird');
    fireEvent.change(finder, { target: { value: 'Grandchild' } });
    fireEvent.keyDown(finder, { key: 'Enter' });

    const rootCard = cardFor('Grandchild');
    expect(rootCard).toHaveTextContent('Root');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('lineage-details')).toHaveTextContent('Grandchild');

    fireEvent.change(finder, { target: { value: 'zzz' } });
    expect(screen.getByText('No birds match.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('surfaces global search matches and can focus the first one', () => {
    render(<Harness query="Grandchild" />);

    expect(screen.getByText(/1 match for/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Focus first/i }));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('lineage-details')).toHaveTextContent('Grandchild');
  });

  it('shows pair details with Sire and Dam role boxes and every offspring', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    fireEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Breeding pair Sire 1 × Dam A, 3 offspring' })
    );
    const details = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    expect(within(details).getByText('Sire')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText('Dam')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getAllByText('Offspring 1A1').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(within(details).getByText('Offspring 1A2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText('Offspring 1A3')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('zooms, resets and toggles the expanded canvas', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    expect(screen.getByText('100%')).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Zoom in'));
    expect(screen.queryByText('100%')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Reset view'));
    expect(screen.getByText('100%')).toBeInTheDocument();

    const expand = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Expand canvas' });
    fireEvent.click(expand);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Exit expanded canvas' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.keyDown(window, { key: 'Escape' });
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Expand canvas' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('never fabricates a parent that is not registered', () => {
    const fowls: FowlRecord[] = [
      bird({ id: 10, name: 'External Sire' }),
      bird({ id: 11, name: 'Registered Dam', gender: 'Hen' }),
      bird({ id: 12, name: 'Single Parent Child', sire: 'Not In Registry', dam: 'Registered Dam' }),
    ];
    render(<Harness fowls={fowls} initialRoot="Registered Dam" />);

    expect(cardFor('Registered Dam')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(cardFor('Single Parent Child')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryAllByTestId('lineage-bird-card').some((el) => el.textContent?.includes('Not In Registry'))).toBe(false);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('lineage-pair-hub')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    fireEvent.click(cardFor('Single Parent Child'));
    const details = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    expect(within(details).getByText(/Not In Registry \(not registered\)/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(details).getByText('Registered Dam')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('highlights one sex without hiding the relationship context', () => {
    render(<Harness />);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hens' }));
    expect(cardFor('Dam A').className).not.toMatch(/opacity-40/);
    expect(cardFor('Sire 1').className).toMatch(/opacity-40/);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cocks' }));
    expect(cardFor('Sire 1').className).not.toMatch(/opacity-40/);
    expect(cardFor('Dam A').className).toMatch(/opacity-40/);

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'All' }));
    expect(cardFor('Sire 1').className).not.toMatch(/opacity-40/);
    expect(cardFor('Dam A').className).not.toMatch(/opacity-40/);
  });

  it('hides hen fight records and actions while cocks keep "No fights" and Fights', () => {
    const matches = [match(10, 4, 'Offspring 1A2', 'Win')];
    render(<Harness matchHistory={matches} />);

    const henCard = cardFor('Offspring 1A2');
    expect(henCard.textContent).not.toMatch(/No fights|\dW-\dL/);

    fireEvent.click(henCard);
    const henDetails = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    expect(within(henDetails).queryByText('Record')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(henDetails).queryByRole('button', { name: /Fight history/i })
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    // A cock with zero fights keeps both the record and the action.
    fireEvent.click(cardFor('Offspring 1A1'));
    const cockDetails = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    expect(within(cockDetails).getByText('Record')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(cockDetails).getByText('No fights')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(cockDetails).getByRole('button', { name: /Fight history/i })
    ).toBeInTheDocument();

    // Pair panel: hen row has no record, and her win never enters the pair total.
    fireEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Breeding pair Sire 1 × Dam A, 3 offspring' })
    );
    const pairDetails = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    const henRow = within(pairDetails).getByRole('button', { name: /Offspring 1A2/ });
    expect(henRow.textContent).not.toMatch(/No fights|\dW-\dL/);
    const cockRow = within(pairDetails).getByRole('button', { name: /Offspring 1A1/ });
    expect(cockRow).toHaveTextContent('No fights');
    expect(pairDetails).toHaveTextContent('0 of 1 cocks fought');
  });

  it('offers parent-role navigation only when the bird is a parent', () => {
    const onOpenAsSire = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onOpenAsSire={onOpenAsSire} />);

    fireEvent.click(cardFor('Offspring 1A1'));
    const details = screen.getByTestId('lineage-details');
    fireEvent.click(within(details).getByRole('button', { name: 'Sire tree' }));
    expect(onOpenAsSire).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Offspring 1A1' }));

    expect(within(details).queryByRole('button', { name: 'Dam tree' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
