'use client';

import React from 'react';
import WinRatePill from '@/components/match/WinRatePill';
import { canFight } from '@/lib/helpers';
import type { FowlRecord } from '@/lib/types';
import type { WinRateStats } from '@/lib/win-rate';

type Props = {
  fowl?: FowlRecord | null;
  stats?: WinRateStats | null;
  className?: string;
};

/**
 * Lifetime fight record shown in the Match Logs table.
 *
 * Uses the same stats object (`buildChickenMatchStatsMap`) and the same
 * `WinRatePill` renderer as the Lineage Directory, so the percentage, W-L-D
 * and LOW SAMPLE / 1 MATCH badge can never drift between the two views.
 * Only fighting birds (cocks/stags) get a record; hens always return null.
 */
export default function MatchLogsRecordBadge({ fowl, stats, className = '' }: Props) {
  if (!fowl || !stats || !canFight(fowl)) return null;

  return (
    <span className={className} data-testid={`match-record-${fowl.id}`}>
      <WinRatePill stats={stats} />
    </span>
  );
}

  return (text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function matchLogRecordText(id: number): string {
  const badges = screen.getAllByTestId(`match-record-${id}`);
  return normalize(badges[0].textContent);
}

describe('Match Logs records match the Lineage Directory', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();

    mockFowlContext.matchHistory = matches;
    nextMatchId = 1;

  it('shows the same lifetime record in both views for every fighting chicken', () => {
    // 1. Read the badge rendered by the Match Logs table.
    mockFowlContext.fowls = fowls;
    mockFowlContext.matchHistory = matches;
    render(
      <UIProvider theme="light" setTheme={() => {}}>
        <MatchLogsTable matches={matches} />
      </UIProvider>,
    );

    const matchLogRecords = new Map<number, string>();
    maleCases.forEach((fowl) => {
      matchLogRecords.set(fowl.id, matchLogRecordText(fowl.id));
    });
    expect(screen.queryAllByTestId(`match-record-${hen.id}`)).toHaveLength(0);
    cleanup();

    // 2. Read the same chicken's badge in the Lineage Directory's Sire tab.
    render(
      <UIProvider theme="light" setTheme={() => {}}>
        <LineageDirectory
          fowls={fowls}
          matchHistory={matches}
          pairingAnalytics={{ all: new Map<string, PairingStats>(), ranked: [] }}
          setSelectedFowlForDetails={vi.fn()}
        />
      </UIProvider>,
    );

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Sire Offspring Tree/i }));
    const sireRegion = screen.getByRole('region', { name: /Sire X details/i });
    const sireTable = within(sireRegion).getByRole('table');

    maleCases.forEach((fowl) => {
      const row = within(sireTable).getByText(fowl.name).closest('tr');
      expect(row).not.toBeNull();
      const lineagePill = within(row as HTMLElement).getByTitle(/win rate|No decisions yet/i);
      expect(matchLogRecords.get(fowl.id)).toBe(normalize(lineagePill.textContent));
    });

    // 3. A hen with match rows never gets a record in either view.
    const henRow = within(sireTable).getByText(hen.name).closest('tr');
    expect(henRow).not.toBeNull();
    expect(within(henRow as HTMLElement).queryByTitle(/win rate|No decisions yet/i)).toBeNull();
    expect(henRow).toHaveTextContent('—');
  });

  it('covers wins, losses, draws, mixed records, deep history and low samples', () => {
    render(
      <UIProvider theme="light" setTheme={() => {}}>
        <MatchLogsTable matches={matches} />
      </UIProvider>,
    );

    expect(matchLogRecordText(allWins.id)).toMatch(/100% · 3W-0L/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(allLosses.id)).toMatch(/0% · 0W-3L/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(drawsOnly.id)).toMatch(/—% · 0W-0L-2D/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(drawsOnly.id)).not.toMatch(/\b0%/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(mixed.id)).toMatch(/67% · 2W-1L-1D/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(deepRecord.id)).toMatch(/92% · 11W-1L/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(lowSample.id)).toMatch(/100% · 2W-0L/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(lowSample.id)).toMatch(/low sample/i);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(oneMatch.id)).toMatch(/100% · 1W-0L/);
    expect(matchLogRecordText(oneMatch.id)).toMatch(/1 match/i);
    expect(screen.queryAllByTestId(`match-record-${hen.id}`)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

'use client';
import React from 'react';
import ChickenIcon from '@/components/ChickenIcon';
import MatchLogsRecordBadge from '@/components/match/MatchLogsRecordBadge';
import MatchMediaButtons from '@/components/match/MatchMediaButtons';
import MatchRecordForm from '@/components/match/MatchRecordForm';
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui';
import { formatBirdCodeForDisplay } from '@/lib/bird-code';
import { useFowl } from '@/lib/contexts/fowl-context';
import { useUI } from '@/lib/contexts/ui-context';
import { useT } from '@/lib/i18n';
import { photosFor, postersFor, videosFor } from '@/lib/services/media-service';
import { toastMessage } from '@/lib/toast-bus';
import type { FowlRecord, MatchRecord } from '@/lib/types';
import { buildChickenMatchStatsMap } from '@/lib/win-rate';

type Props = {
  /** Rows to render — defaults to the full match history from context. */
  matches?: MatchRecord[];
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Page the user came from; used by row click, Edit, Save, and Cancel. */
  returnTo?: string;
};

/**
 * Shared "Historical Analytics Match Logs" table used by the Dashboard and the
 * Chicken Registry (Record Match tab), so both show identical columns,
 * identifier chips, and media buttons.
 */
export default function MatchLogsTable({
  matches,
  emptyText = 'No data available',
  returnTo = '/dashboard',
}: Props) {
  const t = useT();
  const ui = useUI();
  const { fowls, matchHistory, matchMedia, birdCodes } = useFowl();
  const rows = matches ?? matchHistory;
  const [editingMatch, setEditingMatch] = React.useState<MatchRecord | null>(null);

  const fowlById = React.useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<number, FowlRecord>();
    fowls.forEach((f) => m.set(f.id, f));
    return m;
  }, [fowls]);

  // Lifetime records come from ALL matches, never from the (possibly filtered)
  // rows passed to this table.
  const matchStats = React.useMemo(
    () => buildChickenMatchStatsMap(matchHistory, fowls),
    [matchHistory, fowls],
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className="max-w-full min-w-0 overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] table-fixed border-collapse text-left text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground border-border border-b font-extrabold uppercase">
            <th className="w-[9%] p-2.5 pl-3 lg:p-3 lg:pl-4">Match Date</th>
            <th className="w-[24%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Chicken Identifier</th>
            <th className="w-[17%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Opponent</th>
            <th className="w-[13%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Arena Location</th>
            <th className="w-[9%] p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">Outcome</th>
            <th className="w-[13%] p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">Post-Fight Condition</th>
            <th className="bg-card sticky right-0 w-[15%] min-w-[160px] p-2.5 text-center lg:min-w-[120px] lg:p-2">
              Media &amp; Actions
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-border text-muted-foreground divide-y font-semibold">
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <tr>
              <td
                colSpan={7}
                className="text-muted-foreground p-8 text-center text-sm font-semibold"
              >
                {emptyText}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ) : (
            rows.map((log) => {
              const fowl =
                log.fowl_id != null ? fowlById.get(log.fowl_id) ?? null : null;
              const code = fowl ? birdCodes.get(String(fowl.id)) : '';
              const hatch = fowl?.birthdate;
              const isOrphan = !fowl;
              const recordStats = fowl
                ? matchStats.get(fowl.name.trim().toLowerCase())
                : undefined;
              const openFowlInfo = fowl
                ? (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl);
                  }
                : undefined;
              const handleChickenCellClick = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                if (fowl) {
                  ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl);
                } else {
                  toastMessage(
                    'No chicken profile is linked to this historical match.',
                    'warning',
                  );
                }
              };
              return (
                <tr
                  key={log.id}
                  className="hover:bg-muted/30 group transition-colors duration-150"
                >
                  <td className="text-muted-foreground p-2.5 pl-3 font-mono whitespace-nowrap lg:p-3 lg:pl-4">
                    {log.date}
                  </td>
                  <td
                    className="min-w-0 cursor-pointer p-2.5 lg:p-3"
                    onClick={handleChickenCellClick}
                    title={fowl ? `View info for ${log.entry_name}` : undefined}
                  >
                    {openFowlInfo ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={openFowlInfo}
                        aria-label={`View info for ${log.entry_name}`}
                        title={`View info for ${log.entry_name}`}
                        className="focus-visible:ring-ring flex w-full min-w-0 cursor-pointer flex-col items-start rounded-md text-left focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none"
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10">
                            <ChickenIcon className="text-success h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </div>
                          {code && (
                            <span className="text-success rounded border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm font-black uppercase">
                              [{formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}]
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-card-foreground font-bold transition-colors group-hover:text-emerald-600">
                            {log.entry_name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                            {log.breed || '—'}
                            {hatch ? ` · ${t('registry.hatchedDate', { date: hatch })}` : ''}
                          </span>
                          {log.age_category && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                              {log.age_category}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10">
                            <ChickenIcon className="text-success h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </div>
                          {code && (
                            <span className="text-success rounded border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm font-black uppercase">
                              [{formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}]
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-card-foreground font-bold transition-colors group-hover:text-emerald-600">
                            {log.entry_name}
                          </span>
                          {isOrphan && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                              Historical entry (no profile linked)
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                            {log.breed || '—'}
                            {hatch ? ` · ${t('registry.hatchedDate', { date: hatch })}` : ''}
                          </span>
                          {log.age_category && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                              {log.age_category}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )}
                    <MatchLogsRecordBadge
                      fowl={fowl}
                      stats={recordStats}
                      className="mt-1.5 inline-flex"
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="min-w-0 p-2.5 lg:p-3">
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                      {log.opponent_photo_url && (
                        <img
                          src={log.opponent_photo_url}
                          alt="Opponent"
                          className="border-border h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full border object-cover"
                        />
                      )}
                      <span className="text-card-foreground min-w-0 font-bold break-words">
                        {log.opponent || '—'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 block text-xs font-semibold break-words normal-case">
                      {[log.opponent_breed, log.opponent_bloodline].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') ||
                        '—'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="text-muted-foreground p-2.5 font-normal break-words lg:p-3">
                    {log.location || ' - '}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-sm font-black tracking-wider uppercase ${log.outcome && log.outcome.toLowerCase() === 'win' ? 'text-success border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10' : log.outcome && log.outcome.toLowerCase() === 'loss' ? 'text-danger border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border'}`}
                    >
                      {log.outcome || '—'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">
                    {log.post_fight_condition ? (
                      <span
                        className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-sm font-black tracking-wider break-words uppercase ${
                          (log.post_fight_condition || '').toLowerCase().includes('deceased')
                            ? 'text-danger border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10'
                            : (log.post_fight_condition || '').toLowerCase().includes('critical') ||
                                (log.post_fight_condition || '').toLowerCase().includes('severely')
                              ? 'text-warning border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10'
                              : 'text-teal border-teal-500/20 bg-teal-500/10'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {log.post_fight_condition}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm font-bold">—</span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td
                    className="bg-card sticky right-0 w-[15%] min-w-[160px] p-2.5 text-center lg:min-w-[120px] lg:p-2"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    <MatchMediaButtons
                      match={log}
                      videos={videosFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                      photos={photosFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                      posters={postersFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                      returnTo={returnTo}
                      onEdit={() => setEditingMatch(log)}
                    />
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })
          )}
        </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {editingMatch && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
          title="Edit Match Record"
          description="Update the recorded details for this match."
          className="max-w-6xl"
        >
          <MatchRecordForm
            mode="edit"
            initialRecord={editingMatch}
            onSuccess={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
            onCancel={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
          />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

'use client';
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams, usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { toastMessage } from '@/lib/toast-bus';
import {
  Plus,
  Search,
  Filter,
  X,
  Calendar,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Trophy,
  Swords,
} from 'lucide-react';
import ChickenIcon from '@/components/ChickenIcon';
import MatchLogsRecordBadge from '@/components/match/MatchLogsRecordBadge';
import MatchMediaButtons from '@/components/match/MatchMediaButtons';
import MatchRecordForm from '@/components/match/MatchRecordForm';
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui';
import { formatBirdCodeForDisplay } from '@/lib/bird-code';
import { useFowl } from '@/lib/contexts/fowl-context';
import { useUI } from '@/lib/contexts/ui-context';
import { useT } from '@/lib/i18n';
import { photosFor, postersFor, videosFor } from '@/lib/services/media-service';
import type { MatchRecord, FowlRecord } from '@/lib/types';
import {
  buildChickenMatchStatsMap,
  computeWinRate,
  getWinRatePillClasses,
} from '@/lib/win-rate';

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;

export default function MatchLogsView() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const t = useT();
  const ui = useUI();
  const { fowls, matchHistory, matchMedia, birdCodes, loading } = useFowl();
  const [editingMatch, setEditingMatch] = useState<MatchRecord | null>(null);

  // Read URL query params
  const urlSearch = searchParams.get('q') || '';
  const urlOutcome = searchParams.get('outcome') || 'ALL';
  const urlChickenId = searchParams.get('fowlId') || 'ALL';
  const urlClass = searchParams.get('class') || 'ALL';
  const urlStartDate = searchParams.get('startDate') || '';
  const urlEndDate = searchParams.get('endDate') || '';
  const urlSort = searchParams.get('sort') || 'newest';
  const urlPage = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1', 10);

  // Local filter states synced with URL
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(urlSearch);
  const [outcomeFilter, setOutcomeFilter] = useState(urlOutcome);
  const [chickenFilter, setChickenFilter] = useState(urlChickenId);
  const [classFilter, setClassFilter] = useState(urlClass);
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(urlStartDate);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(urlEndDate);
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState(urlSort);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(isNaN(urlPage) || urlPage < 1 ? 1 : urlPage);

  // Preserve active tab and filter state when navigating to match record creation/editing
  const currentReturnPath = useMemo(() => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
    if (pathname === '/profiling' && !sp.get('tab')) {
      sp.set('tab', 'matchForm');
    }
    const qs = sp.toString();
    return `${pathname}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  // Sync state if URL changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    setSearchQuery(urlSearch);
    setOutcomeFilter(urlOutcome);
    setChickenFilter(urlChickenId);
    setClassFilter(urlClass);
    setStartDate(urlStartDate);
    setEndDate(urlEndDate);
    setSortOrder(urlSort);
    setCurrentPage(isNaN(urlPage) || urlPage < 1 ? 1 : urlPage);
  }, [urlSearch, urlOutcome, urlChickenId, urlClass, urlStartDate, urlEndDate, urlSort, urlPage]);

  // Update URL helper
  const updateUrlParams = useCallback(
    (newParams: Record<string, string | null>) => {
      const current = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
      Object.entries(newParams).forEach(([k, v]) => {
        if (!v || v === 'ALL' || (k === 'page' && v === '1') || (k === 'sort' && v === 'newest')) {
          current.delete(k);
        } else {
          current.set(k, v);
        }
      });
      const query = current.toString();
      router.replace(`${pathname}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`, { scroll: false });
    },
    [router, pathname, searchParams],
  );

  const handleSearchChange = (val: string) => {
    setSearchQuery(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ q: val || null, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleOutcomeChange = (val: string) => {
    setOutcomeFilter(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ outcome: val === 'ALL' ? null : val, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleChickenChange = (val: string) => {
    setChickenFilter(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ fowlId: val === 'ALL' ? null : val, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleClassChange = (val: string) => {
    setClassFilter(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ class: val === 'ALL' ? null : val, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleStartDateChange = (val: string) => {
    setStartDate(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ startDate: val || null, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleEndDateChange = (val: string) => {
    setEndDate(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ endDate: val || null, page: '1' });
  };

  const handleSortChange = (val: string) => {
    setSortOrder(val);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    updateUrlParams({ sort: val === 'newest' ? null : val, page: '1' });
  };

  const handlePageChange = (page: number) => {
    setCurrentPage(page);
    updateUrlParams({ page: String(page) });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setOutcomeFilter('ALL');
    setChickenFilter('ALL');
    setClassFilter('ALL');
    setStartDate('');
    setEndDate('');
    setSortOrder('newest');
    setCurrentPage(1);
    if (pathname === '/profiling') {
      router.replace('/profiling?tab=matchForm', { scroll: false });
    } else {
      router.replace(pathname, { scroll: false });
    }
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = Boolean(
    searchQuery.trim() ||
    outcomeFilter !== 'ALL' ||
    chickenFilter !== 'ALL' ||
    classFilter !== 'ALL' ||
    startDate ||
    endDate ||
    sortOrder !== 'newest',
  );

  // Chicken lookup maps
  const fowlById = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<number, FowlRecord>();
    fowls.forEach((f) => map.set(f.id, f));
    return map;
  }, [fowls]);

  const fowlByName = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, FowlRecord>();
    fowls.forEach((f) => {
      const k = (f.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (k) map.set(k, f);
    });
    return map;
  }, [fowls]);

  // Per-chicken lifetime records always use the complete history, so filters,
  // sorting and pagination can never change a chicken's record badge.
  const matchStats = useMemo(
    () => buildChickenMatchStatsMap(matchHistory, fowls),
    [matchHistory, fowls],
  );

  // Filter & sort rows
  const filteredMatches = useMemo(() => {
    let rows = [...matchHistory];

    // Outcome filter
    if (outcomeFilter !== 'ALL') {
      rows = rows.filter((m) => (m.outcome || '').toUpperCase() === outcomeFilter.toUpperCase());
    }

    // Chicken filter
    if (chickenFilter !== 'ALL') {
      const targetId = Number(chickenFilter);
      rows = rows.filter((m) => {
        // Authoritative fowl_id only: orphan matches (fowl_id == null) never match by name fallback
        return m.fowl_id === targetId;
      });
    }

    // Class filter
    if (classFilter !== 'ALL') {
      rows = rows.filter(
        (m) => (m.age_category || 'Cock').trim().toLowerCase() === classFilter.toLowerCase(),
      );
    }

    // Date range filter
    if (startDate) {
      rows = rows.filter((m) => m.date >= startDate);
    }
    if (endDate) {
      rows = rows.filter((m) => m.date <= endDate);
    }

    // Search query
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      rows = rows.filter((m) => {
        const fowl = m.fowl_id != null ? fowlById.get(m.fowl_id) : null;
        const code = fowl ? birdCodes.get(String(fowl.id)) : '';
        const name = (m.entry_name || '').toLowerCase();
        const opponent = (m.opponent || '').toLowerCase();
        const breed = (m.breed || '').toLowerCase();
        const oppBreed = (m.opponent_breed || '').toLowerCase();
        const location = (m.location || '').toLowerCase();
        return (
          name.includes(q) ||
          opponent.includes(q) ||
          (code && code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
          breed.includes(q) ||
          oppBreed.includes(q) ||
          location.includes(q)
        );
      });
    }

    // Sort order
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortOrder === 'oldest') return (a.date || '').localeCompare(b.date || '');
      if (sortOrder === 'opponent') return (a.opponent || '').localeCompare(b.opponent || '');
      // newest first default
      const cmp = (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || '');
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp;
      return (b.id || 0) - (a.id || 0);
    });

    return rows;
  }, [
    matchHistory,
    outcomeFilter,
    chickenFilter,
    classFilter,
    startDate,
    endDate,
    searchQuery,
    sortOrder,
    fowlById,
    fowlByName,
    birdCodes,
  ]);

  // Summary of the rows currently matching the active search/filters.
  const filterStats = useMemo(() => {
    let wins = 0;
    let losses = 0;
    let draws = 0;
    for (const match of filteredMatches) {
      const outcome = (match.outcome || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (outcome === 'win') wins += 1;
      else if (outcome === 'loss') losses += 1;
      else if (outcome === 'draw') draws += 1;
    }
    return computeWinRate(wins, losses, draws);
  }, [filteredMatches]);

  // Pagination calculation
  const totalItems = filteredMatches.length;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE));
  const pageStart = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
  const paginatedRows = filteredMatches.slice(pageStart, pageStart + PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="border-border flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <h1 className="text-foreground flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">
              <Swords className="h-6 w-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Historical Analytics Match Logs</span>
            </h1>
            <span className="text-success hidden rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black sm:inline">
              D4 ANALYTICS DB
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">
            Complete record of logged derby, arena, and championship performance encounters
          </p>
        </div>

        <div>
          <Link
            href={`/match-logs/new?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(currentReturnPath)}`}
            className="inline-flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-md transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700 sm:w-auto"
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Add Match Record</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-card border-border space-y-4 rounded-lg border p-4 shadow-sm">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-12">
          {/* Search Input */}
          <div className="relative md:col-span-3">
            <Search className="text-muted-foreground absolute top-1/2 left-3 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => handleSearchChange(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search chicken, identifier, opponent..."
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-success h-10 w-full rounded-md border bg-white pr-8 pl-9 text-sm font-semibold focus:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(19,169,131,.12)]"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSearchChange('')}
                className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground absolute top-1/2 right-2.5 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Outcome Filter */}
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <select
              value={outcomeFilter}
              onChange={(e) => handleOutcomeChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter by outcome"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground focus:border-success h-10 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-md border bg-white px-3 text-sm font-bold"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Outcomes</option>
              <option value="WIN">WIN</option>
              <option value="LOSS">LOSS</option>
              <option value="DRAW">DRAW</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Chicken Filter */}
          <div className="md:col-span-3">
            <select
              value={chickenFilter}
              onChange={(e) => handleChickenChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter by chicken"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground focus:border-success h-10 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-md border bg-white px-3 text-sm font-bold"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Chickens</option>
              {fowls.map((f) => {
                const code = birdCodes.get(String(f.id));
                return (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {code ? `[${formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}] ` : ''}
                    {f.name}
                  </option>
                );
              })}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Class Filter */}
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <select
              value={classFilter}
              onChange={(e) => handleClassChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter by chicken class"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground focus:border-success h-10 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-md border bg-white px-3 text-sm font-bold"
            >
              <option value="ALL">All Classes</option>
              <option value="Cock">Cock</option>
              <option value="Stag">Stag</option>
              <option value="Open">Open</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Sort Filter */}
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <select
              value={sortOrder}
              onChange={(e) => handleSortChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Sort match records"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground focus:border-success h-10 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-md border bg-white px-3 text-sm font-bold"
            >
              <option value="newest">Sort: Newest First</option>
              <option value="oldest">Sort: Oldest First</option>
              <option value="opponent">Sort: Opponent Name</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Date Range & Clear Action */}
        <div className="border-border/60 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t pt-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase">
              <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Date:</span>
            </span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={startDate}
              onChange={(e) => handleStartDateChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter match records starting from this date"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground h-8 rounded border bg-white px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold"
            />
            <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">to</span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={endDate}
              onChange={(e) => handleEndDateChange(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter match records up to this date"
              className="border-input-border dark:bg-input text-foreground h-8 rounded border bg-white px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold"
            />
          </div>

          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClearFilters}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 hover:underline dark:text-emerald-400"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Clear filters</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Table Card */}
      <div className="bg-card border-border overflow-hidden rounded-lg border shadow-sm">
        {!loading && matchHistory.length > 0 && (
          <div
            data-testid="match-logs-filter-summary"
            className="border-border bg-muted/20 flex flex-col gap-2 border-b px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
          >
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
                Current filter totals
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                Follows the active search and filters
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
              <span className="text-foreground">
                {filteredMatches.length === 1
                  ? '1 match'
                  : `${filteredMatches.length} matches`}
              </span>
              <span className="text-border" aria-hidden="true">
                |
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
                W-L-D
              </span>
              <span className="text-foreground">
                {filterStats.wins}W-{filterStats.losses}L-{filterStats.draws}D
              </span>
              <span className="text-border" aria-hidden="true">
                |
              </span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest uppercase">
                Overall win rate
              </span>
              <span
                className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 font-black ${getWinRatePillClasses(filterStats)}`}
              >
                {filterStats.winRate === null ? '—%' : `${filterStats.winRate}%`}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="animate-pulse space-y-4 p-8">
            <div className="bg-muted h-6 w-1/3 rounded" />
            <div className="bg-muted h-12 w-full rounded" />
            <div className="bg-muted h-12 w-full rounded" />
            <div className="bg-muted h-12 w-full rounded" />
          </div>
        ) : matchHistory.length === 0 ? (
          /* Farm Empty State */
          <div className="space-y-4 p-12 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600">
              <Trophy className="h-7 w-7" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-foreground text-lg font-black">No match records yet</h3>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mx-auto max-w-md text-sm font-semibold">
              Your farm hasn&apos;t logged any derby or arena fights yet. Begin tracking win rates
              and fight performance by adding your first record.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-2">
              <Link
                href={`/match-logs/new?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(currentReturnPath)}`}
                className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-md transition-all hover:bg-emerald-700"
              >
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Add Match Record</span>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : filteredMatches.length === 0 ? (
          /* Filtered Empty State */
          <div className="space-y-3 p-12 text-center">
            <div className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full">
              <Search className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-foreground text-base font-black">No records match your filters</h3>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
              Try adjusting your search query, outcome, or date range filters.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleClearFilters}
                className="border-border text-foreground hover:bg-muted inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Clear Filters</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="max-w-full min-w-0 overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] table-fixed border-collapse text-left text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground border-border border-b text-xs font-extrabold uppercase">
                  <th className="w-[9%] p-2.5 pl-3 lg:p-3 lg:pl-4">Match Date</th>
                  <th className="w-[24%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Chicken Identifier</th>
                  <th className="w-[17%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Opponent</th>
                  <th className="w-[13%] p-2.5 lg:p-3">Arena Location</th>
                  <th className="w-[9%] p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">Outcome</th>
                  <th className="w-[13%] p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">Post-Fight Condition</th>
                  <th className="bg-card sticky right-0 w-[15%] min-w-[160px] p-2.5 text-center lg:min-w-[120px] lg:p-2">
                    Media &amp; Actions
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-border text-muted-foreground divide-y font-semibold">
                {paginatedRows.map((log) => {
                  const fowl = log.fowl_id != null ? fowlById.get(log.fowl_id) ?? null : null;
                  const code = fowl ? birdCodes.get(String(fowl.id)) : '';
                  const hatch = fowl?.birthdate;
                  const isOrphan = !fowl;
                  const recordStats = fowl
                    ? matchStats.get(fowl.name.trim().toLowerCase())
                    : undefined;
                  const openFowlInfo = fowl
                    ? (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
                        event.stopPropagation();
                        ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl);
                      }
                    : undefined;
                  const handleChickenCellClick = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    if (fowl) {
                      ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(fowl);
                    } else {
                      toastMessage(
                        'No chicken profile is linked to this historical match.',
                        'warning',
                      );
                    }
                  };

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={log.id}
                      className="hover:bg-muted/30 group transition-colors duration-150"
                    >
                      <td className="text-muted-foreground p-2.5 pl-3 font-mono whitespace-nowrap lg:p-3 lg:pl-4">
                        {log.date}
                      </td>

                      <td
                        className="min-w-0 cursor-pointer p-2.5 lg:p-3"
                        onClick={handleChickenCellClick}
                        title={fowl ? `View info for ${log.entry_name}` : undefined}
                      >
                        {openFowlInfo ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={openFowlInfo}
                            aria-label={`View info for ${log.entry_name}`}
                            title={`View info for ${log.entry_name}`}
                            className="focus-visible:ring-ring flex w-full min-w-0 cursor-pointer flex-col items-start rounded-md text-left focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none"
                          >
                            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                              <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10">
                                <ChickenIcon className="text-success h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              </div>
                              {code && (
                                <span className="text-success rounded border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase">
                                  [{formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}]
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <span className="text-card-foreground min-w-0 font-bold break-words transition-colors group-hover:text-emerald-600">
                                {log.entry_name}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                                {log.breed || '—'}
                                {hatch ? ` · ${t('registry.hatchedDate', { date: hatch })}` : ''}
                              </span>
                              {log.age_category && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  {log.age_category}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                              <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10">
                                <ChickenIcon className="text-success h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                              </div>
                              {code && (
                                <span className="text-success rounded border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase">
                                  [{formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}]
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <span className="text-card-foreground min-w-0 font-bold break-words transition-colors group-hover:text-emerald-600">
                                {log.entry_name}
                              </span>
                              {isOrphan && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  Historical entry (no profile linked)
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">
                                {log.breed || '—'}
                                {hatch ? ` · ${t('registry.hatchedDate', { date: hatch })}` : ''}
                              </span>
                              {log.age_category && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                                  {log.age_category}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                        <MatchLogsRecordBadge
                          fowl={fowl}
                          stats={recordStats}
                          className="mt-1.5 inline-flex"
                        />
                      </td>

                      <td className="min-w-0 p-2.5 lg:p-3">
                        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                          {log.opponent_photo_url && (
                            <img
                              src={log.opponent_photo_url}
                              alt="Opponent"
                              className="border-border h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full border object-cover"
                            />
                          )}
                          <span className="text-card-foreground min-w-0 font-bold break-words">
                            {log.opponent || '—'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 block text-xs font-semibold break-words normal-case">
                          {[log.opponent_breed, log.opponent_bloodline]
                            .filter(Boolean)
                            .join(' · ') || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="text-muted-foreground p-2.5 font-normal break-words lg:p-3">
                        {log.location || '—'}
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-2.5 text-center lg:p-3">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black tracking-wider uppercase ${
                            log.outcome && log.outcome.toLowerCase() === 'win'
                              ? 'text-success border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10'
                              : log.outcome && log.outcome.toLowerCase() === 'loss'
                                ? 'text-danger border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10'
                                : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {log.outcome || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-4 text-center">
                        {log.post_fight_condition ? (
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black tracking-wider break-words uppercase ${
                              (log.post_fight_condition || '').toLowerCase().includes('deceased')
                                ? 'text-danger border-rose-500/20 bg-rose-500/10'
                                : (log.post_fight_condition || '')
                                      .toLowerCase()
                                      .includes('critical') ||
                                    (log.post_fight_condition || '')
                                      .toLowerCase()
                                      .includes('severely')
                                  ? 'text-warning border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10'
                                  : 'text-teal border-teal-500/20 bg-teal-500/10'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {log.post_fight_condition}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-bold">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td
                        className="bg-card sticky right-0 w-[15%] min-w-[160px] p-2.5 text-center lg:min-w-[120px] lg:p-2"
                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      >
                        <MatchMediaButtons
                          match={log}
                          videos={videosFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                          photos={photosFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                          posters={postersFor(matchMedia, log.id, log)}
                          returnTo={currentReturnPath}
                          onEdit={() => setEditingMatch(log)}
                        />
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Pagination Controls */}
        {!loading && totalItems > PAGE_SIZE && (
          <div className="border-border bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t p-4 text-xs font-semibold sm:flex-row">
            <div>
              Showing <span className="text-foreground font-bold">{pageStart + 1}</span> to{' '}
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">
                {Math.min(pageStart + PAGE_SIZE, totalItems)}
              </span>{' '}
              of <span className="text-foreground font-bold">{totalItems}</span> match records
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
                disabled={currentPage <= 1}
                className="border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded border px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Previous</span>
              </button>

              <div className="bg-muted text-foreground rounded px-3 py-1.5 font-bold">
                Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                className="border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded border px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <span>Next</span>
                <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {editingMatch && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
          title="Edit Match Record"
          description="Update the recorded details for this match."
          className="max-w-6xl"
        >
          <MatchRecordForm
            mode="edit"
            initialRecord={editingMatch}
            onSuccess={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
            onCancel={() => setEditingMatch(null)}
          />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const match = {
  id: 1,
  date: '2025-02-09',
  entry_name: 'Hatch Mountain',
  breed: 'Sweater',
  opponent: 'Kelso',
  location: 'Main Arena',
  type: 'Derby',
  outcome: 'Win',
  status: 'Completed',
} as MatchRecord;

const VIDEO_URL = 'https://cdn.test/match-videos/hatch-mountain.mp4';

function renderRow() {
  return render(
    <UIProvider theme="dark" setTheme={() => {}}>
      <MatchMediaButtons match={match} videos={[VIDEO_URL]} photos={[PHOTO_URL]} />
      <MatchMediaViewer />
    </UIProvider>,
  );
}

describe('MatchMediaButtons + MatchMediaViewer', () => {
  let playSpy: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    nav.pathname = '/match-logs';
    nav.search = '';
    playSpy = vi
      .spyOn(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, 'play')
      .mockResolvedValue(undefined as unknown as void);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    playSpy.mockRestore();
  });

  it('shows Play media button with count, Edit match record, and Share match', () => {
    renderRow();

    const playBtn = screen.getByTitle('Play media');
    expect(within(playBtn).getByText('2')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Play media')).toBeTruthy();

    expect(screen.queryByText('No media')).toBeNull();
    const editLink = screen.getByTitle('Edit match record');
    expect(editLink).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Edit match record')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(editLink.getAttribute('href')).toContain('/match-logs/1/edit');

    expect(screen.getByTitle('Share match')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Share match')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('preserves the current path and query when no explicit returnTo is given (modal entry point)', () => {
    nav.pathname = '/profiling';
    nav.search = 'tab=males&q=Lemon';
    render(
      <UIProvider theme="dark" setTheme={() => {}}>
        <MatchMediaButtons match={match} />
      </UIProvider>,
    );

    const editLink = screen.getByTitle('Edit match record');
    expect(editLink.getAttribute('href')).toBe(
      '/match-logs/1/edit?returnTo=%2Fprofiling%3Ftab%3Dmales%26q%3DLemon',
    );
  });

  it('opens the viewer and plays the video when Play media is clicked', async () => {
    renderRow();

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByTitle('Play media'));

    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog');
    expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Match media');

    // Tabs with counts
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /videos/i })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /photos/i })).toBeTruthy();

    // Video element with the (signed) source
    await waitFor(() => {
      const video = dialog.querySelector('video') as HTMLVideoElement | null;
      expect(video).toBeTruthy();
      expect(video!.getAttribute('src')).toContain('hatch-mountain.mp4');
    });

    // Overlay play button starts playback
    const playButton = await screen.findByLabelText(/^Play video/);
    fireEvent.click(playButton);
    expect(playSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

'use client';
import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Play, Pencil, Share2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useUI } from '@/lib/contexts/ui-context';
import type { MatchRecord } from '@/lib/types';

type Props = {
  match: MatchRecord;
  videos?: string[];
  photos?: string[];
  /** Poster frames index-aligned with `videos`. */
  posters?: (string | null)[];
  /** Show the Edit + Share action buttons (hidden inside read-only surfaces like the share page). */
  showActions?: boolean;
  onEdit?: () => void;
  onShare?: () => void;
  returnTo?: string;
};

/**
 * Shared Actions for a match row:
 * - Play media (only when media exists, with count badge)
 * - Edit match record (navigates to /match-logs/[id]/edit with returnTo)
 * - Share match (opens share modal)
 */
export default function MatchMediaButtons({
  match,
  videos,
  photos,
  posters,
  showActions = true,
  onEdit,
  onShare,
  returnTo,
}: Props) {
  const ui = useUI();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const effectiveVideos =
    videos && videos.length > 0
      ? videos
      : match.videos && match.videos.length > 0
        ? match.videos
        : match.video_url && match.video_url.trim() !== ''
          ? [match.video_url.trim()]
          : [];

  const effectivePhotos =
    photos && photos.length > 0
      ? photos
      : match.photos && match.photos.length > 0
        ? match.photos
        : [];

  const effectivePosters =
    posters && posters.length > 0
      ? posters
      : match.video_posters && match.video_posters.length > 0
        ? match.video_posters
        : [];

  type ProcessingFlags = { video_status?: string; video_processing?: boolean };
  const flags = match as MatchRecord & Partial<ProcessingFlags>;
  const isProcessing = Boolean(
    flags.video_status === 'processing' ||
    flags.status === 'processing' ||
    flags.video_processing ||
    (typeof match.video_url === 'string' &&
      /processing|converting|transcoding/i.test(match.video_url)) ||
    effectiveVideos.some(
      (v) => typeof v === 'string' && /processing|converting|transcoding/i.test(v),
    ),
  );

  const videoCount = match.video_count !== undefined ? match.video_count : effectiveVideos.length;
  const photoCount = match.photo_count !== undefined ? match.photo_count : effectivePhotos.length;

  const hasVideos = (videoCount > 0 || effectiveVideos.length > 0) && !isProcessing;
  const hasPhotos = photoCount > 0 || effectivePhotos.length > 0;
  const hasMedia = (hasVideos || hasPhotos) && !isProcessing;
  const totalMediaCount =
    (videoCount > 0 ? videoCount : 0) + (photoCount > 0 ? photoCount : 0) ||
    effectiveVideos.length + effectivePhotos.length;

  const openMedia = () =>
    ui.openMatchMediaViewer({
      match,
      videos: effectiveVideos,
      photos: effectivePhotos,
      videoPosters: effectivePosters,
      tab: hasVideos ? 'videos' : 'photos',
    });

  const search = searchParams?.toString() ?? '';
  const currentPath =
    pathname && pathname.startsWith('/') ? `${pathname}${search ? `?${search}` : ''}` : '';
  const safeReturn = returnTo || currentPath || '/match-logs';
  const editHref = `/match-logs/${match.id}/edit${safeReturn ? `?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(safeReturn)}` : ''}`;

  const closeModals = () => {
    if (ui.selectedFowlForDetails) ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(null);
    if (ui.fightHistoryFowl) ui.setFightHistoryFowl(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap">
      {isProcessing ? (
        <span
          title="Video is being processed/converted"
          aria-label={`Video processing for ${match.entry_name}`}
          className="text-warning inline-flex cursor-wait items-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap"
        >
          <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
          Processing…
        </span>
      ) : null}

      {hasMedia ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          title="Play media"
          aria-label="Play media"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            openMedia();
          }}
          className="text-success focus-visible:ring-ring relative inline-flex h-8 min-h-[44px] w-8 min-w-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 transition-all hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none sm:min-h-[32px] sm:min-w-[32px]"
        >
          <Play size={13} fill="currentColor" strokeWidth={0} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-500 px-1 text-xs leading-none font-black text-white">
            {totalMediaCount}
          </span>
        </button>
      ) : null}

      {!hasMedia && !isProcessing ? (
        <span
          className="text-muted-foreground/70 hidden text-xs font-bold xl:inline"
          title="No videos or photos yet"
        >
          No media
        </span>
      ) : null}

      {showActions ? (
        <>
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="bg-border mx-0.5 hidden h-5 w-px xl:inline-block" />
          {onEdit ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              title="Edit match record"
              aria-label="Edit match record"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                closeModals();
                onEdit();
              }}
              className="bg-muted border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-success hover:border-success/40 focus-visible:ring-ring inline-flex h-8 min-h-[44px] w-8 min-w-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-sm border transition-all focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none sm:min-h-[32px] sm:min-w-[32px]"
            >
              <Pencil size={13} />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <Link
              href={editHref}
              title="Edit match record"
              aria-label="Edit match record"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                closeModals();
              }}
              className="bg-muted border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-success hover:border-success/40 focus-visible:ring-ring inline-flex h-8 min-h-[44px] w-8 min-w-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-sm border transition-all focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none sm:min-h-[32px] sm:min-w-[32px]"
            >
              <Pencil size={13} />
            </Link>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            title="Share match"
            aria-label="Share match"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (onShare) {
                onShare();
              } else {
                ui.setShareTarget({
                  type: 'match',
                  id: match.id,
                  label: `${match.entry_name} vs ${match.opponent || 'Opponent'} — ${match.date || ''}`,
                });
              }
            }}
            className="bg-muted border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-success hover:border-success/40 focus-visible:ring-ring inline-flex h-8 min-h-[44px] w-8 min-w-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-sm border transition-all focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:outline-none sm:min-h-[32px] sm:min-w-[32px]"
          >
            <Share2 size={13} />
          </button>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
