    // Subject node
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Sweater Red Storm').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('50% Hatch · 50% Sweater').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // G1 parents
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Titan Sweater').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Crimson Belle').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // G2 grandparent nodes are merged unknown nodes
    const mergedNodes = screen.getAllByText('Foundation stock');
    expect(mergedNodes.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(screen.getAllByText('Not registered').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  });

  it('allows re-centering on an ancestor node when clicked', () => {
    const codes = resolveBirdCodes(sampleFowls);
    const onSelect = vi.fn();
    renderWithUI(
      <PedigreeTree
        fowls={sampleFowls}
        codes={codes}
        selectedId={1}
        onSelect={onSelect}
      />
    );

    const titanElements = screen.getAllByText('Titan Sweater');
    const titanCard = titanElements.map((el) => el.closest('[role="treeitem"]')).find(Boolean);
    expect(titanCard).toBeInTheDocument();

    fireEvent.click(titanCard!);
    expect(onSelect).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Titan Sweater' }));
  });

  it('supports searching subjects and navigating with Prev/Next buttons', () => {
    const codes = resolveBirdCodes(sampleFowls);
    const onSelect = vi.fn();
    renderWithUI(
      <PedigreeTree
        fowls={sampleFowls}
        codes={codes}
        selectedId={1}
        onSelect={onSelect}
      />
    );

    const prevButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Previous chicken/i });
    const nextButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Next chicken/i });

    expect(prevButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(nextButton).toBeInTheDocument();

    fireEvent.click(nextButton);
    expect(onSelect).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('VERIFIES NO TWO NODE BOXES OVERLAP (bounding box grid test) for 2E1, full grandparents, and foundation bird', () => {
    const byName = new Map<string, FowlRecord>();
    sampleFowls.forEach((f) => byName.set(f.name.toLowerCase(), f));

    // Case 1: 2E1 Sweater Red Storm (2 merged grandparent nodes)
    const subject2E1 = sampleFowls.find((f) => f.id === 1)!;
    const grid1 = buildPedigreeGrid(subject2E1, sampleFowls, byName, 3);
    expect(grid1.nodes.length).toBe(5); // 1 subject + 2 parents + 2 merged unknown

    // Case 2: Full Family Child (4 registered grandparents)
    const subjectFull = sampleFowls.find((f) => f.id === 8)!;
    const grid2 = buildPedigreeGrid(subjectFull, sampleFowls, byName, 3);
    expect(grid2.nodes.length).toBe(7); // 1 subject + 2 parents + 4 grandparents

    // Case 3: Foundation bird with no parents (Titan Sweater)
    const subjectBase = sampleFowls.find((f) => f.id === 2)!;
    const grid3 = buildPedigreeGrid(subjectBase, sampleFowls, byName, 3);
    expect(grid3.nodes.length).toBe(2); // 1 subject + 1 merged unknown for parents

    // Verify mathematical non-intersection across all cases:
    [grid1, grid2, grid3].forEach(({ nodes }) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
        for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
          const a = nodes[i];
          const b = nodes[j];
          if (a.gen === b.gen) {
            const aEnd = a.startRow + a.rowSpan - 1;
            const bEnd = b.startRow + b.rowSpan - 1;
            const overlaps = !(aEnd < b.startRow || bEnd < a.startRow);
            expect(overlaps).toBe(false);
          }
        }
      }
    });
  });
});

'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { FowlRecord } from '@/lib/types';
import {
  getFowlBloodlineStats,
  UNKNOWN_BLOODLINE,
  isFoundationName,
} from '@/lib/bloodline-composition';
import { getBreedingClassification } from '@/lib/breeding-classification';
import { getOffspringParentageRelatedness } from '@/lib/relatedness-classification';
import RelatednessBadge from '@/components/RelatednessBadge';
import { birdCodeOf, compareBirdCodesNatural, formatBirdCodeForDisplay } from '@/lib/bird-code';
import { useUI } from '@/lib/contexts/ui-context';
import BloodlineBreakdown from '@/components/BloodlineBreakdown';
import ChickenIcon from '@/components/ChickenIcon';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/Card';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/Skeleton';
import { Tooltip } from '@/components/ui/Tooltip';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { SkipLink } from '@/components/ui/SkipLink';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/EmptyState';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Printer,
  ExternalLink,
  Plus,
  UserPlus,
  Search,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

const keyFn = (v?: string | null) =>
  String(v ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

export type PedigreeNode = {
  id: string;
  gen: number;
  startRow: number;
  rowSpan: number;
  fowl: FowlRecord | null;
  name: string;
  isMerged?: boolean;
  role: 'subject' | 'sire' | 'dam' | 'unknown';
  sireName?: string;
  damName?: string;
  childBreedHint?: string;
  childName?: string;
};

function resolveFowlByName(
  fowls: FowlRecord[],
  byName: Map<string, FowlRecord>,
  name?: string | null,
): FowlRecord | undefined {
  if (isFoundationName(name)) return undefined;
  return byName.get(keyFn(name));
}

export function buildPedigreeGrid(
  subject: FowlRecord,
  fowls: FowlRecord[],
  byName: Map<string, FowlRecord>,
  numGens: number,
): { nodes: PedigreeNode[]; totalRows: number } {
  const totalRows = Math.pow(2, numGens - 1);
  const nodes: PedigreeNode[] = [];

  // Generation 0: Subject
  nodes.push({
    id: `g0-r0`,
    gen: 0,
    startRow: 1,
    rowSpan: totalRows,
    fowl: subject,
    name: subject.name,
    role: 'subject',
  });

  let currentLevelNodes: PedigreeNode[] = [nodes[0]];

  for (let gen = 1; gen < numGens; gen++) {
    const nextLevelNodes: PedigreeNode[] = [];

    for (const parentNode of currentLevelNodes) {
      if (!parentNode.fowl || parentNode.isMerged) continue;

      const f = parentNode.fowl;
      const sireName = f.sire;
      const damName = f.dam;
      const sireFowl = resolveFowlByName(fowls, byName, sireName);
      const damFowl = resolveFowlByName(fowls, byName, damName);
      const sireAbsent = !sireFowl;
      const damAbsent = !damFowl;

      const childSpan = parentNode.rowSpan;
      const halfSpan = childSpan / 2;
      const sireStartRow = parentNode.startRow;
      const damStartRow = parentNode.startRow + halfSpan;

      if (sireAbsent && damAbsent) {
        const mergedNode: PedigreeNode = {
          id: `g${gen}-merged-${parentNode.startRow}`,
          gen,
          startRow: parentNode.startRow,
          rowSpan: childSpan,
          fowl: null,
          name: 'Foundation stock',
          isMerged: true,
          role: 'unknown',
          childBreedHint: f.breed || undefined,
          childName: f.name,
        };
        nodes.push(mergedNode);
        nextLevelNodes.push(mergedNode);
      } else {
        const sireNode: PedigreeNode = {
          id: `g${gen}-sire-${sireStartRow}`,
          gen,
          startRow: sireStartRow,
          rowSpan: halfSpan,
          fowl: sireFowl ?? null,
          name: sireFowl ? sireFowl.name : sireName || 'Foundation stock',
          role: 'sire',
          childBreedHint: f.breed || undefined,
          childName: f.name,
        };
        const damNode: PedigreeNode = {
          id: `g${gen}-dam-${damStartRow}`,
          gen,
          startRow: damStartRow,
          rowSpan: halfSpan,
          fowl: damFowl ?? null,
          name: damFowl ? damFowl.name : damName || 'Foundation stock',
          role: 'dam',
          childBreedHint: f.breed || undefined,
          childName: f.name,
        };
        nodes.push(sireNode);
        nodes.push(damNode);
        nextLevelNodes.push(sireNode);
        nextLevelNodes.push(damNode);
      }
    }

    currentLevelNodes = nextLevelNodes;
  }

  return { nodes, totalRows };
}

type ConnectorPath = {
  id: string;
  path: string;
  isDashed: boolean;
};

function computeGridConnectors(
  nodes: PedigreeNode[],
  numGens: number,
  totalRows: number,
  colWidth = 220,
  colGap = 48,
  rowHeight = 76,
  paddingLeft = 20,
  paddingTop = 20,
): ConnectorPath[] {
  const paths: ConnectorPath[] = [];

  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (!node.fowl || node.isMerged || node.gen >= numGens - 1) continue;

    const gen = node.gen;
    const childCenterX = paddingLeft + gen * (colWidth + colGap) + colWidth;
    const childCenterY = paddingTop + (node.startRow - 1 + node.rowSpan / 2) * rowHeight;
    const midX = childCenterX + colGap / 2;
    const parentLeftX = paddingLeft + (gen + 1) * (colWidth + colGap);

    const childNextGenNodes = nodes.filter(
      (n) =>
        n.gen === gen + 1 &&
        n.startRow >= node.startRow &&
        n.startRow < node.startRow + node.rowSpan,
    );

    for (const pNode of childNextGenNodes) {
      const parentCenterY = paddingTop + (pNode.startRow - 1 + pNode.rowSpan / 2) * rowHeight;
      const pathD = `M ${childCenterX} ${childCenterY} H ${midX} V ${parentCenterY} H ${parentLeftX}`;
      paths.push({
        id: `c-${node.id}-to-${pNode.id}`,
        path: pathD,
        isDashed: Boolean(pNode.isMerged),
      });
    }
  }

  return paths;
}

function AncestorAvatar({ image_url, gender }: { image_url?: string | null; gender?: string }) {
  if (image_url) {
    return (
      <img
        src={image_url}
        alt=""
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="bg-muted border-border h-8 w-8 shrink-0 rounded-full border object-cover"
        onError={(e) => {
          (e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none';
        }}
      />
    );
  }
  const tone = gender && gender.toLowerCase().includes('hen') ? 'text-pink-500' : 'text-info';
  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="bg-muted border-border flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border"
    >
      <ChickenIcon className={`h-4 w-4 ${tone}`} />
    </div>
  );
}

type CompactNodeCardProps = {
  node: PedigreeNode;
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  canRegisterAncestor: boolean;
  onRecenter: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
  onViewProfile: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
  onRegisterMerged: (hint: { side?: 'sire' | 'dam'; breed?: string; childName: string }) => void;
  onRegisterSingle: (hint: {
    side: 'sire' | 'dam';
    breed?: string;
    childName: string;
    placeholderName: string;
  }) => void;
};

export function CompactNodeCard(props: CompactNodeCardProps) {
  const {
    node,
    fowls,
    codes,
    canRegisterAncestor,
    onRecenter,
    onViewProfile,
    onRegisterMerged,
    onRegisterSingle,
  } = props;
  const { fowl, name, isMerged, role, childBreedHint, childName } = node;

  const stats = useMemo(
    () => (!isMerged && fowl ? getFowlBloodlineStats(fowl, fowls ?? []) : null),
    [isMerged, fowl, fowls],
  );
  const classification = useMemo(
    () => (!isMerged && fowl ? getBreedingClassification(fowl, fowls ?? []) : null),
    [isMerged, fowl, fowls],
  );
  const recenter = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isMerged && fowl) onRecenter(fowl);
  }, [isMerged, fowl, onRecenter]);

  const viewProfile = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!isMerged && fowl) onViewProfile(fowl);
    },
    [isMerged, fowl, onViewProfile],
  );

  const roleBorder =
    role === 'subject'
      ? 'border-l-4 border-l-emerald-500 border-border bg-card'
      : role === 'sire'
        ? 'border-l-4 border-l-sky-500 border-border bg-card'
        : role === 'dam'
          ? 'border-l-4 border-l-pink-500 border-border bg-card'
          : 'border-l-4 border-l-slate-400 border-dashed border-border bg-card/85';

  if (isMerged) {
    return (
      <div
        data-node-box="true"
        data-gen={node.gen}
        data-start-row={node.startRow}
        data-row-span={node.rowSpan}
        className={`h-[64px] w-[220px] shrink-0 rounded-md border text-left ${roleBorder} flex items-center justify-between gap-2 self-center px-2.5 py-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-all`}
      >
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2">
          <div className="bg-muted/80 text-muted-foreground border-border flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border">
            <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs leading-tight font-black">
              Foundation stock
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-[10px] font-semibold">
              Not registered
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {canRegisterAncestor && (
          <Tooltip content="Register foundation ancestor">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                onRegisterMerged({ breed: childBreedHint, childName: childName || '' })
              }
              aria-label="Register foundation ancestor"
              className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500/20 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const code = fowl
    ? formatBirdCodeForDisplay(codes.get(String(fowl.id)) || birdCodeOf(fowl, fowls))
    : '';
  const missing = !fowl;

  const displayBreed =
    classification?.type === 'Crossbred' ? classification.derivedBreed : fowl?.breed;
  const isAssumed =
    classification?.compositionSource === 'assumed' || !!classification?.basedOnAssumed;
  const baseSummary = stats ? stats.summary : displayBreed ? displayBreed : 'Not registered';
  const summaryTitle = isAssumed ? `${baseSummary} (assumed lineage)` : baseSummary;

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && fowl) {
      e.preventDefault();
      recenter();
    }
  };

  if (missing) {
    return (
      <div
        data-node-box="true"
        data-gen={node.gen}
        data-start-row={node.startRow}
        data-row-span={node.rowSpan}
        className={`h-[64px] w-[220px] shrink-0 rounded-md border text-left ${roleBorder} flex items-center justify-between gap-2 self-center px-2.5 py-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-all`}
      >
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2">
          <AncestorAvatar gender={role === 'dam' ? 'Hen' : 'Rooster'} />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p
              className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs leading-tight font-black"
              title={name}
            >
              {name || 'Foundation stock'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-[10px] font-semibold">
              Not registered
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {canRegisterAncestor && (
          <Tooltip content={`Register ancestor ${name || ''}`}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                onRegisterSingle({
                  side: role === 'dam' ? 'dam' : 'sire',
                  breed: childBreedHint,
                  childName: childName || '',
                  placeholderName: name,
                })
              }
              aria-label={`Register ancestor ${name || ''}`}
              className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500/20 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </Tooltip>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const ariaLabel = `${node.role.toUpperCase()}: ${name}${code ? `, code ${code}` : ''}, ${baseSummary}${isAssumed ? ' (assumed)' : ''}`;

  return (
    <div
      data-node-box="true"
      data-gen={node.gen}
      data-start-row={node.startRow}
      data-row-span={node.rowSpan}
      role="treeitem"
      aria-selected={role === 'subject'}
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      aria-level={node.gen + 1}
      onClick={recenter}
      onKeyDown={onKey}
      className={`group h-[64px] w-[220px] shrink-0 rounded-md border text-left ${roleBorder} flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 self-center px-2.5 py-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-all hover:border-emerald-400/80 hover:shadow-xs focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none`}
    >
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2">
        <AncestorAvatar image_url={fowl.image_url} gender={fowl.gender} />
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
            {code && (
              <span className="py-0.2 shrink-0 rounded bg-emerald-100/80 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-black text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 dark:text-emerald-300">
                [{code}]
              </span>
            )}
            <span
              className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs leading-tight font-black"
              title={name}
            >
              {name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground truncate text-[11px] font-bold" title={summaryTitle}>
            <span>{baseSummary}</span>
            {isAssumed && baseSummary !== 'Not registered' && (
              <span
                className="ml-1 text-xs font-extrabold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                aria-label="Assumed lineage"
              >
                ~
              </span>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
        {fowl.status === 'Archived' ? (
          <span className="rounded bg-amber-100 px-1 text-[9px] font-extrabold text-amber-700 uppercase dark:bg-amber-950/80 dark:text-amber-300">
            Archived
          </span>
        ) : fowl.status === 'Deceased' ? (
          <span className="rounded bg-rose-100 px-1 text-[9px] font-extrabold text-rose-700 uppercase dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300">
            Deceased
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" title="Active" />
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={viewProfile}
          aria-label={`View profile of ${name}`}
          title={`View profile of ${name}`}
          className="text-muted-foreground cursor-pointer rounded p-1 transition-colors hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400"
        >
          <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

type SubjectSelectorProps = {
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  subject: FowlRecord;
  onSelect: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
};

function SubjectSelector({ fowls, codes, subject, onSelect }: SubjectSelectorProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [dropdownOpen, setDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const sortedFowls = useMemo(() => {
    return [...fowls].sort((a, b) => {
      const ca = codes.get(String(a.id)) || birdCodeOf(a, fowls);
      const cb = codes.get(String(b.id)) || birdCodeOf(b, fowls);
      return compareBirdCodesNatural(ca, cb);
    });
  }, [fowls, codes]);

  const matchingFowls = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return sortedFowls;
    return sortedFowls.filter((f) => {
      if (f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      const code = codes.get(String(f.id)) || birdCodeOf(f, fowls);
      if (code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      if (f.bird_code && f.bird_code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      if (f.chicken_code && f.chicken_code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      if (f.birth_code && f.birth_code.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      if (f.wing_band && f.wing_band.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      return false;
    });
  }, [searchQuery, sortedFowls, codes, fowls]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (dropdownOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [dropdownOpen]);

  const subjectCode = codes.get(String(subject.id)) || birdCodeOf(subject, fowls);
  const displayLabel = `${formatBirdCodeForDisplay(subjectCode) ? `${formatBirdCodeForDisplay(subjectCode)} · ` : ''}${subject.name}`;

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className="relative min-w-[260px] flex-1 sm:min-w-[320px]">
      <div className="relative">
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 z-10 -translate-y-1/2"
        >
          <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </span>
        <input
          type="search"
          aria-label="Search pedigree subject"
          placeholder={displayLabel || 'Search subject by code, name, wing band…'}
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
            setDropdownOpen(true);
          }}
          onFocus={() => setDropdownOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
              e.preventDefault();
              setSearchQuery('');
              setDropdownOpen(false);
            }
          }}
          className="border-input-border bg-card text-card-foreground placeholder:text-foreground/90 h-9 w-full rounded-md border py-2 pr-8 pl-9 text-xs font-bold transition-all focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 sm:text-sm [&::-webkit-search-cancel-button]:appearance-none"
        />
        {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Clear subject search"
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchQuery('');
              setDropdownOpen(false);
            }}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground absolute top-1/2 right-2 -translate-y-1/2 cursor-pointer rounded p-1 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {dropdownOpen && matchingFowls.length > 0 && (
        <div
          role="listbox"
          aria-label="Matching chickens"
          className="bg-card border-border divide-border/50 absolute top-full right-0 left-0 z-50 mt-1.5 max-h-80 divide-y overflow-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border shadow-xl"
        >
          <div className="bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold tracking-wider uppercase">
            Matching Chickens ({matchingFowls.length})
          </div>
          {matchingFowls.slice(0, 100).map((f) => {
            const code = codes.get(String(f.id)) || birdCodeOf(f, fowls);
            const isSelected = f.id === subject.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={f.id}
                type="button"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={isSelected}
                onClick={() => {
                  onSelect(f);
                  setDropdownOpen(false);
                  setSearchQuery('');
                }}
                className={`group flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-emerald-950/30' : 'hover:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/30'}`}
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                  {code && (
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded border border-emerald-200/60 bg-emerald-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      [{formatBirdCodeForDisplay(code)}]
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-card-foreground truncate text-xs font-bold group-hover:text-emerald-600 dark:group-hover:text-emerald-400">
                    {f.name}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {f.registry_role && (
                  <span className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black uppercase">
                    {f.registry_role}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = {
  fowls: FowlRecord[];
  codes: Map<string, string>;
  selectedId?: number | null;
  onSelect?: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
  onViewProfile?: (f: FowlRecord) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  canRegisterAncestor?: boolean;
};

export default function PedigreeTree({
  fowls,
  codes,
  selectedId,
  onSelect,
  onViewProfile,
  loading = false,
  canRegisterAncestor = false,
}: Props) {
  const ui = useUI();
  const [internalId, setInternalId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [numGens, setNumGens] = useState<number>(3);
  const [breadcrumb, setBreadcrumb] = useState<{ id: number; name: string }[]>([]);

  const activeId = selectedId != null ? selectedId : internalId;

  const byName = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, FowlRecord>();
    fowls.forEach((f) => {
      const k = keyFn(f.name);
      if (k && !m.has(k)) m.set(k, f);
    });
    return m;
  }, [fowls]);

  const subject = useMemo(
    () => (activeId != null ? (fowls.find((f) => f.id === activeId) ?? null) : (fowls[0] ?? null)),
    [fowls, activeId],
  );

  const stats = useMemo(
    () => (subject ? getFowlBloodlineStats(subject, fowls) : null),
    [subject, fowls],
  );

  const parentageRelatedness = useMemo(
    () => (subject ? getOffspringParentageRelatedness(subject, fowls) : null),
    [subject, fowls],
  );

  const sortedFowls = useMemo(() => {
    return [...fowls].sort((a, b) => {
      const ca = codes.get(String(a.id)) || birdCodeOf(a, fowls);
      const cb = codes.get(String(b.id)) || birdCodeOf(b, fowls);
      return compareBirdCodesNatural(ca, cb);
    });
  }, [fowls, codes]);

  const currentIndex = useMemo(() => {
    if (!subject) return -1;
    return sortedFowls.findIndex((f) => f.id === subject.id);
  }, [sortedFowls, subject]);

  const { nodes, totalRows } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!subject) return { nodes: [], totalRows: 4 };
    return buildPedigreeGrid(subject, fowls, byName, numGens);
  }, [subject, fowls, byName, numGens]);

  const rowHeight = 76;
  const colWidth = 220;
  const colGap = 48;
  const paddingX = 20;
  const paddingTop = 20;

  const innerWidth = numGens * colWidth + (numGens - 1) * colGap + paddingX * 2;
  const innerHeight = totalRows * rowHeight + paddingTop * 2;

  const connectorPaths = useMemo(
    () =>
      computeGridConnectors(
        nodes,
        numGens,
        totalRows,
        colWidth,
        colGap,
        rowHeight,
        paddingX,
        paddingTop,
      ),
    [nodes, numGens, totalRows, colWidth, colGap, rowHeight, paddingX, paddingTop],
  );

  const updateUrlForSubject = useCallback(
    (f: FowlRecord) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
      const code = codes.get(String(f.id)) || birdCodeOf(f, fowls);
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      params.set('chicken', code || String(f.id));
      const existingTab = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab');
      if (existingTab) {
        params.set('tab', existingTab);
      }
      const qs = params.toString();
      const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}${window.location.hash}`;
      try {
        window.history.replaceState({ ...window.history.state }, '', newUrl);
      } catch (_err) {
        // no-op
      }
    },
    [codes, fowls],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    if (selectedId != null) return;
    if (fowls.length === 0) return;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const chicken = params.get('chicken');
    if (!chicken) return;
    const norm = chicken.trim().toLowerCase();
    const found = fowls.find((f) => {
      const code = codes.get(String(f.id)) || birdCodeOf(f, fowls);
      if (code && code.toLowerCase() === norm) return true;
      if (f.bird_code && f.bird_code.toLowerCase() === norm) return true;
      if (f.chicken_code && f.chicken_code.toLowerCase() === norm) return true;
      if (f.birth_code && f.birth_code.toLowerCase() === norm) return true;
      if (f.wing_band && f.wing_band.toLowerCase() === norm) return true;
      if (String(f.id) === norm) return true;
      return false;
    });
    if (found) {
      setInternalId(found.id);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleSubjectSelect = useCallback(
    (f: FowlRecord) => {
      if (!subject) return;
      if (f.id === subject.id) {
        updateUrlForSubject(f);
        return;
      }
      setBreadcrumb((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev];
        if (next.length === 0 || next[next.length - 1].id !== subject.id) {
          next.push({ id: subject.id, name: subject.name });
        }
        return next;
      });
      setInternalId(f.id);
      onSelect?.(f);
      updateUrlForSubject(f);
    },
    [subject, onSelect, updateUrlForSubject],
  );

  const doRecenter = useCallback(
    (f: FowlRecord) => {
      if (!subject) return;
      if (f.id === subject.id) return;
      setBreadcrumb((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev];
        if (next.length === 0 || next[next.length - 1].id !== subject.id) {
          next.push({ id: subject.id, name: subject.name });
        }
        return next;
      });
      setInternalId(f.id);
      onSelect?.(f);
      updateUrlForSubject(f);
    },
    [subject, onSelect, updateUrlForSubject],
  );

  const goPrev = useCallback(() => {
    if (sortedFowls.length === 0) return;
    const idx = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex : 0;
    const prevIdx = idx === 0 ? sortedFowls.length - 1 : idx - 1;
    handleSubjectSelect(sortedFowls[prevIdx]);
  }, [sortedFowls, currentIndex, handleSubjectSelect]);

  const goNext = useCallback(() => {
    if (sortedFowls.length === 0) return;
    const idx = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex : 0;
    const nextIdx = idx === sortedFowls.length - 1 ? 0 : idx + 1;
    handleSubjectSelect(sortedFowls[nextIdx]);
  }, [sortedFowls, currentIndex, handleSubjectSelect]);

  const goBack = useCallback(() => {
    setBreadcrumb((prev) => {
      if (prev.length === 0) return prev;
      const last = prev[prev.length - 1];
      setInternalId(last.id);
      const match = fowls.find((f) => f.id === last.id);
      if (match) onSelect?.(match);
      return prev.slice(0, -1);
    });
  }, [fowls, onSelect]);

  const handleViewProfile = useCallback(
    (f: FowlRecord) => {
      if (onViewProfile) {
        onViewProfile(f);
      } else {
        ui.setSelectedFowlForDetails(f);
      }
    },
    [onViewProfile, ui],
  );

  const handleRegisterMerged = useCallback(
    (_hint: { side?: 'sire' | 'dam'; breed?: string; childName: string }) => {
      if (!subject) return;
      const stub: Partial<FowlRecord> & {
        id: number;
        name: string;
        breed: string;
        gender: string;
        sire: string;
        dam: string;
        status: string;
      } = {
        id: 0,
        name: '',
        breed: _hint.breed || subject.breed || '',
        gender: _hint.side === 'dam' ? 'Hen' : 'Rooster',
        sire: '',
        dam: '',
        status: subject.status || 'Active',
      };
      ui.setEditingFowl(stub as FowlRecord);
    },
    [subject, ui],
  );

  const handleRegisterSingle = useCallback(
    (hint: {
      side: 'sire' | 'dam';
      breed?: string;
      childName: string;
      placeholderName: string;
    }) => {
      const stub: Partial<FowlRecord> & {
        id: number;
        name: string;
        breed: string;
        gender: string;
        sire: string;
        dam: string;
        status: string;
      } = {
        id: 0,
        name:
          hint.placeholderName && hint.placeholderName.toLowerCase() !== 'foundation stock'
            ? hint.placeholderName
            : '',
        breed: hint.breed || subject?.breed || '',
        gender: hint.side === 'dam' ? 'Hen' : 'Rooster',
        sire: '',
        dam: '',
        status: subject?.status || 'Active',
      };
      ui.setEditingFowl(stub as FowlRecord);
    },
    [subject, ui],
  );

  const handlePrint = () => window.print();

  if (loading && fowls.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-10 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-64 w-full" />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (fowls.length === 0 || !subject) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        compact
        title="No Pedigree To Show"
        description="Register chickens with Sire and Dam to build the lineage map."
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 print:space-y-2">
      <SkipLink href="#pedigree-main">Skip to pedigree chart</SkipLink>

      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 lg:flex-row">
        <div id="pedigree-main" className="w-full min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-3">
          <Card className="overflow-hidden print:border-none print:shadow-none">
            <CardContent className="space-y-3 p-3 sm:p-4">
              {/* Toolbar */}
              <div className="bg-muted/30 border-border no-print flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-lg border p-2.5">
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <SubjectSelector
                    fowls={fowls}
                    codes={codes}
                    subject={subject}
                    onSelect={handleSubjectSelect}
                  />

                  <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={goPrev}
                      aria-label="Previous chicken"
                      title="Previous chicken"
                      className="h-9 w-9 p-0"
                    >
                      <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={goNext}
                      aria-label="Next chicken"
                      title="Next chicken"
                      className="h-9 w-9 p-0"
                    >
                      <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>

                  {breadcrumb.length > 0 && (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={goBack}
                      aria-label={`Back to ${breadcrumb[breadcrumb.length - 1].name}`}
                      className="h-9 max-w-[160px] gap-1 truncate text-xs"
                    >
                      <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">
                        Back to {breadcrumb[breadcrumb.length - 1].name}
                      </span>
                    </Button>
                  )}

                  {parentageRelatedness && (
                    <RelatednessBadge
                      classification={parentageRelatedness}
                      prefix="Bred from: "
                      showSecondary
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="bg-muted border-border inline-flex items-center rounded-md border p-0.5 text-xs font-bold">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setNumGens(3)}
                      className={`cursor-pointer rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black transition-colors ${
                        numGens === 3
                          ? 'bg-card text-emerald-600 shadow-2xs dark:text-emerald-400'
                          : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      3 Gens
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setNumGens(4)}
                      className={`cursor-pointer rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-black transition-colors ${
                        numGens === 4
                          ? 'bg-card text-emerald-600 shadow-2xs dark:text-emerald-400'
                          : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      4 Gens
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handlePrint}
                    aria-label="Print or export pedigree as PDF"
                    className="h-9 gap-1.5 text-xs"
                  >
                    <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Print / PDF
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Mobile Outline View (<768px) */}
              <div className="block md:hidden">
                <details className="border-border bg-card/60 rounded-md border">
                  <summary className="text-muted-foreground cursor-pointer px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold select-none">
                    📜 Mobile Pedigree Lineage List (tap to view)
                  </summary>
                  <ul className="border-border divide-border space-y-1 divide-y border-t px-3 pt-1 pb-3">
                    {nodes.map((node) => (
                      <li
                        key={node.id}
                        className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5 text-xs"
                      >
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground font-semibold">
                          {'\u00A0\u00A0'.repeat(node.gen)}
                          <span className="text-card-foreground font-bold">
                            {node.role.toUpperCase()}: {node.name}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        {node.fowl && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleViewProfile(node.fowl!)}
                            className="text-primary text-xs font-bold hover:underline"
                          >
                            Profile
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </details>
              </div>

              {/* Desktop CSS Grid Pedigree Chart (≥768px) */}
              <div className="no-scrollbar border-border bg-muted/20 hidden overflow-x-auto rounded-md border p-4 md:block print:border-0 print:bg-white">
                {/* Column Headers */}
                <div
                  className="text-muted-foreground border-border/60 mb-3 grid border-b pb-2 font-mono text-xs font-black tracking-wider uppercase"
                  style={{
                    gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${numGens}, ${colWidth}px)`,
                    columnGap: `${colGap}px`,
                    paddingLeft: `${paddingX}px`,
                  }}
                >
                  <div>Subject (G0)</div>
                  <div>Parents (G1)</div>
                  <div>Grandparents (G2)</div>
                  {numGens >= 4 && <div>Great-Grandparents (G3)</div>}
                </div>

                <div
                  className="relative"
                  style={{
                    width: innerWidth,
                    minWidth: innerWidth,
                    height: innerHeight,
                  }}
                  aria-label="Pedigree ancestor tree chart"
                  role="tree"
                >
                  <div className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
                    Pedigree chart for {subject.name}. Showing {numGens} generations.
                  </div>

                  {/* SVG Connector Overlay */}
                  <svg
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-0"
                    width={innerWidth}
                    height={innerHeight}
                    viewBox={`0 0 ${innerWidth} ${innerHeight}`}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    {connectorPaths.map((c) => (
                      <path
                        key={c.id}
                        d={c.path}
                        className="stroke-slate-400 dark:stroke-slate-600"
                        fill="none"
                        strokeWidth={1.5}
                        strokeDasharray={c.isDashed ? '4 3' : undefined}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </svg>

                  {/* Mathematical CSS Grid */}
                  <div
                    className="absolute z-10 grid"
                    style={{
                      left: 0,
                      top: 0,
                      width: innerWidth,
                      height: innerHeight,
                      gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${numGens}, ${colWidth}px)`,
                      gridTemplateRows: `repeat(${totalRows}, ${rowHeight}px)`,
                      columnGap: `${colGap}px`,
                      paddingLeft: `${paddingX}px`,
                      paddingTop: `${paddingTop}px`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {nodes.map((node) => {
                      const gridCol = node.gen + 1;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={node.id}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center"
                          style={{
                            gridColumn: gridCol,
                            gridRow: `${node.startRow} / span ${node.rowSpan}`,
                            alignSelf: 'center',
                          }}
                        >
                          <CompactNodeCard
                            node={node}
                            fowls={fowls}
                            codes={codes}
                            canRegisterAncestor={canRegisterAncestor}
                            onRecenter={doRecenter}
                            onViewProfile={handleViewProfile}
                            onRegisterMerged={handleRegisterMerged}
                            onRegisterSingle={handleRegisterSingle}
                          />
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Compact Right Bloodline Panel */}
        <div className="w-full shrink-0 lg:w-[320px]">
          <BloodlineBreakdown
            stats={stats ?? undefined}
            title={`Bloodline — ${subject.name}`}
            subtitle="Compact summary · 50% sire · 50% dam, halved each generation"
            fowl={subject}
            fowls={fowls}
            compact
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @media print {
          body { background: white !important; color: black !important; }
          .no-print { display: none !important; }
          header, nav, sidebar, footer { display: none !important; }
          @page { size: letter landscape; margin: 10mm; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import DeclaredCompositionEditor from './DeclaredCompositionEditor';

describe('DeclaredCompositionEditor Component UI', () => {
  it('renders foundation stock view with empty inputs when no parents and no declaration', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(
      <DeclaredCompositionEditor
        registeredBreed="Hatch"
        availableBreeds={['Hatch', 'Sweater', 'Kelso']}
        value={null}
        onChange={onChange}
        hasParents={false}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.getByText('Purity (breed composition)')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('Foundation Stock')).toBeDefined();
    expect(
      screen.getByText(/Enter it manually if you know it\. Leave blank if unknown/i)
    ).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('Assumed from registered breed (not verified)')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('100% (Assumed)')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('100% Hatch')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('+ Add another breed')).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('renders "No breeds yet. Add your breeds first" with a link when availableBreeds is empty and no parents', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(
      <DeclaredCompositionEditor
        registeredBreed=""
        availableBreeds={[]}
        value={null}
        onChange={onChange}
        hasParents={false}
      />
    );

    expect(
      screen.getByText('No breeds yet. Add your breeds first to declare custom composition.')
    ).toBeDefined();
    const link = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Add Breeds/i });
    expect(link.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/breeds');
  });

  it('one-tap 100% shortcut triggers onChange with 100% registered breed', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    render(
      <DeclaredCompositionEditor
        registeredBreed="Sweater"
        availableBreeds={['Sweater', 'Hatch']}
        value={null}
        onChange={onChange}
        hasParents={false}
      />
    );

    const shortcutBtn = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /100% Sweater/i });
    fireEvent.click(shortcutBtn);
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith([{ breed: 'Sweater', percent: 100 }]);
  });

  it('renders recorded lineage view with Calculated from parents and Adjust manually toggle when parents exist', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    const pedComp = { Hatch: 50, Sweater: 50 };

    render(
      <DeclaredCompositionEditor
        registeredBreed="Crossbred"
        availableBreeds={['Hatch', 'Sweater', 'Kelso']}
        value={null}
        onChange={onChange}
        hasParents={true}
        pedigreeComposition={pedComp}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.getByText('Recorded Lineage')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('Derived from parents')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByText('50% Hatch / 50% Sweater')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Adjust manually/i })).toBeDefined();

    // Clicking toggle turns on manual adjustment and prefills calculated values
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Adjust manually/i }));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith([
      { breed: 'Hatch', percent: 50 },
      { breed: 'Sweater', percent: 50 },
    ]);
  });

  it('renders manual adjustment inputs, pedigree indicators, and warnings when parents exist and adjusted', () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn();
    const pedComp = { Hatch: 50, Sweater: 50 };
    const adjustedValue = [
      { breed: 'Hatch', percent: 75 },
      { breed: 'Sweater', percent: 25 },
    ];

    render(
      <DeclaredCompositionEditor
        registeredBreed="Crossbred"
        availableBreeds={['Hatch', 'Sweater', 'Kelso']}
        value={adjustedValue}
        onChange={onChange}
        hasParents={true}
        pedigreeComposition={pedComp}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.getByText('Adjusted by owner')).toBeDefined();
    expect(screen.getAllByText('(Ped: 50%)')).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(screen.getByText('Reset to calculated')).toBeDefined();
    // Warning because 75% differs from 50% by 25pp (>20pp)
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/differs by 25 percentage points/i)).toHaveLength(2);

    // Clicking reset to calculated calls onChange(null)
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Reset to calculated'));
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null);
  });
});

'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  RotateCcw,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { DeclaredBreedShare } from '@/lib/types';
import {
  validateDeclaredComposition,
  declaredToComposition,
  type DeclaredCompositionValidationResult,
  type BloodlineComposition,
} from '@/lib/bloodline-composition';
import { getBreedingClassification, type CompositionSource } from '@/lib/breeding-classification';
import { cn } from '@/components/ui/utils';

export interface DeclaredCompositionEditorProps {
  registeredBreed: string;
  availableBreeds: string[];
  value: DeclaredBreedShare[] | null;
  onChange: (val: DeclaredBreedShare[] | null) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  hasParents?: boolean;
  pedigreeComposition?: BloodlineComposition | null;
  currentValue?: DeclaredBreedShare[] | null;
  calculatedValue?: BloodlineComposition | null;
  source?: CompositionSource;
}

export function formatCompositionSummary(comp?: BloodlineComposition | null): string {
  if (!comp || Object.keys(comp).length === 0) return 'Unknown';
  return Object.entries(comp)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .map(([breed, pct]) => `${pct}% ${breed}`)
    .join(' / ');
}

export default function DeclaredCompositionEditor({
  registeredBreed,
  availableBreeds,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  hasParents = false,
  pedigreeComposition,
  currentValue,
  calculatedValue,
  source,
}: DeclaredCompositionEditorProps) {
  const currentBreed = registeredBreed.trim() || 'Registered Breed';
  const isCustomDeclared = Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0;

  // Resolve pedigree summary string
  const activePedigree = pedigreeComposition ?? calculatedValue ?? null;
  const pedigreeSummary = useMemo(() => formatCompositionSummary(activePedigree), [activePedigree]);

  // Validation
  const validation: DeclaredCompositionValidationResult = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isCustomDeclared) {
      return { valid: true, total: 100, parsed: [], errors: [], warnings: [] };
    }
    return validateDeclaredComposition(value, registeredBreed, availableBreeds, {
      isOffspring: hasParents,
      pedigreeComposition: activePedigree,
    });
  }, [isCustomDeclared, value, registeredBreed, availableBreeds, hasParents, activePedigree]);

  // Preview classification
  const previewClassification = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isCustomDeclared) return null;
    const comp = declaredToComposition(validation.parsed);
    const mockFowl = {
      id: -999,
      name: 'Preview',
      breed: registeredBreed,
      bloodline_composition: comp,
      declared_composition: validation.parsed,
    };
    return getBreedingClassification(mockFowl as any, []);
  }, [isCustomDeclared, validation.parsed, registeredBreed]);

  // Calculate live total and remaining
  const currentTotal = useMemo(() => {
    if (!value || value.length === 0) return 0;
    const sum = value.reduce((acc, row) => acc + (Number(row.percent) || 0), 0);
    return Math.round(sum * 10) / 10;
  }, [value]);

  const remainingPercent = Math.round(Math.max(0, 100 - currentTotal) * 10) / 10;

  // Toggle manual adjustment on offspring
  const handleToggleOffspringAdjust = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    if (isCustomDeclared) {
      // Turn off manual adjustment -> clear declaration
      onChange(null);
    } else {
      // Turn on manual adjustment -> prefill from calculated pedigree
      if (activePedigree && Object.keys(activePedigree).length > 0) {
        const prefilled: DeclaredBreedShare[] = Object.entries(activePedigree).map(
          ([breed, percent]) => ({ breed, percent }),
        );
        onChange(prefilled);
      } else {
        const initial = registeredBreed.trim() || availableBreeds[0] || 'Registered Breed';
        onChange([{ breed: initial, percent: 100 }]);
      }
    }
  };

  // One-tap 100% shortcut for foundation
  const handleShortcut100 = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    const b = registeredBreed.trim() || availableBreeds[0] || 'Registered Breed';
    onChange([{ breed: b, percent: 100 }]);
  };

  // Add row
  const handleAddRow = () => {
    if (disabled || (value && value.length >= 4)) return;
    const existingKeys = new Set((value || []).map((v) => v.breed.trim().toLowerCase()));
    const nextBreed =
      availableBreeds.find((b) => !existingKeys.has(b.trim().toLowerCase())) ||
      availableBreeds[0] ||
      currentBreed;

    if (!value || value.length === 0) {
      onChange([
        { breed: currentBreed, percent: 0 },
        { breed: nextBreed, percent: 0 },
      ]);
    } else {
      onChange([...value, { breed: nextBreed, percent: 0 }]);
    }
  };

  // Remove row
  const handleRemoveRow = (index: number) => {
    if (disabled || !value) return;
    const next = value.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    if (next.length === 0) {
      onChange(null);
    } else {
      onChange(next);
    }
  };

  // Change row
  const handleRowChange = (index: number, field: 'breed' | 'percent', val: string | number) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    const baseList = value ? [...value] : [{ breed: currentBreed, percent: 0 }];
    if (index >= baseList.length) {
      baseList.push({ breed: currentBreed, percent: 0 });
    }

    if (field === 'breed') {
      baseList[index] = { ...baseList[index], breed: String(val) };
    } else {
      const parsedVal = val === '' ? 0 : typeof val === 'number' ? val : parseFloat(val);
      const num = Number.isNaN(parsedVal) ? 0 : parsedVal;
      baseList[index] = { ...baseList[index], percent: num };
    }
    onChange(baseList);
  };

  // Reset to calculated
  const handleResetToCalculated = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    onChange(null);
  };

  // Pedigree lookup helper for offspring
  const getPedigreePct = (breedName: string): number | null => {
    if (!activePedigree) return null;
    const key = breedName.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (const [s, pct] of Object.entries(activePedigree)) {
      if (s.trim().toLowerCase() === key) return pct;
    }
    return null;
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="purity-composition-section"
      data-testid="purity-composition-editor"
      className="border-border bg-card space-y-3.5 rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-xs"
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">
            Purity (breed composition)
            <span className="border-border bg-muted/50 text-foreground rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-normal normal-case">
              {hasParents ? 'Recorded Lineage' : 'Foundation Stock'}
            </span>
          </h4>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 text-xs">
            {hasParents
              ? 'Expected values calculated from parents; you may adjust manually based on bird traits.'
              : 'Enter it manually if you know it. Leave blank if unknown; the system assumes 100% of the selected breed and marks it Assumed.'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Source badge indicator */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {hasParents ? (
            <span
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold',
                isCustomDeclared
                  ? 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
                  : 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
              )}
            >
              {isCustomDeclared ? 'Adjusted by owner' : 'Derived from parents'}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold',
                isCustomDeclared
                  ? 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
                  : 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400',
              )}
            >
              {isCustomDeclared
                ? 'Declared by owner'
                : 'Assumed from registered breed (not verified)'}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Edit modal summary if current vs calculated values exist */}
      {(currentValue !== undefined || calculatedValue !== undefined) && (
        <div className="border-border/80 bg-muted/20 space-y-1 rounded-lg border p-2.5 text-xs">
          {calculatedValue && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Calculated from parents:</span>
              <span className="text-foreground font-mono font-medium">
                {formatCompositionSummary(calculatedValue)}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          {currentValue && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Current declaration:</span>
              <span className="text-foreground font-mono font-medium">
                {currentValue.map((c) => `${c.percent}% ${c.breed}`).join(' / ')}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          {source && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Source:</span>
              <span className="text-foreground font-medium capitalize">{source}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PARENTS RECORDED VIEW ── */}
      {hasParents && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="border-border/70 bg-muted/30 flex flex-col justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-lg border p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs sm:items-center">
              <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 sm:mt-0 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <div>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Calculated from parents: </span>
                <strong className="text-foreground">{pedigreeSummary}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={handleToggleOffspringAdjust}
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex min-h-[44px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors',
                isCustomDeclared
                  ? 'border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400'
                  : 'border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground',
              )}
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {isCustomDeclared ? 'Adjusting manually (Active)' : 'Adjust manually'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {!isCustomDeclared ? (
            <p className="text-muted-foreground px-1 text-xs">
              By default, this bird inherits the 50/50 pedigree average from its parents. Toggle
              &quot;Adjust manually&quot; if you observed specific breed traits differing from the
              expectation.
            </p>
          ) : (
            /* Offspring manual adjustment rows */
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {value.map((item, idx) => {
                  const pedPct = getPedigreePct(item.breed);
                  const isLineage = pedPct !== null && pedPct > 0;
                  return (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:flex-nowrap">
                      {/* Breed selector */}
                      <div className="min-w-[140px] flex-1">
                        <select
                          disabled={disabled}
                          value={item.breed}
                          onChange={(e) => handleRowChange(idx, 'breed', e.target.value)}
                          className="border-border bg-background text-foreground h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                          aria-label={`Breed for share ${idx + 1}`}
                        >
                          {availableBreeds.map((b) => (
                            <option key={b} value={b}>
                              {b}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      {/* Percent input with pedigree indicator */}
                      <div className="flex w-32 shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          disabled={disabled}
                          min="0"
                          max="100"
                          step="0.1"
                          value={item.percent === 0 ? '' : item.percent}
                          onChange={(e) => handleRowChange(idx, 'percent', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="0"
                          className="border-border bg-background text-foreground h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-lg border px-2.5 text-right font-mono text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                          aria-label={`Percentage for ${item.breed}`}
                        />
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold">
                          %
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Pedigree reference tag */}
                      <div className="text-muted-foreground w-24 shrink-0 font-mono text-xs">
                        {isLineage ? (
                          `(Ped: ${pedPct}%)`
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-sans text-xs text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                            Non-lineage
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Remove row */}
                      {value.length > 1 && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          disabled={disabled}
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveRow(idx)}
                          className="text-muted-foreground flex min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400"
                          title="Remove breed share"
                          aria-label={`Remove breed share ${item.breed}`}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Action buttons & Total indicator */}
              <div className="border-border/50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t pt-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {value.length < 4 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onClick={handleAddRow}
                      className="border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Add Another Breed
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={handleResetToCalculated}
                    className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs transition-colors"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Reset to calculated
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Total indicator */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">Total:</span>
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'flex min-h-[30px] items-center rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold',
                      Math.abs(currentTotal - 100) <= 0.11
                        ? 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                        : 'border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
                    )}
                  >
                    {currentTotal}%
                    {Math.abs(currentTotal - 100) > 0.11 && (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground ml-1 text-xs font-normal">
                        ({remainingPercent}% left)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Warnings (non-blocking) */}
              {validation.warnings.map((w, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300"
                >
                  <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                  <span className="leading-relaxed">{w}</span>
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* Errors (blocking save) */}
              {validation.error && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
                  <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="leading-relaxed">{validation.error}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── NO PARENTS (FOUNDATION / UNKNOWN PARENTS) VIEW ── */}
      {!hasParents && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {availableBreeds.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="border-border/60 bg-muted/20 flex flex-col justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-lg border p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <div className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                <Info className="text-muted-foreground h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>No breeds yet. Add your breeds first to declare custom composition.</span>
              </div>
              <a
                href="/breeds"
                className="flex min-h-[44px] shrink-0 items-center text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 hover:underline dark:text-emerald-400"
              >
                Add Breeds →
              </a>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {/* Rows */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {/* Always render at least Row 0: Registered Breed */}
                {!value || value.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:flex-nowrap">
                    <div className="border-border bg-muted/30 text-foreground flex h-11 min-h-[44px] min-w-[140px] flex-1 items-center rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs font-medium">
                      {currentBreed}
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground ml-2 text-xs font-normal">
                        (Registered)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex w-32 shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        disabled={disabled}
                        min="0"
                        max="100"
                        step="0.1"
                        value=""
                        placeholder="100"
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          if (val === '') {
                            onChange(null);
                          } else {
                            onChange([{ breed: currentBreed, percent: parseFloat(val) || 0 }]);
                          }
                        }}
                        className="border-border bg-background text-foreground h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-lg border px-2.5 text-right font-mono text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                        aria-label={`Percentage for ${currentBreed}`}
                      />
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold">
                        %
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onClick={handleShortcut100}
                      className="border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                      100% {currentBreed}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  value.map((item, idx) => {
                    const isFirst = idx === 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:flex-nowrap">
                        <div className="min-w-[140px] flex-1">
                          {isFirst ? (
                            <div className="border-border bg-muted/30 text-foreground flex h-11 min-h-[44px] items-center rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs font-medium">
                              {item.breed}
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground ml-2 text-xs font-normal">
                                (Registered)
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <select
                              disabled={disabled}
                              value={item.breed}
                              onChange={(e) => handleRowChange(idx, 'breed', e.target.value)}
                              className="border-border bg-background text-foreground h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                              aria-label={`Breed for share ${idx + 1}`}
                            >
                              {availableBreeds.map((b) => (
                                <option key={b} value={b}>
                                  {b}
                                </option>
                              ))}
                            </select>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex w-32 shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            disabled={disabled}
                            min="0"
                            max="100"
                            step="0.1"
                            value={item.percent === 0 ? '' : item.percent}
                            onChange={(e) => handleRowChange(idx, 'percent', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="0"
                            className="border-border bg-background text-foreground h-11 min-h-[44px] w-full rounded-lg border px-2.5 text-right font-mono text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 focus:outline-hidden"
                            aria-label={`Percentage for ${item.breed}`}
                          />
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold">
                            %
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {/* If single row and not 100%, show 100% shortcut */}
                        {isFirst && value.length === 1 && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={disabled}
                            onClick={handleShortcut100}
                            className="border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
                          >
                            <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                            100% {currentBreed}
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {value.length > 1 && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={disabled}
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveRow(idx)}
                            className="text-muted-foreground flex min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400"
                            title="Remove breed share"
                            aria-label={`Remove breed share ${item.breed}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Action buttons & Total indicator */}
              <div className="border-border/50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t pt-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {(!value || value.length < 4) && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onClick={handleAddRow}
                      className="border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />+ Add another breed
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {isCustomDeclared && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      onClick={() => onChange(null)}
                      className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground inline-flex min-h-[44px] cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs transition-colors"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      Clear (assumed pure)
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Total indicator */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold">Total:</span>
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'flex min-h-[30px] items-center rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold',
                      !isCustomDeclared
                        ? 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                        : Math.abs(currentTotal - 100) <= 0.11
                          ? 'border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                          : 'border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
                    )}
                  >
                    {!isCustomDeclared ? '100% (Assumed)' : `${currentTotal}%`}
                    {isCustomDeclared && Math.abs(currentTotal - 100) > 0.11 && (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground ml-1 text-xs font-normal">
                        ({remainingPercent}% left)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Inline Validation Error */}
              {isCustomDeclared && validation.error && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
                  <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="leading-relaxed">{validation.error}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Inline Warnings */}
              {isCustomDeclared &&
                validation.warnings.map((w, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-2.5 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300"
                  >
                    <Info className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                    <span className="leading-relaxed">{w}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}

              {/* Preview of resulting type */}
              {previewClassification && validation.valid && (
                <div className="border-border/80 bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border p-2.5 text-xs">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">Preview Classification:</span>
                  <span className="text-foreground font-semibold">
                    {previewClassification.badgeLabel}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
