export function StatusItem({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  tone,
}: {
  icon?: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  tone: 'green' | 'amber' | 'rose';
}) {
  const toneCls =
    tone === 'green'
      ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
      : tone === 'amber'
        ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
        : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800';

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-muted/50 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-border p-3 min-w-0 h-full flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 min-w-0">
        {icon && <span className="text-xs shrink-0 select-none mt-0.5">{icon}</span>}
        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-tight sm:tracking-wider text-muted-foreground leading-snug break-words">
          {label}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0 min-w-0 max-w-full">
        <span
          className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border min-w-0 max-w-full break-words whitespace-normal text-center ${toneCls}`}
        >
          {value}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function EncodeForm({

  const strainInputElRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const legColorInputRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [strainDropdownPos, setStrainDropdownPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number; width: number } | null>(null);
  const [legColorDropdownPos, setLegColorDropdownPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number; width: number } | null>(null);
  const [isManualOverride, setIsManualOverride] = useState(false);

  const birthdateValidation = useMemo(
    () => validateOffspringBirthdate(newBirthdate, sireName, damName, fowls),
    [newBirthdate, sireName, damName, fowls],
  );

  const hasSire = !!sireName.trim() && sireName.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'foundation stock';
  const hasDam = !!damName.trim() && damName.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'foundation stock';
  const isOffspring = hasSire || hasDam;
  const currentRole: 'sire' | 'dam' | 'offspring' = isOffspring
    ? 'offspring'
    : newGender === 'Hen' || newGender === 'Female'
      ? 'dam'
      : 'sire';

  const pedigreeComposition = useMemo<BloodlineComposition | null>(() => {
    if (!hasAnyParent) return null;
    const draft = {
      id: -1,
      name: newName.trim() || '__preview__',
      breed: selectedStrains.length > 0 ? selectedStrains.join(', ') : newBreed,
      gender: newGender,
      sire: sireName,
      dam: damName,
    } as FowlRecord;
    return computePedigreeComposition(draft, fowls);
  }, [hasAnyParent, newName, selectedStrains, newBreed, newGender, sireName, damName, fowls]);

  const declaredValidation = useMemo(() => {
    if (!newDeclaredComposition || newDeclaredComposition.length === 0) {
      return { valid: true };
    }
    const currentBreed = selectedStrains.length > 0 ? selectedStrains.join(', ') : newBreed;
    return validateDeclaredComposition(newDeclaredComposition, currentBreed, availableStrains, {
      isOffspring,
      pedigreeComposition,
    });
  }, [isOffspring, newDeclaredComposition, selectedStrains, newBreed, availableStrains, pedigreeComposition]);

  const nextIdLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const rawCode = formatBirdCodeForDisplay(birdCode.trim() || suggestedBirdCode);
    if (!rawCode) return currentRole === 'offspring' ? '— (Select parents)' : '—';
    if (currentRole === 'sire') {
      return rawCode.toLowerCase().startsWith('sire') ? rawCode : `Sire ${rawCode}`;
    }
    if (currentRole === 'dam') {
      return rawCode.toLowerCase().startsWith('dam') ? rawCode : `Dam ${rawCode}`;
    }
    return rawCode;
  }, [birdCode, suggestedBirdCode, currentRole]);

  useEffect(() => {

    const update = () => {
      if (strainInputRef.current) {
        const r = strainInputRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        setStrainDropdownPos({ top: r.bottom + 6, left: r.left, width: r.width });
      }
    };
    update();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', update, true);
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);

        {(() => {

            ? fowls.some((f) => normalizeBirdCode(f.bird_code).toLowerCase() === normalizeBirdCode(birdCode).toLowerCase())
            : false;
          const parentCheck = (currentRole === 'offspring' && birdCode.trim())
            ? checkParentageMatch(birdCode.trim(), sireBirdCode, damBirdCode)
            : { matches: true };

          return (
            <div className="bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-muted/40 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-border space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-card-foreground uppercase tracking-wider" htmlFor="chicken-code">
                  {t('registry.uniqueChickenId')}
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setIsManualOverride(!isManualOverride);
                    if (isManualOverride) setBirdCode('');
                  }}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isManualOverride ? (
                    <>
                      <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{t('registry.useAutoAssignedCode')}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{t('registry.editIdManually')}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

              {!isManualOverride ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-md border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{t('registry.identifierLabel')}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-base font-extrabold tracking-wide text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                        {suggestedBirdCode ? formatBirdCodeForDisplay(suggestedBirdCode) : currentRole === 'offspring' ? t('registry.selectSireAndDam') : t('registry.generating')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700">
                      {suggestedBirdCode
                        ? currentRole === 'sire' ? t('registry.autoAssignedSire') : currentRole === 'dam' ? t('registry.autoAssignedDam') : t('registry.autoAssignedOffspring')
                        : currentRole === 'offspring'
                          ? t('registry.awaitingParents')
                          : t('registry.autoAssigned')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={birdCode}
                      onChange={(e) => setBirdCode(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-3 border border-emerald-500 rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground font-mono font-bold focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-100"
                      placeholder={formatBirdCodeForDisplay(suggestedBirdCode) || (currentRole === 'sire' ? 'e.g. 1' : currentRole === 'dam' ? 'e.g. A' : 'e.g. 1A1')}
                      id="chicken-code"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs font-semibold">
                    {birdCode.trim() ? (
                      <>
                        {formatCheck && !formatCheck.valid ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold">⚠️ {formatCheck.error}</span>
                        ) : isDuplicate ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold">{t('registry.idAlreadyInUse', { code: birdCode.trim() })}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">{t('registry.validFormatForRole', { role: currentRole })}</span>
                        )}
                        {!parentCheck.matches && parentCheck.warning && (
                          <span className="text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 rounded p-1">⚠️ {parentCheck.warning}</span>
                        )}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('registry.formatHelpText')}</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })()}
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider" htmlFor="wing-band-id">
              {t('registry.wingBandId')} <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal lowercase">{t('registry.wingBandSub')}</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={wingBand}
            onChange={(e) => setWingBand(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={50}
            className="w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-100 transition-all font-mono font-bold"
            placeholder={t('registry.wingBandPlaceholder')}
            id="wing-band-id"
          />
          {(() => {
            const trimmedBand = wingBand.trim();
            const isBandDuplicate = trimmedBand
              ? fowls.some((f) => (f.wing_band || '').trim().toLowerCase() === trimmedBand.toLowerCase())
              : false;
            return (
              <div className="mt-1">
                {isBandDuplicate && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold mb-1">
                    {t('registry.wingBandDuplicate', { band: trimmedBand })}
                  </p>
                )}
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold">
                  {trimmedBand ? t('registry.wingBandHelpWithVal') : t('registry.wingBandHelpOptional')}
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="genetic-strain">{t('registry.geneticStrain')}</label>
          {selectedStrains.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2.5">
              {selectedStrains.map((s, i) => (
                <span key={`${s}-${i}`} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-card border border-slate-200 dark:border-border shadow-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-card-foreground text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-sm group hover:border-emerald-300 transition-all">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shrink-0"></span>
                  {s}
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => removeStrain(i)} aria-label={t('registry.removeStrainAria')} className="ml-0.5 w-6 h-6 rounded-sm bg-slate-100 dark:bg-muted hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100">✕</button>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="relative" ref={strainInputRef}>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                ref={strainInputElRef}
                type="text"
                value={strainQuery}
                onChange={(e) => { setStrainQuery(e.target.value); setNewBreed(e.target.value); setStrainOpen(true); }}
                onFocus={() => setStrainOpen(true)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const trimmed = strainQuery.trim();
                    if (trimmed) { addStrain(trimmed); setStrainOpen(false); }
                  }
                  if (e.key === 'Escape') setStrainOpen(false);
                }}
                placeholder="Select or type a strain..."
                className={`w-full pl-3 pr-9 p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500 font-semibold transition-all ${strainQuery ? 'text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground font-normal'}`}
              id="genetic-strain" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setStrainOpen((o) => !o)}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 rounded-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-border bg-white dark:bg-input text-muted-foreground text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 cursor-pointer hover:text-success transition-colors"
                aria-label="Toggle strain list"
              >
                ▾
              </button>
            </div>
            {strainOpen && strainDropdownPos && createPortal(
              <div className="fixed z-[9999] bg-white dark:bg-card border border-slate-200 dark:border-border rounded-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-56 flex flex-col" style={{ top: strainDropdownPos.top, left: strainDropdownPos.left, width: strainDropdownPos.width }}>
                <div className="overflow-y-auto">
                  {(() => {
                    const q = strainQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
                    const matching = q
                      ? availableStrains.filter((s) => s.toLowerCase().includes(q))
                      : availableStrains;
                    if (q && !availableStrains.some((s) => s.toLowerCase() === q)) {
                      return (
                        <>
                          {matching.length > 0 && <div className="px-4 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Matching strains</div>}
                          {matching.map((s) => (
                            <div key={s} className="flex items-center w-full group">
                              <button type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); addStrain(s); setStrainQuery(s); setStrainOpen(false); strainInputElRef.current?.blur(); }} className={`flex-1 text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${selectedStrains.includes(s) ? 'text-success dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                                {s} {selectedStrains.includes(s) && <span className="text-xs text-success ml-1">✓ added</span>}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </>
                      );
                    }
                    return matching.map((s) => (
                        <button key={s} type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); addStrain(s); setStrainQuery(s); setStrainOpen(false); strainInputElRef.current?.blur(); }} className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${s.toLowerCase() === strainQuery.trim().toLowerCase() ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-success dark:text-emerald-300' : selectedStrains.includes(s) ? 'text-success dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                          {s} {selectedStrains.includes(s) && <span className="text-xs text-success ml-1">✓ added</span>}
                        </button>
                    ));
                  })()}
                  {strainQuery.trim() === '' && availableStrains.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span>No breeds yet. Add your breeds first.</span>
                      <a
                        href="/breeds"
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline shrink-0"
                      >
                        Add Breeds →
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>,
              document.body
            )}
          </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="gender-class">{t('registry.genderClass')}</label>
            <select value={newGender} onChange={(e) => { const g = e.target.value; setNewGender(g); if (age.trim() !== '' && !isNaN(Number(age))) { setNewGrowthStage(autoComputeGrowthStageLocal(Number(age), g)); } else { setNewGrowthStage(''); } }} className={`w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-muted font-extrabold focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-500/10 transition-all cursor-pointer ${newGender ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground font-normal'}`} required id="gender-class">
              <option value="" disabled className="bg-popover text-muted-foreground">{t('registry.selectGenderClass')}</option>
              {GENDER_CLASS_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                <option
                  key={option.value}
                  value={option.value}
                  className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground"
                >
                  {t(option.labelKey)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          {!hasAnyParent && (
            <div className="sm:col-span-2 pt-1">
              <DeclaredCompositionEditor
                registeredBreed={selectedStrains.length > 0 ? selectedStrains.join(', ') : newBreed}
                availableBreeds={availableStrains}
                value={newDeclaredComposition ?? null}
                onChange={(val) => setNewDeclaredComposition?.(val)}
                hasParents={false}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="feather-color">
              {t('registry.featherColor')}
              {isCustomColor && (
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/60 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 ml-2 normal-case tracking-normal">{t('registry.customBadge')}</span>
              )}
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              list="feather-color-options"
              value={newColor}
              onChange={(e) => setNewColor?.(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => {
                if (newColor) {
                  setNewColor?.(normalizeOptionValue(newColor, featherColorOptions.map((o) => o.value)));
                }
              }}
              placeholder={t('registry.featherColorPlaceholder')}
              className="w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500 font-semibold transition-all"
              id="feather-color"
            />
            <datalist id="feather-color-options">
              {featherColorOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label || opt.value}
                </option>
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="behavior-trait">
              {t('registry.trait')}
              {isCustomTrait && (
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/60 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 ml-2 normal-case tracking-normal">{t('registry.customBadge')}</span>
              )}
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              list="trait-options"
              value={newBehaviorTrait}
              onChange={(e) => setNewBehaviorTrait?.(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => {
                if (newBehaviorTrait) {
                  setNewBehaviorTrait?.(normalizeOptionValue(newBehaviorTrait, traitOptions.map((o) => o.value)));
                }
              }}
              placeholder={t('registry.traitPlaceholder')}
              className="w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500 font-semibold transition-all"
              id="behavior-trait"
            />
            <datalist id="trait-options">
              {traitOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label || opt.value}
                </option>
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="antigravity-hover bg-white dark:bg-card p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-border shadow-sm space-y-5">
        <h3 className="font-black text-sm text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-2 border-b pb-2.5 border-slate-100 dark:border-border">
          <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shrink-0">2</span>
          <span>{t('registry.step2Title')}</span>
        </h3>
        <div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="birth-date">
            {t('registry.birthDate')} <span className="text-success dark:text-emerald-300 font-black">{autoCalcAge ? t('registry.requiredAutoAge') : t('registry.requiredOnly')}</span>
          </label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={newBirthdate}
            onChange={(e) => handleNewBirthdateChange(e.target.value)}
            max={new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}
            className={`w-full p-3 border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground font-semibold focus:ring-4 transition-all ${
              birthdateValidation.errors.length > 0
                ? 'border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-100 dark:focus:ring-rose-950/50'
                : 'border-input-border focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-emerald-100'
            }`}
            required
            id="birth-date"
          />
          {birthdateValidation.errors.map((err, i) => (
            <p key={`bd-err-${i}`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60 rounded-sm px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>⚠️</span>
              <span>{err}</span>
            </p>
          ))}
          {birthdateValidation.warnings.map((warn, i) => (
            <p key={`bd-warn-${i}`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60 rounded-sm px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>⚠️</span>
              <span>{warn}</span>
            </p>
          ))}
          {(() => {
            if (!autoCalcAge) return null;
            const parts = getAgePartsLocal(newBirthdate);
            return parts ? (
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-100 rounded-sm px-2.5 py-1.5">
                {t('registry.autoAgeLabel', { label: getAgeLabelLocal(parts), exact: getAgeExactLocal(parts) })}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold">{t('registry.birthDateDerivedHelp')}</p>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="age-mos">{t('registry.ageMos')} {newBirthdate && autoCalcAge && <span className="text-success dark:text-emerald-300 font-black">{t('registry.autoBadge')}</span>}</label>
            <input type="number" value={newBirthdate && autoCalcAge ? String((getAgePartsLocal(newBirthdate)?.totalMonths ?? 0)) : age} onChange={(e) => handleAgeChange(e.target.value)} readOnly={!!newBirthdate && autoCalcAge} className="w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm text-center font-extrabold bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground" placeholder="0" required id="age-mos" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="growth-stage">{t('registry.growthStage')}</label>
            <select
              value={newGrowthStage}
              onChange={(e) => setNewGrowthStage(e.target.value)}
              className={`w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-muted font-extrabold focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-500/10 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${newGrowthStage ? 'text-success dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-muted-foreground font-normal'}`}
            id="growth-stage">
              <option value="" disabled className="bg-popover text-muted-foreground">{t('registry.selectStage')}</option>
              <option value="Chick" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stageChick')}</option>
              <option value="Stag" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stageStag')}</option>
              <option value="Pullet" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stagePullet')}</option>
              <option value="Bull Stag" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stageBullStag')}</option>
              <option value="Cock" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stageCock')}</option>
              <option value="Hen" className="bg-popover text-popover-foreground">{t('registry.stageHen')}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="height">{t('registry.height')} ({heightUnitLabel(unitPrefs.heightUnit)})</label>
            <input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" value={height} onChange={(e) => { const v = e.target.value; setHeight(v === '' ? '' : String(Math.round(Number(v) * 10) / 10)); }} className="no-spinner w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm text-center font-extrabold bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500" placeholder="e.g. 45.0" id="height" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="weight">{t('registry.weight')} ({weightUnitLabel(unitPrefs.weightUnit)})</label>
            <input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" value={weight} onChange={(e) => { const v = e.target.value; setWeight(v === '' ? '' : String(Math.round(Number(v) * 10) / 10)); }} className="no-spinner w-full p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm text-center font-extrabold bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500" placeholder="e.g. 2.0" id="weight" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="relative" ref={legColorInputRef}>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1.5 tracking-wider" htmlFor="leg-color">{t('registry.legColor')}</label>
          <div className="relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={legColorQuery}
              onChange={(e) => { setLegColorQuery(e.target.value); setNewLegColor(e.target.value); setLegColorOpen(true); }}
              onFocus={() => setLegColorOpen(true)}
              onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setLegColorOpen(false), 150)}
              placeholder={t('registry.legColorPlaceholder')}
              className={`w-full pl-3 pr-9 p-3 border border-input-border rounded-md text-sm bg-white dark:bg-input text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:border-emerald-500 font-semibold transition-all ${legColorQuery ? 'text-neutral-900 dark:text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground dark:text-muted-foreground dark:placeholder:text-muted-foreground font-normal'}`}
            id="leg-color" />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setLegColorOpen((o) => !o)}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 rounded-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-border bg-white dark:bg-input text-muted-foreground text-xs focus:border-emerald-500 cursor-pointer hover:text-success transition-colors"
              aria-label={t('registry.toggleLegColorList')}
            >
              ▾
            </button>
          </div>
          {legColorOpen && legColorDropdownPos && createPortal(
            <div className="fixed z-[9999] bg-white dark:bg-card border border-slate-200 dark:border-border rounded-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-56 flex flex-col" style={{ top: legColorDropdownPos.top, left: legColorDropdownPos.left, width: legColorDropdownPos.width }}>
              <div className="overflow-y-auto">
                {(() => {
                  const q = legColorQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
                  const matching = q
                    ? availableLegColors.filter((s) => s.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 8)
                    : availableLegColors.slice(0, 8);
                  if (q && !availableLegColors.some((s) => s.toLowerCase() === q)) {
                    return (
                      <>
                          <button
                          type="button"
                          onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setLegColorQuery(legColorQuery.trim()); setNewLegColor(legColorQuery.trim()); setLegColorOpen(false); }}
                          className="w-full text-left px-4 py-3 bg-emerald-500/10 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <span className="text-sm font-black text-success dark:text-emerald-300">{t('registry.saveNewLegColor', { color: legColorQuery.trim() })}</span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-success uppercase shrink-0">{t('registry.autoSavedBadge')}</span>
                        </button>
                        {matching.length > 0 && <div className="px-4 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{t('registry.matchingColors')}</div>}
                        {matching.map((s) => (
                            <div key={s} className="flex items-center w-full group">
                              <button type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setLegColorQuery(s); setNewLegColor(s); setLegColorOpen(false); }} className="flex-1 text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-muted-foreground hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer">
                                {s}
                              </button>
                              {customLegColorNames.has(s) && (
                                <button type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); deleteCustomLegColor(s); }} className="shrink-0 w-6 h-6 mr-2 rounded-full bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-danger hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white hover:border-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer" title={t('registry.deleteColorTitle', { color: s })}>✕</button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                        ))}
                      </>
                    );
                  }
                  return matching.map((s) => (
                      <div key={s} className="flex items-center w-full group">
                        <button type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setLegColorQuery(s); setNewLegColor(s); setLegColorOpen(false); }} className={`flex-1 text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${s.toLowerCase() === legColorQuery.trim().toLowerCase() ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-success dark:text-emerald-300' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                          {s}
                        </button>
                        {customLegColorNames.has(s) && (
                          <button type="button" onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); deleteCustomLegColor(s); }} className="shrink-0 w-6 h-6 mr-2 rounded-full bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-danger hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white hover:border-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer" title={t('registry.deleteColorTitle', { color: s })}>✕</button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                  ));
                })()}
                {legColorQuery.trim() === '' && availableLegColors.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold">{t('registry.noLegColorsYet')}</div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>,
            document.body
          )}
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold">{t('registry.legColorHelp')}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="antigravity-hover bg-white dark:bg-card p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-border shadow-sm space-y-4">

            {t('registry.nextIdLabel', { id: nextIdLabel })}
          </span>
        </div>

          <StatusItem icon="✅" label={t('registry.validationStatus')} value={validationPassed && birthdateValidation.valid ? t('registry.validationPassed') : t('registry.validationPending')} tone={validationPassed && birthdateValidation.valid ? 'green' : 'amber'} />
          <StatusItem icon="🔗" label={t('registry.lineageResolved')} value={bloodlineVerified ? t('registry.lineageResolvedStatus') : t('registry.lineageAwaitingStatus')} tone={bloodlineVerified ? 'green' : 'amber'} />
          <StatusItem icon="📊" label={t('registry.dataCompleteness')} value={`${dataCompleteness}%`} tone={dataCompleteness === 100 ? 'green' : 'amber'} />
        </div>
        <button type="submit" disabled={loading || uploadingImage || !birthdateValidation.valid || !declaredValidation.valid} className="w-full bg-slate-900 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:scale-[0.99] text-white font-black py-4 rounded-lg text-sm shadow-md uppercase tracking-widest cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
          {(loading || uploadingImage) && <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></span>}
          <span>{uploadingImage ? t('registry.uploadingAttachment') : loading ? t('registry.registering') : t('registry.registerBtn')}</span>

function autoComputeGrowthStageLocal(ageMonths: number, gender: string): string {
  const g = gender.toLowerCase();
  if (ageMonths < 3) return 'Chick';
  if (g === 'male' || g === 'rooster') {
    if (ageMonths < 6) return 'Stag';
    if (ageMonths < 12) return 'Bull Stag';
    return 'Cock';
  }
  if (ageMonths < 6) return 'Pullet';
  return 'Hen';
}

type AgePartsLocal = { years: number; months: number; days: number; totalMonths: number };

function getAgePartsLocal(birthdate: string): AgePartsLocal | null {
  if (!birthdate) return null;
  const bd = new Date(birthdate);
  if (isNaN(bd.getTime())) return null;
  const now = new Date();
  let years = now.getFullYear() - bd.getFullYear();
  let months = now.getMonth() - bd.getMonth();
  let days = now.getDate() - bd.getDate();
  if (days < 0) { months--; days += 30; }
  if (months < 0) { years--; months += 12; }
  return { years, months, days, totalMonths: years * 12 + months };
}

function getAgeLabelLocal(p: AgePartsLocal): string {
  if (p.years > 0) return `${p.years}y ${p.months}m`;
  if (p.months > 0) return `${p.months}m ${p.days}d`;
  return `${p.days}d`;
}

function getAgeExactLocal(p: AgePartsLocal): string {
  return `${p.years}y ${p.months}m ${p.days}d`;
}

import React from 'react';

  getOffspringClassificationCounts,

} from '@/lib/registry-roles';

const replaceMock = vi.fn();
vi.mock('next/navigation', () => ({
  useRouter: () => ({ replace: replaceMock, push: vi.fn(), back: vi.fn() }),
  usePathname: () => '/profiling',
}));

const mockProspects: FowlRecord[] = [
  // Foundation parents (needed for lineage context)
  { id: 1, name: 'Iron Lemon', breed: 'Lemon', gender: 'Rooster', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
  { id: 2, name: 'Golden Pearl', breed: 'Lemon', gender: 'Hen', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Female' } as FowlRecord,

  { id: 4, name: 'Sunrise Queen', breed: 'Sweater', gender: 'Hen', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Female' } as FowlRecord,

    breeding_role: 'material',
  } as FowlRecord,
];

const mockMatches: MatchRecord[] = [
  { id: 101, fowl_id: 10, entry_name: 'Lemon Storm', outcome: 'Win' } as MatchRecord,
  { id: 102, fowl_id: 13, entry_name: 'Hatch Silver', outcome: 'Loss' } as MatchRecord,
];

function renderOffspringRegistry(overrides = {}) {
  return render(
    <FowlLists
      tab="offspring"
      fowls={mockProspects}
      matchHistory={mockMatches}
      loading={false}
      setProfilingSubTab={vi.fn()}
      setSelectedFowlForArchive={vi.fn()}
      setSelectedFowlForDeceased={vi.fn()}

    />
  );
}

describe('Offspring Breeding Classification & Fighting Status Registry', () => {
  it('enforces Breeding Stock + Non-Breeding = All Offspring invariant on dataset', () => {
    const offspring = mockProspects.filter((f) => f.id >= 10);
    const counts = getOffspringClassificationCounts(offspring);

    expect(counts.all).toBe(4);
    expect(counts.breedingStock).toBe(2);
    expect(counts.nonBreeding).toBe(2);
    expect(counts.breedingStock + counts.nonBreeding).toBe(counts.all);

    // Mutual exclusivity check
    for (const f of offspring) {
      const isBS = isBreedingStockOffspring(f);
      const isNB = isNonBreedingOffspring(f);
      expect(isBS !== isNB).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('determines fight status by fowl ID foreign key rather than name', () => {
    const { foughtFowlIds, foughtNames } = extractFoughtLookups(mockMatches);
    expect(foughtFowlIds.has(10)).toBe(true);
    expect(foughtFowlIds.has(13)).toBe(true);
    expect(foughtFowlIds.has(11)).toBe(false);
    expect(foughtFowlIds.has(12)).toBe(false);

    // Chicken #10 (Lemon Storm) has fight record
    expect(hasFightRecord(mockProspects[4], foughtFowlIds, foughtNames)).toBe(true);
    // Chicken #11 (Lemon Blaze) has no fight record
    expect(hasFightRecord(mockProspects[5], foughtFowlIds, foughtNames)).toBe(false);

    // Verify even if an entry_name matches another chicken, fowl_id is authoritative
    const renamedChicken = { ...mockProspects[5], name: 'Lemon Storm' }; // Name matches Lemon Storm, but ID is 11
    expect(hasFightRecord(renamedChicken, foughtFowlIds, new Set())).toBe(false);
  });

  it('renders all three breeding classification pills with live counts and header total agreeing', () => {
    renderOffspringRegistry();

    // Header total: 4 offspring
    expect(screen.getByText(/4 Total/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Offspring Registry')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Every child of a registered breeding pair')).toBeInTheDocument();

    // Breeding classification pills:
    // All: 4
    // Breeding Stock: 2 (Sweater Bolt and Hatch Silver have breeding_role: 'material')
    // Non-Breeding: 2 (Lemon Storm and Lemon Blaze have breeding_role: 'none')
    const allTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /^All/i });
    const breedingStockTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Breeding Stock/i });
    const nonBreedingTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Non-Breeding/i });

    expect(allTab).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(allTab).toHaveTextContent('All4');
    expect(allTab).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

    expect(breedingStockTab).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(breedingStockTab).toHaveTextContent('Breeding Stock2');
    expect(breedingStockTab).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    expect(breedingStockTab).toHaveAttribute(
      'title',
      'Offspring kept as future breeders. They move to Cocks or Hens when promoted.'
    );

    expect(nonBreedingTab).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(nonBreedingTab).toHaveTextContent('Non-Breeding2');
    expect(nonBreedingTab).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');

    // Initial results count: 4 of 4
    expect(screen.getAllByText('4 of 4')[0]).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('switches to Breeding Stock classification and updates list and results count', async () => {
    renderOffspringRegistry();

    const breedingStockTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Breeding Stock/i });
    fireEvent.click(breedingStockTab);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText('2 of 2')[0]).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    // Only Sweater Bolt and Hatch Silver should appear in Breeding Stock
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Bolt/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Storm/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('switches to Non-Breeding classification and updates list and results count', async () => {
    renderOffspringRegistry();

    const nonBreedingTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Non-Breeding/i });
    fireEvent.click(nonBreedingTab);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText('2 of 2')[0]).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    // Only Lemon Storm and Lemon Blaze should appear in Non-Breeding
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Storm/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Bolt/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('supports Non-Breeding chicken with No Fight Record (orthogonal dimensions)', async () => {
    renderOffspringRegistry();

    // Select Non-Breeding classification pill
    const nonBreedingTab = screen.getByRole('tab', { name: /Non-Breeding/i });
    fireEvent.click(nonBreedingTab);

    // Select Fighting Status filter: "without" (No Fight Record)
    const fightFilter = screen.getByLabelText(/Fighting Status/i);
    fireEvent.change(fightFilter, { target: { value: 'without' } });

    // Lemon Blaze is Non-Breeding AND has No Fight Record
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText('1 of 2')[0]).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Storm/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Bolt/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('supports Breeding Stock chicken with No Fight Record', async () => {
    renderOffspringRegistry();

    // Filter to "without" (No Fight Record) -> Lemon Storm has a fight, so 0 results

  it('renders classification-specific empty states when a classification has 0 chickens', async () => {

        matchHistory={[]}
        loading={false}
        setProfilingSubTab={vi.fn()}

  });

  it('respects URL query values and aliases (class=breeding-stock, class=all, class=all-offspring)', () => {

describe('FowlLists search and filter', () => {
  it('renders initial live count and search input with shortcut hint', () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/11 of 11/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    expect(searchInput).toHaveAttribute('placeholder', 'Search name, ID, wing band…');
  });

  it('filters by chicken name with debounce and updates live count', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'Blaze' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 11\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Iron Lemon/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('filters by unique identifier code (e.g. 1A1)', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: '1A1' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 11\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Storm/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('filters by parent pair code prefix (e.g. 1A matches all offspring in 1A)', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: '1A' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/3 of 11/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Storm/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Duke/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Flash/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('filters by wing band number', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'WB-9' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 11\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Thunder/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('matches only chicken own fields by default (does not match offspring via sire name)', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'Titan' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 11\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Titan Sweater/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Flash/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Bolt/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows friendly empty state when no chickens match and allows clearing', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'NonExistentChicken' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/No chickens found for "NonExistentChicken"/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    const clearButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear search' });
    fireEvent.click(clearButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/11 of 11/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  it('clears search input when Escape key is pressed', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'Sweater' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(searchInput).toHaveValue('Sweater');
    });

    fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape' });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(searchInput).toHaveValue('');
    });
  });

  it('clears search input when the X button is clicked', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'Hatch' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(searchInput).toHaveValue('Hatch');
    });

    const clearInputButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear search input' });
    fireEvent.click(clearInputButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(searchInput).toHaveValue('');
    });
  });

  it('combines text search with Breed dropdown filter', async () => {
    renderFowlLists();
    const breedSelect = screen.getByLabelText(/^Breed$/i);
    fireEvent.change(breedSelect, { target: { value: 'Lemon' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/4 of 11/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    const searchInput = screen.getByLabelText(/Search Registry/i);
    fireEvent.change(searchInput, { target: { value: 'Blaze' } });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 11\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Lemon Blaze/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('Option 1 Breed filter: Hatch Silver appears under Breed = Hatch and Breed = Sweater, but not under Purebred', async () => {
    const crossFowls: FowlRecord[] = [
      { id: 1, name: 'True Hatch', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Rooster', sire: '', dam: '', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
      { id: 2, name: 'Silver Princess', breed: 'Sweater', gender: 'Hen', sire: '', dam: '', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Female' } as FowlRecord,
      { id: 3, name: 'Sweater Flash', breed: 'Sweater', gender: 'Rooster', sire: '', dam: '', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
      { id: 4, name: 'Hatch Silver', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Rooster', sire: 'True Hatch', dam: 'Silver Princess', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
    ];

    renderFowlLists({ fowls: crossFowls });

    const breedSelect = screen.getByLabelText(/^Breed$/i);
    const breedingTypeSelect = screen.getByLabelText(/^Breeding Type$/i);

    // 1. Filter Breed = Hatch -> Hatch Silver appears
    fireEvent.change(breedSelect, { target: { value: 'Hatch' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    // 2. Filter Breed = Sweater -> Hatch Silver appears (composition-aware matching!)
    fireEvent.change(breedSelect, { target: { value: 'Sweater' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Flash/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    // 3. Add Breeding Type = Purebred -> Hatch Silver is excluded, only Sweater Flash remains
    fireEvent.change(breedingTypeSelect, { target: { value: 'purebred' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Sweater Flash/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    // 4. Set Breed = Hatch with Breeding Type = Purebred -> Hatch Silver is also excluded
    fireEvent.change(breedSelect, { target: { value: 'Hatch' } });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Hatch Silver/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /True Hatch/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  it('renders Retired Fighter badge on birds with match records that are designated breeders/breeding stock', async () => {
    const testFowls: FowlRecord[] = [
      { id: 1, name: 'Iron Lemon', breed: 'Lemon', gender: 'Rooster', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
      { id: 2, name: 'Titan Sweater', breed: 'Sweater', gender: 'Rooster', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
    ];
    const testMatches = [
      { id: 101, fowl_id: 1, entry_name: 'Iron Lemon', outcome: 'Win' } as any,
    ];

    renderFowlLists({ fowls: testFowls, matchHistory: testMatches });

    // Iron Lemon fought -> has Retired Fighter badge
    const ironLemonHeading = screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Iron Lemon/i });
    const ironLemonCard = ironLemonHeading.closest('.antigravity-card');
    expect(ironLemonCard).not.toBeNull();
    expect(ironLemonCard).toHaveTextContent(/Retired Fighter/i);

    // Titan Sweater did not fight -> does not have badge
    const titanHeading = screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Titan Sweater/i });
    const titanCard = titanHeading.closest('.antigravity-card');
    expect(titanCard).not.toBeNull();
    expect(titanCard).not.toHaveTextContent(/Retired Fighter/i);
  });

  it('filters by Retired Fighter toggle button and updates live count', async () => {
    const testFowls: FowlRecord[] = [
      { id: 1, name: 'Iron Lemon', breed: 'Lemon', gender: 'Rooster', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
      { id: 2, name: 'Titan Sweater', breed: 'Sweater', gender: 'Rooster', status: 'Active', registry_role: 'Breeding Male' } as FowlRecord,
    ];
    const testMatches = [
      { id: 101, fowl_id: 1, entry_name: 'Iron Lemon', outcome: 'Win' } as any,
    ];

    renderFowlLists({ fowls: testFowls, matchHistory: testMatches });

    // Initially 2 of 2
    expect(screen.getAllByText(/2 of 2/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Click Retired Fighter toggle
    const toggleButton = document.getElementById('filter-by-retired-fighter')!;
    expect(toggleButton).toBeInTheDocument();
    fireEvent.click(toggleButton);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/\b1 of 2\b/).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Iron Lemon/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Titan Sweater/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    // Toggle off
    fireEvent.click(toggleButton);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getAllByText(/2 of 2/i).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 4, name: /Titan Sweater/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

type ListTab = 'males' | 'females' | 'archived' | 'deceased' | 'offspring';

type Props = {
  tab: ListTab;
  category?: BreedingClassification;
  onCategoryChange?: (category: BreedingClassification) => void;

  matchHistory: MatchRecord[];
