import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { en } from './en';
import { tl } from './tl';
import { hil } from './hil';
import {
  parseLanguage,
  formatCurrency,
  formatDateSafe,
  pluralize,
  translateStatus,
  translateRole,
  translateClass,
  translateOutcome,
  translateBreedingType,
  translateRelatedness,
  getDictionary,
  interpolate,
  LANGUAGE_OPTIONS,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
} from './index';

describe('i18n Dictionary Parity & Structure', () => {
  function getLeaves(obj: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): Record<string, string> {
    const res: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
      const full = prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k;
      if (typeof v === 'string') {
        res[full] = v;
      } else if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) {
        Object.assign(res, getLeaves(v as Record<string, unknown>, full));
      }
    }
    return res;
  }

  const enLeaves = getLeaves(en as Record<string, unknown>);
  const tlLeaves = getLeaves(tl as Record<string, unknown>);
  const hilLeaves = getLeaves(hil as Record<string, unknown>);

  it('has exact key parity between English and Tagalog', () => {
    const enKeys = Object.keys(enLeaves).sort();
    const tlKeys = Object.keys(tlLeaves).sort();
    expect(tlKeys).toEqual(enKeys);
  });

  it('has exact key parity between English and Hiligaynon', () => {
    const enKeys = Object.keys(enLeaves).sort();
    const hilKeys = Object.keys(hilLeaves).sort();
    expect(hilKeys).toEqual(enKeys);
  });

  it('preserves all interpolation placeholders in Tagalog and Hiligaynon', () => {
    const placeholderRegex = /\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g;

    for (const [key, enText] of Object.entries(enLeaves)) {
      const enMatches = Array.from(enText.matchAll(placeholderRegex)).map((m) => m[0]).sort();
      if (enMatches.length > 0) {
        const tlText = tlLeaves[key];
        const tlMatches = Array.from(tlText.matchAll(placeholderRegex)).map((m) => m[0]).sort();
        expect(tlMatches).toEqual(enMatches);

        const hilText = hilLeaves[key];
        const hilMatches = Array.from(hilText.matchAll(placeholderRegex)).map((m) => m[0]).sort();
        expect(hilMatches).toEqual(enMatches);
      }
    }
  });

  it('defines 3 supported languages with correct codes and metadata', () => {
    expect(SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES).toEqual(['en', 'tl', 'hil']);
    expect(LANGUAGE_OPTIONS).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(LANGUAGE_OPTIONS.find((l) => l.code === 'hil')?.isBeta).toBe(true);
    expect(Boolean(LANGUAGE_OPTIONS.find((l) => l.code === 'en')?.isBeta)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('Language Cookie & Parsing', () => {
  it('parses valid supported languages', () => {
    expect(parseLanguage('en')).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage('tl')).toBe('tl');
    expect(parseLanguage('hil')).toBe('hil');
  });

  it('defaults to English on invalid or undefined language input', () => {
    expect(parseLanguage(undefined)).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage(null)).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage('')).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage('fr')).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage('es-ES')).toBe('en');
    expect(parseLanguage('invalid<script>')).toBe('en');
  });
});

describe('Interpolation & Translation Fallback', () => {
  it('interpolates placeholders correctly', () => {
    const template = 'Hello {name}, you have {count} items.';
    const result = interpolate(template, { name: 'Juan', count: 5 });
    expect(result).toBe('Hello Juan, you have 5 items.');
  });

  it('leaves missing variables intact', () => {
    const template = 'Value: {foo} and {bar}';
    const result = interpolate(template, { foo: '123' });
    expect(result).toBe('Value: 123 and {bar}');
  });

  it('falls back to English when Tagalog or Hiligaynon key is missing at runtime', () => {
    const consoleSpy = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
    const dict = getDictionary('hil');
    expect(dict.common.save).toBe('I-save');
    // If a key exists in en, it resolves cleanly
    expect(dict.common.cancel).toBe('Kanselahon');
    consoleSpy.mockRestore();
  });
});

describe('Domain Value vs Display Label Separation', () => {
  it('translates canonical status labels without altering database values', () => {
    expect(translateStatus('Active', 'en')).toBe('Active');
    expect(translateStatus('Active', 'tl')).toBe('Aktibo');
    expect(translateStatus('Active', 'hil')).toBe('Aktibo');

    expect(translateStatus('Deceased', 'en')).toBe('Deceased');
    expect(translateStatus('Deceased', 'tl')).toBe('Pumanaw');
    expect(translateStatus('Deceased', 'hil')).toBe('Napatay');

    expect(translateStatus('Sold', 'tl')).toBe('Nabenta');
    expect(translateStatus('Sold', 'hil')).toBe('Nabaligya');
  });

  it('translates match outcomes cleanly', () => {
    expect(translateOutcome('Win', 'en')).toBe('Win');
    expect(translateOutcome('Win', 'tl')).toBe('Panalo');
    expect(translateOutcome('Win', 'hil')).toBe('Daug');

    expect(translateOutcome('Loss', 'en')).toBe('Loss');
    expect(translateOutcome('Loss', 'tl')).toBe('Talo');
    expect(translateOutcome('Loss', 'hil')).toBe('Pirdi');

    expect(translateOutcome('Draw', 'tl')).toBe('Tabla');
    expect(translateOutcome('Draw', 'hil')).toBe('Tabla');
  });

  it('translates breeding types correctly', () => {
    expect(translateBreedingType('Purebred', 'en')).toBe('Purebred');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Purebred', 'tl')).toBe('Purebred');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Purebred', 'hil')).toBe('Purebred');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Crossbred', 'tl')).toBe('Crossbred');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Crossbred', 'hil')).toBe('Crossbred');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Unverified', 'tl')).toBe('Unverified Lineage');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Unverified', 'hil')).toBe('Unverified Lineage');

    expect(translateClass('Cock', 'tl')).toBe('Cock');
    expect(translateClass('Stag', 'hil')).toBe('Stag');
  });

  it('keeps Outcross out of the breeding-type dimension and inside relatedness', () => {
    // Breeding Type is Purebred / Crossbred / Unverified Lineage only.
    expect(translateBreedingType('Outcross', 'en')).toBe('Outcross');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Outcross', 'tl')).toBe('Outcross');
    expect(translateBreedingType('Outcross', 'hil')).toBe('Outcross');

    // Outcross is a relatedness classification.
    expect(translateRelatedness('outcross', 'en')).toBe('Outcross');
    expect(translateRelatedness('outcross', 'tl')).toBe('Outcross');
    expect(translateRelatedness('outcross', 'hil')).toBe('Outcross');
    expect(translateRelatedness('close', 'en')).toBe('Close Breeding');
    expect(translateRelatedness('line', 'en')).toBe('Line Breeding');
    expect(translateRelatedness('unknown', 'en')).toBe('Unknown');
  });

  it('returns fallback as-is for unknown custom statuses', () => {
    expect(translateStatus('SpecialPen' as never, 'tl')).toBe('SpecialPen');
    expect(translateRole('UnknownRole' as never, 'hil')).toBe('UnknownRole');
  });
});

describe('Date, Currency, and Plural Formatting', () => {
  it('formats currency consistently with Philippine Peso symbol across all languages', () => {
    expect(formatCurrency(1500, 'en')).toBe('₱1,500.00');
    expect(formatCurrency(1500, 'tl')).toBe('₱1,500.00');
    expect(formatCurrency(1500, 'hil')).toBe('₱1,500.00');
  });

  it('formats dates safely without timezone shifts', () => {
    const formattedEn = formatDateSafe('2026-05-15', 'en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
    expect(formattedEn).toContain('May');
    expect(formattedEn).toContain('15');
    expect(formattedEn).toContain('2026');

    // Hiligaynon explicit month dictionary
    const formattedHil = formatDateSafe('2026-05-15', 'hil', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
    expect(formattedHil).toContain('Mayo');
    expect(formattedHil).toContain('15');
    expect(formattedHil).toContain('2026');
  });

  it('handles pluralization correctly across languages', () => {
    expect(pluralize(1, 'chicken', 'chickens', 'en')).toBe('1 chicken');
    expect(pluralize(5, 'chicken', 'chickens', 'en')).toBe('5 chickens');

    expect(pluralize(1, 'manok', 'mga manok', 'tl')).toBe('1 manok');
    expect(pluralize(5, 'manok', 'mga manok', 'tl')).toBe('5 mga manok');

    expect(pluralize(1, 'manok', 'mga manok', 'hil')).toBe('1 ka manok');
    expect(pluralize(5, 'manok', 'mga manok', 'hil')).toBe('5 ka mga manok');
  });
});

'use client';
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { en } from './en';
import { tl } from './tl';
import { hil } from './hil';
import {
  type AppLanguage,
  type AppTranslations,
  type TranslationKey,
  type LanguageOption,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
  LANGUAGE_COOKIE,
  LANGUAGE_OPTIONS,
  HILIGAYNON_BETA,
} from './types';
import * as formatters from './formatters';

export * from './types';
export * from './formatters';

export const DICTIONARIES: Record<AppLanguage, AppTranslations> = {
  en,
  tl,
  hil,
};

import { sanitizeLanguage } from './server';

export * from './server';

export const getDictionary = (lang: AppLanguage = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) => DICTIONARIES[lang] || DICTIONARIES.en;

/**
 * Writes the language cookie in client-side document.cookie.
 */
export function setLanguageCookie(lang: AppLanguage): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const oneYearSeconds = 31536000;
  document.cookie = `${LANGUAGE_COOKIE}=${lang}; path=/; max-age=${oneYearSeconds}; SameSite=Lax`;
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
}

// Track warning logs to avoid spamming dev console
const warnedKeys = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Resolves a dot-delimited translation path (e.g. 'common.save') on a nested dictionary object.
 */
function resolvePath(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string): string | undefined {
  const parts = path.split('.');
  let current: unknown = obj;
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (current && typeof current === 'object' && part in current) {
      current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
    } else {
      return undefined;
    }
  }
  return typeof current === 'string' ? current : undefined;
}

/**
 * Replaces `{paramName}` placeholders with provided param values.
 */
export function interpolate(template: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  if (!params) return template;
  return template.replace(/\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g, (match, key) => {
    return key in params ? String(params[key]) : match;
  });
}

/**
 * Core translation function with fallback to English and dev-only warning.
 */
export function translate(
  key: TranslationKey,
  lang: AppLanguage = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
  params?: Record<string, string | number>
): string {
  const targetDict = DICTIONARIES[lang] || DICTIONARIES.en;
  let text = resolvePath(targetDict as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, key);

  if (!text) {
    // Missing key in target language: fallback to English
    text = resolvePath(DICTIONARIES.en as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, key);

    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && lang !== 'en') {
      const warnKey = `${lang}:${key}`;
      if (!warnedKeys.has(warnKey)) {
        warnedKeys.add(warnKey);
        console.warn(`[i18n] Missing translation for key "${key}" in language "${lang}", falling back to English.`);
      }
    }
  }

  if (!text) {
    // If key missing even in English, return raw key
    return key;
  }

  return interpolate(text, params);
}

/**
 * Server-safe helper to get a bound translation function for a specific language.
 */
export function getTranslations(lang: AppLanguage = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) {
  return {
    t: (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => translate(key, lang, params),
    lang,
    formatDate: (d: Date | string | number | null | undefined, options?: formatters.DateFormatOptions) =>
      formatters.formatDate(d, lang, options),
    formatNumber: (n: number, options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions) => formatters.formatNumber(n, lang, options),
    formatCurrency: (a: number, decimals?: number) => formatters.formatCurrency(a, lang, decimals),
    formatPercent: (p: number, decimals?: number) => formatters.formatPercent(p, lang, decimals),
    pluralize: (count: number, singular: string, plural: string) => formatters.pluralize(count, singular, plural, lang),
  };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Domain label translators (separating canonical database values from UI)    */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export function translateStatus(status: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!status) return '—';
  const s = status.trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (s) {
    case 'active':
      return translate('domain.statusActive', lang);
    case 'archived':
      return translate('domain.statusArchived', lang);
    case 'deceased':
      return translate('domain.statusDeceased', lang);
    case 'sold':
      return translate('domain.statusSold', lang);
    case 'quarantined':
      return translate('domain.statusQuarantined', lang);
    default:
      return status;
  }
}

export function translateClass(cls: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!cls) return '—';
  const c = cls.trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (c) {
    case 'cock':
      return translate('domain.classCock', lang);
    case 'stag':
      return translate('domain.classStag', lang);
    case 'open':
      return translate('domain.classOpen', lang);
    default:
      return cls;
  }
}

export function translateRole(role: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!role) return '—';
  const r = role.trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (r) {
    case 'sire':
      return translate('domain.roleSire', lang);
    case 'dam':
      return translate('domain.roleDam', lang);
    case 'offspring':
      return translate('domain.roleOffspring', lang);
    default:
      return role;
  }
}

export function translateOutcome(outcome: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!outcome) return '—';
  const o = outcome.trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (o) {
    case 'win':
      return translate('domain.outcomeWin', lang);
    case 'loss':
      return translate('domain.outcomeLoss', lang);
    case 'draw':
      return translate('domain.outcomeDraw', lang);
    case 'no contest':
      return translate('domain.outcomeNoContest', lang);
    default:
      return outcome;
  }
}

export function translateBreedingType(type: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!type) return '—';
  const t = type.trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (t) {
    case 'purebred':
      return translate('domain.breedingPurebred', lang);
    case 'crossbred':
      return translate('domain.breedingCrossbred', lang);
    case 'unverified':
      return translate('domain.breedingUnverified', lang);
    default:
      // 'Outcross' is NOT a breeding type: it belongs to the relatedness dimension
      // (Close Breeding / Line Breeding / Outcross). Unknown values pass through.
      return type;
  }
}

/**
 * Translates a relatedness classification (Close Breeding / Line Breeding / Outcross).
 * These are separate from breeding types (Purebred / Crossbred / Unverified Lineage).
 */
export function translateRelatedness(type: string | null | undefined, lang: AppLanguage = 'en'): string {
  if (!type) return '—';
  switch (type.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    case 'close':
      return translate('domain.relatednessClose', lang);
    case 'line':
      return translate('domain.relatednessLine', lang);
    case 'outcross':
      return translate('domain.relatednessOutcross', lang);
    case 'unknown':
      return translate('domain.relatednessUnknown', lang);
    default:
      return type;
  }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* React Context and Hook                                                     */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface LanguageContextValue {
  language: AppLanguage;
  setLanguage: (lang: AppLanguage) => void;
  t: (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;
  languages: readonly LanguageOption[];
  isBeta: (lang: AppLanguage) => boolean;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextValue | null>(null);

export interface LanguageProviderProps {
  initialLanguage?: AppLanguage;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function LanguageProvider({ initialLanguage = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, children }: LanguageProviderProps) {
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<AppLanguage>(initialLanguage);
  const [prevInitial, setPrevInitial] = useState<AppLanguage>(initialLanguage);

  // Sync state if initialLanguage changes across server route navigations
  if (initialLanguage !== prevInitial) {
    setPrevInitial(initialLanguage);
    if (initialLanguage && SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(initialLanguage)) {
      setLanguageState(initialLanguage);
    }
  }

  // Keep <html lang="..."> attribute in sync on client
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      document.documentElement.lang = language;
    }
  }, [language]);

  const setLanguage = useCallback((newLang: AppLanguage) => {
    const valid = sanitizeLanguage(newLang);
    setLanguageState(valid);
    setLanguageCookie(valid);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => {
      return translate(key, language, params);
    },
    [language]
  );

  const isBeta = useCallback((lang: AppLanguage) => {
    return lang === 'hil' && HILIGAYNON_BETA;
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      language,
      setLanguage,
      t,
      languages: LANGUAGE_OPTIONS,
      isBeta,
    }),
    [language, setLanguage, t, isBeta]
  );

  return React.createElement(LanguageContext.Provider, { value }, children);
}

export type UseTHook = ((key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string) & {
  t: (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;
  language: AppLanguage;
};

/**
 * Hook to access the current language translation function `t(key, params)`.
 * Can be called directly as `const t = useT(); t('key')` or destructured as `const { t } = useT();`.
 */
export function useT(): UseTHook {
  const ctx = useContext(LanguageContext);
  const fn = ctx
    ? ctx.t
    : (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => translate(key, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, params);

  const lang = ctx ? ctx.language : DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
  const callable = (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => fn(key, params);

  return Object.assign(callable, {
    t: fn,
    language: lang,
  });
}

/**
 * Hook to access full language controls: { language, setLanguage, t, languages, isBeta }.
 */
export function useLanguage(): LanguageContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    return {
      language: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
      setLanguage: () => {},
      t: (key: TranslationKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>) => translate(key, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, params),
      languages: LANGUAGE_OPTIONS,
      isBeta: (lang: AppLanguage) => lang === 'hil' && HILIGAYNON_BETA,
    };
  }
  return ctx;
}

import {
  type AppLanguage,
  SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
  LANGUAGE_COOKIE,
} from './types';

/**
 * Validates a language code against supported values; safely defaults to 'en'.
 * Safe to run on server and client.
 */
export function sanitizeLanguage(val: unknown): AppLanguage {
  if (typeof val === 'string') {
    const trimmed = val.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(trimmed as AppLanguage)) {
      return trimmed as AppLanguage;
    }
  }
  return DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
}

export const parseLanguage = sanitizeLanguage;

/**
 * Reads language from a server cookie store (e.g. Next.js App Router cookies() in layout.tsx or headers).
 * Safe for server components.
 */
export function getLanguageFromCookies(
  cookieStore?: { get: (name: string) => { value?: string } | undefined } | null
): AppLanguage {
  if (!cookieStore) return DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
  try {
    const cookie = cookieStore.get(LANGUAGE_COOKIE);
    return sanitizeLanguage(cookie?.value);
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
  }
}

import type { TranslationSchema } from './en';

export type AppLanguage = 'en' | 'tl' | 'hil';

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES: readonly AppLanguage[] = ['en', 'tl', 'hil'] as const;

export const DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: AppLanguage = 'en';

export const LANGUAGE_COOKIE = 'gt-lang';

/**
 * Constant controlling the Beta marker next to Hiligaynon.
 * Per requirement, this disappears only when explicitly set to false after manual review.
 */
export const HILIGAYNON_BETA = true;

export interface LanguageOption {
  code: AppLanguage;
  name: string;
  nativeName: string;
  isBeta?: boolean;
}

export const LANGUAGE_OPTIONS: readonly LanguageOption[] = [
  { code: 'en', name: 'English', nativeName: 'English' },
  { code: 'tl', name: 'Tagalog', nativeName: 'Tagalog' },
  { code: 'hil', name: 'Hiligaynon', nativeName: 'Hiligaynon', isBeta: HILIGAYNON_BETA },
] as const;

/**
 * Recursively maps a canonical literal schema to require all keys with string leaf values.
 * Missing keys in Tagalog or Hiligaynon will fail compilation.
 */
type DeepStringify<T> = {
  readonly [K in keyof T]: T[K] extends object ? DeepStringify<T[K]> : string;
};

/**
 * Translation dictionary contract.
 * Any language dictionary (Tagalog, Hiligaynon) MUST satisfy this contract.
 * If any key is missing or invalid, TypeScript will raise a compile-time error.
 */
export type AppTranslations = DeepStringify<TranslationSchema>;

// Helper to construct dot-separated paths for nested keys
type NestedKeyOf<ObjectType extends object> = {
  [Key in keyof ObjectType & (string | number)]: ObjectType[Key] extends object
    ? `${Key}.${NestedKeyOf<ObjectType[Key]>}`
    : `${Key}`;
}[keyof ObjectType & (string | number)];

export type TranslationKey = NestedKeyOf<TranslationSchema>;

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';

vi.mock('next/font/google', () => ({
  Geist: () => ({ variable: '--font-geist-sans' }),
  Geist_Mono: () => ({ variable: '--font-geist-mono' }),
}));

import { metadata as layoutMetadata, viewport as layoutViewport } from '../app/layout';
import { metadata as landingMetadata } from '../app/page';

describe('GalloTrack Favicon Suite & Metadata', () => {
  const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');

  it('all required icon assets exist on disk', () => {
    const requiredFiles = [
      'app/icon.svg',
      'app/favicon.ico',
      'app/apple-icon.png',
      'public/favicon.ico',
      'public/icon-192x192.png',
      'public/icon-512x512.png',
      'public/icon-maskable-512x512.png',
      'public/manifest.json',
    ];

    for (const rel of requiredFiles) {
      const fullPath = path.join(root, rel);
      expect(fs.existsSync(fullPath), `Missing icon file: ${rel}`).toBe(true);
      expect(fs.statSync(fullPath).size, `File is empty: ${rel}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  it('favicon.ico is a valid multi-size ICO containing 16x16, 32x32, and 48x48 images', () => {
    const icoPath = path.join(root, 'app/favicon.ico');
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(icoPath);

    // 2-byte reserved (0), 2-byte type (1 = ICO), 2-byte image count
    expect(buf.readUInt16LE(0)).toBe(0);
    expect(buf.readUInt16LE(2)).toBe(1);
    const count = buf.readUInt16LE(4);
    expect(count).toBe(3);

    const sizes: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const offset = 6 + i * 16;
      const w = buf.readUInt8(offset) || 256;
      const h = buf.readUInt8(offset + 1) || 256;
      expect(w).toBe(h);
      sizes.push(w);

      const imgOffset = buf.readUInt32LE(offset + 12);
      const magic = buf.subarray(imgOffset, imgOffset + 8);
      // Valid PNG header magic: 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A
      expect(magic).toEqual(Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]));
    }

    expect(sizes).toEqual([16, 32, 48]);
  });

  it('apple-icon.png is exactly 180x180 with solid background', async () => {
    const applePath = path.join(root, 'app/apple-icon.png');
    const meta = await sharp(applePath).metadata();
    expect(meta.width).toBe(180);
    expect(meta.height).toBe(180);
    expect(meta.format).toBe('png');
  });

  it('PWA icons have expected dimensions', async () => {
    const p192 = await sharp(path.join(root, 'public/icon-192x192.png')).metadata();
    expect(p192.width).toBe(192);
    expect(p192.height).toBe(192);

    const p512 = await sharp(path.join(root, 'public/icon-512x512.png')).metadata();
    expect(p512.width).toBe(512);
    expect(p512.height).toBe(512);

    const pMaskable = await sharp(path.join(root, 'public/icon-maskable-512x512.png')).metadata();
    expect(pMaskable.width).toBe(512);
    expect(pMaskable.height).toBe(512);
  });

  it('manifest.json has correct PWA metadata and icon configurations', () => {
    const manifestPath = path.join(root, 'public/manifest.json');
    const content = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));

    expect(content.name).toBe('GalloTrack');
    expect(content.short_name).toBe('GalloTrack');
    expect(content.theme_color).toBe('#022c22');
    expect(content.background_color).toBe('#090d16');

    const srcs = content.icons.map((i: { src: string }) => i.src);
    expect(srcs).toContain('/icon-192x192.png');
    expect(srcs).toContain('/icon-512x512.png');
    expect(srcs).toContain('/icon-maskable-512x512.png');

    const maskableIcon = content.icons.find((i: { purpose?: string }) => i.purpose === 'maskable');
    expect(maskableIcon).toBeDefined();
    expect(maskableIcon.sizes).toBe('512x512');
  });

  it('layout metadata exports expected title template and default', () => {
    expect(layoutMetadata.title).toEqual({
      template: '%s | GalloTrack',
      default: 'GalloTrack | Gamefowl Breeding & Match Analytics',
    });
    expect(layoutViewport.themeColor).toBe('#022c22');
    expect(layoutMetadata.manifest).toBe('/manifest.json');
  });

  it('landing page metadata uses absolute title preventing duplicate template suffix', () => {
    expect(landingMetadata.title).toEqual({
      absolute: 'GalloTrack | Gamefowl Breeding & Match Analytics',
    });
    expect(landingMetadata.description).not.toMatch(/100%|guaranteed|#1|revolutionary/i);
    expect(landingMetadata.description).toContain('lineage tracking');
    expect(landingMetadata.description).toContain('fight performance logs');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  archiveDisplay,
  archiveDraftIssue,
  archiveKindLabel,
  archivePatch,
  conditionPatch,
  deceasedPatch,
  mergeOptions,
  restorePatch,
  rolePatch,
  retiredScopeLabel,
} from './lifecycle';
import type { RegistryOption } from './types';

describe('conditionPatch (injury status)', () => {
  it('touches condition_status and nothing else', () => {
    const patch = conditionPatch('Severely Injured');
    expect(Object.keys(patch)).toEqual(['condition_status']);
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('breeding_role');
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('status');
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('activity_status');
  });

  it('never converts an injury into a breeder, even for Deceased', () => {
    const patch = conditionPatch('Deceased');
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('breeding_role');
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('status');
  });
});

describe('rolePatch (manual breeding decision)', () => {
  it('touches breeding_role only', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(rolePatch('material'))).toEqual(['breeding_role']);
    expect(rolePatch('breeder')).toEqual({ breeding_role: 'breeder' });
  });
});

describe('archivePatch', () => {
  it('archives with the structured kind and goes inactive', () => {
    const patch = archivePatch({ kind: 'sold', note: 'Sold to derby team' });
    expect(patch.status).toBe('Archived');
    expect(patch.archive_kind).toBe('sold');
    expect(patch.activity_status).toBe('inactive');
    expect(patch.retired_scope).toBeNull();
    expect(patch.return_date).toBeNull();

  it('keeps retired scope only for retired birds', () => {

    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('condition_status');
    expect(patch).not.toHaveProperty('breeding_role');
  });

import type { FowlRecord, RegistryOption } from './types';

/**
 * Pure lifecycle helpers for the M1 registry work.
 *
 * Rules encoded here (from user feedback):
 * - condition (injury), breeding role, active/inactive and final (deceased)
 *   are four SEPARATE concepts; nothing in this file converts one into another
 *   except the explicitly allowed Deceased record, which is a user action.
 * - patch builders are the single place lifecycle writes are shaped, so tests
 *   can assert an injury change never touches the breeding role.
 */

export type ArchiveKind = 'sold' | 'transfer' | 'inactive' | 'retired' | 'other';

export const ARCHIVE_KIND_FALLBACK_LABELS: Record<ArchiveKind, string> = {
  sold: 'Sold',
  transfer: 'Transfer / Borrowed',
  inactive: 'Inactive',
  retired: 'Retired from fighting/circuit',
  other: 'Other',
};

export const CONDITION_FALLBACK_OPTIONS = [
  'Fit / Recovered',
  'Injured',
  'Severely Injured',
  'Critically Injured',
  'Deceased',
] as const;

export const RETIRED_SCOPE_FALLBACK_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  fighting: 'Fighting only',
  breeding: 'Breeding only',
  both: 'Both (fighting and breeding)',
};

export const BREEDING_ROLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  none: 'Not a breeder',
  breeder: 'Breeder',
  material: 'Material',
};

import { FEATHER_COLOR_LIST, TRAIT_LIST } from './helpers';

export const BUILTIN_SUGGESTIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  feather_color: FEATHER_COLOR_LIST,
  trait: TRAIT_LIST,
};

/** Merge template + farm rows of one list: farm row wins, inactive dropped, sorted. */
export function mergeOptions(
  rows: RegistryOption[] | undefined,
  listKey: string,
  currentValue?: string | null,
): RegistryOption[] {
  const byValue = new Map<string, RegistryOption>();
  const inactiveKeys = new Set<string>();

  // If built-in suggestions exist for this listKey, start with them as default templates
  const suggestions = BUILTIN_SUGGESTIONS[listKey];
  if (suggestions) {
    for (const [idx, val] of suggestions.entries()) {
      byValue.set(val, {
        list_key: listKey,
        value: val,
        label: val,
        sort_order: idx + 1,
      });
    }
  }

  for (const row of rows ?? []) {
    if (row.list_key !== listKey) continue;
    const lower = row.value.toLowerCase();
    if (row.is_active === false) {
      inactiveKeys.add(lower);
      continue;
    }
    const existing = byValue.get(row.value);
    if (!existing || (row.user_id && !existing.user_id)) byValue.set(row.value, row);
  }

  for (const [val] of byValue) {
    if (inactiveKeys.has(val.toLowerCase())) {
      byValue.delete(val);
    }
  }

  if (currentValue && !byValue.has(currentValue)) {
    byValue.set(currentValue, {
      list_key: listKey,
      value: currentValue,
      label: currentValue,
      sort_order: 999,
    });
  }
  return [...byValue.values()].sort(
    (a, b) => (a.sort_order ?? 0) - (b.sort_order ?? 0) || a.label.localeCompare(b.label),
  );
}

/** Label for an archive kind, falling back to built-in text before options load. */
export function archiveKindLabel(kind?: string | null, options?: RegistryOption[]): string {
  if (!kind) return 'Archived';
  const hit = (options ?? []).find((o) => o.list_key === 'archive_reason' && o.value === kind);
  return hit?.label ?? ARCHIVE_KIND_FALLBACK_LABELS[kind as ArchiveKind] ?? kind;
}

/**
 * Archive display line: legacy rows (no kind) show their free text; new rows
 * show `Label — note` but never repeat the label the note already starts with.
 */
export function archiveDisplay(
  fowl: Pick<FowlRecord, 'archive_kind' | 'archive_reason'>,
  options?: RegistryOption[],
): string {
  const note = (fowl.archive_reason || '').trim();
  if (!fowl.archive_kind) return note || 'Archived';
  const label = archiveKindLabel(fowl.archive_kind, options);
  if (!note) return label;
  if (note.toLowerCase().startsWith(label.toLowerCase())) return note;
  if (note.toUpperCase() === fowl.archive_kind.toUpperCase()) return label;
  return `${label} — ${note}`;
}

export function conditionLabel(value?: string | null): string {
  return (value || '').trim() || 'Fit / Recovered';
}

export function breedingRoleLabel(role?: string | null): string {
  return BREEDING_ROLE_LABELS[role || 'none'] ?? 'Not a breeder';
}

export function retiredScopeLabel(scope?: string | null, options?: RegistryOption[]): string {
  if (!scope) return '';
  const hit = (options ?? []).find((o) => o.list_key === 'retired_scope' && o.value === scope);
  return hit?.label ?? RETIRED_SCOPE_FALLBACK_LABELS[scope] ?? scope;
}

// ── patch builders (the only shapes lifecycle writes take) ──────────────────

/** Injury/condition change: touches condition_status and NOTHING else. */
export function conditionPatch(value: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { condition_status: value };
}

/** Breeding/material role change: manual action only, never derived. */
export function rolePatch(role: 'none' | 'breeder' | 'material'): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { breeding_role: role };
}

export type ArchiveDraft = {
  kind?: string;
  note?: string;
  retiredScope?: string | null;
  returnDate?: string | null;
};

/** Archive write: lifecycle goes inactive; a reason kind is mandatory. */
export function archivePatch(draft: ArchiveDraft): Record<string, unknown> {
  const note = (draft.note || '').trim();
  return {
    status: 'Archived',
    archive_kind: draft.kind ?? null,
    archive_reason: note,
    retired_scope: draft.kind === 'retired' ? draft.retiredScope || null : null,
    return_date: draft.kind === 'transfer' ? draft.returnDate || null : null,
    activity_status: 'inactive',
  };
}

/** Return/restore: clears every archive dimension and reactivates. */
export function restorePatch(): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    status: 'Active',
    archive_kind: null,
    archive_reason: null,
    retired_scope: null,
    return_date: null,
    activity_status: 'active',
  };
}

/** Final record: user-driven, sets condition + lifecycle together (atomic by app). */
export function deceasedPatch(reason: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    status: 'Deceased',
    condition_status: 'Deceased',
    death_reason: reason,
    death_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    activity_status: 'inactive',
  };
}

/** Validation for the archive modal. Returns an error message or null. */
export function archiveDraftIssue(draft: ArchiveDraft): string | null {
  if (!draft.kind) return 'Select an archive reason.';
  if (draft.kind === 'other' && !(draft.note || '').trim()) return 'Type the archive reason.';
  if (draft.kind === 'retired' && !draft.retiredScope) {
    return 'Select what this chicken is retired from.';
  }
  return null;
}

describe('lineage graph — topology', () => {

  const base = { rootId: '1', direction: 'down' as const, maxDepth: 4, collapsed: new Set<string>() };

  it('builds generations plus the unregistered lineage partner', () => {
    const topology = buildLineageTopology(index, base);
    expect(topology).not.toBeNull();
    const gens = Object.fromEntries(topology!.nodes.map((n) => [n.fowl.name, n.generation]));
    expect(gens).toMatchObject({
      'Sire 1': 0,
      'Dam A': 0,
      'Offspring 1A1': 1,
      'Offspring 1A2': 1,
      'Offspring 1A3': 1,
      'Dam C': 1,

    });
    expect(topology!.nodes.find((n) => n.isRoot)?.fowl.name).toBe('Sire 1');
  });

  it('groups shared children under the correct breeding pair only', () => {
    const topology = buildLineageTopology(index, base)!;
    const pairKeys = topology.pairs.map((p) => `${p.sireId}|||${p.damId}`);
    expect(pairKeys).toEqual(['1|||2', '3|||6']);
    const rootPair = topology.pairs.find((p) => p.key === '1|||2');
    expect(rootPair?.childIds).toEqual(['3', '4', '5']);
    const nextPair = topology.pairs.find((p) => p.key === '3|||6');
    expect(nextPair?.childIds).toEqual(['7']);
  });

  it('limits generations and reports hidden relatives', () => {
    const topology = buildLineageTopology(index, { ...base, maxDepth: 1 })!;
    expect(topology.nodes.map((n) => n.fowl.name).sort()).toEqual([
      'Dam A',
      'Offspring 1A1',
      'Offspring 1A2',
      'Offspring 1A3',
      'Sire 1',
    ]);
    const first = topology.nodes.find((n) => n.fowl.name === 'Offspring 1A1')!;
    expect(first.hiddenChildren).toBe(1);
    expect(first.hiddenDescendants).toBe(1);
  });

  it('collapsing a branch hides only that branch and counts it', () => {
    const topology = buildLineageTopology(index, {
      ...base,
      collapsed: new Set(['3']),
    })!;

    // The other siblings and their dam are untouched.

  });

      rootId: '1',
      direction: 'both',
      maxDepth: 6,
      collapsed: new Set(),

    expect(topology.nodes.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(fowls.length);
    const genById = new Map(topology.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n.generation]));
    topology.pairs.forEach((pair) => {
      pair.childIds.forEach((childId) => {
        expect(genById.get(pair.sireId)).toBeLessThan(genById.get(childId)!);
        expect(genById.get(pair.damId)).toBeLessThan(genById.get(childId)!);
      });
    });
    topology.singles.forEach((single) => {
      single.childIds.forEach((childId) => {
        expect(genById.get(single.parentId)).toBeLessThan(genById.get(childId)!);
      });
    });
  });

  it('is deterministic', () => {
    const a = buildLineageTopology(index, base);
    const b = buildLineageTopology(index, base);
    expect(JSON.stringify(a)).toEqual(JSON.stringify(b));
  });
});

describe('lineage graph — layout', () => {
  const index = buildLineageIndex(family);
  const topology = buildLineageTopology(index, {
    rootId: '1',
    direction: 'down',
    maxDepth: 4,
    collapsed: new Set(),
  })!;
  const layout = layoutLineageTopology(topology);

  it('places a generation on one row with no overlapping cards', () => {
    const rows = new Map<number, typeof layout.nodes>();
    layout.nodes.forEach((node) => {
      const row = rows.get(node.generation) ?? [];
      row.push(node);
      rows.set(node.generation, row);
    });
    rows.forEach((row) => {
      const sorted = [...row].sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      sorted.forEach((node, i) => {
        expect(node.y).toBe(sorted[0].y);
        if (i > 0) {
          expect(node.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(sorted[i - 1].x + sorted[i - 1].width);
        }
      });
    });
    expect(layout.nodes.every((n) => Number.isFinite(n.x) && Number.isFinite(n.y))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps each breeding pair adjacent', () => {
    layout.pairs.forEach((pair) => {
      const sire = layout.nodes.find((n) => n.id === pair.sireId)!;
      const dam = layout.nodes.find((n) => n.id === pair.damId)!;
      expect(Math.abs(sire.x - dam.x)).toBe(LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH + 28);
    });
  });

  it('connects pair hubs to the children below them', () => {
    layout.pairs.forEach((pair) => {
      const children = pair.childIds.map((id) => layout.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id)!);
      const parentNode = layout.nodes.find((n) => n.id === pair.sireId)!;
      expect(pair.hubY).toBeGreaterThan(parentNode.y + parentNode.height);
      expect(pair.busY).toBeGreaterThan(pair.hubY);
      children.forEach((child, i) => {
        expect(child.y).toBeGreaterThan(pair.busY);
        expect(pair.childPaths[i]).toBe(`M ${child.centerX} ${pair.busY} V ${child.y}`);
      });
      expect(pair.hubX).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Math.min(pair.sireX, pair.damX));
      expect(pair.hubX).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Math.max(pair.sireX, pair.damX));
    });
  });

  it('produces generation labels and finite bounds', () => {
    expect(layout.generations.map((g) => g.label)).toEqual([
      'Generation 1',
      'Generation 2',
      'Generation 3',
    ]);
    expect(layout.width).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(layout.height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('lineage graph — helpers', () => {
  it('picks the most prolific registered parent as the default root', () => {
    expect(pickDefaultRootId(family)).toBe('1');
  });

  it('formats the displayed bird code from the record or code map', () => {
    expect(lineageBirdCode(family[0])).toBe('1');
    expect(lineageBirdCode(bird({ id: 9, name: 'No code' }), new Map([['9', '4B2']]))).toBe('4B2');
  });
});

import type { FowlRecord } from './types';
import { parentRecordOf } from './lineage';
import { compareBirdCodesNatural, formatBirdCodeForDisplay } from './bird-code';

/**
 * Pedigree graph construction.
 *
 * Source of truth is the existing registry: a bird is a child of the birds
 * resolved by `parentRecordOf` (id link first, unambiguous name match as the
 * legacy fallback). Nothing here invents a relationship: unresolved parents
 * simply produce no node/edge.
 */

export type LineageDirection = 'down' | 'up' | 'both';

export interface LineageIndex {
  byId: Map<string, FowlRecord>;
  /** parentId -> children, deduped and stably sorted. */
  childrenByParent: Map<string, FowlRecord[]>;
  /** childId -> resolved parent records (null when unregistered/unknown). */
  parentsByChild: Map<string, { sire: FowlRecord | null; dam: FowlRecord | null }>;
}

export interface LineageTopologyNode {
  id: string;
  fowl: FowlRecord;
  generation: number;
  isRoot: boolean;
  /** Direct children that are not drawn (collapsed / depth cut). */
  hiddenChildren: number;
  /** Every descendant that is not drawn (cycle-safe count). */
  hiddenDescendants: number;
}

export interface LineageTopologyPair {
  key: string;
  sireId: string;
  damId: string;
  childIds: string[];
}

export interface LineageTopologySingle {
  parentId: string;
  childIds: string[];
}

export interface LineageTopology {
  rootId: string;
  direction: LineageDirection;
  nodes: LineageTopologyNode[];
  pairs: LineageTopologyPair[];
  singles: LineageTopologySingle[];
  /** Deterministic traversal order used by the layout. */
  nodeOrder: string[];
}

export interface LineageLayoutNode extends LineageTopologyNode {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  centerX: number;
}

export interface LineageLayoutPair extends LineageTopologyPair {
  hubX: number;
  hubY: number;
  busY: number;
  sireX: number;
  damX: number;
  parentPaths: string[];
  dropPath: string;
  busPath: string;
  childPaths: string[];
  childCount: number;
}

export interface LineageLayoutSingle extends LineageTopologySingle {
  busY: number;
  parentX: number;
  parentBottom: number;
  path: string;
  busPath: string;
  childPaths: string[];
}

export interface LineageGenerationRow {
  gen: number;
  label: string;
  y: number;
  isRoot: boolean;
}

export interface LineageLayout {
  nodes: LineageLayoutNode[];
  pairs: LineageLayoutPair[];
  singles: LineageLayoutSingle[];
  generations: LineageGenerationRow[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export const LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH = 196;
export const LINEAGE_NODE_HEIGHT = 104;
const NODE_GAP = 28;
const CHAIN_GAP = 74;
const ROW_GAP = 138;
const PAD_X = 92;
const PAD_Y = 64;
const PAIR_DROP = 30;
const PAIR_BUS = 30;
const SINGLE_DROP = 40;

const codeOf = (fowl: FowlRecord): string =>
  fowl.birth_code || fowl.chicken_code || fowl.bird_code || '';

const sortChildren = (a: FowlRecord, b: FowlRecord): number => {
  const codeA = codeOf(a);
  const codeB = codeOf(b);
  if (codeA && codeB) {
    const byCode = compareBirdCodesNatural(codeA, codeB);
    if (byCode !== 0) return byCode;
  }
  if (codeA && !codeB) return -1;
  if (!codeA && codeB) return 1;
  return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
};

/** Build the resolved parent/child index once per registry snapshot. */
export function buildLineageIndex(fowls: FowlRecord[]): LineageIndex {
  const byId = new Map<string, FowlRecord>();
  fowls.forEach((f) => byId.set(String(f.id), f));

  const childrenByParent = new Map<string, FowlRecord[]>();
  const parentsByChild = new Map<string, { sire: FowlRecord | null; dam: FowlRecord | null }>();

  fowls.forEach((child) => {
    const sire = parentRecordOf(child, 'sire', fowls);
    const dam = parentRecordOf(child, 'dam', fowls);
    const safeSire = sire && sire.id !== child.id ? sire : null;
    const safeDam = dam && dam.id !== child.id ? dam : null;
    parentsByChild.set(String(child.id), { sire: safeSire, dam: safeDam });

    [safeSire, safeDam].forEach((parent) => {
      if (!parent) return;
      const parentId = String(parent.id);
      const bucket = childrenByParent.get(parentId) ?? [];
      if (!bucket.some((c) => c.id === child.id)) bucket.push(child);
      childrenByParent.set(parentId, bucket);
    });
  });

  childrenByParent.forEach((bucket) => bucket.sort(sortChildren));

  return { byId, childrenByParent, parentsByChild };
}

/** A good initial root: the most prolific registered parent (sires first on ties). */
export function pickDefaultRootId(fowls: FowlRecord[], index?: LineageIndex): string | null {
  if (fowls.length === 0) return null;
  const idx = index ?? buildLineageIndex(fowls);
  const maleRank = (gender?: string) =>
    ['rooster', 'cock', 'stag', 'male'].includes((gender ?? '').trim().toLowerCase()) ? 0 : 1;
  let best: { id: string; count: number; rank: number; name: string } | null = null;
  for (const [id, children] of idx.childrenByParent) {
    const fowl = idx.byId.get(id);
    if (!fowl) continue;
    const rank = maleRank(fowl.gender);
    if (
      !best ||
      children.length > best.count ||
      (children.length === best.count && rank < best.rank) ||
      (children.length === best.count && rank === best.rank && fowl.name.localeCompare(best.name) < 0)
    ) {
      best = { id, count: children.length, rank, name: fowl.name };
    }
  }
  if (best) return best.id;
  return String(fowls[0].id);
}

export interface BuildTopologyOptions {
  rootId: string;
  direction: LineageDirection;
  maxDepth: number;
  collapsed: Set<string>;
}

/**
 * Build the visible pedigree topology around a root bird.
 *
 * - `down` walks children, `up` walks parents, `both` does each from the root.
 * - Partners (the other resolved parent of a drawn child) are included in the
 *   parent generation so every drawing pair is visually complete.
 * - Collapsed nodes and the depth limit prune traversal; the pruned counts are
 *   reported on the node so the UI can show "+N".
 * - Cycles are bounded by a step guard and never recurse infinitely.
 */
export function buildLineageTopology(
  index: LineageIndex,
  options: BuildTopologyOptions
): LineageTopology | null {
  const { rootId, direction, maxDepth, collapsed } = options;
  const root = index.byId.get(rootId);
  if (!root) return null;

  const generations = new Map<string, number>();
  const order: string[] = [];
  const seenOrder = new Set<string>();
  const record = (id: string) => {
    if (seenOrder.has(id)) return;
    seenOrder.add(id);
    order.push(id);
  };

  const queue: Array<{ id: string; gen: number }> = [{ id: rootId, gen: 0 }];
  const guardLimit = Math.max(64, index.byId.size * 6);
  let steps = 0;

  while (queue.length > 0 && steps < guardLimit) {
    steps += 1;
    const next = queue.shift();
    if (!next) break;
    const { id, gen } = next;
    const current = generations.get(id);
    if (current !== undefined && current >= gen) continue;

    generations.set(id, gen);
    record(id);

    // A collapsed node hides its branch in the direction of travel.
    if (Math.abs(gen) >= maxDepth || collapsed.has(id)) continue;

    if (direction !== 'up') {
      (index.childrenByParent.get(id) ?? []).forEach((child) => {
        queue.push({ id: String(child.id), gen: gen + 1 });
      });
    }
    if (direction !== 'down') {
      const parents = index.parentsByChild.get(id);
      if (parents?.sire) queue.push({ id: String(parents.sire.id), gen: gen - 1 });
      if (parents?.dam) queue.push({ id: String(parents.dam.id), gen: gen - 1 });
    }
  }

  // Partners: when a child is in the graph but one of its parents is not (the
  // mate of a lineage bird), include that parent in the child's parent row.
  if (direction !== 'up') {
    Array.from(generations.entries()).forEach(([childId, gen]) => {
      const parents = index.parentsByChild.get(childId);
      if (!parents) return;
      const partnerGen = gen - 1;
      if (Math.abs(partnerGen) > maxDepth) return;
      [parents.sire, parents.dam].forEach((parent) => {
        if (!parent) return;
        const parentId = String(parent.id);
        if (parentId === childId || generations.has(parentId)) return;
        generations.set(parentId, partnerGen);
        record(parentId);
      });
    });
  }

  const included = (id: string) => generations.has(id);
  const generationOf = (id: string) => generations.get(id) ?? 0;

  const pairMap = new Map<string, LineageTopologyPair>();
  const singleMap = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  generations.forEach((childGen, childId) => {
    const parents = index.parentsByChild.get(childId);
    if (!parents) return;
    const sire = parents.sire;
    const dam = parents.dam;
    const sireId = sire ? String(sire.id) : null;
    const damId = dam ? String(dam.id) : null;
    const sireOk = sireId != null && included(sireId) && generationOf(sireId) < childGen;
    const damOk = damId != null && included(damId) && generationOf(damId) < childGen;

    if (sireOk && damOk && sireId !== damId) {
      const key = `${sireId}|||${damId}`;
      const pair = pairMap.get(key) ?? {
        key,
        sireId: sireId as string,
        damId: damId as string,
        childIds: [],
      };
      if (!pair.childIds.includes(childId)) pair.childIds.push(childId);
      pairMap.set(key, pair);
      return;
    }
    const parentId = sireOk ? sireId : damOk ? damId : null;
    if (!parentId) return;
    const bucket = singleMap.get(parentId) ?? new Set<string>();
    bucket.add(childId);
    singleMap.set(parentId, bucket);
  });

  // Cycle-safe count of every descendant that is not drawn.
  const countHidden = (id: string): { children: number; descendants: number } => {
    const visited = new Set<string>([id]);
    const stack = (index.childrenByParent.get(id) ?? []).map((c) => c.id);
    let hiddenChildren = 0;
    let hiddenDescendants = 0;
    while (stack.length > 0) {
      const nextId = stack.pop();
      if (nextId == null) continue;
      const key = String(nextId);
      if (visited.has(key)) continue;
      visited.add(key);
      if (!included(key)) hiddenDescendants += 1;
      (index.childrenByParent.get(key) ?? []).forEach((grandchild) =>
        stack.push(grandchild.id)
      );
    }
    (index.childrenByParent.get(id) ?? []).forEach((child) => {
      if (!included(String(child.id))) hiddenChildren += 1;
    });
    return { children: hiddenChildren, descendants: hiddenDescendants };
  };

  const nodes: LineageTopologyNode[] = order
    .map((id) => {
      const fowl = index.byId.get(id);
      if (!fowl) return null;
      const hidden = countHidden(id);
      return {
        id,
        fowl,
        generation: generationOf(id),
        isRoot: id === rootId,
        hiddenChildren: hidden.children,
        hiddenDescendants: hidden.descendants,
      } satisfies LineageTopologyNode;
    })
    .filter((node): node is LineageTopologyNode => node !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => a.generation - b.generation || order.indexOf(a.id) - order.indexOf(b.id));

  const pairs = Array.from(pairMap.values()).map((pair) => ({
    ...pair,
    childIds: [...pair.childIds].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        order.indexOf(a) - order.indexOf(b) ||
        (index.byId.get(a)?.name ?? '').localeCompare(index.byId.get(b)?.name ?? '')
    ),
  }));

  const singles: LineageTopologySingle[] = Array.from(singleMap.entries()).map(
    ([parentId, childIds]) => ({
      parentId,
      childIds: Array.from(childIds).sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a) - order.indexOf(b)),
    })
  );

  return {
    rootId,
    direction,
    nodes,
    pairs,
    singles,
    nodeOrder: order,
  };
}

/**
 * Deterministic layered layout. Partners that share a visible child are kept
 * adjacent within a generation so pair connectors stay short and readable.
 */
export function layoutLineageTopology(topology: LineageTopology): LineageLayout {
  const nodeById = new Map(topology.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const orderIndex = new Map(topology.nodeOrder.map((id, i) => [id, i]));
  const gens = Array.from(new Set(topology.nodes.map((n) => n.generation))).sort(
    (a, b) => a - b
  );
  const minGen = gens[0] ?? 0;
  const rowY = (gen: number) => PAD_Y + (gen - minGen) * (LINEAGE_NODE_HEIGHT + ROW_GAP);

  const partnerAdjacency = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  topology.pairs.forEach((pair) => {
    const sire = nodeById.get(pair.sireId);
    const dam = nodeById.get(pair.damId);
    if (!sire || !dam || sire.generation !== dam.generation) return;
    const sireSet = partnerAdjacency.get(pair.sireId) ?? new Set<string>();
    sireSet.add(pair.damId);
    partnerAdjacency.set(pair.sireId, sireSet);
    const damSet = partnerAdjacency.get(pair.damId) ?? new Set<string>();
    damSet.add(pair.sireId);
    partnerAdjacency.set(pair.damId, damSet);
  });

  const positions = new Map<string, { x: number; y: number; centerX: number }>();
  let maxRowWidth = 0;
  const rowChains = new Map<number, string[][]>();

  gens.forEach((gen) => {
    const rowIds = topology.nodes
      .filter((n) => n.generation === gen)
      .map((n) => n.id)
      .sort((a, b) => (orderIndex.get(a) ?? 0) - (orderIndex.get(b) ?? 0));

    const visited = new Set<string>();
    const chains: string[][] = [];
    rowIds.forEach((startId) => {
      if (visited.has(startId)) return;
      const chain: string[] = [];
      const stack: string[] = [startId];
      visited.add(startId);
      while (stack.length > 0) {
        const id = stack.shift();
        if (id == null) continue;
        chain.push(id);
        const partners = Array.from(partnerAdjacency.get(id) ?? []).sort(
          (a, b) => (orderIndex.get(a) ?? 0) - (orderIndex.get(b) ?? 0)
        );
        partners.forEach((partner) => {
          if (visited.has(partner)) return;
          visited.add(partner);
          stack.push(partner);
        });
      }
      chains.push(chain);
    });

    const chainWidth = (chain: string[]) =>
      chain.length * LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH + (chain.length - 1) * NODE_GAP;
    const width = chains.reduce((sum, chain) => sum + chainWidth(chain), 0);
    const totalWidth = width + Math.max(0, chains.length - 1) * CHAIN_GAP;
    maxRowWidth = Math.max(maxRowWidth, totalWidth);
    rowChains.set(gen, chains);
  });

  gens.forEach((gen) => {
    const chains = rowChains.get(gen) ?? [];
    const chainWidth = (chain: string[]) =>
      chain.length * LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH + (chain.length - 1) * NODE_GAP;
    const rowWidth =
      chains.reduce((sum, chain) => sum + chainWidth(chain), 0) +
      Math.max(0, chains.length - 1) * CHAIN_GAP;
    let cursor = PAD_X + (maxRowWidth - rowWidth) / 2;
    const y = rowY(gen);

    chains.forEach((chain) => {
      chain.forEach((id, idx) => {
        const x = cursor + idx * (LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH + NODE_GAP);
        positions.set(id, {
          x,
          y,
          centerX: x + LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH / 2,
        });
      });
      cursor += chainWidth(chain) + CHAIN_GAP;
    });
  });

  const nodes: LineageLayoutNode[] = topology.nodes.map((node) => {
    const pos = positions.get(node.id) ?? { x: PAD_X, y: rowY(node.generation), centerX: PAD_X + LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH / 2 };
    return {
      ...node,
      x: pos.x,
      y: pos.y,
      centerX: pos.centerX,
      width: LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH,
      height: LINEAGE_NODE_HEIGHT,
    };
  });
  const laidOutById = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));

  const pairs: LineageLayoutPair[] = topology.pairs
    .map((pair) => {
      const sire = laidOutById.get(pair.sireId);
      const dam = laidOutById.get(pair.damId);
      const children = pair.childIds
        .map((id) => laidOutById.get(id))
        .filter((n): n is LineageLayoutNode => Boolean(n));
      if (!sire || !dam || children.length === 0) return null;

      const parentBottom = Math.max(sire.y + sire.height, dam.y + dam.height);
      const hubY = parentBottom + PAIR_DROP;
      const busY = hubY + PAIR_BUS;
      const hubX = (sire.centerX + dam.centerX) / 2;
      const childXs = children.map((child) => child.centerX);
      const minChildX = Math.min(...childXs);
      const maxChildX = Math.max(...childXs);

      return {
        ...pair,
        hubX,
        hubY,
        busY,
        sireX: sire.centerX,
        damX: dam.centerX,
        parentPaths: [
          `M ${sire.centerX} ${sire.y + sire.height} V ${hubY} H ${hubX}`,
          `M ${dam.centerX} ${dam.y + dam.height} V ${hubY} H ${hubX}`,
        ],
        dropPath: `M ${hubX} ${hubY} V ${busY}`,
        busPath:
          minChildX === maxChildX
            ? `M ${minChildX} ${busY} V ${children[0].y}`
            : `M ${minChildX} ${busY} H ${maxChildX}`,
        childPaths: children.map((child) => `M ${child.centerX} ${busY} V ${child.y}`),
        childCount: children.length,
      } satisfies LineageLayoutPair;
    })
    .filter((pair): pair is LineageLayoutPair => pair !== null);

  const singles: LineageLayoutSingle[] = topology.singles
    .map((single) => {
      const parent = laidOutById.get(single.parentId);
      const children = single.childIds
        .map((id) => laidOutById.get(id))
        .filter((n): n is LineageLayoutNode => Boolean(n));
      if (!parent || children.length === 0) return null;
      const parentBottom = parent.y + parent.height;
      const busY = parentBottom + SINGLE_DROP;
      const childXs = children.map((child) => child.centerX);
      const minChildX = Math.min(...childXs);
      const maxChildX = Math.max(...childXs);
      return {
        ...single,
        busY,
        parentX: parent.centerX,
        parentBottom,
        path: `M ${parent.centerX} ${parentBottom} V ${busY}`,
        busPath:
          minChildX === maxChildX
            ? `M ${minChildX} ${busY} V ${children[0].y}`
            : `M ${minChildX} ${busY} H ${maxChildX}`,
        childPaths: children.map((child) => `M ${child.centerX} ${busY} V ${child.y}`),
      } satisfies LineageLayoutSingle;
    })
    .filter((single): single is LineageLayoutSingle => single !== null);

  const maxX = Math.max(
    ...nodes.map((node) => node.x + node.width),
    PAD_X + LINEAGE_NODE_WIDTH
  );
  const maxY = Math.max(
    ...nodes.map((node) => node.y + node.height),
    PAD_Y + LINEAGE_NODE_HEIGHT
  );

  const rootNode = nodes.find((node) => node.isRoot);
  const generations: LineageGenerationRow[] = gens.map((gen, idx) => ({
    gen,
    label: `Generation ${idx + 1}`,
    y: rowY(gen),
    isRoot: rootNode?.generation === gen,
  }));

  return {
    nodes,
    pairs,
    singles,
    generations,
    width: maxX + PAD_X,
    height: maxY + PAD_Y,
  };
}

/** Code shown on a node; falls back to the resolved code map. */
export function lineageBirdCode(fowl: FowlRecord, codes?: Map<string, string>): string {
  const raw =
    fowl.bird_code ||
    fowl.chicken_code ||
    fowl.birth_code ||
    codes?.get(String(fowl.id)) ||
    '';
  return formatBirdCodeForDisplay(raw);
}

    expect(resolveParentId('Spur', chick, flock)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses ambiguous names', () => {

    expect(parentRecordOf(legacy, 'sire', flock)?.id).toBe(1);
    expect(parentRecordOf(legacy, 'dam', flock)?.id).toBe(2);
  });
});

describe('childrenOf', () => {
  it('returns children linked by id', () => {
    expect(childrenOf(sire, flock).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);
    expect(childrenOf(dam, flock).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);
  });

  it('falls back to parent names for legacy rows', () => {
    const legacy = bird({ id: 5, name: 'Legacy', sire: 'Blue King', dam: 'Gold Hen' });
    expect(childrenOf(sire, [...flock, legacy]).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3, 5]);
  });

  it('ignores unrelated birds', () => {
    const stranger = bird({ id: 6, name: 'Stranger', sire: 'Nobody', dam: 'Nobody' });
    expect(childrenOf(sire, [...flock, stranger]).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);
  });
});

describe('pairings / partner / offspring', () => {
  const pair = pairing({
    id: 10,
    sire_id: 1,
    dam_id: 2,
    sire_name: 'Blue King',
    dam_name: 'Gold Hen',
    pairing_code: '1A',
    offspring_seq: 1,
  });

  it('finds pairings for either bird', () => {
    expect(pairingsFor(sire, [pair]).map((p) => p.id)).toEqual([10]);
    expect(pairingsFor(dam, [pair]).map((p) => p.id)).toEqual([10]);
    expect(pairingsFor(chick, [pair])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('resolves the active partner', () => {
    expect(activePartnerOf(sire, [pair], flock)?.partner?.id).toBe(2);
    expect(activePartnerOf(dam, [pair], flock)?.partner?.id).toBe(1);
    expect(activePartnerOf(chick, [pair], flock)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null when there is no active pairing', () => {
    const done = pairing({ ...pair, outcome: 'Completed' });
    expect(activePartnerOf(sire, [done], flock)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('lists offspring by pairing id, then by couple, then by names', () => {
    expect(offspringForPairing(pair, flock).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);

    const noLink = { ...chick, sire_id: null, dam_id: null, pairing_id: null };
    expect(offspringForPairing(pair, [sire, dam, noLink]).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);

    const coupleOnly = {
      ...pair,
      id: 11,
      sire_id: null,
      dam_id: null,
    };
    expect(offspringForPairing(coupleOnly, [sire, dam, noLink]).map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([3]);
  });
});

describe('pairingCodeFor', () => {
  it('joins normalized codes', () => {
    expect(pairingCodeFor('1', 'A')).toBe('1A');
    expect(pairingCodeFor(' 1B ', 'x')).toBe('1Bx');
  });

  it('is null when either code is missing', () => {
    expect(pairingCodeFor('1', '')).toBeNull();
    expect(pairingCodeFor(null, 'A')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('fowlMatchesQuery', () => {
  it('matches only name, wing band, and codes by default', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'spur')).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'wb-003')).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, '1A1')).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, '1A')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('does NOT match parents, breed, traits, or color by default', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'blue king')).toBe(false);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'gold hen')).toBe(false);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'kelso')).toBe(false);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'red')).toBe(false);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'aggressive')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('matches parents only when includeParents option is true', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'blue king', null, { includeParents: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'gold hen', null, { includeParents: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'kelso', null, { includeParents: true })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('matches trait and feather color when includeTraitsAndColors option is true', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'red', null, { includeTraitsAndColors: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'aggressive', null, { includeTraitsAndColors: true })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('ignores extra whitespace and case differences', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, '   SPUR   ')).toBe(true);
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, '  wb-003  ')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('does not match unrelated text', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, 'hatch')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('matches everything on an empty query', () => {
    expect(fowlMatchesQuery(chick, '   ')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('pairingConflict', () => {
  const couple = pairing({
    id: 10,
    sire_id: 1,
    dam_id: 2,
    sire_name: 'Blue King',
    dam_name: 'Gold Hen',
    pairing_code: '1A',
  });

  it('is null when neither bird is paired', () => {
    expect(pairingConflict([], sire, dam)).toBeNull();
    expect(pairingConflict(null as unknown as BreedingPairRecord[], null, dam)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('reports the exact couple when it is already on file', () => {
    const done = pairing({ ...couple, outcome: 'Completed' });
    const conflict = pairingConflict([done], sire, dam);
    expect(conflict).toEqual({ kind: 'couple', pairing: done });
  });

  it('treats the couple Active pairing as already recorded, not occupied', () => {
    const conflict = pairingConflict([couple], sire, dam);
    expect(conflict?.kind).toBe('couple');
  });

  it('blocks when the sire has a different Active partner', () => {
    const rival = pairing({ id: 11, sire_id: 1, dam_id: 7, dam_name: 'Other Hen', outcome: 'Active' });
    const conflict = pairingConflict([rival], sire, dam);
    expect(conflict).toEqual({ kind: 'occupied', bird: 'sire', partnerName: 'Other Hen', pairing: rival });
  });

  it('blocks when the dam has a different Active partner', () => {
    const rival = pairing({ id: 12, sire_id: 7, dam_id: 2, sire_name: 'Other Hen', outcome: 'Active' });
    const conflict = pairingConflict([rival], sire, dam);
    expect(conflict).toEqual({ kind: 'occupied', bird: 'dam', partnerName: 'Other Hen', pairing: rival });
  });

  it('matches legacy name-only couple rows', () => {
    const legacy = pairing({ id: 13, sire_id: null, dam_id: null, sire_name: 'Blue King', dam_name: 'Gold Hen' });
    expect(pairingConflict([legacy], sire, dam)?.kind).toBe('couple');
  });

  it('ignores Completed pairings of other couples', () => {
    const old = pairing({ id: 14, sire_id: 1, dam_id: 7, outcome: 'Completed' });
    expect(pairingConflict([old], sire, dam)).toBeNull();
  });
});

  const born = pairing({ id: 10, pairing_code: '1A', outcome: 'Active' });

    expect(originPairingOf({ ...chick, pairing_id: 99 }, [born])).toBeNull();

});

import type { BreedingPairRecord, FowlRecord } from './types';
import { isKnownParent, nameKey, normalizeParentName } from './family-tree';
import { normalizeBirdCode } from './bird-code';
import { offspringBaseCode } from './breeding';

/** 'foundation stock' and blank names never resolve to a registry row. */
export const isResolvableParentName = (value?: string | null): boolean =>
  normalizeParentName(value) !== '' && isKnownParent(value);

const sameFarm = (
  a: { user_id?: string | number } | null | undefined,
  b: { user_id?: string | number } | null | undefined
): boolean => {
  if (a?.user_id == null || b?.user_id == null) return true;
  return String(a.user_id) === String(b.user_id);
};

/** Unique, non-self, same-farm name match — the only case we trust as an id link. */
export function resolveParentId(
  parentName: string | null | undefined,
  child: { id?: number; user_id?: string | number } | null | undefined,
  fowls: FowlRecord[]
): number | null {
  const key = nameKey(parentName);
  if (!key || !isKnownParent(parentName)) return null;
  const matches = fowls.filter(
    (f) =>
      nameKey(f.name) === key &&
      (child?.id == null || f.id !== child.id) &&
      sameFarm(f, child)
  );
  return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0].id : null;
}

/** Resolved parent ids for a child being created/edited from sire/dam names. */
export function parentLinkIds(
  child: { id?: number; user_id?: string | number },
  sireName: string | null | undefined,
  damName: string | null | undefined,
  fowls: FowlRecord[]
): { sire_id: number | null; dam_id: number | null } {
  return {
    sire_id: resolveParentId(sireName, child, fowls),
    dam_id: resolveParentId(damName, child, fowls),
  };
}

/** Parent row: id link first, unambiguous name match as legacy fallback. */
export function parentRecordOf(
  child: FowlRecord,
  role: 'sire' | 'dam',
  fowls: FowlRecord[]
): FowlRecord | null {
  const linkedId = role === 'sire' ? child.sire_id : child.dam_id;
  if (linkedId != null) {
    const linked = fowls.find((f) => f.id === linkedId);
    if (linked) return linked;
  }
  const id = resolveParentId(role === 'sire' ? child.sire : child.dam, child, fowls);
  return id != null ? fowls.find((f) => f.id === id) ?? null : null;
}

/** Children of a bird — id link first, parent-name match for legacy rows. */
export function childrenOf(parent: FowlRecord, fowls: FowlRecord[]): FowlRecord[] {
  const key = nameKey(parent.name);
  return fowls.filter((c) => {
    if (c.sire_id != null || c.dam_id != null) {
      return c.sire_id === parent.id || c.dam_id === parent.id;
    }
    return nameKey(c.sire) === key || nameKey(c.dam) === key;
  });
}

/** Pairings where this bird is the sire or the dam (id link, name fallback). */
export function pairingsFor(bird: FowlRecord, pairings: BreedingPairRecord[]): BreedingPairRecord[] {
  const key = nameKey(bird.name);
  return pairings.filter(
    (p) =>
      p.sire_id === bird.id ||
      p.dam_id === bird.id ||
      (p.sire_id == null && nameKey(p.sire_name) === key) ||
      (p.dam_id == null && nameKey(p.dam_name) === key)
  );
}

/** The bird's current partner, if it has one 'Active' pairing. */
export function activePartnerOf(
  bird: FowlRecord,
  pairings: BreedingPairRecord[],
  fowls: FowlRecord[]
): { partner: FowlRecord | null; pairing: BreedingPairRecord } | null {
  const active = pairingsFor(bird, pairings).find((p) => p.outcome === 'Active');
  if (!active) return null;

  const birdKey = nameKey(bird.name);
  const isSire =
    active.sire_id === bird.id ||
    (active.sire_id == null && nameKey(active.sire_name) === birdKey);
  const partnerId = isSire ? active.dam_id : active.sire_id;
  const partnerName = isSire ? active.dam_name : active.sire_name;

  let partner =
    partnerId != null ? fowls.find((f) => f.id === partnerId) ?? null : null;
  if (!partner) {
    const id = resolveParentId(partnerName, bird, fowls);
    partner = id != null ? fowls.find((f) => f.id === id) ?? null : null;
  }
  return { partner, pairing: active };
}

/** Offspring recorded for a pairing — pairing_id link, couple match as fallback. */
export function offspringForPairing(
  pairing: BreedingPairRecord,
  fowls: FowlRecord[]
): FowlRecord[] {
  return fowls.filter((c) => {
    if (c.pairing_id != null) return c.pairing_id === pairing.id;
    const coupleMatches =
      pairing.sire_id != null &&
      pairing.dam_id != null &&
      c.sire_id === pairing.sire_id &&
      c.dam_id === pairing.dam_id;
    if (coupleMatches) return true;
    return (
      nameKey(c.sire) === nameKey(pairing.sire_name) &&
      nameKey(c.dam) === nameKey(pairing.dam_name) &&
      isKnownParent(pairing.sire_name) &&
      isKnownParent(pairing.dam_name)
    );
  });
}

/** Auto pairing code: sire bird_code + dam bird_code (e.g. '1A'). */
export function pairingCodeFor(
  sireCode: string | null | undefined,
  damCode: string | null | undefined
): string | null {
  const code = offspringBaseCode(normalizeBirdCode(sireCode), normalizeBirdCode(damCode));
  return code || null;
}

/** Why a new pairing cannot be inserted as-is, or that it already exists. */
export type PairingConflict =
  | { kind: 'occupied'; bird: 'sire' | 'dam'; partnerName: string; pairing: BreedingPairRecord }
  | { kind: 'couple'; pairing: BreedingPairRecord };

/**
 * Pre-flight check for recording a sire x dam pairing:
 * - 'occupied' — one of the birds already has a DIFFERENT Active partner
 *   (the unique index would reject the insert; the user must end that pairing).
 * - 'couple'   — this exact couple is already on file (an existing row should be
 *   reactivated / updated instead of inserting a duplicate).
 */
export function pairingConflict(
  pairings: BreedingPairRecord[],
  sire: FowlRecord | null | undefined,
  dam: FowlRecord | null | undefined
): PairingConflict | null {
  if (!sire || !dam) return null;

  const sameCouple = (p: BreedingPairRecord): boolean =>
    (p.sire_id != null && p.dam_id != null && p.sire_id === sire.id && p.dam_id === dam.id) ||
    (p.sire_id == null &&
      p.dam_id == null &&
      nameKey(p.sire_name) === nameKey(sire.name) &&
      nameKey(p.dam_name) === nameKey(dam.name));

  const occupiedByOther = (
    bird: FowlRecord,
    role: 'sire' | 'dam'
  ): PairingConflict | null => {
    const clash = pairingsFor(bird, pairings).find(
      (p) => p.outcome === 'Active' && !sameCouple(p)
    );
    if (!clash) return null;
    return {
      kind: 'occupied',
      bird: role,
      partnerName: role === 'sire' ? clash.dam_name : clash.sire_name,
      pairing: clash,
    };
  };

  return occupiedByOther(sire, 'sire') ?? occupiedByOther(dam, 'dam') ?? (() => {
    const couple = pairings.find(sameCouple);
    return couple ? { kind: 'couple', pairing: couple } : null;
  })();
}

/** The pairing this bird was produced by (`fowl.pairing_id`), if it is loaded. */
export function originPairingOf(
  bird: FowlRecord,
  pairings: BreedingPairRecord[]
): BreedingPairRecord | null {
  if (bird.pairing_id == null) return null;
  return pairings.find((p) => p.id === bird.pairing_id) ?? null;
}

/**
 * Normalizes text for search: removes excess whitespace, converts subscripts to digits, and lowercases.
 */
export function normalizeSearchTerm(text?: string | null): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return String(text)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[\u2080-\u2089]/g, (c) => String(c.charCodeAt(0) - 0x2080));
}

export interface FowlMatchOptions {
  includeParents?: boolean;
  includeTraitsAndColors?: boolean;
}

export type FowlMatchReason = 'self' | 'sire' | 'dam' | null;

export interface FowlMatchResult {
  matched: boolean;
  reason: FowlMatchReason;
  parentHint?: string;
  nameStarts: boolean;
  nameContains: boolean;
}

/**
 * Detailed inspection of how a fowl matches a search query.
 * By default, matches ONLY the chicken's own fields:
 * - Chicken name
 * - Unique identifier (e.g. 1A1; "1A" matches offspring of that pair)
 * - Wing band number
 * If includeParents is true, also matches sire and dam.
 * If includeTraitsAndColors is true, also matches trait and feather color.
 */
export function inspectFowlMatch(
  fowl: FowlRecord,
  query: string,
  resolvedCode?: string | null,
  options?: FowlMatchOptions
): FowlMatchResult {
  const q = normalizeSearchTerm(query);
  if (!q) {
    return {
      matched: true,
      reason: null,
      nameStarts: false,
      nameContains: false,
    };
  }

  const code = resolvedCode || fowl.chicken_code || fowl.bird_code;
  const normName = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.name);
  const normCode = normalizeSearchTerm(code);
  const normWing = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.wing_band);

  const nameStarts = normName.startsWith(q);
  const nameContains = normName.includes(q);
  const codeMatches = normCode ? normCode.includes(q) : false;
  const wingMatches = normWing ? normWing.includes(q) : false;

  let colorMatches = false;
  let traitMatches = false;
  if (options?.includeTraitsAndColors) {
    const normColor = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.feather_color || fowl.color);
    const normTrait = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.trait || fowl.behavior_trait);
    colorMatches = normColor ? normColor.includes(q) : false;
    traitMatches = normTrait ? normTrait.includes(q) : false;
  }

  // 1. Own fields have highest priority
  if (nameContains || codeMatches || wingMatches || colorMatches || traitMatches) {
    return {
      matched: true,
      reason: 'self',
      nameStarts,
      nameContains,
    };
  }

  // 2. Optional: Parents search
  if (options?.includeParents) {
    const normDam = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.dam);
    if (normDam && normDam.includes(q)) {
      return {
        matched: true,
        reason: 'dam',
        parentHint: `Dam: ${fowl.dam}`,
        nameStarts: false,
        nameContains: false,
      };
    }
    const normSire = normalizeSearchTerm(fowl.sire);
    if (normSire && normSire.includes(q)) {
      return {
        matched: true,
        reason: 'sire',
        parentHint: `Sire: ${fowl.sire}`,
        nameStarts: false,
        nameContains: false,
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    matched: false,
    reason: null,
    nameStarts: false,
    nameContains: false,
  };
}

/** Text search across chicken own fields (name, code/identifier, wing band). */
export function fowlMatchesQuery(
  fowl: FowlRecord,
  query: string,
  resolvedCode?: string | null,
  options?: FowlMatchOptions
): boolean {
  return inspectFowlMatch(fowl, query, resolvedCode, options).matched;
}

/**
 * Relevance comparator:
 * 1. Names that START with query
 * 2. Names that merely CONTAIN query
 * 3. Other own-field matches (identifier, wing band)
 * 4. Parent matches (when includeParents is true)
 */
export function compareFowlSearchRelevance(
  matchA: FowlMatchResult,
  matchB: FowlMatchResult
): number {
  const rank = (m: FowlMatchResult) => {
    if (!m.matched) return 99;
    if (m.nameStarts) return 1;
    if (m.nameContains) return 2;
    if (m.reason === 'self') return 3;
    if (m.reason === 'sire' || m.reason === 'dam') return 4;
    return 5;
  };
  return rank(matchA) - rank(matchB);
}
