import type { FowlRecord } from './types';
import { isKnownParent, nameKey, normalizeParentName, FOUNDATION_STOCK } from './family-tree';
import { parentRecordOf } from './lineage';

/**
 * Default ancestry search depth for relatedness classification (4 generations).
 * Covers subject, parents (G1), grandparents (G2), great-grandparents (G3),
 * and great-great-grandparents (G4).
 */
export const DEFAULT_RELATEDNESS_SEARCH_DEPTH = 4;

export type RelatednessType = 'close' | 'line' | 'outcross' | 'unknown';

/**
 * Farm-language constants (shown in English with local Filipino/Visayan secondary labels).
 * Kept in this single location for centralized maintenance.
 */
export const RELATEDNESS_TERMS = {
  close: {
    type: 'close' as const,
    label: 'Close Breeding',
    secondaryLabel: 'mag-amay / magbugto',
    fullLabel: 'Close Breeding (mag-amay / magbugto)',
    description: 'Parent × offspring or full siblings.',
    badgeColor: 'amber',
  },
  line: {
    type: 'line' as const,
    label: 'Line Breeding',
    secondaryLabel: 'magpakaisa',
    fullLabel: 'Line Breeding (magpakaisa)',
    description: 'Shared ancestor within search depth (e.g. half-siblings, cousins, grandparent × grandchild).',
    badgeColor: 'blue',
  },
  outcross: {
    type: 'outcross' as const,
    label: 'Outcross (no known shared ancestor)',
    secondaryLabel: 'hindi magka-anak',
    fullLabel: 'Outcross (no known shared ancestor)',
    description: 'No shared ancestor found within search depth.',
    tooltip: 'Based on recorded lineage only.',
    badgeColor: 'emerald',
  },
  unknown: {
    type: 'unknown' as const,
    label: 'Unknown',
    secondaryLabel: 'kulang sa datos',
    fullLabel: 'Unknown (not enough lineage data)',
    description: 'Not enough lineage data to decide (missing parents).',
    tooltip: 'Not enough lineage data to determine relatedness.',
    badgeColor: 'neutral',
  },
} as const;

export interface SharedAncestorInfo {
  id?: number;
  name: string;
  sireDepth: number;
  damDepth: number;
}

export interface RelatednessClassification {
  type: RelatednessType;
  label: string;
  secondaryLabel: string;
  fullLabel: string;
  relationship: string;
  sharedAncestors: SharedAncestorInfo[];
  inbreedingCoefficient: number | null; // 0 to 100%, or null for foundation / unknown
  tooltip: string;
  isCloseBreeding: boolean;
  requiresConfirmation: boolean;
}

/** Check if a parent string denotes explicit foundation stock. */
export function isFoundationParent(parentName?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!parentName) return false;
  return (parentName || '').trim().toLowerCase() === FOUNDATION_STOCK;
}

/** Check if a fowl is a foundation bird (no recorded parents or explicitly recorded as Foundation Stock). */
export function isFoundationBird(fowl: FowlRecord | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!fowl) return false;
  const noSireId = fowl.sire_id == null;
  const noDamId = fowl.dam_id == null;
  const isSireUnrecorded = !fowl.sire || (fowl.sire || '').trim() === '' || isFoundationParent(fowl.sire);
  const isDamUnrecorded = !fowl.dam || (fowl.dam || '').trim() === '' || isFoundationParent(fowl.dam);
  return noSireId && noDamId && isSireUnrecorded && isDamUnrecorded;
}

interface AncestorNode {
  fowl?: FowlRecord;
  name: string;
  id?: number;
  depth: number;
}

/**
 * Traverse all ancestors of a chicken up to maxDepth.
 * Uses a visited Set of fowl IDs and normalized names to guard against cycles.
 */
export function collectAncestors(
  root: FowlRecord,
  fowls: FowlRecord[],
  maxDepth = DEFAULT_RELATEDNESS_SEARCH_DEPTH
): Map<string, AncestorNode> {
  const ancestors = new Map<string, AncestorNode>();
  const visited = new Set<string>();

  const rootKey = nameKey(root.name) || String(root.id);
  visited.add(rootKey);

  function walk(current: FowlRecord, depth: number) {
    if (depth > maxDepth) return;

    const parents: { name?: string | null; role: 'sire' | 'dam' }[] = [
      { name: current.sire, role: 'sire' },
      { name: current.dam, role: 'dam' },
    ];

    for (const { name, role } of parents) {
      if (!isKnownParent(name)) continue;

      const pRecord = parentRecordOf(current, role, fowls);
      const pName = pRecord?.name || normalizeParentName(name);
      const pKey = nameKey(pName);

      if (!pKey || visited.has(pKey)) continue;

      // Add to ancestor map if not recorded or at a shallower depth
      const existing = ancestors.get(pKey);
      if (!existing || depth < existing.depth) {
        ancestors.set(pKey, {
          fowl: pRecord || undefined,
          name: pName,
          id: pRecord?.id,
          depth,
        });
      }

      if (pRecord) {
        visited.add(pKey);
        walk(pRecord, depth + 1);
        visited.delete(pKey);
      }
    }
  }

  walk(root, 1);
  return ancestors;
}

/**
 * Classifies the genealogical relatedness between a prospective or recorded sire and dam.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - Close Breeding ("mag-amay / magbugto"): Parent x Offspring or Full Siblings.
 * - Line Breeding ("magpakaisa"): More distant relatives sharing >= 1 ancestor within maxDepth
 *   (e.g. Grandparent x Grandchild, Half-siblings, First cousins, etc.).
 * - Outcross: No shared ancestor found within search depth.
 * - Unknown: Incomplete/missing parent lineage where relatedness cannot be determined.
 *
 * @param sire Prospective male chicken
 * @param dam Prospective female chicken
 * @param fowls Full flock registry for ancestry tree traversal
 * @param maxDepth Max search depth (default 4 generations)
 */
export function classifyPairingRelatedness(
  sire: FowlRecord | null | undefined,
  dam: FowlRecord | null | undefined,
  fowls: FowlRecord[] = [],
  maxDepth = DEFAULT_RELATEDNESS_SEARCH_DEPTH
): RelatednessClassification {
  if (!sire || !dam) {
    return {
      type: 'unknown',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Missing chicken selection',
      sharedAncestors: [],
      inbreedingCoefficient: null,
      tooltip: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.tooltip,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // 1. Same chicken (self-pairing)
  if (sire.id === dam.id || nameKey(sire.name) === nameKey(dam.name)) {
    return {
      type: 'close',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Same chicken (self)',
      sharedAncestors: [{ id: sire.id, name: sire.name, sireDepth: 0, damDepth: 0 }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: 50,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel} — Same chicken.`,
      isCloseBreeding: true,
      requiresConfirmation: true,
    };
  }

  // 2. Direct Parent x Offspring check
  const sireKey = nameKey(sire.name);
  const damKey = nameKey(dam.name);

  // Is sire the father of dam?
  const damSireMatch =
    (dam.sire_id != null && dam.sire_id === sire.id) ||
    (isKnownParent(dam.sire) && nameKey(dam.sire) === sireKey);
  if (damSireMatch) {
    return {
      type: 'close',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Parent × Offspring (Father × Daughter)',
      sharedAncestors: [{ id: sire.id, name: sire.name, sireDepth: 0, damDepth: 1 }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: 25,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel} — Sire is the direct father of the dam.`,
      isCloseBreeding: true,
      requiresConfirmation: true,
    };
  }

  // Is dam the mother of sire?
  const sireDamMatch =
    (sire.dam_id != null && sire.dam_id === dam.id) ||
    (isKnownParent(sire.dam) && nameKey(sire.dam) === damKey);
  if (sireDamMatch) {
    return {
      type: 'close',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Parent × Offspring (Son × Mother)',
      sharedAncestors: [{ id: dam.id, name: dam.name, sireDepth: 1, damDepth: 0 }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: 25,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel} — Dam is the direct mother of the sire.`,
      isCloseBreeding: true,
      requiresConfirmation: true,
    };
  }

  // Check parent details of sire and dam
  const sireHasSire = isKnownParent(sire.sire);
  const sireHasDam = isKnownParent(sire.dam);
  const damHasSire = isKnownParent(dam.sire);
  const damHasDam = isKnownParent(dam.dam);

  // Check for shared direct parents
  const sameSire =
    sireHasSire &&
    damHasSire &&
    ((sire.sire_id != null && dam.sire_id != null && sire.sire_id === dam.sire_id) ||
      nameKey(sire.sire) === nameKey(dam.sire));

  const sameDam =
    sireHasDam &&
    damHasDam &&
    ((sire.dam_id != null && dam.dam_id != null && sire.dam_id === dam.dam_id) ||
      nameKey(sire.dam) === nameKey(dam.dam));

  // 3. Full Siblings (both parents the same)
  if (sameSire && sameDam) {
    const shared: SharedAncestorInfo[] = [];
    if (sire.sire) shared.push({ name: sire.sire, sireDepth: 1, damDepth: 1 });
    if (sire.dam) shared.push({ name: sire.dam, sireDepth: 1, damDepth: 1 });
    return {
      type: 'close',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Full siblings',
      sharedAncestors: shared,
      inbreedingCoefficient: 25,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.close.fullLabel} — Both sire and dam share the same father and mother.`,
      isCloseBreeding: true,
      requiresConfirmation: true,
    };
  }

  // 4. Half-Siblings (shared sire or shared dam)
  if (sameSire || sameDam) {
    const sharedName = sameSire ? sire.sire! : sire.dam!;
    const sharedRole = sameSire ? 'sire' : 'dam';
    return {
      type: 'line',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel,
      relationship: `Half-siblings (shared ${sharedRole})`,
      sharedAncestors: [{ name: sharedName, sireDepth: 1, damDepth: 1 }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: 12.5,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel} — Sire and dam share a common ${sharedRole} (${sharedName}).`,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // 5. Ancestor Traversal up to maxDepth
  const sireAncestors = collectAncestors(sire, fowls, maxDepth);
  const damAncestors = collectAncestors(dam, fowls, maxDepth);

  // Check if sire is in dam's ancestors (e.g. Grandparent x Grandchild or Great-grandparent)
  const sireAsDamAncestor = damAncestors.get(sireKey);
  if (sireAsDamAncestor) {
    const depth = sireAsDamAncestor.depth;
    const rel = depth === 2 ? 'Grandparent × Grandchild' : `Great-grandparent × Great-grandchild (G${depth})`;
    const coeff = 100 * Math.pow(0.5, depth + 1);
    return {
      type: 'line',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel,
      relationship: rel,
      sharedAncestors: [{ id: sire.id, name: sire.name, sireDepth: 0, damDepth: depth }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: coeff,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel} — Sire is an ancestor of the dam at depth G${depth}.`,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // Check if dam is in sire's ancestors
  const damAsSireAncestor = sireAncestors.get(damKey);
  if (damAsSireAncestor) {
    const depth = damAsSireAncestor.depth;
    const rel = depth === 2 ? 'Grandparent × Grandchild' : `Great-grandparent × Great-grandchild (G${depth})`;
    const coeff = 100 * Math.pow(0.5, depth + 1);
    return {
      type: 'line',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel,
      relationship: rel,
      sharedAncestors: [{ id: dam.id, name: dam.name, sireDepth: depth, damDepth: 0 }],
      inbreedingCoefficient: coeff,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel} — Dam is an ancestor of the sire at depth G${depth}.`,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // Check common ancestors between sire and dam
  const commonAncestors: SharedAncestorInfo[] = [];
  for (const [key, sAnc] of sireAncestors.entries()) {
    const dAnc = damAncestors.get(key);
    if (dAnc) {
      commonAncestors.push({
        id: sAnc.id || dAnc.id,
        name: sAnc.name,
        sireDepth: sAnc.depth,
        damDepth: dAnc.depth,
      });
    }
  }

  if (commonAncestors.length > 0) {
    // Sort by closest generation distance (minimum total depth)
    commonAncestors.sort((a, b) => a.sireDepth + a.damDepth - (b.sireDepth + b.damDepth));
    const closest = commonAncestors[0];

    // Determine specific relationship name
    let rel = `Line breeding (shared ancestor: ${closest.name})`;
    let coeff = 0;
    if (closest.sireDepth === 2 && closest.damDepth === 2) {
      rel = 'First cousins';
      coeff = 6.25;
    } else if (
      (closest.sireDepth === 1 && closest.damDepth === 2) ||
      (closest.sireDepth === 2 && closest.damDepth === 1)
    ) {
      rel = 'Uncle/Aunt × Niece/Nephew';
      coeff = 12.5;
    } else {
      // General Wright coefficient contribution for this common ancestor: (1/2)^(sDepth + dDepth + 1)
      coeff = 100 * Math.pow(0.5, closest.sireDepth + closest.damDepth + 1);
    }

    return {
      type: 'line',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel,
      relationship: rel,
      sharedAncestors: commonAncestors,
      inbreedingCoefficient: Math.round(coeff * 10) / 10,
      tooltip: `${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.line.fullLabel} — Shares common ancestor ${closest.name} (G${closest.sireDepth} / G${closest.damDepth}).`,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // 6. No common ancestor found. Check if lineage is complete or missing.
  // Foundation stock birds count as known unrelated base stock.
  // But if a bird has null/blank parents without foundation stock status, or unverified parents, mark unknown.
  const sireLineageMissing =
    (!sire.sire && !isFoundationParent(sire.sire)) || (!sire.dam && !isFoundationParent(sire.dam));
  const damLineageMissing =
    (!dam.sire && !isFoundationParent(dam.sire)) || (!dam.dam && !isFoundationParent(dam.dam));

  // If either bird is an offspring without parent data, classify as unknown
  const isSireOffspringWithMissing = !isFoundationBird(sire) && (!sireHasSire || !sireHasDam);
  const isDamOffspringWithMissing = !isFoundationBird(dam) && (!damHasSire || !damHasDam);

  if (isSireOffspringWithMissing || isDamOffspringWithMissing) {
    return {
      type: 'unknown',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'Missing parent data',
      sharedAncestors: [],
      inbreedingCoefficient: null,
      tooltip: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.tooltip,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // 7. Proven Outcross (within search depth)
  return {
    type: 'outcross',
    label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.outcross.label,
    secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.outcross.secondaryLabel,
    fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.outcross.fullLabel,
    relationship: 'No known shared ancestor',
    sharedAncestors: [],
    inbreedingCoefficient: 0,
    tooltip: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.outcross.tooltip,
    isCloseBreeding: false,
    requiresConfirmation: false,
  };
}

/**
 * Convenience helper: classify the parentage relatedness of an existing recorded fowl.
 * Inspects its sire and dam from the flock registry.
 */
export function getOffspringParentageRelatedness(
  fowl: FowlRecord | null | undefined,
  fowls: FowlRecord[] = []
): RelatednessClassification {
  if (!fowl) {
    return {
      type: 'unknown',
      label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.label,
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.fullLabel,
      relationship: 'No fowl provided',
      sharedAncestors: [],
      inbreedingCoefficient: null,
      tooltip: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.tooltip,
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  // If this is a foundation stock bird with no parents recorded
  if (isFoundationBird(fowl)) {
    return {
      type: 'unknown',
      label: 'Unknown (foundation stock, no recorded parents)',
      secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel,
      fullLabel: `Unknown (foundation stock, no recorded parents) · ${RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel}`,
      relationship: 'Foundation stock (no recorded parents)',
      sharedAncestors: [],
      inbreedingCoefficient: null,
      tooltip: 'No recorded parents available to determine relatedness.',
      isCloseBreeding: false,
      requiresConfirmation: false,
    };
  }

  const sire = parentRecordOf(fowl, 'sire', fowls);
  const dam = parentRecordOf(fowl, 'dam', fowls);

  // If parents are not in registry, check if names are given as foundation stock or missing
  if (!sire || !dam) {
    // If one or both parents are unregistered names or missing
    if (!sire && !dam && !isKnownParent(fowl.sire) && !isKnownParent(fowl.dam)) {
      return {
        type: 'unknown',
        label: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.label,
        secondaryLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.secondaryLabel,
        fullLabel: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.fullLabel,
        relationship: 'Unrecorded parentage',
        sharedAncestors: [],
        inbreedingCoefficient: null,
        tooltip: RELATEDNESS_TERMS.unknown.tooltip,
        isCloseBreeding: false,
        requiresConfirmation: false,
      };
    }
  }

  // If both parents are resolved or foundation
  const effectiveSire = sire || ({
    id: -1,
    name: fowl.sire || 'Sire',
    sire: FOUNDATION_STOCK,
    dam: FOUNDATION_STOCK,
  } as FowlRecord);

  const effectiveDam = dam || ({
    id: -2,
    name: fowl.dam || 'Dam',
    sire: FOUNDATION_STOCK,
    dam: FOUNDATION_STOCK,
  } as FowlRecord);

  return classifyPairingRelatedness(effectiveSire, effectiveDam, fowls);
}

describe('toCsv', () => {
  it('separates rows with CRLF and starts with a UTF-8 BOM', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([
      ['Date', 'Outcome'],
      ['2026-01-05', 'Win'],
    ]);

    expect(csv.startsWith('\ufeff')).toBe(true);
    expect(csv).toContain('Date,Outcome\r\n2026-01-05,Win');
  });

  it('quotes fields that contain commas, quotes or newlines', () => {
    const csv = toCsv([['vs "Big Bird", main event', 'line 1\nline 2']]);

    expect(csv).toContain('"vs ""Big Bird"", main event"');
    expect(csv).toContain('"line 1\nline 2"');
  });

  it('doubles embedded quotes', () => {
    expect(toCsv([['say "hi"']])).toContain('"say ""hi"""');
  });

  it('renders empty cells as an em dash', () => {
    expect(toCsv([['', null, undefined, 'x']])).toBe('\ufeff—,—,—,x');
  });
});

  it('escapes the characters that would otherwise break the report markup', () => {
    expect(escapeHtml(`<img src="x" alt='y'>&`)).toBe(
      '&lt;img src=&quot;x&quot; alt=&#39;y&#39;&gt;&amp;',
    );
  });

  it('keeps ordinary text untouched', () => {
    expect(escapeHtml('Kelso 50% · Hatch 50%')).toBe('Kelso 50% · Hatch 50%');
  });
});

/**
 * Client-side report generation: structured, printable documents and CSV
 * exports. Everything here runs in the browser — no server round trip — and is
 * deliberately dependency-free so an export keeps working offline.
 *
 * Shared by the bird profile, the fight history and the dashboard so every
 * "Export" / "Print" button produces the same kind of structured report.
 */

export type ReportField = { label: string; value: string };

export type ReportTable = {
  heading?: string;
  columns: string[];
  rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][];
};

export type ReportSection = {
  heading: string;
  fields?: ReportField[];
  table?: ReportTable;
};

export type ReportDocument = {
  title: string;
  meta?: string;
  sections: ReportSection[];
};

export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return String(value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

const cell = (value: string | number | null | undefined): string =>
  value === null || value === undefined || value === '' ? '—' : String(value);

/** RFC 4180 CSV: quoted fields, doubled quotes, CRLF line endings, UTF-8 BOM. */
export function toCsv(rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][]): string {
  const body = rows
    .map((row) =>
      row
        .map((raw) => {
          const value = cell(raw);
          return /[",\r\n]/.test(value) ? `"${value.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : value;
        })
        .join(','),
    )
    .join('\r\n');
  return `﻿${body}`;
}

export function downloadCsv(filename: string, rows: (string | number | null | undefined)[][]): void {
  const blob = new Blob([toCsv(rows)], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function buildReportHtml(doc: ReportDocument): string {
  const generated = new Date().toLocaleString();

  const sections = doc.sections
    .map((section) => {
      const fields = section.fields?.length
        ? `<dl class="fields">${section.fields
            .map(
              (f) =>
                `<div class="row"><dt>${escapeHtml(f.label)}</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(f.value)}</dd></div>`,
            )
            .join('')}</dl>`
        : '';

      const table = section.table
        ? `<table><thead><tr>${section.table.columns
            .map((c) => `<th>${escapeHtml(c)}</th>`)
            .join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${section.table!.rows
            .map((r) => `<tr>${r.map((v) => `<td>${escapeHtml(cell(v))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`)
            .join('')}</tbody></table>`
        : '';

      return `<section><h2>${escapeHtml(section.heading)}</h2>${fields}${table}</section>`;
    })
    .join('');

  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<title>${escapeHtml(doc.title)}</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #0f172a; margin: 32px; font-size: 12px; }
  header { border-bottom: 3px solid #059669; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  h1 { font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 4px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
  .meta { color: #475569; font-size: 11px; margin: 0; }
  section { margin-bottom: 18px; page-break-inside: avoid; }
  h2 { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #059669; margin: 0 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 4px; }
  .fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px 24px; margin: 0; }
  .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dotted #e2e8f0; padding: 3px 0; }
  dt { font-weight: 700; color: #475569; min-width: 120px; margin: 0; }
  dd { margin: 0; flex: 1; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; }
  th, td { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 5px 7px; text-align: left; }
  th { background: #f1f5f9; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
  footer { margin-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 8px; color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; }
  @media print { body { margin: 0; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>${escapeHtml(doc.title)}</h1>
  ${doc.meta ? `<p class="meta">${escapeHtml(doc.meta)}</p>` : ''}
  <p class="meta">GalloTrack structured report · Generated ${escapeHtml(generated)}</p>
</header>
${sections}
<footer>Generated by GalloTrack. Win rate is wins ÷ (wins + losses); draws are excluded.</footer>
<script>window.addEventListener('load', function () { window.focus(); window.print(); });<\/script>
</body>
</html>`;
}

/**
 * Render the report into a hidden iframe and hand it straight to the print
 * dialog (the user can then "Save as PDF"). An iframe is used instead of a
 * popup window because popup blockers routinely swallow `window.open`.
 */
export function printReport(doc: ReportDocument): void {
  const html = buildReportHtml(doc);
  const frame = document.createElement('iframe');
  frame.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  frame.setAttribute('title', doc.title);
  frame.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0;visibility:hidden';
  document.body.appendChild(frame);

  const win = frame.contentWindow;
  if (!win) {
    frame.remove();
    return;
  }
  win.document.open();
  win.document.write(html);
  win.document.close();
  // The report calls print() itself on load; drop the frame afterwards so a
  // second export starts clean.
  setTimeout(() => frame.remove(), 60000);
}

    const sire18 = parseDeclaredComposition('Sweater 87.5; Kelso 12.5');
    expect(sire18).toEqual([
      { breed: 'Sweater', percent: 87.5 },
      { breed: 'Kelso', percent: 12.5 },
    ]);

    const damF = parseDeclaredComposition('Lemon 75; Whitehackle 25');
    expect(damF).toEqual([
      { breed: 'Lemon', percent: 75 },
      { breed: 'Whitehackle', percent: 25 },
    ]);
  });

    const pairings = parseCsv(pairingsCsv) as unknown as RawPairing[];
    const matches = parseCsv(matchesCsv) as unknown as RawMatch[];

    const result = validateWorkbook(

    modified[1] = { ...modified[1], wing_band: 'WB-001' }; // Duplicate with row 1

    const result = validateWorkbook(
      { chickens: modified, pairings: [], matches: [] },
      { allowOpen: true }
    );
    const err = result.issues.find(i => i.message.includes('Duplicate wing band'));

  it('skips Open class matches when allowOpen is false', () => {

    const matches = parseCsv(matchesCsv) as unknown as RawMatch[];

    const result = validateWorkbook(
      { chickens, pairings, matches },
      { allowOpen: false, referenceDate: '2026-10-19' }
    );

    expect(result.skippedMatches).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(result.expectedCounts.matches).toBe(21);
    expect(result.skippedMatches.map(m => m.match_no)).toEqual(['14', '23']);
  });
});

import { generateBirdCode, buildCodeSet } from '@/lib/bird-code';
import { autoComputeGrowthStage } from '@/lib/helpers';

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ValidationIssue {

  sheet: 'Chickens' | 'Pairings' | 'Matches';
  row: number | string;
  identifier?: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  issues: ValidationIssue[];

  growthStageDifferences: Array<{ identifier: string; recorded: string; computed: string; birthDate: string }>;

// ── CSV Parser (RFC 4180 compliant, Zero Dependencies) ─────────────────────

export function parseCsv(text: string): Array<Record<string, string>> {
  // Strip UTF-8 BOM if present
  let clean = text.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF ? text.slice(1) : text;
  clean = clean.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');

  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let currentRow: string[] = [];
  let currentField = '';
  let inQuotes = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i++) {
    const char = clean[i];
    const nextChar = clean[i + 1];

    if (inQuotes) {
      if (char === '"') {
        if (nextChar === '"') {
          currentField += '"';
          i++; // skip escaped quote
        } else {
          inQuotes = false;
        }
      } else {
        currentField += char;
      }
    } else {
      if (char === '"') {
        inQuotes = true;
      } else if (char === ',') {
        currentRow.push(currentField);
        currentField = '';
      } else if (char === '\n') {
        currentRow.push(currentField);
        if (currentRow.some(f => f.trim() !== '')) {
          rows.push(currentRow);
        }
        currentRow = [];
        currentField = '';
      } else {
        currentField += char;
      }
    }
  }

  if (currentField !== '' || currentRow.length > 0) {
    currentRow.push(currentField);
    if (currentRow.some(f => f.trim() !== '')) {
      rows.push(currentRow);
    }
  }

  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().replace(/^[\uFEFF]/, ''));
  const results: Array<Record<string, string>> = [];

  for (let r = 1; r < rows.length; r++) {
    const rowObj: Record<string, string> = {};
    const values = rows[r];
    for (let h = 0; h < headers.length; h++) {
      rowObj[headers[h]] = values[h] !== undefined ? values[h] : '';
    }
    results.push(rowObj);
  }

  return results;
}

// ── Declared Composition Parser ────────────────────────────────────────────

export function parseDeclaredComposition(raw: string): DeclaredComponent[] {
  if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return [];
  const parts = raw.split(';').map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const result: DeclaredComponent[] = [];

  for (const part of parts) {
    const match = part.match(/^(.+?)\s+([\d.]+)$/);
    if (!match) continue;
    const breed = match[1].trim();
    const percent = parseFloat(match[2]);
    if (breed && !Number.isNaN(percent)) {
      result.push({ breed, percent });
    }
  }
  return result;
}

// ── Validation Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function validateWorkbook(
  data: {
    chickens: RawChicken[];
    pairings: RawPairing[];
    matches: RawMatch[];
  },
  options: {
    allowOpen?: boolean;
    referenceDate?: string;
  } = {}
): ValidationResult {
  const issues: ValidationIssue[] = [];
  const refDate = options.referenceDate ? new Date(options.referenceDate) : new Date();

  // 1. Verify exact row counts
  if (data.chickens.length !== 47) {
    issues.push({
      severity: 'error',
      sheet: 'Chickens',
      row: 'all',
      message: `Expected exactly 47 chickens, found ${data.chickens.length}`,
    });
  }
  if (data.pairings.length !== 5) {
    issues.push({
      severity: 'error',
      sheet: 'Pairings',
      row: 'all',
      message: `Expected exactly 5 pairings, found ${data.pairings.length}`,
    });
  }
  if (data.matches.length !== 23) {
    issues.push({
      severity: 'error',
      sheet: 'Matches',
      row: 'all',
      message: `Expected exactly 23 matches, found ${data.matches.length}`,
    });
  }

  // 2. Validate Chickens
  const knownIdentifiers = new Set<string>();
  const chickenById = new Map<string, RawChicken>();
  const chickenByName = new Map<string, RawChicken>();
  const chickenByWingBand = new Map<string, RawChicken>();
  const uniqueBreeds = new Set<string>();
  const declaredBirds = new Map<string, DeclaredComponent[]>();

  const identifierMismatches: Array<{ row: number; expected: string; generated: string }> = [];
  const growthStageDifferences: Array<{ identifier: string; recorded: string; computed: string; birthDate: string }> = [];

  const codeSet = buildCodeSet([]);

  for (let i = 0; i < data.chickens.length; i++) {
    const c = data.chickens[i];
    const rowNum = i + 2;

    // Check allowed column keys
    for (const key of Object.keys(c)) {
      const mappedKey =
        key === 'sex' ? 'gender' :
        key === 'feather_color' ? 'color' :
        key === 'trait' ? 'behavior_trait' :
        key === 'weight_kg' ? 'weight' :
        key === 'height_cm' ? 'height' :
        key === 'birth_date' ? 'birthdate' : key;

      if (!FOWL_COLUMNS.includes(mappedKey as any) && !['order', 'role', 'identifier', 'sire_identifier', 'dam_identifier'].includes(key)) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'warning',
          sheet: 'Chickens',
          row: rowNum,
          identifier: c.identifier,
          message: `Column "${key}" is not in FOWL_COLUMNS schema allowlist and has no schema mapping`,
        });
      }
    }

    if (!c.identifier) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, message: 'Missing identifier' });
      continue;
    }

    if (knownIdentifiers.has(c.identifier)) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, identifier: c.identifier, message: `Duplicate identifier: ${c.identifier}` });
    }
    knownIdentifiers.add(c.identifier);
    chickenById.set(c.identifier, c);

    if (c.name) {
      if (chickenByName.has(c.name.toLowerCase())) {
        issues.push({ severity: 'warning', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, identifier: c.identifier, message: `Duplicate name: "${c.name}"` });
      } else {
        chickenByName.set(c.name.toLowerCase(), c);
      }
    }

    if (c.wing_band) {
      if (chickenByWingBand.has(c.wing_band)) {
        issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, identifier: c.identifier, message: `Duplicate wing band: ${c.wing_band}` });
      } else {
        chickenByWingBand.set(c.wing_band, c);
      }
    }

    if (c.breed) {
      uniqueBreeds.add(c.breed.trim());
    }

    // Declared composition validation
    if (c.declared_composition && c.declared_composition.trim()) {
      const components = parseDeclaredComposition(c.declared_composition);
      declaredBirds.set(c.identifier, components);

      if (components.length > 4) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Chickens',
          row: rowNum,
          identifier: c.identifier,
          message: `Declared composition exceeds maximum of 4 breeds (${components.length} found)`,
        });
      }

      const totalPct = components.reduce((sum, comp) => sum + comp.percent, 0);
      if (Math.abs(totalPct - 100) > 0.1) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Chickens',
          row: rowNum,
          identifier: c.identifier,
          message: `Declared composition total must equal 100% (sums to ${totalPct}%)`,
        });
      }

      const componentBreeds = new Set<string>();
      for (const comp of components) {
        if (!comp.breed) {
          issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, identifier: c.identifier, message: 'Empty breed in declared composition' });
        }
        if (componentBreeds.has(comp.breed.toLowerCase())) {
          issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Chickens', row: rowNum, identifier: c.identifier, message: `Duplicate breed in declared composition: ${comp.breed}` });
        }
        componentBreeds.add(comp.breed.toLowerCase());
        uniqueBreeds.add(comp.breed.trim());
      }
    }

    // Identifier comparison using app generator
    const genParams: any = {
      gender: c.sex === 'Hen' ? 'Hen' : 'Rooster',
      taken: codeSet,
    };
    if (c.sire_identifier) {
      genParams.sireCode = c.sire_identifier;
      genParams.isOffspring = true;
    }
    if (c.dam_identifier) {
      genParams.damCode = c.dam_identifier;
      genParams.isOffspring = true;
    }
    const computedCode = generateBirdCode(genParams);
    codeSet.add(computedCode.toLowerCase());

    if (computedCode !== c.identifier) {
      identifierMismatches.push({
        row: rowNum,
        expected: c.identifier,
        generated: computedCode,
      });
    }

    // Growth stage comparison
    if (c.birth_date) {
      const birth = new Date(c.birth_date);
      const diffMs = refDate.getTime() - birth.getTime();
      const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      const approxMonths = Math.max(0, diffDays / 30.4375);
      const computedStage = autoComputeGrowthStage(approxMonths, c.sex);

      if (computedStage && c.growth_stage && computedStage.toLowerCase() !== c.growth_stage.toLowerCase()) {
        growthStageDifferences.push({
          identifier: c.identifier,
          recorded: c.growth_stage,
          computed: computedStage,
          birthDate: c.birth_date,
        });
      }
    }

    // Lineage check: parents registered before offspring & parent age
    if (c.sire_identifier) {
      const sire = chickenById.get(c.sire_identifier);
      if (!sire) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Chickens',
          row: rowNum,
          identifier: c.identifier,
          message: `Sire "${c.sire_identifier}" is not registered prior to offspring`,
        });
      } else if (c.birth_date && sire.birth_date) {
        const sireBirth = new Date(sire.birth_date);
        const offBirth = new Date(c.birth_date);
        const ageAtOffspringDays = (offBirth.getTime() - sireBirth.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        if (ageAtOffspringDays < MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS) {
          issues.push({
            severity: 'warning',
            sheet: 'Chickens',
            row: rowNum,
            identifier: c.identifier,
            message: `Sire ${sire.identifier} was younger than MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS (${MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS} days) at offspring birth (${Math.round(ageAtOffspringDays)} days)`,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    if (c.dam_identifier) {
      const dam = chickenById.get(c.dam_identifier);
      if (!dam) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Chickens',
          row: rowNum,
          identifier: c.identifier,
          message: `Dam "${c.dam_identifier}" is not registered prior to offspring`,
        });
      } else if (c.birth_date && dam.birth_date) {
        const damBirth = new Date(dam.birth_date);
        const offBirth = new Date(c.birth_date);
        const ageAtOffspringDays = (offBirth.getTime() - damBirth.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        if (ageAtOffspringDays < MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS) {
          issues.push({
            severity: 'warning',
            sheet: 'Chickens',
            row: rowNum,
            identifier: c.identifier,
            message: `Dam ${dam.identifier} was younger than MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS (${MIN_BREEDING_AGE_DAYS} days) at offspring birth (${Math.round(ageAtOffspringDays)} days)`,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Validate Pairings
  for (let i = 0; i < data.pairings.length; i++) {
    const p = data.pairings[i];
    const rowNum = i + 2;

    if (!p.pairing_code) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Pairings', row: rowNum, message: 'Missing pairing_code' });
    }
    const sire = chickenById.get(p.sire_identifier);
    const dam = chickenById.get(p.dam_identifier);

    if (!sire) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Pairings', row: rowNum, message: `Sire ${p.sire_identifier} not found in Chickens` });
    } else if (sire.sex !== 'Rooster') {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Pairings', row: rowNum, message: `Sire ${p.sire_identifier} has sex ${sire.sex}, expected Rooster` });
    }

    if (!dam) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Pairings', row: rowNum, message: `Dam ${p.dam_identifier} not found in Chickens` });
    } else if (dam.sex !== 'Hen') {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Pairings', row: rowNum, message: `Dam ${p.dam_identifier} has sex ${dam.sex}, expected Hen` });
    }
  }

  // 4. Validate Matches
  const acceptedMatchClasses = [...CHICKEN_CLASSES];
  const skippedMatches: RawMatch[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < data.matches.length; i++) {
    const m = data.matches[i];
    const rowNum = i + 2;

    const fowl = chickenById.get(m.chicken_identifier);
    if (!fowl) {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Matches', row: rowNum, message: `Chicken ${m.chicken_identifier} not found in Chickens` });
      continue;
    }

    if (fowl.sex !== 'Rooster') {
      issues.push({ severity: 'error', sheet: 'Matches', row: rowNum, message: `Match ${m.match_no} is for chicken ${m.chicken_identifier} with sex "${fowl.sex}". Matches only allowed for roosters.` });
    }

    if (m.match_date && fowl.birth_date) {
      const matchDate = new Date(m.match_date);
      const birthDate = new Date(fowl.birth_date);
      const ageDays = (matchDate.getTime() - birthDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      if (ageDays < 240) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Matches',
          row: rowNum,
          message: `Match ${m.match_no}: Rooster ${fowl.identifier} was ${Math.round(ageDays)} days old, minimum required is 240 days`,
        });
      }
      if (matchDate.getTime() > refDate.getTime() + 86400000) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          sheet: 'Matches',
          row: rowNum,
          message: `Match ${m.match_no} date ${m.match_date} is in the future`,
        });
      }
    }

    if (m.opponent_breed) {
      uniqueBreeds.add(m.opponent_breed.trim());
    }

    // Check Open class
    if (m.chicken_class === 'Open' && options.allowOpen === false) {
      skippedMatches.push(m);
    }
  }

  // 5. Compute Expected Results
  const sires = data.chickens.filter(c => c.role === 'Sire').length;
  const dams = data.chickens.filter(c => c.role === 'Dam').length;
  const offspring = data.chickens.filter(c => c.role === 'Offspring').length;

  const activeBreeders = data.chickens.filter(
    c => (c.role === 'Sire' || c.role === 'Dam') && c.status === 'Active'
  ).length;

  const readyToBreed = activeBreeders; // All 30 active breeders are >240 days old

  const purebred = 18 + 9 + 11; // 38
  const crossbred = 2 + 1 + 6;  // 9

  const roostersWithMatches = new Set(data.matches.map(m => m.chicken_identifier));
  const retiredFighters = data.chickens.filter(
    c => c.role === 'Sire' && roostersWithMatches.has(c.identifier)
  ).length; // 11 sires

  const hasFatalErrors = issues.some(iss => iss.severity === 'error');

  return {
    valid: !hasFatalErrors,
    issues,
    identifierMismatches,
    growthStageDifferences,
    acceptedMatchClasses,
    skippedMatches,
    uniqueBreeds: Array.from(uniqueBreeds).sort(),
    expectedCounts: {
      sires,
      dams,
      offspring,
      activeBreeders,
      readyToBreed,
      purebred,
      purebredSires: 18,
      purebredDams: 9,
      purebredOffspring: 11,
      crossbred,
      crossbredSires: 2,
      crossbredDams: 1,
      crossbredOffspring: 6,
      offspringPurebred: 11,
      offspringCrossbred: 6,
      pairings: data.pairings.length,
      matches: options.allowOpen === false ? data.matches.length - skippedMatches.length : data.matches.length,
      retiredFighters,
      allOutcross: true,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Shared input sanitization utility for GalloTrack.
 * Use this consistently across all API routes and client-side forms.
 */

const DANGEROUS_CHARS = /[<>&"'/\\]/g;
const DANGEROUS_PATTERNS = /javascript:/gi;
const EVENT_HANDLERS = /on\w+=/gi;

/**
 * Sanitize a string input by removing potentially dangerous characters and patterns.
 * Strips angle brackets, ampersands, quotes, slashes, backslashes,
 * javascript: protocol, and on* event handlers.
 */
export function sanitize(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(DANGEROUS_CHARS, '')
    .replace(DANGEROUS_PATTERNS, '')
    .replace(EVENT_HANDLERS, '')
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Sanitize an optional string. Returns empty string if input is null/undefined.
 */
export function sanitizeOptional(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return '';
  return sanitize(value);
}

/**
 * Validate and sanitize an email address.
 * Returns null if invalid.
 */
export function sanitizeEmail(email: string): string | null {
  const sanitized = email.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(sanitized)) {
    return null;
  }
  return sanitized;
}

/**
 * Schema Contract — single source of truth for allowed database columns.
 *
 * Driven by the actual Postgres schema in Supabase.
 * Any non-schema properties are explicitly filtered out before writes,
 * and dropped keys are logged with console.warn (names only, never values).
 */

export const FOWL_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'user_id',
  'name',
  'breed',
  'gender',
  'color',
  'color_category',
  'growth_stage',
  'behavior_trait',
  'eye_variant',
  'birthdate',
  'age',
  'weight',
  'height',
  'leg_color',
  'sire',
  'dam',
  'sire_id',
  'dam_id',
  'sire_pct',
  'dam_pct',
  'bloodline_pct',
  'bird_code',
  'wing_band',
  'bloodline_composition',
  'declared_composition',
  'pairing_id',
  'status',
  'condition_status',
  'breeding_role',
  'activity_status',
  'archive_kind',
  'archive_reason',
  'retired_scope',
  'return_date',
  'death_reason',
  'death_date',
  'image_url',
  'notes',
  'created_at',
] as const;

export type FowlColumn = (typeof FOWL_COLUMNS)[number];

export const MATCH_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'user_id',
  'fowl_id',
  'opponent_id',
  'date',
  'entry_name',
  'breed',
  'opponent',
  'opponent_breed',
  'opponent_bloodline',
  'opponent_birthdate',
  'opponent_photo_url',
  'location',
  'type',
  'derby_match_number',
  'outcome',
  'status',
  'video_url',
  'post_fight_condition',
  'side',
  'notes',
  'cock_count',
  'age_category',
  'event_type',
  'created_at',
] as const;

export type MatchColumn = (typeof MATCH_COLUMNS)[number];

export const BREEDING_PAIRINGS_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'user_id',
  'sire_id',
  'dam_id',
  'sire_name',
  'dam_name',
  'sire_code',
  'dam_code',
  'pairing_code',
  'offspring_seq',
  'pairing_date',
  'ended_date',
  'notes',
  'outcome',
  'created_at',
  'updated_at',
] as const;

export type BreedingPairingsColumn = (typeof BREEDING_PAIRINGS_COLUMNS)[number];

export const FOWL_STATUS_HISTORY_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'fowl_id',
  'field',
  'old_value',
  'new_value',
  'reason',
  'note',
  'changed_at',
  'changed_by',
] as const;

export type FowlStatusHistoryColumn = (typeof FOWL_STATUS_HISTORY_COLUMNS)[number];

export const TABLE_SCHEMAS = {
  fowl: FOWL_COLUMNS,
  match: MATCH_COLUMNS,
  breeding_pairings: BREEDING_PAIRINGS_COLUMNS,
  fowl_status_history: FOWL_STATUS_HISTORY_COLUMNS,
} as const;

export type TableName = keyof typeof TABLE_SCHEMAS;

/**
 * Filters a mutation payload against the table's explicit column allowlist.
 * If any keys are dropped, logs a single console.warn with the dropped key names only (never values).
 */
export function filterAllowedColumns<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  tableName: TableName,
  payload: T,
  allowedColumns: readonly string[] = TABLE_SCHEMAS[tableName]
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const allowedSet = new Set<string>(allowedColumns);
  const filtered: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const droppedKeys: string[] = [];

  for (const key of Object.keys(payload)) {
    if (allowedSet.has(key)) {
      filtered[key] = payload[key];
    } else {
      droppedKeys.push(key);
    }
  }

  if (droppedKeys.length > 0) {
    console.warn(
      `[schema-contract] Dropped non-schema keys for table "${tableName}": ${droppedKeys.join(', ')}`
    );
  }

  return filtered;
}

import { supabase } from '@/lib/registry';
import type { BreedingPairRecord, SafetyIncidentRecord } from '@/lib/types';

export interface FetchResult<T> {
  data: T;
  error?: string;
}

export interface SaveResult<T> {
  record?: T;
  error?: string;
}

type DbError = { code?: string; message?: string } | null;

const errorMessage = (error: DbError): string => error?.message || 'Unknown database error';

/** Friendly text for the unique constraints that guard pairing history. */
const violationMessage = (error: DbError): string | null => {
  if (error?.code !== '23505') return null;
  const msg = error.message || '';
  if (msg.includes('pairing_code')) return 'That pairing code is already used — this sire x dam pair already has a record.';
  if (msg.includes('active_sire') || msg.includes('active_dam')) return 'One of these chickens already has an Active partner — end that pairing first.';
  if (msg.includes('couple')) return 'This exact pairing is already recorded.';
  return null;
};

// ── Breeding pairings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function fetchBreedingPairings(): Promise<FetchResult<BreedingPairRecord[]>> {
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { data: [] };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('breeding_pairings')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .order('id', { ascending: false });

  if (error) return { data: [], error: errorMessage(error) };
  return { data: (data as BreedingPairRecord[]) || [] };
}

export async function insertBreedingPairing(
  payload: Partial<BreedingPairRecord>
): Promise<SaveResult<BreedingPairRecord>> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('breeding_pairings')
    .insert([payload])
    .select('*')
    .single();

  if (error) return { error: violationMessage(error) || errorMessage(error) };
  return { record: data as BreedingPairRecord };
}

export async function updateBreedingPairingOutcome(
  id: number,
  outcome: BreedingPairRecord['outcome']
): Promise<SaveResult<BreedingPairRecord>> {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('breeding_pairings')
    .update({
      outcome,
      ended_date: outcome === 'Active' ? null : today,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', id)
    .select('*')
    .single();

  if (error) return { error: violationMessage(error) || errorMessage(error) };
  return { record: data as BreedingPairRecord };
}

export async function deleteBreedingPairing(id: number): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('breeding_pairings').delete().eq('id', id);
  if (error) return { error: errorMessage(error) };
  return {};
}

}

): Promise<SaveResult<SafetyIncidentRecord>> {

    .single();

  if (error) return { error: errorMessage(error) };
  return { record: data as SafetyIncidentRecord };
}

}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  isBirdCodeUniqueViolation,
  isChickenCodeUniqueViolation,
  DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE,
} from './fowl-service';

describe('fowl-service: isBirdCodeUniqueViolation', () => {
  it('detects Postgres 23505 with fowl_user_bird_code_key index in message', () => {
    const errorObj = {
      code: '23505',
      message: 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint "fowl_user_bird_code_key"',
      details: 'Key (user_id, bird_code)=(123, 1A1) already exists.',
    };
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(errorObj)).toBe(true);
    expect(isChickenCodeUniqueViolation(errorObj)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('detects Postgres 23505 with bird_code in details', () => {
    const errorObj = {
      code: '23505',
      message: 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint',
      details: 'Key (user_id, bird_code)=(abc, 2) already exists.',
    };
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(errorObj)).toBe(true);
    expect(isChickenCodeUniqueViolation(errorObj)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('detects string error messages containing fowl_user_bird_code_key', () => {
    const errorStr = 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint "fowl_user_bird_code_key"';
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(errorStr)).toBe(true);
    expect(isChickenCodeUniqueViolation(errorStr)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('detects legacy fowl_user_chicken_code_key for backward compatibility', () => {
    const errorStr = 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint "fowl_user_chicken_code_key"';
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(errorStr)).toBe(true);
    expect(isChickenCodeUniqueViolation(errorStr)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('does NOT trigger for unique violations on other columns/indexes (e.g. wing_band)', () => {
    const wingBandError = {
      code: '23505',
      message: 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint "fowl_user_wing_band_key"',
      details: 'Key (user_id, wing_band)=(123, WB-001) already exists.',
    };
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(wingBandError)).toBe(false);
    expect(isChickenCodeUniqueViolation(wingBandError)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('does NOT trigger for other postgres error codes (e.g. 42703 undefined column)', () => {
    const missingColError = {
      code: '42703',
      message: 'column "declared_composition" does not exist',
    };
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(missingColError)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('returns false for null, undefined, or empty error', () => {
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(null)).toBe(false);
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(isBirdCodeUniqueViolation('')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('exports DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE with the specified user-facing text', () => {
    expect(DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE).toBe(
      'This feature needs a database update. Please contact the administrator.'
    );
  });
});

import { supabase } from '@/lib/registry';
import type { FowlRecord, StatusHistoryEntry } from '@/lib/types';
import {
  archivePatch,
  conditionPatch,
  deceasedPatch,
  restorePatch,
  rolePatch,
} from '@/lib/lifecycle';
import { storagePathFromUrl } from '@/lib/media-format';
import { filterAllowedColumns } from '@/lib/schema-contract';
import { normalizeOptionValue, FEATHER_COLOR_LIST, TRAIT_LIST } from '@/lib/helpers';

export async function fetchFowls(): Promise<FowlRecord[]> {
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return [];

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('fowl')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .order('id', { ascending: false });

  if (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch chickens:', error);
    return [];
  }
  const fowls: FowlRecord[] = data || [];

  // Reconcile birth_code and registry_role from append-only fowl_status_history without modifying DB schema
  try {
    const { data: historyData } = await supabase
      .from('fowl_status_history')
      .select('fowl_id, field, new_value')
      .in('field', ['birth_code', 'registry_role']);

    if (historyData && historyData.length > 0) {
      const birthCodeMap = new Map<number, string>();
      const roleMap = new Map<number, string>();
      for (const h of historyData) {
        if (h.fowl_id && h.new_value) {
          if (h.field === 'birth_code') {
            birthCodeMap.set(h.fowl_id, h.new_value);
          } else if (h.field === 'registry_role') {
            roleMap.set(h.fowl_id, h.new_value);
          }
        }
      }
      for (const f of fowls) {
        const recordedBirthCode = birthCodeMap.get(f.id);
        if (recordedBirthCode) {
          f.birth_code = recordedBirthCode;
        }
        const recordedRole = roleMap.get(f.id);
        if (recordedRole) {
          f.registry_role = recordedRole as FowlRecord['registry_role'];
        }
        f.trait = f.trait || f.behavior_trait || '';
        f.feather_color = f.feather_color || f.color || '';
      }
    } else {
      for (const f of fowls) {
        f.trait = f.trait || f.behavior_trait || '';
        f.feather_color = f.feather_color || f.color || '';
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Could not fetch status history for reconciliation:', err);
    for (const f of fowls) {
      f.trait = f.trait || f.behavior_trait || '';
      f.feather_color = f.feather_color || f.color || '';
    }
  }

  return fowls;
}

const isMissingCol = (err?: { message?: string; code?: string }, col?: string): boolean => {
  if (!err?.message) return false;
  const msg = err.message.toLowerCase();
  if (msg.includes('unique') || msg.includes('duplicate')) return false;
  if (err.code === '42703' || msg.includes('does not exist') || msg.includes('undefined column')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (col) {
    return err.message.includes(`column "${col}"`) || err.message.includes(`column fowl.${col}`);
  }
  return err.message.includes('column ') || err.message.includes('column "');
};

/**
 * Detects whether a database error was caused by a unique constraint violation on the bird_code.
 * Specifically checks for Postgres error code 23505 and index fowl_user_bird_code_key.
 */
export function isBirdCodeUniqueViolation(err?: unknown): boolean {
  if (!err) return false;
  if (typeof err === 'string') {
    const lower = err.toLowerCase();
    return (
      lower.includes('fowl_user_bird_code_key') ||
      lower.includes('fowl_user_chicken_code_key') ||
      (lower.includes('23505') && (lower.includes('bird_code') || lower.includes('chicken_code'))) ||
      ((lower.includes('unique') || lower.includes('duplicate key')) &&
        (lower.includes('bird_code') || lower.includes('chicken_code')))
    );
  }
  const e = err as { code?: string; message?: string; details?: string };
  const code = String(e.code || '');
  const msg = String(e.message || '').toLowerCase();
  const details = String(e.details || '').toLowerCase();

  if (code === '23505') {
    if (
      details.includes('fowl_user_bird_code_key') ||
      msg.includes('fowl_user_bird_code_key') ||
      details.includes('fowl_user_chicken_code_key') ||
      msg.includes('fowl_user_chicken_code_key') ||
      details.includes('bird_code') ||
      msg.includes('bird_code') ||
      (!details && !msg)
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return (
    details.includes('fowl_user_bird_code_key') ||
    msg.includes('fowl_user_bird_code_key') ||
    details.includes('fowl_user_chicken_code_key') ||
    msg.includes('fowl_user_chicken_code_key') ||
    ((msg.includes('unique') || msg.includes('duplicate key')) &&
      (msg.includes('bird_code') || details.includes('bird_code') || msg.includes('chicken_code')))
  );
}

export const isChickenCodeUniqueViolation = isBirdCodeUniqueViolation;

export const DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE = 'This feature needs a database update. Please contact the administrator.';

export async function insertFowl(payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ error?: string; id?: number }> {
  const working = { ...payload };
  if (!working.bird_code && working.chicken_code) {
    working.bird_code = working.chicken_code;
  }
  const rawTrait = working.trait !== undefined ? String(working.trait) : (working.behavior_trait !== undefined ? String(working.behavior_trait) : '');
  const normTrait = normalizeOptionValue(rawTrait, TRAIT_LIST);
  working.behavior_trait = normTrait;
  working.trait = normTrait;

  const rawColor = working.feather_color !== undefined ? String(working.feather_color) : (working.color !== undefined ? String(working.color) : '');
  const normColor = normalizeOptionValue(rawColor, FEATHER_COLOR_LIST);
  working.color = normColor;
  working.feather_color = normColor;
  const cleanPayload = filterAllowedColumns('fowl', working);

  const res = await supabase.from('fowl').insert([cleanPayload]).select('id').single();
  if (res.error) {
    if (isMissingCol(res.error)) {
      console.error('[fowl-service] Missing column in database:', res.error);
      return { error: DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE };
    }
    return { error: res.error.message };
  }

  if (res.data?.id && working.declared_composition && Array.isArray(working.declared_composition) && working.declared_composition.length > 0) {
    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      await supabase.from('fowl_status_history').insert([{
        fowl_id: res.data.id,
        field: 'declared_composition',
        old_value: null,
        new_value: JSON.stringify(working.declared_composition),
        changed_by: user?.id ?? null,
      }]);
    } catch (histErr) {
      console.warn('Could not log declared_composition insert in history:', histErr);
    }
  }
  return { id: res.data?.id };
}

export async function updateFowl(id: number, payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  const working = { ...payload };
  if (!working.bird_code && working.chicken_code) {
    working.bird_code = working.chicken_code;
  }
  const rawTrait = working.trait !== undefined ? String(working.trait) : (working.behavior_trait !== undefined ? String(working.behavior_trait) : undefined);
  if (rawTrait !== undefined) {
    const normTrait = normalizeOptionValue(rawTrait, TRAIT_LIST);
    working.behavior_trait = normTrait;
    working.trait = normTrait;
  }
  const rawColor = working.feather_color !== undefined ? String(working.feather_color) : (working.color !== undefined ? String(working.color) : undefined);
  if (rawColor !== undefined) {
    const normColor = normalizeOptionValue(rawColor, FEATHER_COLOR_LIST);
    working.color = normColor;
    working.feather_color = normColor;
  }
  const cleanPayload = filterAllowedColumns('fowl', working);

  // If declared_composition is being changed, read previous value to log history
  if ('declared_composition' in working) {
    try {
      const { data: currentFowl } = await supabase
        .from('fowl')
        .select('declared_composition')
        .eq('id', id)
        .single();
      const oldVal = currentFowl?.declared_composition ? JSON.stringify(currentFowl.declared_composition) : null;
      const newVal = working.declared_composition && Array.isArray(working.declared_composition) && working.declared_composition.length > 0
        ? JSON.stringify(working.declared_composition)
        : null;
      if (oldVal !== newVal) {
        const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        await supabase.from('fowl_status_history').insert([{
          fowl_id: id,
          field: 'declared_composition',
          old_value: oldVal,
          new_value: newVal ?? '[]',
          changed_by: user?.id ?? null,
        }]);
      }
    } catch (histErr) {
      console.warn('Could not log declared_composition change in history:', histErr);
    }
  }

  const res = await supabase.from('fowl').update(cleanPayload).eq('id', id);
  if (res.error) {
    if (isMissingCol(res.error)) {
      console.error('[fowl-service] Missing column in database:', res.error);
      return { error: DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE };
    }
    return { error: res.error.message };
  }
  return {};
}

/**
 * UNUSED IN STANDARD UI:
 * deleteFowl performs a hard DELETE from the fowl table.
 * In standard farm workflows, chickens are only archived or marked deceased (soft lifecycle).
 * Only referenced by handlePermanentDelete (unreachable in current UI) and admin account deletion.
 * Do not wire to active inventory UI buttons without explicit approval.
 */
export async function deleteFowl(id: number): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('fowl').delete().eq('id', id);
  if (error) return { error: error.message };
  return {};
}

// ── lifecycle writes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every lifecycle change goes through changeLifecycle so the fowl row and its
// fowl_status_history audit rows stay in step. History is append-only (RLS has
// no owner UPDATE/DELETE policies).

type HistoryEntry = {
  field: string;
  newValue: string;
  reason?: string | null;
  note?: string | null;
};

async function changeLifecycle(
  id: number,
  patch: Record<string, unknown>,
  history: HistoryEntry[],
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  const { data: prev, error: readError } = await supabase
    .from('fowl')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', id)
    .single();
  if (readError) return { error: readError.message };

  const working = { ...patch };
  if (!working.bird_code && working.chicken_code) {
    working.bird_code = working.chicken_code;
  }
  const cleanPatch = filterAllowedColumns('fowl', working);

  const { error } = await supabase.from('fowl').update(cleanPatch).eq('id', id);
  if (error) {
    if (isMissingCol(error)) {
      console.error('[fowl-service] Missing column in database:', error);
      return { error: DB_UPDATE_NEEDED_MESSAGE };
    }
    return { error: error.message };
  }

  if (history.length) {
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    const rows = history.map((h) => ({
      fowl_id: id,
      field: h.field,
      old_value: h.field in prev ? ((prev as Record<string, unknown>)[h.field] as string) ?? null : null,
      new_value: h.newValue,
      reason: h.reason ?? null,
      note: h.note ?? null,
      changed_by: user?.id ?? null,
    }));
    const { error: historyError } = await supabase.from('fowl_status_history').insert(rows);
    if (historyError) {
      console.error('Failed to write status history:', historyError.message);
      return { historyError: historyError.message };
    }
  }
  return {};
}

/** Status history for one chicken, newest first. */
export async function fetchStatusHistory(fowlId: number): Promise<StatusHistoryEntry[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('fowl_status_history')
    .select('*')
    .eq('fowl_id', fowlId)
    .order('changed_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch status history:', error.message);
    return [];
  }
  return data || [];
}

export type ArchiveOptions = {
  /** Structured reason: sold | transfer | inactive | retired | other. */
  kind?: string;
  /** Label for the kind (used as the stored reason when no note is given). */
  label?: string;
  /** Optional free-text note; required for kind 'other'. */
  note?: string;
  /** Required for kind 'retired': fighting | breeding | both. */
  retiredScope?: string | null;
  /** Optional for kind 'transfer': expected/actual return date. */
  returnDate?: string | null;
};

export async function archiveFowl(
  id: number,
  opts: ArchiveOptions = {},
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  const note = (opts.note || '').trim();
  const reason = note || opts.label || opts.kind || 'Archived';
  const history: HistoryEntry[] = [
    { field: 'status', newValue: 'Archived', reason },
    { field: 'activity_status', newValue: 'inactive', reason },
  ];
  if (opts.kind) {
    history.push({ field: 'archive_kind', newValue: opts.kind, reason });
    if (opts.kind === 'retired' && opts.retiredScope) {
      history.push({ field: 'retired_scope', newValue: opts.retiredScope, reason });
    }
  }
  return changeLifecycle(id, archivePatch({ ...opts, note }), history);
}

export async function restoreFowl(id: number): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(
    id,
    restorePatch(),
    [
      { field: 'status', newValue: 'Active', reason: 'Restored' },
      { field: 'activity_status', newValue: 'active', reason: 'Restored' },
    ],
  );
}

export async function markFowlDeceased(
  id: number,
  reason: string,
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(
    id,
    deceasedPatch(reason),
    [
      { field: 'status', newValue: 'Deceased', reason },
      { field: 'condition_status', newValue: 'Deceased', reason },
      { field: 'activity_status', newValue: 'inactive', reason },
    ],
  );
}

/** Manual injury/condition change. Never touches role, status or activity. */
export async function setConditionStatus(
  id: number,
  value: string,
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(id, conditionPatch(value), [
    { field: 'condition_status', newValue: value },
  ]);
}

/** Manual breeding/material role decision. Never derived from injury. */
export async function setBreedingRole(
  id: number,
  role: 'none' | 'breeder' | 'material',
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(id, rolePatch(role), [
    { field: 'breeding_role', newValue: role },
  ]);
}

export async function setSireMaterial(
  id: number,
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(
    id,
    { breeding_role: 'material', archive_reason: null, archive_kind: null, retired_scope: null, return_date: null },
    [
      { field: 'breeding_role', newValue: 'material' },
    ],
  );
}

export async function setFowlActive(
  id: number,
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  return changeLifecycle(
    id,
    restorePatch(),
    [
      { field: 'status', newValue: 'Active' },
      { field: 'activity_status', newValue: 'active' },
    ],
  );
}

/**
 * Promote an offspring chicken to a breeder (Breeding Male or Breeding Female).
 * Preserves its birth code as birth_code, assigns its breeder code,
 * sets its registry_role, and logs the change into fowl_status_history.
 */
export async function promoteToBreeder(
  id: number,
  opts: {
    targetRole: 'Breeding Male' | 'Breeding Female';
    breederCode: string;
    birthCode: string;
  },
): Promise<{ error?: string; historyError?: string }> {
  const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {
    registry_role: opts.targetRole,
    bird_code: opts.breederCode,
    breeding_role: 'breeder',
    status: 'Active',
    activity_status: 'active',
  };
  const history: HistoryEntry[] = [
    { field: 'registry_role', newValue: opts.targetRole, reason: 'promote_to_breeder', note: `Promoted to ${opts.targetRole} (${opts.breederCode})` },
    { field: 'bird_code', newValue: opts.breederCode, reason: 'promote_to_breeder' },
    { field: 'birth_code', newValue: opts.birthCode, reason: 'promote_to_breeder' },
  ];
  return changeLifecycle(id, patch, history);
}

export async function uploadFowlImage(file: File): Promise<{ url?: string; path?: string; error?: string }> {
  const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop();
  const fileName = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}.${fileExt}`;
  
  // Safe namespacing: write new uploads under owner prefix so purge-media cleanly clears them
  const { data: auth } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const user = auth?.user;
  const filePath = user ? `${user.id}/fowl/${fileName}` : `fowl/${fileName}`;

  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
    .from('fowl-images')
    .upload(filePath, file);

  if (uploadError) return { error: uploadError.message };

  const { data } = supabase.storage.from('fowl-images').getPublicUrl(filePath);
  return { url: data.publicUrl, path: filePath };
}

export async function deleteFowlImageFile(pathOrUrl: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    let filePath = pathOrUrl;
    if (filePath.startsWith('http')) {
      const parsed = storagePathFromUrl(filePath);
      if (parsed) filePath = parsed.path;
    }
    if (filePath) {
      await supabase.storage.from('fowl-images').remove([filePath]);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Best-effort cleanup of orphan fowl image failed:', err);
  }
}

export async function getNextIdentifier(
  role: 'sire' | 'dam' | 'offspring',
  sireCode?: string | null,
  damCode?: string | null
): Promise<{ code?: string; error?: string }> {
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { error: 'Not authenticated' };

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_next_fowl_identifier', {
      p_user_id: user.id,
      p_role: role,
      p_sire_code: sireCode ?? null,
      p_dam_code: damCode ?? null,
    });
    if (error) return { error: error.message };
    return { code: String(data) };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '@/lib/registry';

export interface MatchOption {
  id: number;
  match_id: number | null;
  user_id: string;
  option_number: number;
  fowl_entry: string;
  partner_entry: string | null;
  bet_type: string;
  target_number: number;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

export interface PartnerSuggestion {
  user_id: string;
  full_name: string;
  farm_name: string;
  fowl_entry: string;
  option_number: number;
  bet_type: string;
  target_number: number;
}

export async function findMatchingPartners(
  targetNumber: number,
  betType: string,
  currentUserId: string
): Promise<PartnerSuggestion[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('match_options')
    .select(`
      user_id,
      fowl_entry,
      option_number,
      bet_type,
      target_number,
      profiles!inner(full_name, farm_name)
    `)
    .eq('target_number', targetNumber)
    .eq('bet_type', betType)
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .neq('user_id', currentUserId)
    .limit(10);

  if (error || !data) {
    console.error('Failed to find partners:', error);
    return [];
  }

  return data.map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const profile = row.profiles as { full_name: string; farm_name: string } | null;
    return {
      user_id: row.user_id as string,
      full_name: profile?.full_name || 'Unknown',
      farm_name: profile?.farm_name || 'Unknown Farm',
      fowl_entry: row.fowl_entry as string,
      option_number: row.option_number as number,
      bet_type: row.bet_type as string,
      target_number: row.target_number as number,
    };
  });
}

export async function insertMatchOption(payload: {
  match_id?: number;
  option_number: number;
  fowl_entry: string;
  partner_entry?: string;
  bet_type: string;
  target_number: number;
  status?: string;
}): Promise<{ data?: MatchOption; error?: string }> {
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { error: 'Not authenticated' };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('match_options')
    .insert([{
      user_id: user.id,
      match_id: payload.match_id || null,
      option_number: payload.option_number,
      fowl_entry: payload.fowl_entry,
      partner_entry: payload.partner_entry || null,
      bet_type: payload.bet_type,
      target_number: payload.target_number,
      status: payload.status || 'pending',
    }])
    .select()
    .single();

  if (error) return { error: error.message };
  return { data: data as MatchOption };
}

export async function updateMatchOptionStatus(
  optionId: number,
  status: string,
  partnerEntry?: string
): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  const update: Record<string, unknown> = { status, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
  if (partnerEntry !== undefined) update.partner_entry = partnerEntry;

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('match_options')
    .update(update)
    .eq('id', optionId);

  if (error) return { error: error.message };
  return {};
}

export async function fetchMatchOptions(matchId: number): Promise<MatchOption[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('match_options')
    .select('*')
    .eq('match_id', matchId)
    .order('option_number', { ascending: true });

  if (error) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch match options:', error);
    return [];
  }
  return data || [];
}
