import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const supabase = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

// Import lineage logic and registry roles logic
import { buildRegistryContext, roleOf, isRegisteredChild } from '../lib/registry-roles';
import { isKnownParent } from '../lib/family-tree';
import { resolveBirdCodes, formatBirdCodeForDisplay } from '../lib/bird-code';

async function main() {
  const { data: fowls, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').select('*').order('id', { ascending: true });
  if (error || !fowls) {
    console.error('Error fetching fowls:', error);
    return;
  }

  // Find user IDs
  const userIds = Array.from(new Set(fowls.map(f => f.user_id)));
  console.log(`Total users in DB: ${userIds.length}`);

  // Analyze each user
  for (const uid of userIds) {
    const userFowls = fowls.filter(f => f.user_id === uid);
    if (userFowls.length === 0) continue;

    console.log(`\n========================================================================`);
    console.log(`USER: ${uid} (Total chickens: ${userFowls.length})`);
    console.log(`========================================================================`);

    const ctx = buildRegistryContext(userFowls);
    const codes = resolveBirdCodes(userFowls);

    // 1. Lineage offspring (registered children with at least one known parent)
    const lineageOffspring = userFowls.filter(f => isKnownParent(f.sire) || isKnownParent(f.dam));
    console.log(`\n1. Lineage Offspring count (has known sire or dam): ${lineageOffspring.length}`);

    // 2. Non-Breeding tab membership
    const nonBreedingChickens = userFowls.filter(f => roleOf(f, ctx) === 'Non-Breeding');
    console.log(`2. Non-Breeding chickens count: ${nonBreedingChickens.length}`);

    // 3. Compare the two sets
    const nonBreedingIds = new Set(nonBreedingChickens.map(f => f.id));
    const lineageIds = new Set(lineageOffspring.map(f => f.id));

    const inLineageButNotNonBreeding = lineageOffspring.filter(f => !nonBreedingIds.has(f.id));
    console.log(`\n3. Chickens in Lineage Offspring but NOT in Non-Breeding (${inLineageButNotNonBreeding.length}):`);
    for (const f of inLineageButNotNonBreeding) {
      const role = roleOf(f, ctx);
      console.log(` - [ID ${f.id}] "${f.name}" | Gender: ${f.gender} | Status: ${f.status} | Role: "${role}" | breeding_role: "${f.breeding_role}" | registry_role: "${f.registry_role}" | Sire: "${f.sire}", Dam: "${f.dam}" | Code: "${codes.get(String(f.id)) || f.bird_code}"`);
    }

    const inNonBreedingButNotLineage = nonBreedingChickens.filter(f => !lineageIds.has(f.id));
    console.log(`\n4. Chickens in Non-Breeding but NOT in Lineage Offspring (${inNonBreedingButNotLineage.length}):`);
    for (const f of inNonBreedingButNotLineage) {
      console.log(` - [ID ${f.id}] "${f.name}" | Sire: "${f.sire}", Dam: "${f.dam}"`);
    }

    // Role breakdown
    const rolesCount: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const f of userFowls) {
      const r = roleOf(f, ctx);
      rolesCount[r] = (rolesCount[r] || 0) + 1;
    }
    console.log('\nRoles count breakdown:', rolesCount);

    // Sires & Dams in this user's registry
    const sires = userFowls.filter(f => roleOf(f, ctx) === 'Breeding Male');
    const dams = userFowls.filter(f => roleOf(f, ctx) === 'Breeding Female');
    console.log(`\nBreeding Males (${sires.length}):`, sires.map(s => `[ID ${s.id}] ${s.name} (code: ${codes.get(String(s.id)) || s.bird_code})`).join(', '));
    console.log(`Breeding Females (${dams.length}):`, dams.map(d => `[ID ${d.id}] ${d.name} (code: ${codes.get(String(d.id)) || d.bird_code})`).join(', '));
  }
}

main().catch(console.error);

/**
 * Responsive Horizontal Overflow Audit (Playwright Regression Test)
 *
 * NOTE: This audit script intercepts and mocks the Supabase data layer locally
 * to inject synthetic datasets (including the 40-fowl stress dataset) and verify
 * browser layout and mobile responsiveness. It checks CSS rendering and layout only,
 * and cannot / does not validate real database writes or database constraints.
 *
 * Verifies that all dashboard routes and sub-tabs fit within phone and desktop
 * viewports with ZERO horizontal overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth)
 * and with no action control clipped or pushed past the viewport.
 *
 * Tests across:
 *   - Phone viewports: 320x640, 360x800, 390x844
 *   - Desktop viewports: 1024x768, 1100x800, 1280x720, 1330x900, 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080
 *   - Font scaling: 100%, 125%, 150% on phones; 100% on desktop
 *   - Dynamically discovered tabs and sub-pills across all modules
 *   - Interactive modals & sheets: Chicken Profile modal, Edit Chicken modal, Add Match Record with selected fowl, and DateRangePicker bottom sheet
 *   - Route health guards: Fails on 404, error boundary ("Something went wrong"), or redirect to /login
 *   - Stress dataset: 40 chickens (with long names/crossbred badges), 10 matches (with long opponent names), and 8 pairings
 *   - Local-only guard: strictly refuses to run against external/production URLs
 *   - Credentials security: reads untracked .env.local or process environment with zero hardcoded credentials
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npm run audit:mobile
 *   or:
 *   BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run audit:mobile
 */

import { chromium, type Browser, type BrowserContext, type Page } from 'playwright';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { STRESS_FOWLS, STRESS_MATCHES, STRESS_PAIRINGS } from './fixtures/stress-dataset';

// Load environment variables from untracked .env.local if present
const envLocalPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
if (fs.existsSync(envLocalPath)) {
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(envLocalPath, 'utf-8').split('\n');
  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
    if (idx > 0) {
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim();
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim();
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v;
    }
  }
}

const BASE_URL = process.env.BASE_URL || process.env.SMOKE_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
const EMAIL = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL || '';
const PASSWORD = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || '';
const ALLOW_EXTERNAL =
  process.env.ALLOW_EXTERNAL_URL === 'true' || process.argv.includes('--allow-external');

if (!EMAIL || !PASSWORD) {
  console.error(
    '\n❌ ERROR: SMOKE_EMAIL and SMOKE_PASSWORD must be provided via environment variables or untracked .env.local.',
  );
  console.error('Credentials must never be hardcoded into the repository.\n');
  process.exit(1);
}

// Validate local-only base URL
function assertLocalBaseUrl(urlStr: string): void {
  try {
    const u = new URL(urlStr);
    const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
    const isLocal =
      host === 'localhost' ||
      host === '127.0.0.1' ||
      host === '::1' ||
      host === '[::1]' ||
      host.endsWith('.localhost');

    if (!isLocal && !ALLOW_EXTERNAL) {
      console.error(`\n❌ ERROR: Refusing to run audit against non-local BASE_URL (${urlStr}).`);
      console.error('This script is strictly intended for local regression testing.');
      console.error(
        'To override intentionally, pass the --allow-external flag or set ALLOW_EXTERNAL_URL=true.\n',
      );
      process.exit(1);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(`\n❌ ERROR: Invalid BASE_URL: "${urlStr}"`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

assertLocalBaseUrl(BASE_URL);

interface ViewportSpec {
  name: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  /** Desktop sizes are checked at 100% font scale only. */
  desktop?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Viewports under test. Override with AUDIT_VIEWPORTS="320x568,360x800".
 * Default covers the three phone widths the layout gate must satisfy.
 */
const MOBILE_VIEWPORTS: ViewportSpec[] = (process.env.AUDIT_VIEWPORTS ?? '320x640,360x800,390x844')
  .split(',')
  .map((spec) => {
    const [w, h] = spec.trim().split('x').map(Number);
    return { name: spec.trim(), width: w, height: h };
  })
  .filter((v) => !Number.isNaN(v.width) && !Number.isNaN(v.height));

/**
 * Desktop viewports. The old audits only covered phone widths, which is how
 * the desktop horizontal overflow (Match Logs table / action bar) slipped
 * through. Desktop sizes are checked at 100% font scale; the phone widths keep
 * the full 100/125/150% matrix.
 */
const DESKTOP_VIEWPORTS: ViewportSpec[] = (
  process.env.AUDIT_DESKTOP_VIEWPORTS ??
  '1024x768,1100x800,1280x720,1330x900,1366x768,1440x900,1920x1080'
)
  .split(',')
  .map((spec) => {
    const [w, h] = spec.trim().split('x').map(Number);
    return { name: spec.trim(), width: w, height: h, desktop: true };
  })
  .filter((v) => !Number.isNaN(v.width) && !Number.isNaN(v.height));

const VIEWPORTS: ViewportSpec[] = [...MOBILE_VIEWPORTS, ...DESKTOP_VIEWPORTS];

const FONT_SCALES = (process.env.AUDIT_FONT_SCALES ?? '1.0,1.25,1.5')
  .split(',')
  .map((n) => Number(n.trim()))
  .filter((n) => !Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0);

/** Desktop sizes only need the 100% scale; the phone widths keep all three. */
const fontScalesFor = (vp: ViewportSpec) => (vp.desktop ? [1.0] : FONT_SCALES);

/** Every language is exercised at every viewport and every font scale. */
const AUDIT_LANGUAGES: readonly string[] = (
  process.env.AUDIT_LANG ? process.env.AUDIT_LANG.split(',') : ['en', 'tl', 'hil']
)
  .map((l) => l.trim())
  .filter(Boolean);

  { name: 'Breeding Hub', path: '/breeding', hasDynamicTabs: true },
  { name: 'Match Logs', path: '/match-logs', hasDynamicTabs: false },
  { name: 'Add Match Record', path: '/match-logs/new?fowlId=101', hasDynamicTabs: false },
  { name: 'Edit Match Record', path: '/match-logs/1/edit', hasDynamicTabs: false },
  { name: 'Settings', path: '/settings', hasDynamicTabs: true },
];

function findCachedChromium(): string | null {
  const cache = path.join(
    process.env.USERPROFILE ?? process.env.HOME ?? '',
    'AppData',
    'Local',
    'ms-playwright',
  );
  if (!fs.existsSync(cache)) return null;

  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(cache)) {
    if (!entry.startsWith('chromium')) continue;
    const dir = path.join(cache, entry);
    if (!fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const sub of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = path.join(dir, sub);
      if (!fs.statSync(full).isDirectory()) continue;
      const exes = [
        path.join(full, 'chrome.exe'),
        path.join(full, 'headless_shell.exe'),
        path.join(full, 'chrome-win', 'chrome.exe'),
        path.join(full, 'chrome-win64', 'chrome.exe'),
      ];
      for (const e of exes) {
        if (fs.existsSync(e)) return e;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function launchBrowser(): Promise<Browser> {
  if (process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH) {
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH });
  }
  try {
    return await chromium.launch();
  } catch {
    const cached = findCachedChromium();
    if (!cached) {
      throw new Error(
        'Chromium executable not found. Please install Playwright browsers or set PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH.',
      );
    }
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: cached });
  }
}

async function authenticate(context: BrowserContext, lang: string): Promise<void> {
  // Drop any existing session first: an authenticated context is redirected
  // away from /login, and the Supabase access token is only refreshed while a
  // page is open (this audit closes pages between checks).
  await context.clearCookies();
  await context.addCookies([{ name: 'gt-lang', value: lang, url: BASE_URL }]);

  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/login`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.waitForSelector('input[type="password"]', { timeout: 15000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

  const emailInput = page
    .locator('input[type="email"], input[id="email-address"], input[name="username"]')
    .first();
  await emailInput.fill(EMAIL);
  const passwordInput = page.locator('input[type="password"]').first();
  await passwordInput.fill(PASSWORD);
  await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  await page.click('button[type="submit"]');

  await page.waitForURL(/dashboard/, { timeout: 20000 });
  await page.close();
}

/**
 * Auth reliability counters. The Supabase access token expires while the audit
 * closes pages between checks, so the run intermittently lands on /login or the
 * landing page. Every such event is counted and recovered by re-authenticating.
 */
const authStats = {
  logins: 0,
  retries: 0,
  sessionRedirects: 0,
  failures: 0,
};

async function authenticateWithRetry(
  context: BrowserContext,
  lang: string,
  attempts = 3,
): Promise<void> {
  let lastErr: unknown;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      await authenticate(context, lang);
      authStats.logins++;
      return;
    } catch (err) {
      lastErr = err;
      authStats.retries++;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 750 * attempt));
    }
  }
  authStats.failures++;
  throw lastErr instanceof Error ? lastErr : new Error(String(lastErr));
}

function isUnauthenticatedUrl(rawUrl: string): boolean {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
    return parsed.pathname === '/' || parsed.pathname.startsWith('/login');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Navigate to a protected page and recover from a lost session by signing in
 * again and retrying. A page that still ends on /login or / is never treated as
 * a pass: the caller records a fatal failure for it.
 */
async function gotoWithAuthRetry(
  page: Page,
  context: BrowserContext,
  lang: string,
  url: string,
  attempts = 3,
): Promise<void> {
  let lastErr: unknown;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
    const res = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
    if (isUnauthenticatedUrl(page.url())) {
      authStats.sessionRedirects++;
      lastErr = new Error(`Authentication lost: page ended on ${page.url()} while loading ${url}`);
      if (attempt < attempts) {
        await authenticateWithRetry(context, lang);
        continue;
      }
      throw lastErr;
    }
    try {
      await assertPageHealthy(page, url, res);
      return;
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      if (/Authentication lost|redirected to \/login|ended on/.test(msg)) {
        authStats.sessionRedirects++;
        lastErr = err;
        if (attempt < attempts) {
          await authenticateWithRetry(context, lang);
          continue;
        }
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
  throw lastErr instanceof Error ? lastErr : new Error(String(lastErr));
}

interface OverflowCheckResult {
  clientWidth: number;
  scrollWidth: number;
  hasOverflow: boolean;
  overflowAmount: number;
  culprits: Array<{ tag: string; id: string; className: string; right: number }>;
}

async function measureOverflow(page: Page): Promise<OverflowCheckResult> {
  return await page.evaluate(() => {
    const clientWidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    const scrollWidth = document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
    const bodyScrollWidth = document.body.scrollWidth;
    const effectiveScroll = Math.max(scrollWidth, bodyScrollWidth);

    const culprits: Array<{ tag: string; id: string; className: string; right: number }> = [];
    if (effectiveScroll > clientWidth) {
      document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.right > clientWidth + 1) {
          culprits.push({
            tag: el.tagName,
            id: el.id,
            className: (el.className?.toString?.() || '').slice(0, 60),
            right: Math.round(rect.right),
          });
        }
      });
    }

    return {
      clientWidth,
      scrollWidth: effectiveScroll,
      hasOverflow: effectiveScroll > clientWidth,
      overflowAmount: Math.max(0, effectiveScroll - clientWidth),
      culprits: culprits.slice(0, 5),
    };
  });
}

async function assertPageHealthy(page: Page, url: string, response: any): Promise<void> {
  const currentUrl = page.url();
  if (currentUrl.includes('/login')) {
    throw new Error(`Authentication lost: redirected to /login when navigating to ${url}`);
  }
  if (isUnauthenticatedUrl(currentUrl)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Authentication lost: landed on the landing page (${currentUrl}) when navigating to ${url}`,
    );
  }
  if (response && response.status() >= 400) {
    throw new Error(
      `HTTP Error ${response.status()} (${response.statusText()}) navigating to ${url}`,
    );
  }
  const pageError = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const text = document.body?.innerText || '';
    if (
      text.includes('404') &&
      (text.includes('This page could not be found') ||
        text.includes('Page Not Found') ||
        text.includes('Record Not Found'))
    ) {
      return '404 / Not Found page detected';
    }
    if (
      text.includes('Something went wrong') ||
      text.includes('Application error: a client-side exception')
    ) {
      return 'Error boundary triggered: "Something went wrong"';
    }
    return null;
  });
  if (pageError) {
    throw new Error(`Page render failure on ${url}: ${pageError}`);
  }
}

interface RenderElementCounts {
  cards: number;
  rows: number;
  badges: number;
}

async function countRenderedElements(page: Page): Promise<RenderElementCounts> {
  return await page.evaluate(() => {
    // Cards: fowl cards, pair cards, dashboard stat cards
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll(
      '.group.bg-card, [data-testid="fowl-card"], article, div[class*="rounded-2xl border"], div[class*="rounded-3xl border"], div[class*="bg-card"][class*="rounded-lg border"]',
    ).length;

    // Table rows
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, [role="row"]').length;

    // Badges / pills: status badges, breeding type badges, bloodline chips, tags
    const badges = document.querySelectorAll(
      '[data-testid="status-badge"], span[class*="rounded-full"], span[class*="rounded-md"][class*="text-xs"], span[class*="tracking-wider"], span[class*="font-mono"]',
    ).length;

    return { cards, rows, badges };
  });
}

/**
 * Detects action controls (Edit / Share / Media / Save / Cancel) that are cut
 * off: either pushed past the viewport's right edge, or clipped by an ancestor
 * that hides overflow. This is the check that catches the "Media & Actions
 * column is cut off" and "action bar covers the fields" regressions.
 */
async function measureClippedActions(page: Page): Promise<{ count: number; details: string[] }> {
  return await page.evaluate(() => {
    const vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
    const details: string[] = [];
    const selector =
      'a[href], button, [role="button"], [role="tab"], input[type="submit"], [data-testid*="action"]';
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach((el) => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;
      const style = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.display === 'none') return;
      const label = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || el.tagName)
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .slice(0, 40);

      // 1. pushed past the right edge of the viewport
      if (rect.right > vw + 1) {
        const key = `viewport:${label}`;
        if (!seen.has(key)) {
          seen.add(key);
          details.push(`"${label}" extends ${Math.round(rect.right - vw)}px past the viewport`);
        }
        return;
      }

      // 2. clipped by an ancestor with hidden/clip overflow
      let ancestor: HTMLElement | null = el.parentElement;
      while (ancestor && ancestor !== document.body) {
        const overflowX = getComputedStyle(ancestor).overflowX;
        if (overflowX === 'auto' || overflowX === 'scroll') break;
        if (overflowX === 'hidden' || overflowX === 'clip') {
          const over = Math.round(rect.right - ancestor.getBoundingClientRect().right);
          if (over > 2) {
            const key = `clip:${label}`;
            if (!seen.has(key)) {
              seen.add(key);
              details.push(`"${label}" is clipped ${over}px by its container`);
            }
          }
          break;
        }
        ancestor = ancestor.parentElement;
      }
    });
    return { count: details.length, details: details.slice(0, 5) };
  });
}

interface FailureReport {
  viewport: string;
  fontScale: string;
  targetDescription: string;
  clientWidth: number;
  scrollWidth: number;
  overflowAmount: number;
  culprits: Array<{ tag: string; id: string; className: string; right: number }>;
}

/**
 * Scenario checks that cannot be reached by simply loading a route:
 *  - Register Chicken with every section visible
 *  - the parent selector dropdown (Sire / Dam picker)
 *  - the filter bar with all filters open
 *  - the Edit Chicken modal with the parent selectors open
 */
async function runScenarioChecks(
  page: Page,
  opts: {
    baseUrl: string;
    viewport: string;
    fontScale: string;
    measure: (p: Page) => Promise<OverflowCheckResult>;
    record: (entry: string, check: OverflowCheckResult) => void;
    recordClipped?: (entry: string) => Promise<void>;
  },
): Promise<void> {
  const { baseUrl, measure, record, recordClipped } = opts;
  const check = () => measure(page);

  // ── Register Chicken with every section visible ──────────────────────────
  try {
    await page.goto(`${baseUrl}/profiling?tab=form`, {
      waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',
      timeout: 30000,
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(900);
    const formVisible = await page
      .locator('#encode-sire, #growth-stage')
      .first()
      .isVisible()
      .catch(() => false);
    if (formVisible) {
      record('Register Chicken (all sections visible)', await check());
      await recordClipped?.('Register Chicken -> Action controls visible');
    } else {
      console.log('  – skipped Register Chicken scenario (form not reachable)');
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(
      `  ✗ ERROR: [Register Chicken] ${err instanceof Error ? err.message.split('\n')[0] : err}`,
    );
  }

  // ── Parent selector dropdown open ────────────────────────────────────────
  try {
    const sireInput = page.locator('#encode-sire');
    if (await sireInput.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
      await sireInput.click().catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(400);
      record('Register Chicken -> Parent selector open', await check());
      await recordClipped?.('Register Chicken -> Parent selector actions visible');
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(
      `  ✗ ERROR: [Parent selector] ${err instanceof Error ? err.message.split('\n')[0] : err}`,
    );
  }

  // ── Filter bar with all filters open ─────────────────────────────────────
  try {
    await page.goto(`${baseUrl}/catalog`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(900);
    const filtersToggle = page.locator('button[aria-controls="mobile-filter-dropdowns"]').first();
    if (await filtersToggle.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
      await filtersToggle.click().catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(400);
      record('Chicken Inventory -> Filter bar with all filters open', await check());
      await recordClipped?.('Chicken Inventory -> Filter bar actions visible');
    } else {
      // Desktop layout: the filter panel is always visible.
      record('Chicken Inventory -> Filter bar with all filters open', await check());
      await recordClipped?.('Chicken Inventory -> Filter bar actions visible');
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(
      `  ✗ ERROR: [Filter bar] ${err instanceof Error ? err.message.split('\n')[0] : err}`,
    );
  }

  // ── Edit Chicken modal with the parent selector open ─────────────────────
  try {
    await page.goto(`${baseUrl}/profiling`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(900);
    const editBtn = page.locator('button:has-text("Edit")').first();
    if (await editBtn.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
      await editBtn.click().catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForSelector('[role="dialog"]', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(400);
      record('Chicken Registry -> Edit Chicken modal', await check());
      await recordClipped?.('Chicken Registry -> Edit modal actions visible');

      const editSire = page.locator('#edit-sire');
      if (await editSire.isVisible().catch(() => false)) {
        await editSire.click().catch(() => {});
        await page.waitForTimeout(400);
        record('Chicken Registry -> Edit modal -> Parent selector open', await check());
      }

      await page.keyboard.press('Escape').catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(
      `  ✗ ERROR: [Edit modal] ${err instanceof Error ? err.message.split('\n')[0] : err}`,
    );
  }
}

async function runAudit(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('============================================================');
  console.log('Responsive Overflow Audit (Playwright with Stress Dataset)');
  console.log(`Base URL: ${BASE_URL} (Local-only verification enforced)`);
  console.log(
    `Stress Dataset: ${STRESS_FOWLS.length} Chickens, ${STRESS_MATCHES.length} Matches, ${STRESS_PAIRINGS.length} Pairings`,
  );
  const matrixCount =
    VIEWPORTS.reduce((n, vp) => n + fontScalesFor(vp).length, 0) * AUDIT_LANGUAGES.length;
  console.log(
    `Matrix: ${VIEWPORTS.length} viewports x ${AUDIT_LANGUAGES.length} languages x font scales (100% on desktop) = ${matrixCount} environment configurations`,
  );
  console.log('============================================================\n');

  let browser: Browser;
  try {
    browser = await launchBrowser();
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('Failed to launch browser:', msg);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // Pure in-memory session: no storage-state file, no trace recording, no cookies written to disk
  const context = await browser.newContext();

  try {
    console.log('Authenticating in-memory session (credentials never logged or persisted)...');
    await authenticateWithRetry(context, AUDIT_LANGUAGES[0]);
    console.log('✓ In-memory authentication successful\n');
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error('Failed to authenticate session:', msg);
    await browser.close();
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // Intercept all Supabase REST data calls with deterministic stress dataset
  // Strictly read-only simulation, never writes to database
  await context.route('**/*.supabase.co/rest/v1/**', async (route) => {
    const url = route.request().url();
    const headers = route.request().headers();
    const acceptHeader = headers['accept'] || '';
    const isSingleObject = acceptHeader.includes('application/vnd.pgrst.object+json');

    if (
      url.includes('/fowl_photos') ||
      url.includes('/match_videos') ||
      url.includes('/match_photos') ||
      url.includes('/safety_incidents')
    ) {
      return route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify([]),
      });
    }

    if (url.includes('/fowl')) {
      if (isSingleObject) {
        const fowlId = url.match(/id=eq\.(\d+)/)?.[1];
        const match = STRESS_FOWLS.find((f) => String(f.id) === fowlId) || STRESS_FOWLS[0];
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify(match),
        });
      }
      return route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify(STRESS_FOWLS),
      });
    }

    if (url.includes('/match')) {
      if (isSingleObject) {
        const matchId = url.match(/id=eq\.(\d+)/)?.[1];
        const match = STRESS_MATCHES.find((m) => String(m.id) === matchId) || STRESS_MATCHES[0];
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify(match),
        });
      }
      return route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify(STRESS_MATCHES),
      });
    }

    if (url.includes('/breeding_pairings')) {
      return route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify(STRESS_PAIRINGS),
      });
    }

    return route.continue();
  });

  const failures: FailureReport[] = [];
  const visitedCatalog = new Set<string>();
  const elementMetricsMap = new Map<string, RenderElementCounts>();
  const perLanguage = new Map<string, { checks: number; failures: number }>();
  let totalChecks = 0;
  let passedChecks = 0;

  for (let vpIdx = 0; vpIdx < VIEWPORTS.length; vpIdx++) {
    const vp = VIEWPORTS[vpIdx];
    for (const fontScale of fontScalesFor(vp)) {
      for (const lang of AUDIT_LANGUAGES) {
        await context.addCookies([{ name: 'gt-lang', value: lang, url: BASE_URL }]);
        const scalePct = `${Math.round(fontScale * 100)}%`;
        const envLabel = `Viewport: ${vp.name} (${vp.width}x${vp.height}) | Font Scale: ${scalePct} | Language: ${lang}`;
        console.log(`>>> Checking ${envLabel}`);

        // Re-authenticate for every configuration: the Supabase access token is
        // refreshed by a timer that only runs while a page is open, and this
        // audit closes every page between checks, so a long run would otherwise
        // silently fall back to /login halfway through.
        try {
          await authenticateWithRetry(context, lang);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
          totalChecks++;
          failures.push({
            viewport: vp.name,
            fontScale: scalePct,
            targetDescription: `Authentication (${lang})`,
            clientWidth: vp.width,
            scrollWidth: -1,
            overflowAmount: 999,
            culprits: [{ tag: 'ERROR', id: 'FATAL_AUTH', className: msg.slice(0, 60), right: 999 }],
          });
          console.error(`  ✗ ERROR: re-authentication failed after retries: ${msg.split('\n')[0]}`);
          continue;
        }

        const page = await context.newPage();
        await page.setViewportSize({ width: vp.width, height: vp.height });
        const checksBefore = totalChecks;
        const failsBefore = failures.length;

        for (const route of BASE_ROUTES) {
          const url = `${BASE_URL}${route.path}`;
          try {
            await gotoWithAuthRetry(page, context, lang, url);

            if (route.expectedSelector) {
              await page
                .locator(route.expectedSelector)
                .first()
                .waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 5000 })
                .catch(() => {});
            }

            if (fontScale !== 1.0) {
              await page.evaluate((scale) => {
                document.documentElement.style.fontSize = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
              }, fontScale);
            }

            // Await data hydration for stress dataset
            if (route.path === '/catalog') {
              await page
                .waitForFunction(
                  () => {
                    const el = document.querySelector('#inventory-tab-all span:last-child');
                    return el && parseInt(el.textContent?.trim() || '0', 10) > 0;
                  },
                  { timeout: 10000 },
                )
                .catch(() => {});
            } else if (route.path === '/profiling') {
              await page
                .waitForFunction(
                  () => {
                    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
                    return Array.from(tabs).some(
                      (t) => t.textContent?.includes('4') || t.textContent?.includes('24'),
                    );
                  },
                  { timeout: 10000 },
                )
                .catch(() => {});
            } else if (route.path === '/lineage') {
              await page
                .waitForFunction(
                  () => {
                    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
                    return Array.from(tabs).some((t) => {
                      const num = parseInt(t.textContent?.match(/\d+/)?.[0] || '0', 10);
                      return num > 0;
                    });
                  },
                  { timeout: 10000 },
                )
                .catch(() => {});
            } else if (route.path === '/match-logs') {
              await page
                .locator('tbody tr, [role="row"]')
                .first()
                .waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 8000 })
                .catch(() => {});
            } else if (route.path.includes('/match-logs/1/edit')) {
              await page
                .locator('input[name="opponent_name"], input[placeholder*="opponent" i]')
                .first()
                .waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 8000 })
                .catch(() => {});
            } else {
              await page.waitForTimeout(400);
            }

            if (!route.hasDynamicTabs) {
              // Static route check
              const check = await measureOverflow(page);
              totalChecks++;
              const entryName = `${route.name} (default)`;
              visitedCatalog.add(entryName);

              // Action controls must be fully visible (not clipped, not off-screen)
              const clipped = await measureClippedActions(page);
              totalChecks++;
              const clipEntry = `${route.name} -> Action controls visible`;
              visitedCatalog.add(clipEntry);
              if (clipped.count > 0) {
                failures.push({
                  viewport: vp.name,
                  fontScale: scalePct,
                  targetDescription: clipEntry,
                  clientWidth: vp.width,
                  scrollWidth: -1,
                  overflowAmount: clipped.count,
                  culprits: clipped.details.map((d) => ({
                    tag: 'ACTION',
                    id: 'CLIPPED',
                    className: d,
                    right: 0,
                  })),
                });
                console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: [${clipEntry}] ${clipped.details.join('; ')}`);
              } else {
                passedChecks++;
              }

              // Record render element metrics on default view
              if (!elementMetricsMap.has(entryName)) {
                const counts = await countRenderedElements(page);
                elementMetricsMap.set(entryName, counts);
              }

              if (check.hasOverflow) {
                failures.push({
                  viewport: vp.name,
                  fontScale: scalePct,
                  targetDescription: `${route.name} (${route.path})`,
                  clientWidth: check.clientWidth,
                  scrollWidth: check.scrollWidth,
                  overflowAmount: check.overflowAmount,
                  culprits: check.culprits,
                });
                console.error(
                  `  ✗ FAIL: [${route.name}] scrollWidth=${check.scrollWidth} > clientWidth=${check.clientWidth} (+${check.overflowAmount}px)`,
                );
              } else {
                passedChecks++;
                console.log(

              // Route-specific interaction: DateRangePicker on Dashboard

                  className: d,
                  right: 0,
                })),
              });
              console.error(`  ✗ FAIL: [${entry}] ${clipped.details.join('; ')}`);
            } else {
              passedChecks++;
              console.log(`  ✓ PASS: [${entry}]`);
            }
          },
        });

        const langTotals = perLanguage.get(lang) ?? { checks: 0, failures: 0 };
        perLanguage.set(lang, {
          checks: langTotals.checks + (totalChecks - checksBefore),
          failures: langTotals.failures + (failures.length - failsBefore),
        });

        await page.close();
        console.log(`✓ Completed checks for ${envLabel}\n`);
      }
    }

  await browser.close();

  console.log('============================================================');

  console.log('============================================================');

  console.log(`Passed: ${passedChecks}`);
  console.log(`Failed: ${failures.length}\n`);

  console.log(
    `Auth reliability: logins=${authStats.logins}, retries=${authStats.retries}, ` +

  if (failures.length > 0) {

    console.error('============================================================');
    for (const f of failures) {

  }

  console.log('============================================================');

  console.log('ZERO HORIZONTAL OVERFLOW DETECTED.');

}

runAudit().catch((err: unknown) => {

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import type { FowlRecord } from '../lib/types';
import { computeAllCompositions, getBloodlineStats, compositionIsStale } from '../lib/bloodline-composition';

const ENV_PATH = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const admin = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

const SELECT =
  'id, name, breed, gender, sire, dam, bloodline_pct, bird_code, bloodline_composition, created_at';

async function main() {
  const apply = process.argv.includes('--apply');
  const { data, error } = await admin.from('fowl').select(SELECT).order('id');
  if (error) {
    console.error('❌ select failed ->', error.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const fowls = (data ?? []) as FowlRecord[];
  console.log(`Loaded ${fowls.length} fowl rows.`);

  const compositions = computeAllCompositions(fowls);
  const updates: Array<{ id: number; bloodline_composition: Record<string, number>; bloodline_pct: number }> = [];
  let stale = 0;

  for (const f of fowls) {
    const comp = compositions.get(String(f.id));
    if (!comp || Object.keys(comp).length === 0) continue;
    const stats = getBloodlineStats(comp);
    const specificPct = stats?.specificPct ?? 0;
    const pctStale = Math.abs((Number(f.bloodline_pct) || 0) - specificPct) > 0.01;
    if (compositionIsStale(f.bloodline_composition, comp) || pctStale) {
      stale++;
      updates.push({ id: f.id, bloodline_composition: comp, bloodline_pct: specificPct });
    }
  }

  console.log(`Rows needing a composition backfill: ${stale}`);
  if (!apply) {
    console.log('Dry run — pass --apply to write.');
    const byId = new Map(fowls.map((f) => [f.id, f]));
    const isFoundation = (v?: string | null) => {
      const k = (v || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return !k || k === 'foundation stock';
    };
    const offspring = updates.filter((u) => {
      const f = byId.get(u.id);
      return !!f && !isFoundation(f.sire) && !isFoundation(f.dam);
    });
    console.log(`Offspring with registered parents: ${offspring.length}`);
    const multi = updates.filter((u) => Object.keys(u.bloodline_composition).length > 1);
    console.log(`Multi-strain (hatian) compositions: ${multi.length}`);
    multi.slice(0, 5).forEach((u) => {
      const f = byId.get(u.id);
      console.log(`  #${u.id} ${f?.name} (${f?.sire} x ${f?.dam}) -> ${JSON.stringify(u.bloodline_composition)}`);
    });
    const sample = (offspring.length > 0 ? offspring : updates).slice(0, 8);
    sample.forEach((u) => {
      const f = byId.get(u.id);
      const stats = getBloodlineStats(u.bloodline_composition);
      console.log(
        `  #${u.id} ${f?.name} (${f?.sire} x ${f?.dam}) -> ${JSON.stringify(u.bloodline_composition)} (specific ${stats?.specificPct}%)`
      );
    });
    return;
  }

  const groups = new Map<string, { ids: number[]; comp: Record<string, number>; pct: number }>();
  updates.forEach((u) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(u.bloodline_composition);
    const g = groups.get(key) ?? { ids: [], comp: u.bloodline_composition, pct: u.bloodline_pct };
    g.ids.push(u.id);
    groups.set(key, g);
  });

  const distinct = [...groups.values()];
  console.log(`Distinct compositions: ${distinct.length}`);

  let written = 0;
  for (const g of distinct) {
    const { error: updErr } = await admin
      .from('fowl')
      .update({ bloodline_composition: g.comp, bloodline_pct: g.pct })
      .in('id', g.ids);
    if (updErr) {
      console.error(`❌ update failed for ${JSON.stringify(g.comp)} ->`, updErr.message);
      process.exit(1);
    }
    written += g.ids.length;
  }

  const { data: after, error: afterErr } = await admin
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, bloodline_composition')
    .not('bloodline_composition', 'is', null);
  if (afterErr) {
    console.error('❌ verify select failed ->', afterErr.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`✅ Wrote ${written} composition(s). Rows now with a stored composition: ${after?.length}/${fowls.length}`);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const envPath = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const supabase = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

async function main() {
  // Backfill: any Active male with a Severely Injured match -> Sire Material
  const { data: crit } = await supabase
    .from('match')
    .select('entry_name, user_id, post_fight_condition')
    .ilike('post_fight_condition', '%Severely%');

  if (!crit?.length) {
    console.log('No critical matches found.');
    return;
  }

  const names = [...new Set(crit.map((m) => m.entry_name))];
  console.log('Critical-match entries:', names);

  const { data: fowls } = await supabase
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, name, status, user_id')
    .in('name', names);

  console.log('Matching fowls:', JSON.stringify(fowls, null, 2));

  for (const f of fowls || []) {
    if (f.status === 'Sire Material') {
      console.log(`skip ${f.name} (already Sire Material)`);
      continue;
    }
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('fowl')
      .update({ status: 'Sire Material' })
      .eq('id', f.id);
    if (error) {
      console.error(`FAIL ${f.name}: ${error.message}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`OK ${f.name}: Active/${f.status} -> Sire Material`);
    }
  }

  const { data: sires } = await supabase
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, name, status, user_id')
    .eq('status', 'Sire Material');
  console.log('Sire Material count now:', sires?.length);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * PRODUCTION & STAGING DATABASE & STORAGE BACKUP SCRIPT
 *
 * Capabilities:
 * - Dynamically derives tables from live PostgREST schema (/rest/v1/).
 * - Excludes derived SQL views and snapshot/backup tables (logging rationale).
 * - Recursively traverses all storage subdirectories preserving folder paths.
 * - Handles storage pagination beyond 1000 objects.
 * - Supports owner-scoped backup via `--owner <user_id>`.
 * - Computes SHA-256 checksums for every downloaded file.
 * - Creates manifest.json with table counts, storage metadata, and checksums.
 * - Fails loudly if live counts mismatch or any download fails.
 * - Never prints secret keys or auth tokens.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npx tsx scripts/backup-production.ts [--owner <user_id>]
 */

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(ENV_PATH)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
function getArg(name: string): string | null {
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    if (args[i] === `--${name}` && args[i + 1]) {
      return args[i + 1];
    }
    if (args[i].startsWith(`--${name}=`)) {
      return args[i].slice(name.length + 3);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

const ownerArg = getArg('owner');

const supabaseUrl = process.env.BACKUP_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.BACKUP_SUPABASE_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('❌ Error: BACKUP_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

interface SchemaItem {
  name: string;
  type: 'table' | 'view' | 'snapshot' | 'rpc';
  reason?: string;
}

interface StorageFile {
  name: string;
  id: string | null;
  updated_at?: string;
  created_at?: string;
  last_accessed_at?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any> | null;
}

interface ManifestFileEntry {
  path: string;
  size: number;
  sha256: string;
}

interface ManifestTableEntry {
  rowCount: number;
  liveCount: number;
  status: 'verified' | 'mismatch' | 'error';
  note?: string;
}

interface BackupManifest {
  manifestVersion: string;
  timestamp: string;
  targetHost: string;
  ownerScope: string | null;
  tables: Record<string, ManifestTableEntry>;
  storage: Record<
    string,
    {
      fileCount: number;
      totalBytes: number;
      files: ManifestFileEntry[];
    }
  >;
  schemaAudit: {
    includedTables: string[];
    excludedItems: { name: string; type: string; reason: string }[];
  };
  summary: {
    totalTablesBackedUp: number;
    totalRowsBackedUp: number;
    totalFilesDownloaded: number;
    totalStorageBytesDownloaded: number;
  };
}

async function discoverSchema(): Promise<{
  activeTables: string[];
  excludedItems: { name: string; type: string; reason: string }[];
}> {
  const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/`, {
    headers: {
      apikey: serviceKey,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
    },
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to query OpenAPI schema from ${supabaseUrl}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  }

  const openApi = await res.json();
  const definitions: Record<string, any> = openApi.definitions || {};

  const activeTables: string[] = [];
  const excludedItems: { name: string; type: string; reason: string }[] = [];

  for (const name of Object.keys(definitions)) {
    // 1. Views
    if (name.startsWith('vw_')) {
      excludedItems.push({
        name,
        type: 'view',
        reason: 'Derived SQL view (computed, non-relational table)',
      });
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Snapshots or backup archives
    if (/backup/i.test(name)) {
      excludedItems.push({
        name,
        type: 'snapshot',
        reason: 'Snapshot / point-in-time recovery archive table (skipped per safety net protocol)',
      });
      continue;
    }

    // 3. RPC functions
    if (name.startsWith('rpc/')) {
      excludedItems.push({
        name,
        type: 'rpc',
        reason: 'Stored function / RPC endpoint',
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Live schema table
    activeTables.push(name);
  }

  // Check known requested tables that do not exist in live schema
  const knownPotentialTables = ['match_options'];
  for (const kt of knownPotentialTables) {
    if (!definitions[kt]) {
      excludedItems.push({
        name: kt,
        type: 'missing_table',
        reason: 'Table does not exist in live database schema (not exposed by PostgREST)',
      });
    }
  }

  return { activeTables: activeTables.sort(), excludedItems };
}

async function listRecursive(bucket: string, prefix = ''): Promise<{ path: string; size: number }[]> {
  const result: { path: string; size: number }[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  const limit = 1000;

  while (true) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from(bucket).list(prefix, {
      limit,
      offset,
      sortBy: { column: 'name', order: 'asc' },
    });

    if (error) {
      throw new Error(`Failed listing storage in bucket '${bucket}', prefix '${prefix}': ${error.message}`);
    }

    if (!data || data.length === 0) break;

    for (const item of data as StorageFile[]) {
      if (!item.name || item.name.startsWith('.')) continue;

      const fullItemPath = prefix ? `${prefix}/${item.name}` : item.name;

      if (item.id === null) {
        // Subdirectory - traverse recursively
        const subFiles = await listRecursive(bucket, fullItemPath);
        result.push(...subFiles);
      } else {
        const size = item.metadata?.size ?? 0;
        result.push({ path: fullItemPath, size });
      }
    }

    if (data.length < limit) break;
    offset += limit;
  }

  return result;
}

function sha256(buf: Buffer): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');
}

async function backup() {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
  const backupDir = path.resolve(__dirname, `../../backups/backup-${timestamp}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(backupDir, { recursive: true });

  const targetHost = new URL(supabaseUrl).hostname;
  console.log(`=======================================================`);
  console.log(`📦 GALLOTRACK DATABASE & STORAGE BACKUP`);
  console.log(`Destination: ${backupDir}`);
  console.log(`Target Supabase Host: ${targetHost}`);
  console.log(`Owner Scope: ${ownerArg ? ownerArg : 'ALL (Full Database Backup)'}`);
  console.log(`=======================================================\n`);

  // 1. Schema Discovery
  console.log('--- 1. Live Schema Discovery ---');
  const { activeTables, excludedItems } = await discoverSchema();
  console.log(`Discovered ${activeTables.length} active database tables to back up:`);
  console.log(`  ${activeTables.join(', ')}`);

  console.log(`\nExcluded Schema Objects (${excludedItems.length}):`);
  for (const ex of excludedItems) {
    console.log(`  • ${ex.name} [${ex.type}]: ${ex.reason}`);
  }

  // 2. Fetch and Export Tables
  console.log('\n--- 2. Exporting Database Tables ---');
  const dbBackup: Record<string, any[]> = {};
  const manifestTables: Record<string, ManifestTableEntry> = {};

  // For owner scope: pre-fetch owner's fowl IDs to correctly filter fowl_status_history
  let ownerFowlIds: number[] = [];
  if (ownerArg) {
    const { data: ownerFowls, error: fErr } = await supabase
      .from('fowl')
      .select('id')
      .eq('user_id', ownerArg);
    if (fErr) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch owner fowls for scope filtering: ${fErr.message}`);
    }
    ownerFowlIds = (ownerFowls || []).map((f) => f.id);
  }

  for (const table of activeTables) {
    try {
      // Build query and live count query based on scope
      let selectQuery = supabase.from(table).select('*');
      let countQuery = supabase.from(table).select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });

      if (ownerArg) {
        if (table === 'fowl') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'match') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'breeding_pairings') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'share_links') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'profiles') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'farms') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('owner_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('owner_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'fowl_status_history') {
          if (ownerFowlIds.length > 0) {
            selectQuery = selectQuery.in('fowl_id', ownerFowlIds);
            countQuery = countQuery.in('fowl_id', ownerFowlIds);
          } else {
            selectQuery = selectQuery.in('fowl_id', [-999999]);
            countQuery = countQuery.in('fowl_id', [-999999]);
          }
        } else if (
          [
            'registry_options',
            'user_settings',
            'safety_incidents',
            'fowl_identifier_counters',
            'match_photos',
            'match_videos',
            'fowl_photos',
          ].includes(table)
        ) {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('user_id', ownerArg);
        } else if (table === 'admin_audit_logs') {
          selectQuery = selectQuery.eq('admin_id', ownerArg);
          countQuery = countQuery.eq('admin_id', ownerArg);
        } else {
          // System reference tables without user_id (strains, leg_colors, system_settings)
          // In owner-scoped personal backup, these are omitted so personal backup has no cross-user/system data
          dbBackup[table] = [];
          manifestTables[table] = {
            rowCount: 0,
            liveCount: 0,
            status: 'verified',
            note: 'System reference table (omitted from owner-scoped backup)',
          };
          console.log(`  ✓ Table '${table}': 0 rows (system table skipped for owner-scoped backup)`);
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Fetch live count
      const { count: liveCount, error: countErr } = await countQuery;
      if (countErr) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to query live count for table '${table}': ${countErr.message}`);
      }
      const expectedCount = liveCount ?? 0;

      // Fetch actual rows
      const { data: rows, error: selectErr } = await selectQuery;
      if (selectErr) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to select rows from table '${table}': ${selectErr.message}`);
      }

      const rowCount = rows ? rows.length : 0;

      // Fail loudly if counts differ
      if (rowCount !== expectedCount) {
        throw new Error(
          `ROW COUNT MISMATCH for table '${table}': live count was ${expectedCount}, but exported ${rowCount} rows!`,
        );
      }

      dbBackup[table] = rows || [];
      manifestTables[table] = {
        rowCount,
        liveCount: expectedCount,
        status: 'verified',
      };

      console.log(`  ✓ Table '${table}': ${rowCount} rows (verified match against live count ${expectedCount})`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(`❌ Table '${table}' backup failed:`, err.message);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  // Save database.json
  const dbJsonPath = path.join(backupDir, 'database.json');
  fs.writeFileSync(dbJsonPath, JSON.stringify(dbBackup, null, 2), 'utf8');
  console.log(`  💾 Saved database.json (${(fs.statSync(dbJsonPath).size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`);

  // 3. Storage Bucket Files Download
  console.log('\n--- 3. Backing up Storage Buckets (Recursive) ---');
  const storageDir = path.join(backupDir, 'storage');
  fs.mkdirSync(storageDir, { recursive: true });

  const { data: bucketList, error: bListErr } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets();
  if (bListErr) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to list storage buckets: ${bListErr.message}`);
  }

  const allBucketNames = Array.from(
    new Set(['fowl-images', 'match-videos', 'match-photos', ...(bucketList ? bucketList.map((b) => b.name) : [])]),
  );

  const manifestStorage: Record<
    string,
    {
      fileCount: number;
      totalBytes: number;
      files: ManifestFileEntry[];
    }
  > = {};

  let totalFilesDownloaded = 0;
  let totalStorageBytesDownloaded = 0;

  for (const bucket of allBucketNames) {
    const bucketLocalDir = path.join(storageDir, bucket);
    fs.mkdirSync(bucketLocalDir, { recursive: true });

    let allObjects: { path: string; size: number }[] = [];
    try {
      allObjects = await listRecursive(bucket, '');
    } catch (listErr: any) {
      console.warn(`  ℹ️ Bucket '${bucket}': unable to list or empty (${listErr.message})`);
      manifestStorage[bucket] = { fileCount: 0, totalBytes: 0, files: [] };
      continue;
    }

    // Scope filtering for storage
    let filesToDownload = allObjects;
    if (ownerArg) {
      // In owner mode, only download files belonging to the owner
      // (paths starting with `${ownerArg}/` or matching URLs in owner's records)
      filesToDownload = allObjects.filter((f) => {
        if (f.path.startsWith(`${ownerArg}/`)) return true;
        if (f.path.startsWith(`profiles/${ownerArg}`)) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }

    console.log(
      `  ✓ Bucket '${bucket}': ${allObjects.length} total objects in bucket; downloading ${filesToDownload.length} object(s)...`,
    );

    const bucketFilesManifest: ManifestFileEntry[] = [];
    let bucketTotalBytes = 0;

    for (const file of filesToDownload) {
      try {
        const { data: fileBlob, error: dlErr } = await supabase.storage.from(bucket).download(file.path);
        if (dlErr || !fileBlob) {
          throw new Error(`Download error for ${bucket}/${file.path}: ${dlErr?.message || 'Empty response'}`);
        }

        const buffer = Buffer.from(await fileBlob.arrayBuffer());
        const checksum = sha256(buffer);

        const localFilePath = path.join(bucketLocalDir, file.path);
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(localFilePath), { recursive: true });
        fs.writeFileSync(localFilePath, buffer);

        bucketTotalBytes += buffer.length;
        totalStorageBytesDownloaded += buffer.length;
        totalFilesDownloaded++;

        bucketFilesManifest.push({
          path: file.path,
          size: buffer.length,
          sha256: checksum,
        });

        console.log(`    📥 Downloaded ${file.path} (${(buffer.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB, sha256: ${checksum.slice(0, 12)}...)`);
      } catch (dlException: any) {
        console.error(`❌ FAILED downloading object ${bucket}/${file.path}:`, dlException.message);
        throw dlException;
      }
    }

    manifestStorage[bucket] = {
      fileCount: bucketFilesManifest.length,
      totalBytes: bucketTotalBytes,
      files: bucketFilesManifest,
    };
  }

  // 4. Generate manifest.json
  const totalRows = Object.values(manifestTables).reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.rowCount, 0);
  const manifest: BackupManifest = {
    manifestVersion: '1.0',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    targetHost,
    ownerScope: ownerArg || null,
    tables: manifestTables,
    storage: manifestStorage,
    schemaAudit: {
      includedTables: activeTables,
      excludedItems,
    },
    summary: {
      totalTablesBackedUp: activeTables.length,
      totalRowsBackedUp: totalRows,
      totalFilesDownloaded,
      totalStorageBytesDownloaded,
    },
  };

  const manifestPath = path.join(backupDir, 'manifest.json');
  fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), 'utf8');

  // Also write legacy metadata.json for backward compatibility with older tools
  const metaPath = path.join(backupDir, 'metadata.json');
  fs.writeFileSync(
    metaPath,
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        timestamp: manifest.timestamp,
        targetUrlHost: targetHost,
        ownerScope: ownerArg || null,
        tableCounts: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(manifestTables).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.rowCount])),
        storageCounts: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(manifestStorage).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.fileCount])),
      },
      null,
      2,
    ),
    'utf8',
  );

  console.log(`\n=======================================================`);
  console.log(`✅ BACKUP COMPLETED AND VERIFIED`);
  console.log(`Manifest: ${manifestPath}`);
  console.log(`Summary:`);
  console.log(`  • Tables Backed Up: ${activeTables.length}`);
  console.log(`  • Total Rows: ${totalRows}`);
  console.log(`  • Files Downloaded: ${totalFilesDownloaded} (${(totalStorageBytesDownloaded / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB)`);
  console.log(`=======================================================\n`);
}

backup().catch((err) => {
  console.error('\n💥 FATAL BACKUP ERROR (terminating with code 1):', err.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

  });

import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve, extname } from 'node:path';

const root = execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();

const BINARY_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.webp', '.avif', '.bmp',
  '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.otf', '.eot',
  '.pdf', '.zip', '.gz', '.7z', '.rar', '.xlsx', '.xls', '.docx', '.doc',
  '.mp3', '.mp4', '.mov', '.webm', '.wav', '.ogg', '.bin', '.exe', '.dll', '.wasm',
]);

// Built from codepoints so this file never contains the mojibake it detects.
// The regexes match the cp1252 decoding of a UTF-8 lead byte plus a continuation
// byte (for example U+2014 em dash -> bytes E2 80 94), which is the corruption
// signature we have actually observed in this repository.
const MOJIBAKE_PATTERNS: Array<{ label: string; re: RegExp }> = [
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead E2 80', re: /\u00e2\u20ac/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead E2 9C', re: /\u00e2\u0153/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead E2 94', re: /\u00e2\u201d/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead E2 95', re: /\u00e2\u2022/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead E2 86', re: /\u00e2\u2020/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead C3 97', re: /\u00c3\u2014/ },
  { label: 'cp1252 mojibake lead C2 B7', re: /\u00c2\u00b7/ },
  { label: 'UTF-8 BOM rendered as text', re: /\u00ef\u00bb\u00bf/ },
  { label: 'Unicode replacement character U+FFFD', re: /\ufffd/ },
];

type Violation = { file: string; line: number; kind: string; detail: string };

function listTrackedFiles(): string[] {
  const out = execFileSync(
    'git',
    ['ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'],
    { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 },
  );
  return out.split('\0').filter(Boolean);
}

function checkFile(relPath: string): Violation[] {
  const violations: Violation[] = [];
  const absPath = resolve(root, relPath);
  const bytes = readFileSync(absPath);

  if (bytes.length >= 3 && bytes[0] === 0xef && bytes[1] === 0xbb && bytes[2] === 0xbf) {
    violations.push({ file: relPath, line: 1, kind: 'utf8-bom', detail: 'UTF-8 BOM at start of file' });
  }
  if (bytes.length >= 2 && ((bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xfe) || (bytes[0] === 0xfe && bytes[1] === 0xff))) {
    violations.push({ file: relPath, line: 1, kind: 'utf16-bom', detail: 'UTF-16 BOM detected; expected UTF-8' });
  }

  let text: string;
  try {
    text = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
  } catch {
    violations.push({ file: relPath, line: 1, kind: 'invalid-utf8', detail: 'File is not valid UTF-8' });
    return violations;
  }

  const crlf = (text.match(/\r\n/g) || []).length;
  const lfOnly = (text.match(/(?<!\r)\n/g) || []).length;
  const loneCr = (text.match(/\r(?!\n)/g) || []).length;
  if ((crlf > 0 && (lfOnly > 0 || loneCr > 0)) || loneCr > 0) {
    violations.push({
      file: relPath,
      line: 1,
      kind: 'mixed-line-endings',
      detail: `CRLF=${crlf}, LF=${lfOnly}, loneCR=${loneCr}`,
    });
  }

  const lines = text.split(/\r\n|\r|\n/);
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    for (const pattern of MOJIBAKE_PATTERNS) {
      if (pattern.re.test(lines[i])) {
        violations.push({
          file: relPath,
          line: i + 1,
          kind: 'mojibake',
          detail: `${pattern.label}: ${lines[i].trim().slice(0, 80)}`,
        });
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return violations;
}

const files = listTrackedFiles().filter((rel) => !BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(extname(rel).toLowerCase()));
const violations = files.flatMap(checkFile);

if (violations.length > 0) {
  console.error(`[check:encoding] ${violations.length} encoding issue(s) found:\n`);
  for (const v of violations) {
    console.error(`  ${v.file}:${v.line} [${v.kind}] ${v.detail}`);
  }
  process.exitCode = 1;
} else {
  console.log(`[check:encoding] Clean: ${files.length} files checked (UTF-8, no BOM/mojibake, consistent EOL).`);
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import type { FowlRecord } from '../lib/types';
import { findParentSexMismatches } from '../lib/parent-sex';

/**
 * REPORT-ONLY integrity check.
 *
 * Lists every registered child whose sire is not male or whose dam is not
 * female. It never updates, fixes or deletes a row.
 */
const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

if (!env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) {
  console.error(
    'Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in .env.local. ' +
      'The report needs the service-role key to read every farm; no data was changed.'
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabase = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

async function main() {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').select('*').order('id', { ascending: true });
  if (error || !data) {
    console.error('Could not load fowl rows:', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
    return;
  }

  const fowls = data as FowlRecord[];
  const farms = new Map<string, FowlRecord[]>();
  for (const fowl of fowls) {
    const key = String(fowl.user_id ?? 'unknown');
    const rows = farms.get(key) ?? [];
    rows.push(fowl);
    farms.set(key, rows);
  }

  console.log('Parent role/sex integrity report (report only - no fixes applied)');
  console.log(`Scanned ${fowls.length} chicken(s) across ${farms.size} farm account(s).`);

  let total = 0;
  for (const [farmId, rows] of farms) {
    const mismatches = findParentSexMismatches(rows);
    if (mismatches.length === 0) continue;

    total += mismatches.length;
    console.log(`\nFarm ${farmId}: ${mismatches.length} mismatch(es)`);
    for (const m of mismatches) {
      console.log(
        `  - Child #${m.childId} "${m.childName}": ${m.role} #${m.parentId} ` +
          `"${m.parentName}" is ${m.parentSex}, expected ${m.expectedSex}`
      );
    }
  }

  if (total === 0) {
    console.log('\nNo parent role/sex mismatches found.');
  } else {
    console.log(`\nTotal mismatches: ${total} (reported only).`);
  }
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

/**
 * check-secrets.ts — Local secrets guard.
 *
 * Scans the git working tree and git commit history for:
 * - Exposed Supabase service role keys
 * - JWT tokens (eyJ...)
 * - Committed .env or .env.local files
 * - Database URLs with passwords
 *
 * SAFETY RULE: Never prints full secret values. Reports only first 4 characters and length.
 */

import { execSync } from 'child_process';
import * as path from 'path';

const repoRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');

function runGit(args: string): string {
  try {
    return execSync(`git ${args}`, { cwd: repoRoot, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return '';
  }
}

interface SecretHit {
  type: string;
  file: string;
  commit?: string;
  prefix: string;
  length: number;
}

function scan(): { hits: SecretHit[]; clean: boolean } {
  const hits: SecretHit[] = [];

  // 1. Scan for committed .env files
  const envFiles = runGit('log --all --name-only --oneline -- "*.env*" "*env.local*"');
  for (const line of envFiles.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.endsWith('.env.example') || trimmed.includes(' ')) continue;
    if (trimmed.endsWith('.env') || trimmed.endsWith('.env.local') || trimmed.includes('.env.')) {
      hits.push({
        type: 'COMMITTED_ENV_FILE',
        file: trimmed,
        prefix: trimmed.slice(0, 4),
        length: trimmed.length,
      });
    }
  }

  // 2. Scan git history for JWT patterns (eyJ...)
  const jwtLog = runGit('log -p -G "eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}"');
  const jwtRegex = /\+.*?(eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/g;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((match = jwtRegex.exec(jwtLog)) !== null) {
    const token = match[1];
    hits.push({
      type: 'JWT',
      file: 'git-history',
      prefix: token.slice(0, 4),
      length: token.length,
    });
  }

  // 3. Scan git history for database URLs with passwords
  const dbUrlLog = runGit('log -p -G "postgres.*://.*:.*@"');
  const dbUrlRegex = /\+.*?(postgres(?:ql)?:\/\/([^:]+):([^@]+)@([^\s/'")]+))/g;
  while ((match = dbUrlRegex.exec(dbUrlLog)) !== null) {
    const user = match[2];
    const pw = match[3];
    // Exclude mock/placeholder localhost passwords
    if (user === 'username' && pw === 'password') continue;
    hits.push({
      type: 'DB_URL_WITH_PASSWORD',
      file: 'git-history',
      prefix: pw.slice(0, 4),
      length: pw.length,
    });
  }

  // 4. Scan working tree for hardcoded secrets
  const treeGrep = runGit('grep --untracked -iE "(service_role_key|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*[\'"`][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{20,}" -- ":!.env*" ":!scratch/*" ":!*check-secrets.ts"');
  if (treeGrep.trim()) {
    for (const line of treeGrep.split('\n')) {
      if (!line.trim() || line.includes('your-') || line.includes('placeholder')) continue;
      const parts = line.split(':');
      const file = parts[0];
      hits.push({
        type: 'EXPOSED_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY',
        file,
        prefix: 'key-',
        length: line.length,
      });
    }
  }

  // 5. Scan working tree for legacy credentials (flagged without printing values)
  const legacyStrings = [
    Buffer.from('Y2xpZW50QGdtYWlsLmNvbQ==', 'base64').toString(),
    Buffer.from('cGFzc3dvcmQxMjM=', 'base64').toString(),
  ];
  for (const cred of legacyStrings) {
    const res = runGit(`grep --untracked -F -l "${cred}" -- ":!.env*" ":!scratch/*" ":!*check-secrets.ts"`);
    if (res.trim()) {
      for (const file of res.trim().split('\n')) {
        if (!file.trim()) continue;
        hits.push({
          type: 'DISALLOWED_CREDENTIAL_STRING',
          file: file.trim(),
          prefix: 'cred-',
          length: cred.length,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return { hits, clean: hits.length === 0 };
}

console.log('[check:secrets] Running secret scan on repository...');
const { hits, clean } = scan();

if (!clean) {
  console.error(`\n❌ [check:secrets] Detected ${hits.length} potential secret(s):`);
  for (const hit of hits) {
    console.error(`  - Type: ${hit.type} | File: ${hit.file} | Prefix: ${hit.prefix}... | Length: ${hit.length}`);
  }
  process.exit(1);
} else {
  console.log('✔ [check:secrets] No exposed secrets, JWTs, or committed .env files found.');
  process.exit(0);
}

  const { data: crit } = await supabase
    .from('match')
    .select('entry_name, outcome, post_fight_condition, date, user_id')
    .ilike('post_fight_condition', '%Severely%')
    .order('date', { ascending: false });
  console.log('=== CRITICAL MATCHES ===');
  console.log(JSON.stringify(crit, null, 2));

  const sample = fowls?.[0];
  if (sample) {
    const { error: updErr } = await supabase
      .from('fowl')
      .update({ status: 'Sire Material', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', sample.id)
      .select();
    console.log('=== UPDATE with updated_at ===');
    console.log(updErr ? `FAILED: ${updErr.message}` : 'OK');
    if (!updErr) {
      await supabase.from('fowl').update({ status: 'Active' }).eq('id', sample.id);
      console.log('(reverted to Active)');
    }

    const { error: updErr2 } = await supabase
      .from('fowl')
      .update({ status: 'Sire Material' })
      .eq('id', sample.id)
      .select();
    console.log('=== UPDATE status only ===');
    console.log(updErr2 ? `FAILED: ${updErr2.message}` : 'OK');
    if (!updErr2) {
      await supabase.from('fowl').update({ status: sample.status }).eq('id', sample.id);
      console.log(`(reverted to ${sample.status})`);
    }
  }
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import { resolve } from 'path';

for (const envFile of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
  const p = resolve(__dirname, '..', envFile);
  if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
    for (const line of lines) {
      const match = line.match(/^\s*([\w.-]+)\s*=\s*(.*)?\s*$/);
      if (match && !process.env[match[1]]) {
        process.env[match[1]] = (match[2] || '').replace(/(^['"]|['"]$)/g, '');
      }
    }
  }
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {

import type { FowlRecord } from '../lib/types';

async function main() {
  console.log('=== GalloTrack Tab Membership Exclusivity Check ===\n');

  let fowls: FowlRecord[] = [];

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

  if (supabaseUrl && serviceKey) {
    const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').select('*').order('id', { ascending: true });
    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      fowls = data as FowlRecord[];
      console.log(`Fetched ${fowls.length} chickens from live database.`);
    }
  }

  // Fallback to dump if network/auth unavailable
  if (fowls.length === 0) {
    const dumpPath = resolve(__dirname, 'db-fowls-dump.json');
    if (fs.existsSync(dumpPath)) {
      fowls = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dumpPath, 'utf8'));
      console.log(`Loaded ${fowls.length} chickens from ${dumpPath}.`);
    } else {
      console.error('ERROR: No database connection and no db-fowls-dump.json found.');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }

  // Filter to primary test user or evaluate all active birds
  const primaryUserId = '9cc100d9-c855-41d3-a6a8-3c10fd65221c';
  const userFowls = fowls.filter((f) => !f.user_id || f.user_id === primaryUserId);

  console.log(`Evaluating user partition (${userFowls.length} chickens)...\n`);

  // Run exclusivity check
  try {
    const lists = registryTabLists(userFowls);
    assertTabExclusivity(lists.males, lists.females, lists.nonBreeding);

    const check = countRuleCheck(userFowls);
    console.log('Rule check results:');
    console.log(`- Active fowls: ${check.activeCount}`);
    console.log(`- Breeding Males: ${lists.males.length}`);
    console.log(`- Breeding Females: ${lists.females.length}`);
    console.log(`- Non-Breeding: ${lists.nonBreeding.length}`);
    console.log(`- Tab Sum: ${check.registryTabSum}`);
    console.log(`- Registry Rule OK: ${check.registryRuleOk}`);
    console.log(`- Overlapping IDs: ${check.overlappingChickenIds.length}`);

    if (!check.registryRuleOk || check.overlappingChickenIds.length > 0) {
      console.error('\nFAILURE: Tab exclusivity check failed! Overlap detected.');
      process.exit(1);
    }

    // Specific assertions required by prompt
    const maleIds = new Set(lists.males.map((f) => f.id));
    const femaleIds = new Set(lists.females.map((f) => f.id));
    const nbIds = new Set(lists.nonBreeding.map((f) => f.id));

    // Iron Lemon (ID 30)
    const ironLemon = userFowls.find((f) => f.name === 'Iron Lemon');
    if (ironLemon) {
      if (!maleIds.has(ironLemon.id) || femaleIds.has(ironLemon.id) || nbIds.has(ironLemon.id)) {
        console.error(`FAILURE: Iron Lemon is not in Breeding Male only! Found in: Male=${maleIds.has(ironLemon.id)}, Female=${femaleIds.has(ironLemon.id)}, NB=${nbIds.has(ironLemon.id)}`);
        process.exit(1);
      }
      console.log(`- Verified: Iron Lemon (${ironLemon.name}, id=${ironLemon.id}) is in Breeding Male ONLY.`);
    }

    // Lemon Storm (ID 42)
    const lemonStorm = userFowls.find((f) => f.name === 'Lemon Storm');
    if (lemonStorm) {
      if (!nbIds.has(lemonStorm.id) || maleIds.has(lemonStorm.id) || femaleIds.has(lemonStorm.id)) {
        console.error(`FAILURE: Lemon Storm is not in Non-Breeding only! Found in: Male=${maleIds.has(lemonStorm.id)}, Female=${femaleIds.has(lemonStorm.id)}, NB=${nbIds.has(lemonStorm.id)}`);
        process.exit(1);
      }
      console.log(`- Verified: Lemon Storm (${lemonStorm.name}, id=${lemonStorm.id}) is in Non-Breeding ONLY.`);
    }

    // Check for chickens with both breeder identifier and birth code
    const dualIdentBirds = userFowls.filter(
      (f) =>
        f.birth_code &&
        (f.chicken_code || f.bird_code) &&
        f.birth_code !== (f.chicken_code || f.bird_code),
    );
    console.log(`- Chickens with both breeder identifier and birth code: ${dualIdentBirds.length}`);
    dualIdentBirds.forEach((b) => {
      console.log(`  * [${b.id}] ${b.name}: breeder code=${b.chicken_code || b.bird_code}, birth code=${b.birth_code}`);
    });

    console.log('\nSUCCESS: All exclusivity constraints satisfied with 0 overlap!\n');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('\nFAILURE during exclusivity check:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});
