/**
 * CLONE ALL PER-USER DATA FROM ONE OWNER TO A TEST ACCOUNT
 *
 * Copies every per-user table from SRC_EMAIL to DST_EMAIL (creating the
 * target auth account with DST_PASSWORD if it does not exist yet).
 * The source account is never modified. Re-runs are safe: if the target
 * already owns data, the script reports state and exits without changes.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npx tsx scripts/clone-owner-to-test-user.ts            # real run
 *   npx tsx scripts/clone-owner-to-test-user.ts --dry-run  # plan only
 */
import { createClient, SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(ENV_PATH)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const SRC_EMAIL = process.env.CLONE_SRC_EMAIL || env.CLONE_SRC_EMAIL || process.env.SRC_EMAIL || env.SRC_EMAIL;
const DST_EMAIL = process.env.CLONE_DST_EMAIL || env.CLONE_DST_EMAIL || process.env.DST_EMAIL || env.DST_EMAIL;
const DST_PASSWORD = process.env.CLONE_DST_PASSWORD || env.CLONE_DST_PASSWORD || process.env.DST_PASSWORD || env.DST_PASSWORD;
const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');

if (!SRC_EMAIL || !DST_EMAIL || !DST_PASSWORD) {
  console.error('❌ Missing required environment variables: CLONE_SRC_EMAIL, CLONE_DST_EMAIL, CLONE_DST_PASSWORD. Set them in .env.local or environment.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
  console.error('❌ Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
  process.exit(1);
}

const db: SupabaseClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, {
  auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
});

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
type IdMap = Record<string, number>;

const fkMaps: Record<string, IdMap> = { fowl: {}, match: {}, breeding_pairings: {} };

const TABLE_PLAN: {
  table: string;
  ownerCol: 'user_id' | 'owner_id' | null;
  orderCol?: string;
  remap?: Record<string, keyof typeof fkMaps>;
  shareLink?: boolean;
  changedBy?: boolean;
}[] = [
  { table: 'farms', ownerCol: 'owner_id' },
  { table: 'match', ownerCol: 'user_id', remap: { fowl_id: 'fowl', opponent_id: 'fowl' } },
  { table: 'fowl_photos', ownerCol: 'user_id', remap: { fowl_id: 'fowl' } },
  { table: 'match_photos', ownerCol: 'user_id', remap: { match_id: 'match' } },
  { table: 'match_videos', ownerCol: 'user_id', remap: { match_id: 'match' } },
  { table: 'safety_incidents', ownerCol: 'user_id', remap: { fowl_id: 'fowl' } },
  { table: 'registry_options', ownerCol: 'user_id' },
  { table: 'share_links', ownerCol: 'user_id', shareLink: true },
  { table: 'user_settings', ownerCol: 'user_id', orderCol: 'key' },
  { table: 'fowl_identifier_counters', ownerCol: 'user_id', orderCol: 'counter_type' },
];

function fail(where: string, message: string): never {
  console.error(`❌ ${where}: ${message}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

async function listUsers() {
  const { data, error } = await db.auth.admin.listUsers({ page: 1, perPage: 500 });
  if (error) fail('auth.admin.listUsers', error.message);
  return data?.users ?? [];
}

async function headCount(table: string, col: string, value: string): Promise<number> {
  const { count, error } = await db
    .from(table)
    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq(col, value);
  return error ? -1 : (count ?? 0);
}

async function headCountIn(table: string, col: string, values: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (!values.length) return 0;
  const { count, error } = await db
    .from(table)
    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .in(col, values);
  return error ? -1 : (count ?? 0);
}

async function fetchAll(table: string, col: string, value: string, orderCol = 'id'): Promise<Row[]> {
  const { data, error } = await db.from(table).select('*').eq(col, value).order(orderCol as never);
  if (error) fail(table, error.message);
  return (data ?? []) as Row[];
}

async function insertRow(table: string, payload: Row): Promise<Row> {
  if (DRY_RUN) return { id: -1 };
  const { data, error } = await db.from(table).insert(payload).select('*').single();
  if (error) fail(table, error.message);
  return data as Row;
}

async function patchRow(table: string, id: unknown, payload: Row): Promise<void> {
  if (DRY_RUN) return;
  const { error } = await db.from(table).update(payload).eq('id', id as never);
  if (error) fail(table, `patch #${String(id)}: ${error.message}`);
}

function buildPayload(row: Row, ownerCol: string | null, dstId: string, extra: Row = {}): Row {
  const payload: Row = { ...row };
  delete payload.id;
  if (ownerCol) payload[ownerCol] = dstId;
  return { ...payload, ...extra };
}

async function positionalMap(table: string, ownerCol: string, srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const srcRows = await fetchAll(table, ownerCol, srcId);
  const dstRows = await fetchAll(table, ownerCol, dstId);
  if (srcRows.length !== dstRows.length || srcRows.length === 0) {
    console.log(
      `• ${table}: target already has ${dstRows.length} row(s) vs source ${srcRows.length} -> skipped, but ids cannot be remapped`,
    );
    return false;
  }
  srcRows.forEach((row, i) => {
    fkMaps[table][String(row.id)] = Number(dstRows[i].id);
  });
  console.log(`• ${table}: target already has ${dstRows.length} row(s) -> skipped (ids remapped)`);
  return true;
}

async function allCounts(userId: string, fowlIds: string[]): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const out: Record<string, number> = { profiles: await headCount('profiles', 'id', userId) };
  for (const plan of TABLE_PLAN) {
    out[plan.table] = await headCount(plan.table, plan.ownerCol as string, userId);
  }
  out.fowl = await headCount('fowl', 'user_id', userId);
  out.breeding_pairings = await headCount('breeding_pairings', 'user_id', userId);
  out.fowl_status_history = await headCountIn('fowl_status_history', 'fowl_id', fowlIds);
  return out;
}

async function fowlIdList(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const { data, error } = await db.from('fowl').select('id').eq('user_id', userId);
  if (error) fail('fowl', error.message);
  return (data ?? []).map((r) => String((r as { id: unknown }).id));
}

async function ensureTargetAccount(): Promise<string> {
  const users = await listUsers();
  const existing = users.find((u) => u.email?.toLowerCase() === DST_EMAIL.toLowerCase());

  if (existing) {
    console.log(`• Account ${DST_EMAIL} already exists (${existing.id})`);
    if (DRY_RUN) return existing.id;
    const { error } = await db.auth.admin.updateUserById(existing.id, {
      password: DST_PASSWORD,
      email_confirm: true,
    });
    if (error) fail('auth.admin.updateUserById', error.message);
    console.log('  → password reset to the default, email confirmed');
    return existing.id;
  }

  console.log(`• Creating account ${DST_EMAIL} (password: ${DST_PASSWORD}, auto-confirmed)`);
  if (DRY_RUN) return '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
  const { data, error } = await db.auth.admin.createUser({
    email: DST_EMAIL,
    password: DST_PASSWORD,
    email_confirm: true,
  });
  if (error) fail('auth.admin.createUser', error.message);
  return data.user.id;
}

async function copyProfile(srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<void> {
  const rows = await fetchAll('profiles', 'id', srcId);
  if (!rows.length) {
    console.log('• profiles: source has no row -> skipped');
    return;
  }
  const src = rows[0];
  const identity: Row = {
    full_name: src.full_name,
    avatar_url: src.avatar_url,
    phone_number: src.phone_number,
    farm_name: src.farm_name,
    email: DST_EMAIL,
    role: 'owner',
    is_admin: false,
    is_active: true,
    is_verified: false,
    account_status: 'active',
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  const existing = await headCount('profiles', 'id', dstId);
  if (existing > 0) {
    if (DRY_RUN) {
      console.log('• profiles: target already has a row -> will update identity fields');
      return;
    }
    const { error } = await db.from('profiles').update(identity).eq('id', dstId);
    if (error) fail('profiles', error.message);
    console.log('• profiles: existing row updated (name/farm/phone cloned from source)');
  } else {
    await insertRow('profiles', { ...src, ...identity, id: dstId, created_at: src.created_at });
    console.log('• profiles: cloned');
  }
}

async function copyFowl(srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<Row[]> {
  const rows = await fetchAll('fowl', 'user_id', srcId);
  const dstN = await headCount('fowl', 'user_id', dstId);
  if (dstN > 0) {
    await positionalMap('fowl', 'user_id', srcId, dstId);
    return rows;
  }
  console.log(`• fowl: ${rows.length} row(s)`);

  for (const row of rows) {
    const created = await insertRow(
      'fowl',
      buildPayload(row, 'user_id', dstId, { sire_id: null, dam_id: null, pairing_id: null }),
    );
    fkMaps.fowl[String(row.id)] = Number(created.id);
  }

  let relinked = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const sire = row.sire_id != null ? fkMaps.fowl[String(row.sire_id)] ?? null : null;
    const dam = row.dam_id != null ? fkMaps.fowl[String(row.dam_id)] ?? null : null;
    if (sire == null && dam == null) continue;
    await patchRow('fowl', fkMaps.fowl[String(row.id)], { sire_id: sire, dam_id: dam });
    relinked += 1;
  }
  if (relinked) console.log(`  → parent links (sire_id/dam_id) restored on ${relinked} row(s)`);
  return rows;
}

async function copyPairings(srcFowl: Row[], srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<void> {
  const rows = await fetchAll('breeding_pairings', 'user_id', srcId);
  const dstN = await headCount('breeding_pairings', 'user_id', dstId);
  if (dstN > 0) {
    await positionalMap('breeding_pairings', 'user_id', srcId, dstId);
  } else {
    console.log(`• breeding_pairings: ${rows.length} row(s)`);

    for (const row of rows) {
      const created = await insertRow(
        'breeding_pairings',
        buildPayload(row, 'user_id', dstId, {
          sire_id: row.sire_id != null ? fkMaps.fowl[String(row.sire_id)] ?? null : null,
          dam_id: row.dam_id != null ? fkMaps.fowl[String(row.dam_id)] ?? null : null,
          offspring_seq: 0,
        }),
      );
      fkMaps.breeding_pairings[String(row.id)] = Number(created.id);
    }
  }

  const dstFowl = await fetchAll('fowl', 'user_id', dstId);
  let linked = 0;
  let drift = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const children = srcFowl.filter((f) => String(f.pairing_id) === String(row.id)).length;
    if (children !== Number(row.offspring_seq ?? 0)) drift += 1;
  }
  for (const row of dstFowl) {
    const srcPairing = srcFowl.find((f) => fkMaps.fowl[String(f.id)] === Number(row.id))?.pairing_id;
    if (srcPairing == null) continue;
    const target = fkMaps.breeding_pairings[String(srcPairing)];
    if (target == null || Number(row.pairing_id) === target) continue;
    await patchRow('fowl', row.id, { pairing_id: target });
    linked += 1;
  }
  if (linked) console.log(`  → pairing_id linked on ${linked} fowl row(s) (offspring_seq recounted by trigger)`);
  if (drift) console.log(`  ⚠️ ${drift} pairing(s) where the source offspring_seq disagreed with the real child count`);
}

async function copyStatusHistory(srcFowlIds: string[], srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!srcFowlIds.length) {
    console.log('• fowl_status_history: 0 row(s)');
    return;
  }
  const dstFowlIds = await fowlIdList(dstId);
  if ((await headCountIn('fowl_status_history', 'fowl_id', dstFowlIds)) > 0) {
    console.log('• fowl_status_history: target already has rows -> skipped');
    return;
  }
  const { data, error } = await db
    .from('fowl_status_history')
    .select('*')
    .in('fowl_id', srcFowlIds)
    .order('id');
  if (error) fail('fowl_status_history', error.message);
  const rows = (data ?? []) as Row[];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const mappedFowl = fkMaps.fowl[String(row.fowl_id)];
    if (mappedFowl == null) {
      console.log(`  ⚠️ fowl_status_history #${String(row.id)}: fowl_id not cloned -> skipped`);
      continue;
    }
    const extra: Row = { fowl_id: mappedFowl };
    if (row.changed_by != null) extra.changed_by = String(row.changed_by) === srcId ? dstId : row.changed_by;
    await insertRow('fowl_status_history', buildPayload(row, null, dstId, extra));
  }
  console.log(`• fowl_status_history: ${rows.length} row(s)`);
}

async function copyTable(plan: (typeof TABLE_PLAN)[number], srcId: string, dstId: string): Promise<void> {
  const rows = await fetchAll(plan.table, plan.ownerCol as string, srcId, plan.orderCol ?? 'id');
  const dstN = await headCount(plan.table, plan.ownerCol as string, dstId);
  if (dstN > 0) {
    if (fkMaps[plan.table]) await positionalMap(plan.table, plan.ownerCol as string, srcId, dstId);
    else console.log(`• ${plan.table}: target already has ${dstN} row(s) -> skipped`);
    return;
  }
  if (!rows.length) {
    console.log(`• ${plan.table}: 0 row(s)`);
    return;
  }

  for (const row of rows) {
    const extra: Row = {};
    for (const [col, mapName] of Object.entries(plan.remap ?? {})) {
      const value = row[col];
      if (value == null) continue;
      const mapped = fkMaps[mapName][String(value)];
      if (mapped == null) {
        console.log(`  ⚠️ ${plan.table} #${String(row.id)}: ${col}=${String(value)} has no clone -> NULL`);
        extra[col] = null;
      } else {
        extra[col] = mapped;
      }
    }
    if (plan.shareLink) {
      const mapName = String(row.entity_type);
      const mapped = fkMaps[mapName]?.[String(row.entity_id)];
      if (mapped != null) extra.entity_id = mapped;
      else console.log(`  ⚠️ share_links #${String(row.id)}: entity ${mapName}#${String(row.entity_id)} not cloned -> kept as-is`);
      extra.token = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    }

    const created = await insertRow(plan.table, buildPayload(row, plan.ownerCol, dstId, extra));
    if (fkMaps[plan.table]) fkMaps[plan.table][String(row.id)] = Number(created.id);
  }
  console.log(`• ${plan.table}: ${rows.length} row(s)`);
}

async function main() {
  console.log('=======================================================');
  console.log(`GALLOTRACK OWNER CLONE${DRY_RUN ? ' (DRY RUN)' : ''}`);
  console.log(`source: ${SRC_EMAIL}`);
  console.log(`target: ${DST_EMAIL} (password: ${DRY_RUN ? '(unchanged)' : DST_PASSWORD})`);
  console.log('=======================================================\n');

  const users = await listUsers();
  const src = users.find((u) => u.email?.toLowerCase() === SRC_EMAIL.toLowerCase());
  if (!src) fail('lookup', `source user not found: ${SRC_EMAIL}`);
  const srcId = src.id;
  console.log(`source uuid: ${srcId}`);

  const srcFowlIds = await fowlIdList(srcId);
  const srcCounts = await allCounts(srcId, srcFowlIds);
  console.log('source row counts:', JSON.stringify(srcCounts), '\n');

  const dstId = await ensureTargetAccount();

  await copyProfile(srcId, dstId);
  const srcFowl = await copyFowl(srcId, dstId);
  await copyPairings(srcFowl, srcId, dstId);
  for (const plan of TABLE_PLAN) await copyTable(plan, srcId, dstId);
  await copyStatusHistory(srcFowlIds, srcId, dstId);

  if (DRY_RUN) {
    console.log('\nDRY RUN complete - no rows were written.');
    return;
  }

  const finalSrc = await allCounts(srcId, srcFowlIds);
  const finalDst = await allCounts(dstId, await fowlIdList(dstId));
  console.log('\n================ CLONE RESULT ================');
  console.log('table'.padEnd(28) + 'source'.padStart(8) + 'target'.padStart(8));
  for (const table of Object.keys(finalSrc)) {
    console.log(table.padEnd(28) + String(finalSrc[table]).padStart(8) + String(finalDst[table]).padStart(8));
  }
  const profile = await db
    .from('profiles')
    .select('full_name, farm_name, role, is_admin, is_active, email')
    .eq('id', dstId)
    .single();
  if (profile.data) console.log('target profile:', JSON.stringify(profile.data));
  console.log('source rows are UNCHANGED (copy, not move).');
  console.log('==============================================');
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Fatal:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * ROW COUNT COMPARISON UTILITY
 * Compares table row counts between a backup snapshot and a target Supabase database.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npx tsx scripts/compare-row-counts.ts [--backup=<folder_name>] [--target=staging|production]
 */

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(ENV_PATH)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const getArg = (name: string) => {
  const match = args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`));
  return match ? match.slice(name.length + 3) : null;
};

const backupFolderArg = getArg('backup');
const targetEnv = getArg('target') || 'production';

async function compare() {
  console.log(`=======================================================`);
  console.log(`📊 ROW COUNT COMPARISON AUDIT`);
  console.log(`=======================================================\n`);

  const backupsParentDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../backups');
  let selectedBackupDir: string | null = null;

  if (backupFolderArg) {
    selectedBackupDir = path.isAbsolute(backupFolderArg)
      ? backupFolderArg
      : path.join(backupsParentDir, backupFolderArg);
  } else if (fs.existsSync(backupsParentDir)) {
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(backupsParentDir).filter((d) => d.startsWith('backup-')).sort().reverse();
    if (entries.length > 0) {
      selectedBackupDir = path.join(backupsParentDir, entries[0]);
    }
  }

  let sourceCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  if (selectedBackupDir && fs.existsSync(path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'database.json'))) {
    console.log(`Source Backup: ${path.basename(selectedBackupDir)}`);
    const dbData: Record<string, any[]> = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'database.json'), 'utf8'));
    for (const [table, rows] of Object.entries(dbData)) {
      sourceCounts[table] = rows.length;
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`Source: Live Production Database`);
  }

  let targetUrl = '';
  let targetKey = '';

  if (targetEnv === 'staging') {
    targetUrl = process.env.STAGING_SUPABASE_URL || env.STAGING_SUPABASE_URL;
    targetKey = process.env.STAGING_SUPABASE_KEY || env.STAGING_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  } else {
    targetUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    targetKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  }

  if (!targetUrl || !targetKey) {
    console.error(`❌ Error: Could not determine credentials for target environment '${targetEnv}'`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`Target Database: ${targetEnv.toUpperCase()} (${new URL(targetUrl).hostname})\n`);

  const supabase = createClient(targetUrl, targetKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });

  const TABLES = [
    'fowl',
    'match',
    'profiles',
    'farms',
    'strains',
    'leg_colors',
    'breeding_pairings',
    // 'marketplace_listings', // DEPRECATED — removed from active tables
    'admin_audit_logs',
    'share_links',
    'system_settings',
  ];

  console.log(`+-----------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+`);
  console.log(`| Table Name            | Backup Count  | Target Count  | Status        |`);
  console.log(`+-----------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+`);

  let allMatch = true;

  for (const table of TABLES) {
    const srcCount = sourceCounts[table] ?? 0;
    const { count: tgtCount, error } = await supabase.from(table).select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true });
    
    const targetCountVal = error ? -1 : (tgtCount ?? 0);
    const statusStr = error
      ? 'ERROR'
      : srcCount === targetCountVal
      ? '✓ MATCH'
      : '⚠️ MISMATCH';

    if (srcCount !== targetCountVal && !error) allMatch = false;

    const padName = table.padEnd(21);
    const padSrc = String(srcCount).padStart(13);
    const padTgt = String(targetCountVal >= 0 ? targetCountVal : 'ERR').padStart(13);
    const padStatus = statusStr.padEnd(13);

    console.log(`| ${padName} | ${padSrc} | ${padTgt} | ${padStatus} |`);
  }

  console.log(`+-----------------------+---------------+---------------+---------------+`);

  if (allMatch) {
    console.log(`\n✅ All table row counts match perfectly!`);
  } else {
    console.log(`\n⚠️ Mismatches found between backup snapshot and target database.`);
  }
}

compare().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Fatal compare error:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

/** Debug helper: dump rendered text of key pages for needle selection. */
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { existsSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

function findCachedChromium(): string | null {
  const cache = join(process.env.USERPROFILE ?? process.env.HOME ?? '', 'AppData', 'Local', 'ms-playwright');
  if (!existsSync(cache)) return null;
  for (const entry of readdirSync(cache)) {
    if (!entry.startsWith('chromium')) continue;
    const dir = join(cache, entry);
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const sub of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = join(dir, sub);
      if (!statSync(full).isDirectory()) continue;
      const exe = ['headless_shell.exe', 'chrome.exe'].map((n) => join(full, n))
        .concat([join(full, 'chrome-win', 'chrome.exe'), join(full, 'chrome-win64', 'chrome.exe')])
        .find((p) => existsSync(p));
      if (exe) return exe;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function launch() {
  try { return await chromium.launch(); }
  catch {
    const cached = findCachedChromium();
    if (!cached) throw new Error('no chromium');
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: cached });
  }
}

async function main() {
  const envPath = join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  const env: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (existsSync(envPath)) {
    const { readFileSync } = await import('node:fs');
    for (const line of readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
      const i = line.indexOf('=');
      env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
    }
  }

  const email = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL || env.SMOKE_EMAIL;
  const password = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || env.SMOKE_PASSWORD;
  if (!email || !password) {
    console.error('❌ Missing SMOKE_EMAIL or SMOKE_PASSWORD. Set them in .env.local or environment.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const browser = await launch();
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.waitForSelector('#email-address', { timeout: 30000 });
  await page.fill('#email-address', email);
  await page.fill('#password', password);
  await page.click('button[type=submit]');
  await page.waitForURL(/dashboard/, { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
  await page.waitForTimeout(4000);

  for (const path of ['/dashboard', '/breeding']) {
    await page.goto('http://localhost:3000' + path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
    await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
    const text = await page.locator('main, body').first().innerText().catch(() => '');
    console.log('==== ' + path + ' ==== (' + text.length + ' chars)');
    console.log(text.slice(0, 3500));
    console.log('...');
  }
  await browser.close();
}
main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const envPath = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const supabase = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

const REQUIRED = [
  { id: 'fowl-images', public: true },
  { id: 'match-videos', public: true },
];

async function main() {
  const { data: buckets, error: listErr } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets();
  if (listErr) {
    console.error('listBuckets failed:', listErr.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('Existing buckets:', buckets?.map(b => b.name).join(', ') || '(none)');

  for (const b of REQUIRED) {
    const exists = buckets?.some(x => x.name === b.id);
    if (exists) {
      console.log(`OK (exists): ${b.id}`);
      continue;
    }
    const { error } = await supabase.storage.createBucket(b.id, { public: b.public });
    if (error) console.error(`FAILED create ${b.id}:`, error.message);
    else console.log(`CREATED: ${b.id} (public=${b.public})`);
  }

  const { data: after } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets();
  console.log('Buckets now:', after?.map(b => b.name).join(', ') || '(none)');
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

/**
 * scripts/fixtures/stress-dataset.ts
 *
 * Comprehensive stress dataset designed for mobile overflow testing:
 * - 40 chickens with long multi-word names, long wing bands, 50+ character notes,
 *   multi-line bloodline compositions, and complex crossbred badges.
 * - 10 match records with long opponent names, event titles, and fight notes.
 * - 8 breeding pairings connecting sires and dams with pairing codes and notes.
 *
 * Used by audit-mobile-overflow.ts via Playwright route interception.
 * Never writes to any database.
 */

import type { FowlRecord, MatchRecord, BreedingPairRecord } from '../../lib/types';

export const STRESS_FOWLS: FowlRecord[] = [
  // ── Sires (Breeding Males) ──

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import { offspringBase } from '../lib/bird-code';

const ENV_PATH = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const admin = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

function numberToLetter(n: number): string {
  let value = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(n) || 1));
  let out = '';
  while (value > 0) {
    value -= 1;
    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + (value % 26)) + out;
    value = Math.floor(value / 26);
  }
  return out;
}

// Dams sequence: A, B, C... W, Y, Z, AA... (skipping single 'X' reserved for unknown dam)
function getDamLetter(index: number): string {
  let count = 0;
  for (let n = 1; n < 100000; n++) {
    const l = numberToLetter(n);
    if (l === 'X') continue; // skip single X
    count++;
    if (count === index) return l;
  }
  return 'A';
}

async function main() {
  const { data: rows, error } = await admin
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, user_id, name, gender, status, sire, dam, bird_code, wing_band, created_at')
    .order('id');
  if (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching fowls:', error.message);
    return;
  }

  // Group by user_id
  const byUser = new Map<string, typeof rows>();
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (!byUser.has(r.user_id)) byUser.set(r.user_id, []);
    byUser.get(r.user_id)!.push(r);
  }

  for (const [userId, fowls] of byUser.entries()) {
    console.log(`\n======================================================`);
    console.log(`USER: ${userId} (${fowls.length} chickens)`);
    console.log(`======================================================`);

    const byName = new Map<string, typeof fowls[0]>();
    for (const f of fowls) {
      const k = (f.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (k) byName.set(k, f);
    }

    // 1. Separate Founders vs Offspring
    // Founder: sire & dam are 'Foundation Stock' or empty or missing
    // Offspring: has recorded sire or dam (or both)
    const siresFounders: typeof fowls = [];
    const damsFounders: typeof fowls = [];
    const offspring: typeof fowls = [];
    const flaggedMissingParents: Array<{ fowl: typeof fowls[0]; reason: string }> = [];

    for (const f of fowls) {
      const s = (f.sire || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const d = (f.dam || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const isSireFounder = !s || s === 'foundation stock';
      const isDamFounder = !d || d === 'foundation stock';

      if (isSireFounder && isDamFounder) {
        if (f.gender === 'Hen' || f.gender === 'Female') {
          damsFounders.push(f);
        } else {
          siresFounders.push(f);
        }
      } else {
        // Offspring
        offspring.push(f);
        // Check if sire or dam named doesn't exist in registry
        const sireExists = s && s !== 'foundation stock' && byName.has(s);
        const damExists = d && d !== 'foundation stock' && byName.has(d);
        if ((s && s !== 'foundation stock' && !sireExists) || (d && d !== 'foundation stock' && !damExists)) {
          flaggedMissingParents.push({
            fowl: f,
            reason: `Named parent not found in registry (Sire: "${f.sire}", Dam: "${f.dam}")`
          });
        } else if (isSireFounder || isDamFounder) {
          flaggedMissingParents.push({
            fowl: f,
            reason: `One parent is unknown / foundation stock (Sire: "${f.sire}", Dam: "${f.dam}")`
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Assign founder codes
    const assignedCodes = new Map<number, string>();
    siresFounders.forEach((f, idx) => {
      assignedCodes.set(f.id, String(idx + 1));
    });

    damsFounders.forEach((f, idx) => {
      assignedCodes.set(f.id, getDamLetter(idx + 1));
    });

    // Assign offspring codes
    // Pair map: pairKey -> count
    const pairCounters = new Map<string, number>();

    for (const f of offspring) {
      const s = (f.sire || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const d = (f.dam || '').trim().toLowerCase();

      const sireBird = s && s !== 'foundation stock' ? byName.get(s) : null;
      const damBird = d && d !== 'foundation stock' ? byName.get(d) : null;

      const sireCode = sireBird ? assignedCodes.get(sireBird.id) || '0' : '0';
      const damCode = damBird ? assignedCodes.get(damBird.id) || 'X' : 'X';

      const pairKey = offspringBase(sireCode, damCode);
      const nextSeq = (pairCounters.get(pairKey) || 0) + 1;
      pairCounters.set(pairKey, nextSeq);

      const code = `${pairKey}${nextSeq}`;
      assignedCodes.set(f.id, code);
    }

    console.log(`\nPROPOSED CODES PREVIEW:`);
    console.log(`-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------`);
    console.log(`ID | Chicken Name                | Gender  | Current Code | Proposed Code | Parents`);
    console.log(`-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------`);
    for (const f of fowls) {
      const proposed = assignedCodes.get(f.id);
      const isFlagged = flaggedMissingParents.some(p => p.fowl.id === f.id);
      const flagMark = isFlagged ? '⚠️ ' : '  ';
      console.log(
        `${String(f.id).padEnd(4)} | ${flagMark}${f.name.padEnd(25)} | ${(f.gender || '').padEnd(7)} | ${(f.bird_code || '—').padEnd(12)} | ${(proposed || '—').padEnd(13)} | Sire: ${f.sire || 'None'}, Dam: ${f.dam || 'None'}`
      );
    }

    if (flaggedMissingParents.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\n⚠️  FLAGGED RECORDS NEEDING ATTENTION (${flaggedMissingParents.length}):`);
      for (const item of flaggedMissingParents) {
        console.log(` - [ID ${item.fowl.id}] ${item.fowl.name}: ${item.reason} -> Proposed Code: ${assignedCodes.get(item.fowl.id)}`);
      }
    }
  }
}

main();

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const supabase = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

import { isFemaleCode, numberToLetter, UNKNOWN_DAM_CODE, UNKNOWN_SIRE_CODE, offspringBase } from '../lib/bird-code';
import { isKnownParent } from '../lib/family-tree';
import { roleOf, buildRegistryContext } from '../lib/registry-roles';
import type { FowlRecord } from '../lib/types';

function getDamLetter(index: number): string {
  let count = 0;
  for (let n = 1; n < 100000; n++) {
    const l = numberToLetter(n);
    if (l === UNKNOWN_DAM_CODE) continue; // skip 'X'
    count++;
    if (count === index) return l;
  }
  return 'A';
}

async function main() {
  const { data: fowls, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').select('*').order('id', { ascending: true });
  if (error || !fowls) {
    console.error('Error:', error);
    return;
  }

  const userIds = Array.from(new Set(fowls.map(f => f.user_id)));

  for (const uid of userIds) {
    const userFowls = fowls.filter(f => f.user_id === uid);
    if (userFowls.length === 0) continue;

    console.log(`\n========================================================================================`);
    console.log(`USER: ${uid} (Total chickens: ${userFowls.length})`);
    console.log(`========================================================================================`);

    const ctx = buildRegistryContext(userFowls);
    const byName = new Map<string, FowlRecord>();
    userFowls.forEach(f => {
      const k = (f.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (k && !byName.has(k)) byName.set(k, f);
    });

    // Sires and Dams in registration order (created_at ascending, then id ascending)
    const siresList = userFowls
      .filter(f => {
        const r = roleOf(f, ctx);
        return r === 'Breeding Male' || (!isKnownParent(f.sire) && !isKnownParent(f.dam) && !isFemaleCode(f.gender));
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (a.created_at || '').localeCompare(b.created_at || '') || a.id - b.id);

    const damsList = userFowls
      .filter(f => {
        const r = roleOf(f, ctx);
        return r === 'Breeding Female' || (!isKnownParent(f.sire) && !isKnownParent(f.dam) && isFemaleCode(f.gender));
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (a.created_at || '').localeCompare(b.created_at || '') || a.id - b.id);

    const proposedSireCodes = new Map<number, string>();
    siresList.forEach((f, idx) => {
      proposedSireCodes.set(f.id, String(idx + 1));
    });

    const proposedDamCodes = new Map<number, string>();
    damsList.forEach((f, idx) => {
      proposedDamCodes.set(f.id, getDamLetter(idx + 1));
    });

    console.log('\n--- SIRES (Breeding Males / Founder Roosters) ---');
    siresList.forEach(s => {
      console.log(`ID ${s.id} | ${s.name.padEnd(20)} | Current: ${(s.bird_code || '—').padEnd(4)} | Proposed: ${proposedSireCodes.get(s.id)} | Registered: ${s.created_at}`);
    });

    console.log('\n--- DAMS (Breeding Females / Founder Hens) ---');
    damsList.forEach(d => {
      console.log(`ID ${d.id} | ${d.name.padEnd(20)} | Current: ${(d.bird_code || '—').padEnd(4)} | Proposed: ${proposedDamCodes.get(d.id)} | Registered: ${d.created_at}`);
    });

    // Offspring (has known sire or dam)
    const offspringList = userFowls.filter(f => isKnownParent(f.sire) || isKnownParent(f.dam));

    // Sort offspring by: Pair, then Birth date ascending (oldest first), then created_at, then name
    // First determine pair prefix for each offspring
    const offspringWithPair = offspringList.map(f => {
      const sName = (f.sire || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const dName = (f.dam || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const sireFowl = sName && sName !== 'foundation stock' ? byName.get(sName) : null;
      const damFowl = dName && dName !== 'foundation stock' ? byName.get(dName) : null;

      const sireCode = sireFowl ? proposedSireCodes.get(sireFowl.id) || '0' : '0';
      const damCode = damFowl ? proposedDamCodes.get(damFowl.id) || 'X' : 'X';
      const pairPrefix = `${sireCode}${damCode}`;

      return {
        fowl: f,
        sireFowl,
        damFowl,
        sireCode,
        damCode,
        pairPrefix,
      };
    });

    // Group by pairPrefix
    const pairGroups = new Map<string, typeof offspringWithPair>();
    offspringWithPair.forEach(item => {
      if (!pairGroups.has(item.pairPrefix)) pairGroups.set(item.pairPrefix, []);
      pairGroups.get(item.pairPrefix)!.push(item);
    });

    const proposedOffspringCodes = new Map<number, string>();
    const flaggedRecords: Array<{ fowl: FowlRecord; reason: string }> = [];

    pairGroups.forEach((items, pairPrefix) => {
      // Sort inside pair by: birthdate (oldest = 1), created_at, name
      items.sort((a, b) => {
        const bDateA = a.fowl.birthdate || '';
        const bDateB = b.fowl.birthdate || '';
        if (bDateA && bDateB && bDateA !== bDateB) return bDateA.localeCompare(bDateB);
        if (bDateA && !bDateB) return -1;
        if (!bDateA && bDateB) return 1;

        const regA = a.fowl.created_at || '';
        const regB = b.fowl.created_at || '';
        if (regA !== regB) return regA.localeCompare(regB);

        return a.fowl.name.localeCompare(b.fowl.name);
      });

      items.forEach((item, seq) => {
        const seqNumber = seq + 1;
        const code = `${pairPrefix}${seqNumber}`;
        proposedOffspringCodes.set(item.fowl.id, code);

        if (!item.sireFowl || !item.damFowl) {
          flaggedRecords.push({
            fowl: item.fowl,
            reason: `Incomplete parents (Sire: "${item.fowl.sire}", Dam: "${item.fowl.dam}")`,
          });
        }
        if (!item.fowl.birthdate) {
          flaggedRecords.push({
            fowl: item.fowl,
            reason: `Missing birth date`,
          });
        }
      });
    });

    console.log('\n--- PROPOSED OFFSPRING CODES PREVIEW ---');
    console.log('ID   | Name                     | Gender  | Sire (Code)         | Dam (Code)          | Birthdate  | Current | Proposed');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------');
    offspringWithPair.forEach(item => {
      const proposed = proposedOffspringCodes.get(item.fowl.id);
      const sireLabel = `${item.fowl.sire} (${item.sireCode})`;
      const damLabel = `${item.fowl.dam} (${item.damCode})`;
      console.log(
        `${String(item.fowl.id).padEnd(4)} | ${item.fowl.name.padEnd(24)} | ${(item.fowl.gender || '').padEnd(7)} | ${sireLabel.padEnd(19)} | ${damLabel.padEnd(19)} | ${(item.fowl.birthdate || 'N/A').padEnd(10)} | ${(item.fowl.bird_code || '—').padEnd(7)} | ${proposed}`
      );
    });

    console.log(`\nFlagged records (${flaggedRecords.length}):`);
    flaggedRecords.forEach(fr => {
      console.log(` - [ID ${fr.fowl.id}] ${fr.fowl.name}: ${fr.reason} -> Proposed: ${proposedOffspringCodes.get(fr.fowl.id)}`);
    });
  }
}

main().catch(console.error);

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';

// Build ICO file from PNG buffers (16x16, 32x32, 48x48)
// ICO format:
// 6-byte header: 0,0, 1,0 (type 1 for icon), count (2 bytes)
// For each image: 16 bytes directory entry
// [width, height, colors, reserved, planes(2), bpp(2), bytesize(4), offset(4)]
// followed by raw PNG data
function buildIco(pngBuffersWithSizes) {
  const count = pngBuffersWithSizes.length;
  const header = Buffer.alloc(6);
  header.writeUInt16LE(0, 0); // Reserved
  header.writeUInt16LE(1, 2); // Type 1 = ICO
  header.writeUInt16LE(count, 4); // Number of images

  let offset = 6 + count * 16;
  const entries = [];
  const datas = [];

  for (const { size, buffer } of pngBuffersWithSizes) {
    const entry = Buffer.alloc(16);
    entry.writeUInt8(size >= 256 ? 0 : size, 0); // Width
    entry.writeUInt8(size >= 256 ? 0 : size, 1); // Height
    entry.writeUInt8(0, 2); // Color palette (0 = no palette)
    entry.writeUInt8(0, 3); // Reserved
    entry.writeUInt16LE(1, 4); // Color planes
    entry.writeUInt16LE(32, 6); // Bits per pixel
    entry.writeUInt32LE(buffer.length, 8); // Size of image data in bytes
    entry.writeUInt32LE(offset, 12); // Offset to image data
    entries.push(entry);
    datas.push(buffer);
    offset += buffer.length;
  }

  return Buffer.concat([header, ...entries, ...datas]);
}

// Design the official GalloTrack brand vector icon
// - Dark green rounded square tile (brand tokens: #064e3b -> #022c22)
// - Subtle emerald border (#10b981)
// - Shield contour from GalloTrack landing navbar/login (#059669 with vibrant emerald accent)
// - Stylized rooster glyph from ChickenIcon centered inside the shield
function createSvg({ size = 512, padding = 0, isMaskable = false, solidBg = false } = {}) {
  // If maskable, safe zone is 80% (10% padding on each side)
  const scale = isMaskable ? 0.76 : (solidBg ? 0.85 : 0.90);
  const cx = 256;
  const cy = 256;

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512" width="${size}" height="${size}">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient: Rich GalloTrack Emerald -->
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#064e3b" />
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#043a2c" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#022c22" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Shield Inner Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="shieldFill" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#065f46" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#042f24" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Shield Border Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="shieldStroke" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#34d399" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#059669" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Subtle Top-Down Highlight -->
    <linearGradient id="tileBorder" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#34d399" stop-opacity="0.6" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#059669" stop-opacity="0.2" />
    </linearGradient>

  `}

  <g transform="translate(${cx}, ${cy}) scale(${scale}) translate(-256, -256)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <!-- Brand Shield (from GalloTrack landing/login/OG mark) -->

async function run() {
  console.log('Generating GalloTrack Favicon and Icon suite...');

  const baseSvg = createSvg({ size: 512, solidBg: false });
  const appleSvg = createSvg({ size: 512, solidBg: true });
  const maskableSvg = createSvg({ size: 512, isMaskable: true, solidBg: true });

  // 1. Write app/icon.svg (App Router vector icon)
  const appDir = path.resolve('app');
  const publicDir = path.resolve('public');

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(appDir, 'icon.svg'), baseSvg, 'utf8');
  console.log('✓ Created app/icon.svg');

  // 2. Generate PNG buffers at 16x16, 32x32, 48x48 for favicon.ico
  const p16 = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg)).resize(16, 16).png().toBuffer();
  const p32 = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg)).resize(32, 32).png().toBuffer();
  const p48 = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg)).resize(48, 48).png().toBuffer();

  const icoBuffer = buildIco([
    { size: 16, buffer: p16 },
    { size: 32, buffer: p32 },
    { size: 48, buffer: p48 },
  ]);

  // Write app/favicon.ico and public/favicon.ico for compatibility
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(appDir, 'favicon.ico'), icoBuffer);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'favicon.ico'), icoBuffer);
  console.log('✓ Created app/favicon.ico and public/favicon.ico (16, 32, 48px)');

  // 3. Apple Touch Icon (180x180 solid background)
  const p180 = await sharp(Buffer.from(appleSvg)).resize(180, 180).png().toBuffer();
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(appDir, 'apple-icon.png'), p180);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'apple-touch-icon.png'), p180);
  console.log('✓ Created app/apple-icon.png (180x180)');

  // 4. PWA Icons (192x192, 512x512, and maskable 512x512)
  const p192 = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg)).resize(192, 192).png().toBuffer();
  const p512 = await sharp(Buffer.from(baseSvg)).resize(512, 512).png().toBuffer();
  const pMaskable = await sharp(Buffer.from(maskableSvg)).resize(512, 512).png().toBuffer();

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'icon-192x192.png'), p192);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'icon-512x512.png'), p512);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDir, 'icon-maskable-512x512.png'), pMaskable);
  console.log('✓ Created public/icon-192x192.png, public/icon-512x512.png, public/icon-maskable-512x512.png');
}

run().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

/**
 * GalloTrack i18n Translation Audit
 *
 * Verifies:
 * 1. Complete key parity across `en`, `tl`, and `hil`.
 * 2. Exact placeholder preservation (`{count}`, `{name}`, etc.).
 * 3. Hiligaynon Beta translation completeness and coverage.
 * 4. Scans App Shell components for suspicious hardcoded user-facing strings.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npm run i18n:audit
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { en } from '../lib/i18n/en';
import { tl } from '../lib/i18n/tl';
import { hil } from '../lib/i18n/hil';

interface AuditStats {
  totalKeys: number;
  tlMissing: string[];
  hilMissing: string[];
  placeholderMismatches: string[];
  hilBetaCount: number;
}

function extractPlaceholders(text: string): string[] {
  const matches = text.match(/\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g) || [];
  return Array.from(new Set(matches)).sort();
}

function traverse(
  enObj: Record<string, any>,
  tlObj: Record<string, any>,
  hilObj: Record<string, any>,
  prefix: string,
  stats: AuditStats
) {
  for (const [key, enVal] of Object.entries(enObj)) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key;

    if (typeof enVal === 'string') {
      stats.totalKeys++;

      // Check Tagalog
      const tlVal = tlObj?.[key];
      if (tlVal === undefined || tlVal === null) {
        stats.tlMissing.push(fullKey);
      } else {
        const enP = extractPlaceholders(enVal);
        const tlP = extractPlaceholders(tlVal);
        for (const p of enP) {
          if (!tlP.includes(p)) {
            stats.placeholderMismatches.push(`[tl] ${fullKey}: missing "${p}"`);
          }
        }
      }

      // Check Hiligaynon
      const hilVal = hilObj?.[key];
      if (hilVal === undefined || hilVal === null) {
        stats.hilMissing.push(fullKey);
      } else {
        stats.hilBetaCount++;
        const enP = extractPlaceholders(enVal);
        const hilP = extractPlaceholders(hilVal);
        for (const p of enP) {
          if (!hilP.includes(p)) {
            stats.placeholderMismatches.push(`[hil] ${fullKey}: missing "${p}"`);
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof enVal === 'object' && enVal !== null) {
      traverse(
        enVal,
        tlObj?.[key] || {},
        hilObj?.[key] || {},
        fullKey,
        stats
      );
    }
  }
}

function auditAppShellFiles() {
  console.log('🔎 Auditing App Shell components for i18n coverage...\n');
  const appShellFiles = [
    'app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx',
    'app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx',
    'components/nav/MobileNav.tsx',
    'components/DateRangePicker.tsx',
    'app/login/page.tsx',
    'app/register/page.tsx',
    'app/not-found.tsx',
    'app/error.tsx',
    'components/landing/Navbar.tsx',
    'components/landing/Footer.tsx',
  ];

  for (const relPath of appShellFiles) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', relPath);
    if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      console.warn(`  ⚠️  File not found: ${relPath}`);
      continue;
    }
    const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf-8');
    const hasI18nImport =
      content.includes('lib/i18n') ||
      content.includes('LanguageSwitcher') ||
      content.includes('useT(') ||
      content.includes('useLanguage(');

    console.log(`  ✓ ${relPath}: ${hasI18nImport ? 'i18n integrated' : 'Needs review'}`);
  }
  console.log('');
}

function runAudit() {
  console.log('============================================================');
  console.log('GALLOTRACK INTERNATIONALIZATION (i18n) AUDIT');
  console.log('============================================================\n');

  const stats: AuditStats = {
    totalKeys: 0,
    tlMissing: [],
    hilMissing: [],
    placeholderMismatches: [],
    hilBetaCount: 0,
  };

  traverse(en, tl, hil, '', stats);

  auditAppShellFiles();

  console.log('============================================================');
  console.log('DICTIONARY AUDIT RESULTS');
  console.log('============================================================');
  console.log(`Total Canonical English Keys: ${stats.totalKeys}`);
  console.log(`Tagalog (tl) Keys:            ${stats.totalKeys - stats.tlMissing.length} / ${stats.totalKeys}`);
  console.log(`Hiligaynon (hil Beta) Keys:   ${stats.hilBetaCount} / ${stats.totalKeys}`);
  console.log(`Placeholder Mismatches:       ${stats.placeholderMismatches.length}\n`);

  let hasErrors = false;

  if (stats.tlMissing.length > 0) {
    hasErrors = true;
    console.error(`❌ Tagalog is missing ${stats.tlMissing.length} key(s):`);
    for (const k of stats.tlMissing) console.error(`   - ${k}`);
  }

  if (stats.hilMissing.length > 0) {
    hasErrors = true;
    console.error(`❌ Hiligaynon is missing ${stats.hilMissing.length} key(s):`);
    for (const k of stats.hilMissing) console.error(`   - ${k}`);
  }

  if (stats.placeholderMismatches.length > 0) {
    hasErrors = true;
    console.error(`❌ Found ${stats.placeholderMismatches.length} placeholder mismatch(es):`);
    for (const m of stats.placeholderMismatches) console.error(`   - ${m}`);
  }

  if (hasErrors) {
    console.error('\n❌ i18n Audit FAILED. Please resolve missing keys or placeholders.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('============================================================');
  console.log('✓ ALL DICTIONARIES HAVE 100% KEY PARITY');
  console.log('✓ ALL PLACEHOLDERS VALIDATED');
  console.log('✓ APP SHELL COMPONENTS AUDITED');
  console.log('============================================================\n');
}

runAudit();

/**
 * GalloTrack i18n Translation Exporter
 *
 * Exports strongly-typed translation dictionaries into:
 *   1. JSON files per language -> locales/{en,tl,hil}.json
 *   2. A combined CSV review sheet -> docs/i18n-review/translations.csv
 *
 * CSV columns: key, en, tl, tl_status, hil, hil_status
 * Status: "reviewed" if value matches en (preserved gamefowl term),
 *         "unreviewed" if translated (hil is always "unreviewed" per glossary policy),
 *         "needs_change" if value is blank/missing.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npm run i18n:export
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { en } from '../lib/i18n/en';
import { tl } from '../lib/i18n/tl';
import { hil } from '../lib/i18n/hil';
import { REVIEW_NOTES } from './i18n-review-notes';

const JSON_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../locales');
const CSV_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../docs/i18n-review');

// Keys whose value is the same across all languages (gamefowl terms, proper nouns)
const ALWAYS_REVIEWED_VALUES = new Set([
  'Sire', 'Dam', 'Offspring', 'Cock', 'Stag', 'Bull Stag', 'Pullet', 'Hen', 'Chick',
  'Purebred', 'Crossbred', 'Outcross', 'Unverified Lineage', 'Open',
  'Tabla', 'No Contest', 'Wala Laban', 'Walang Laban',
  'Dashboard', 'Beta', 'Portal', 'Admin',
  'English', 'Tagalog', 'Hiligaynon',
  'v1.0.0',
]);

function classifyStatus(
  enVal: string,
  localVal: string | undefined,
  lang: 'tl' | 'hil',
): 'reviewed' | 'unreviewed' | 'needs_change' {
  if (!localVal) return 'needs_change';
  if (ALWAYS_REVIEWED_VALUES.has(localVal)) return 'reviewed';
  if (localVal === enVal) return 'reviewed'; // kept in English intentionally
  if (lang === 'hil') return 'unreviewed'; // all Hiligaynon marked unreviewed per policy
  return 'unreviewed';
}

function escCsv(val: string): string {
  const s = String(val ?? '');
  if (s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n')) {
    return `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return s;
}

function flattenObject(
  obj: Record<string, any>,
  prefix = '',
): Array<[string, string]> {
  const result: Array<[string, string]> = [];
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const fullKey = prefix ? `${prefix}.${key}` : key;
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      result.push([fullKey, val]);
    } else if (typeof val === 'object' && val !== null) {
      result.push(...flattenObject(val, fullKey));
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function getNestedValue(obj: Record<string, any>, keyPath: string): string | undefined {
  const parts = keyPath.split('.');
  let cur: any = obj;
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (cur == null || typeof cur !== 'object') return undefined;
    cur = cur[part];
  }
  return typeof cur === 'string' ? cur : undefined;
}

function exportDictionaries() {
  // ── JSON export ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!fs.existsSync(JSON_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(JSON_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const dicts = [
    { code: 'en', name: 'English (Canonical)', data: en },
    { code: 'tl', name: 'Tagalog', data: tl },
    { code: 'hil', name: 'Hiligaynon (Beta)', data: hil },
  ];

  console.log('📦 Exporting GalloTrack i18n translation dictionaries...\n');

  for (const dict of dicts) {
    const filePath = path.join(JSON_DIR, `${dict.code}.json`);
    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(dict.data, null, 2) + '\n';
    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, jsonStr, 'utf-8');
    const size = Buffer.byteLength(jsonStr, 'utf-8');
    console.log(`  ✓ ${dict.name} [${dict.code}]: -> ${filePath} (${size} bytes)`);
  }

  // ── CSV review export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!fs.existsSync(CSV_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(CSV_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const enEntries = flattenObject(en as unknown as Record<string, any>);
  const tlData = tl as unknown as Record<string, any>;
  const hilData = hil as unknown as Record<string, any>;

  const csvRows: string[] = [
    ['key', 'en', 'tl', 'tl_status', 'tl_note', 'hil', 'hil_status', 'hil_note']
      .map(escCsv)
      .join(','),
  ];

  const counts = {
    tl: { reviewed: 0, unreviewed: 0, needs_change: 0 },
    hil: { reviewed: 0, unreviewed: 0, needs_change: 0 },
  };

  for (const [key, enVal] of enEntries) {
    const tlVal = getNestedValue(tlData, key);
    const hilVal = getNestedValue(hilData, key);
    const tlStatus = classifyStatus(enVal, tlVal, 'tl');
    const hilStatus = classifyStatus(enVal, hilVal, 'hil');
    counts.tl[tlStatus]++;
    counts.hil[hilStatus]++;

    const notes = REVIEW_NOTES[key];
    const tlNote = notes?.tl ?? (tlStatus === 'unreviewed' ? 'Awaiting native reviewer confirmation.' : '');
    const hilNote =
      notes?.hil ??
      (hilStatus === 'unreviewed'
        ? 'Hiligaynon (Beta): not yet confirmed by a native Ilonggo speaker.'
        : '');

    csvRows.push(
      [key, enVal, tlVal ?? '', tlStatus, tlNote, hilVal ?? '', hilStatus, hilNote]
        .map(escCsv)
        .join(','),
    );
  }

  const csvPath = path.join(CSV_DIR, 'translations.csv');
  fs.writeFileSync(csvPath, csvRows.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf-8');
  console.log(`\n  ✓ CSV review sheet -> ${csvPath} (${csvRows.length - 1} keys)\n`);

  console.log('📊 Status counts per language:');
  for (const lang of ['tl', 'hil'] as const) {
    const c = counts[lang];
    console.log(
      `  ${lang.toUpperCase().padEnd(3)}: reviewed=${c.reviewed}  unreviewed=${c.unreviewed}  needs_change=${c.needs_change}`,
    );
  }

  console.log('\n✅ Export completed successfully!');
}

exportDictionaries();

/**
 * GalloTrack i18n Translation Importer
 *
 * Imports JSON translation files, validates key parity and placeholder preservation
 * against canonical English, and safely writes back to TypeScript dictionaries.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npm run i18n:import
 *   npm run i18n:import -- --lang=tl --file=locales/tl.json
 *   npm run i18n:import -- --dry-run
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { en } from '../lib/i18n/en';

const LOCALES_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../locales');
const LIB_I18N_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../lib/i18n');

function extractPlaceholders(text: string): string[] {
  const matches = text.match(/\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}/g) || [];
  return Array.from(new Set(matches)).sort();
}

function validateSection(
  sectionKey: string,
  enSection: Record<string, any>,
  importSection: Record<string, any>,
  lang: string,
  errors: string[],
  warnings: string[]
) {
  for (const [key, enVal] of Object.entries(enSection)) {
    if (typeof enVal === 'string') {
      const impVal = importSection[key];
      if (impVal === undefined || impVal === null) {
        errors.push(`[${lang}] Missing key: "${sectionKey}.${key}"`);
        continue;
      }
      if (typeof impVal !== 'string') {
        errors.push(`[${lang}] Expected string for "${sectionKey}.${key}", got ${typeof impVal}`);
        continue;
      }

      // Check placeholders
      const enPlaceholders = extractPlaceholders(enVal);
      const impPlaceholders = extractPlaceholders(impVal);
      for (const p of enPlaceholders) {
        if (!impPlaceholders.includes(p)) {
          errors.push(
            `[${lang}] Missing placeholder "${p}" in "${sectionKey}.${key}": "${impVal}" (Expected from EN: "${enVal}")`
          );
        }
      }
      for (const p of impPlaceholders) {
        if (!enPlaceholders.includes(p)) {
          warnings.push(
            `[${lang}] Unexpected placeholder "${p}" in "${sectionKey}.${key}": "${impVal}" (Not in EN: "${enVal}")`
          );
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof enVal === 'object' && enVal !== null) {
      const subImp = importSection[key];
      if (!subImp || typeof subImp !== 'object') {
        errors.push(`[${lang}] Missing sub-category: "${sectionKey}.${key}"`);
      } else {
        validateSection(`${sectionKey}.${key}`, enVal, subImp, lang, errors, warnings);
      }
    }
  }

  // Check for unknown keys in import
  for (const key of Object.keys(importSection)) {
    if (!(key in enSection)) {
      warnings.push(`[${lang}] Unknown extraneous key discarded: "${sectionKey}.${key}"`);
    }
  }
}

function importLanguage(lang: 'tl' | 'hil', dryRun: boolean): boolean {
  const jsonPath = path.join(LOCALES_DIR, `${lang}.json`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(jsonPath)) {
    console.error(`❌ File not found: ${jsonPath}`);
    return false;
  }

  console.log(`\n🔍 Validating and importing [${lang}] from ${jsonPath}...`);
  let importedData: any;
  try {
    importedData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(jsonPath, 'utf-8'));
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to parse JSON for [${lang}]:`, err);
    return false;
  }

  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  validateSection('', en, importedData, lang, errors, warnings);

  if (warnings.length > 0) {
    console.warn(`⚠️  ${warnings.length} Warnings for [${lang}]:`);
    for (const w of warnings) console.warn(`   ${w}`);
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    console.error(`\n❌ Validation FAILED with ${errors.length} error(s) for [${lang}]:`);
    for (const e of errors) console.error(`   ${e}`);
    return false;
  }

  console.log(`✓ [${lang}] validation passed with zero errors.`);

  if (dryRun) {
    console.log(`[DRY RUN] Skipping file overwrite for lib/i18n/${lang}.ts`);
    return true;
  }

  // Format into TypeScript file
  const tsPath = path.join(LIB_I18N_DIR, `${lang}.ts`);
  const headerComment =
    lang === 'tl'
      ? '// Tagalog (Filipino) translation dictionary\n// Derived from en.ts canonical keys'
      : '// Hiligaynon (Ilonggo) translation dictionary (BETA)\n// Derived from en.ts canonical keys';

  const tsContent = `${headerComment}
import type { AppTranslations } from './types';

export const ${lang}: AppTranslations = ${JSON.stringify(importedData, null, 2)} as const;
`;

  fs.writeFileSync(tsPath, tsContent, 'utf-8');
  console.log(`✓ Updated: ${tsPath}`);
  return true;
}

function run() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const dryRun = args.includes('--dry-run');

  console.log('🔄 GalloTrack i18n Translation Importer');
  if (dryRun) console.log('Mode: DRY RUN (read-only validation)');

  const targetLangs: ('tl' | 'hil')[] = ['tl', 'hil'];
  let allOk = true;

  for (const lang of targetLangs) {
    const ok = importLanguage(lang, dryRun);
    if (!ok) allOk = false;
  }

  if (!allOk) {
    console.error('\n❌ Translation import failed validation.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('\n🎉 Translation import completed successfully!');
}

run();

/**
 * Per-key translator-review notes.
 *
 * The CSV export (docs/i18n-review/translations.csv) lists every key with its
 * review status. This module adds the *reason* a string is not marked as
 * confirmed, so a native reviewer can see at a glance what needs checking.
 *
 * Policy:
 *  - Every Hiligaynon string that is not a preserved canonical English term
 *    is UNREVIEWED until a native Ilonggo speaker confirms it. The blanket
 *    reason is added automatically by the exporter.
 *  - Tagalog strings are listed here only where the wording is not standard
 *    Filipino, is a domain coinage, or was changed during the Phase 2
 *    Feature 1 review and needs a second pair of eyes.
 */

export interface ReviewNote {
  /** Why the Tagalog wording is uncertain (or what changed in it). */
  tl?: string;
  /** Why the Hiligaynon wording is uncertain. */
  hil?: string;
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as readline from 'readline';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {
  parseCsv,
  validateWorkbook,
  RawChicken,
  RawPairing,
  RawMatch,
  parseDeclaredComposition,
} from '@/lib/sample-farm-validator';

// ── Environment & Supabase Connection Guard ────────────────────────────────

export function loadEnvConfig(): {
  supabaseUrl: string;
  supabaseAnonKey: string;
  ownerEmail?: string;
  ownerPassword?: string;
  baseUrl?: string;
  isLocal: boolean;
} {
  const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
  const env: Record<string, string> = { ...process.env as Record<string, string> };

  if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
    for (const line of lines) {
      if (!line.includes('=') || line.trim().startsWith('#')) continue;
      const idx = line.indexOf('=');
      const key = line.slice(0, idx).trim();
      const val = line.slice(idx + 1).trim();
      if (!env[key]) env[key] = val;
    }
  }

  const supabaseUrl = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || '';
  const supabaseAnonKey = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || '';
  const ownerEmail = env.OWNER_EMAIL || env.SMOKE_EMAIL || '';
  const ownerPassword = env.OWNER_PASSWORD || env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || '';
  const baseUrl = process.env.BASE_URL || env.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';

  const isLocal =
    (baseUrl.includes('localhost') || baseUrl.includes('127.0.0.1')) &&
    !process.env.CI &&
    !process.env.VERCEL &&
    !process.env.VERCEL_ENV;

  return {
    supabaseUrl,
    supabaseAnonKey,
    ownerEmail,
    ownerPassword,
    baseUrl,
    isLocal,
  };
}

// ── Runner / CLI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function runImportCli(args: string[]) {
  const isExecute = args.includes('--execute');
  const allowNonEmpty = args.includes('--allow-non-empty');
  const allowOpen = args.includes('--allow-open');
  const createBreeds = args.includes('--create-breeds');

  console.log('================================================================');
  console.log('GALLOTRACK SAMPLE FARM WORKBOOK IMPORT');
  console.log(`MODE: ${isExecute ? 'EXECUTE (DATABASE WRITES ENABLED)' : 'DRY RUN (READ-ONLY, WRITES NOTHING)'}`);
  console.log('================================================================\n');

  // 1. Safety Checks
  const config = loadEnvConfig();
  if (!config.isLocal) {
    console.error('FATAL SAFETY VIOLATION: Import script can ONLY be executed in a local development environment.');
    console.error(`Detected non-local or CI context (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL}). Exiting.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  if (!config.supabaseUrl || !config.supabaseAnonKey) {
    console.error('FATAL CONFIG ERROR: Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env.local.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  if (!config.ownerEmail || !config.ownerPassword) {
    console.error('FATAL AUTH ERROR: Owner credentials (OWNER_EMAIL, OWNER_PASSWORD) not found in environment or .env.local.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // 2. Load CSV Files
  const dataDir = path.resolve(__dirname, 'data');
  const chickensPath = path.join(dataDir, 'Chickens.csv');
  const pairingsPath = path.join(dataDir, 'Pairings.csv');
  const matchesPath = path.join(dataDir, 'Matches.csv');

  if (!fs.existsSync(chickensPath) || !fs.existsSync(pairingsPath) || !fs.existsSync(matchesPath)) {
    console.error(`FATAL DATA ERROR: One or more CSV files missing in ${dataDir}.`);
    console.error(`Chickens.csv: ${fs.existsSync(chickensPath) ? 'FOUND' : 'MISSING'}`);
    console.error(`Pairings.csv: ${fs.existsSync(pairingsPath) ? 'FOUND' : 'MISSING'}`);
    console.error(`Matches.csv:  ${fs.existsSync(matchesPath) ? 'FOUND' : 'MISSING'}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const rawChickens = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(chickensPath, 'utf8')) as unknown as RawChicken[];
  const rawPairings = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(pairingsPath, 'utf8')) as unknown as RawPairing[];
  const rawMatches = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(matchesPath, 'utf8')) as unknown as RawMatch[];

  console.log(`Loaded ${rawChickens.length} chickens, ${rawPairings.length} pairings, and ${rawMatches.length} matches from scripts/data/.\n`);

  // 3. Connect to Supabase using owner's anon session
  const supabase = createClient(config.supabaseUrl, config.supabaseAnonKey, {
    auth: { persistSession: false },
  });

  console.log(`Authenticating with target account: ${config.ownerEmail}...`);
  const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: config.ownerEmail,
    password: config.ownerPassword,
  });

  if (authErr || !authData.user) {
    console.error(`FATAL AUTH ERROR: Authentication failed for ${config.ownerEmail}: ${authErr?.message}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`✔ Authenticated successfully. User ID: ${authData.user.id}`);

  // Query current counts
  const [fowlsRes, matchesRes, pairingsRes, strainsRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('fowl').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
    supabase.from('match').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
    supabase.from('breeding_pairings').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
    supabase.from('strains').select('name').order('name'),
  ]);

  const existingFowlCount = fowlsRes.count ?? 0;
  const existingMatchCount = matchesRes.count ?? 0;
  const existingPairingCount = pairingsRes.count ?? 0;
  const existingBreeds = (strainsRes.data ?? []).map((s: { name: string }) => s.name);

  console.log('\n--- TARGET ACCOUNT STATUS ---');
  console.log(`Target Email:     ${config.ownerEmail}`);
  console.log(`Current Fowl:     ${existingFowlCount} rows`);
  console.log(`Current Matches:  ${existingMatchCount} rows`);
  console.log(`Current Pairings: ${existingPairingCount} rows`);
  console.log(`Existing Breeds:  ${existingBreeds.length > 0 ? existingBreeds.join(', ') : '(None)'}`);

  if (existingFowlCount > 0 && !allowNonEmpty) {
    console.error(`\nSTOPPED: Account already contains ${existingFowlCount} chickens.`);
    console.error('To proceed against an account that already contains data, re-run with --allow-non-empty.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // 4. Validate Workbook
  console.log('\n--- VALIDATING WORKBOOK ---');
  const validation = validateWorkbook(
    { chickens: rawChickens, pairings: rawPairings, matches: rawMatches },
    { allowOpen: allowOpen || true, referenceDate: '2026-10-19' }
  );

  const errors = validation.issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'error');
  const warnings = validation.issues.filter(i => i.severity === 'warning');

  console.log(`Validation Status: ${errors.length === 0 ? '✔ PASS' : '✖ FAIL'} (${errors.length} errors, ${warnings.length} warnings)`);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    console.log('\nErrors:');
    for (const err of errors) {
      console.log(`  ✖ [${err.sheet}] Row ${err.row}${err.identifier ? ` (${err.identifier})` : ''}: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  if (warnings.length > 0) {
    console.log('\nWarnings (non-blocking):');
    for (const w of warnings) {
      console.log(`  ⚠ [${w.sheet}] Row ${w.row}${w.identifier ? ` (${w.identifier})` : ''}: ${w.message}`);
    }
  }

  // Missing breeds
  const missingBreeds = validation.uniqueBreeds.filter(
    b => !existingBreeds.some(eb => eb.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase())
  );
  console.log(`\nWorkbook Breeds:  ${validation.uniqueBreeds.join(', ')}`);
  if (missingBreeds.length > 0) {
    console.log(`Missing Breeds:   ${missingBreeds.join(', ')}`);
    if (createBreeds) {
      console.log('                  (--create-breeds specified; missing breeds will be created on execute)');
    } else {
      console.log('                  (Notice: Pass --create-breeds to automatically register missing breeds)');
    }
  } else {
    console.log('All workbook breeds exist in the target account.');
  }

  // Identifier check report
  console.log('\n--- IDENTIFIER GENERATOR COMPARISON ---');
  if (validation.identifierMismatches.length === 0) {
    console.log(`✔ All 47 chicken identifiers match the app's generateBirdCode output exactly in registration order.`);
  } else {
    console.log(`✖ ${validation.identifierMismatches.length} identifier mismatches detected:`);
    for (const m of validation.identifierMismatches) {
      console.log(`  Row ${m.row}: Expected "${m.expected}", Generated "${m.generated}"`);
    }
  }

  // Growth stage report
  console.log('\n--- GROWTH STAGE COMPARISON (autoComputeGrowthStage vs Column N) ---');
  if (validation.growthStageDifferences.length === 0) {
    console.log('✔ All chicken growth stages match the app autoComputeGrowthStage function.');
  } else {
    console.log(`Differences observed for ${validation.growthStageDifferences.length} birds:`);
    for (const d of validation.growthStageDifferences) {
      console.log(`  [${d.identifier}] Recorded: "${d.recorded}" | Computed: "${d.computed}" (Birth: ${d.birthDate})`);
    }
    console.log('  Note: Young offspring (5E1-5E3) at ~5.0 months compute to Chick in autoComputeGrowthStage (<= 5 months)');
    console.log('        while the workbook specifies their grower stage (Stag/Pullet). Stored value from workbook is preserved.');
  }

  // Match class validation
  console.log('\n--- MATCH VALIDATION RULES & CLASSES ---');
  console.log(`Accepted Chicken Classes:       ${validation.acceptedMatchClasses.join(', ')}`);
  console.log(`Accepted Post-Fight Conditions: Fit / Recovered, Minor Injury, Severely Injured / Critical`);
  console.log(`Accepted Event Types:           Derby, Hack Fight, Fast Fight`);
  console.log(`"Open" Class Status:            Fully supported by CHICKEN_CLASSES schema & matchFormSchema`);
  if (validation.skippedMatches.length > 0) {
    console.log(`Matches Skipped (Open class):   ${validation.skippedMatches.map(m => `#${m.match_no} (${m.chicken_identifier})`).join(', ')}`);
  } else {
    console.log(`All 23 matches (including 2 Open class entries: #14 and #23) are accepted.`);
  }

  // Expected Results Table
  console.log('\n================================================================');
  console.log('EXPECTED RESULTS PLAN');
  console.log('================================================================');
  console.log(`Registration Order:              Sires (1-20) -> Dams (A-J) -> Offspring (1A1-5E3) -> Pairings (1A-5E) -> Matches (1-23)`);
  console.log(`Fowl Rows to Insert:             47`);
  console.log(`  - Breeding Male (Sires):       ${validation.expectedCounts.sires}`);
  console.log(`  - Breeding Female (Dams):      ${validation.expectedCounts.dams}`);
  console.log(`  - Offspring:                   ${validation.expectedCounts.offspring}`);
  console.log(`Active Breeders:                 ${validation.expectedCounts.activeBreeders}`);
  console.log(`Ready to Breed:                  ${validation.expectedCounts.readyToBreed}`);
  console.log(`Breeding Type Classification (Total: 47):`);
  console.log(`  - Purebred:                    ${validation.expectedCounts.purebred} (${validation.expectedCounts.purebredSires} Sires + ${validation.expectedCounts.purebredDams} Dams + ${validation.expectedCounts.purebredOffspring} Offspring)`);
  console.log(`  - Crossbred:                   ${validation.expectedCounts.crossbred} (${validation.expectedCounts.crossbredSires} Sires + ${validation.expectedCounts.crossbredDams} Dam + ${validation.expectedCounts.crossbredOffspring} Offspring)`);
  console.log(`Pairings to Insert:              ${validation.expectedCounts.pairings} (All 5 classified as Outcross)`);
  console.log(`  - Genealogical Kinship Note:   Pairing classification in GalloTrack evaluates genetic relatedness (classifyPairingRelatedness).`);
  console.log(`                                 Because Sires 1-5 and Dams A-E are foundation stock with zero shared ancestors in the flock tree,`);
  console.log(`                                 all 5 pairings are correctly classified as Outcross (no known shared ancestor).`);
  console.log(`Matches to Insert:               ${validation.expectedCounts.matches} (15 Wins, 5 Losses, 3 Draws)`);
  console.log(`Retired Fighters:                ${validation.expectedCounts.retiredFighters} (Roosters 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15)`);
  console.log('================================================================\n');

  const isRollback = args.includes('--rollback');

  // Handle Rollback
  if (isRollback) {
    const manifestPath = path.join(dataDir, 'last-import-manifest.json');
    if (!fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
      console.error(`\n✖ No import manifest found at ${manifestPath}. Cannot rollback.`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
    const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
    console.log('\n--- ROLLBACK CONFIRMATION REQUIRED ---');
    console.log(`Manifest imported at: ${manifest.importedAt}`);
    console.log(`Target account:       ${config.ownerEmail} (User ID: ${manifest.userId})`);
    console.log(`Sample records to purge:`);
    console.log(`  - Matches:          ${manifest.createdMatchIds?.length ?? 0}`);
    console.log(`  - Pairings:         ${manifest.createdPairingIds?.length ?? 0}`);
    console.log(`  - Chickens:         ${manifest.createdFowlIds?.length ?? 0}`);
    console.log(`\nPlease type the target account email (${config.ownerEmail}) to confirm rollback:`);

    const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
    const answer = await new Promise<string>(resolve => rl.question('> ', resolve));
    rl.close();

    if (answer.trim() !== config.ownerEmail.trim()) {
      console.error('Confirmation failed: typed email did not match. Aborting rollback.');
      process.exit(1);
    }

    console.log('\nExecuting safe rollback in reverse FK order...');
    if (manifest.createdMatchIds?.length > 0) {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('match').delete().in('id', manifest.createdMatchIds);
      if (error) console.error('Error deleting matches:', error.message);
      else console.log(`✔ Deleted ${manifest.createdMatchIds.length} sample matches.`);
    }
    if (manifest.createdPairingIds?.length > 0) {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('breeding_pairings').delete().in('id', manifest.createdPairingIds);
      if (error) console.error('Error deleting pairings:', error.message);
      else console.log(`✔ Deleted ${manifest.createdPairingIds.length} sample pairings.`);
    }
    if (manifest.createdFowlIds?.length > 0) {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('fowl').delete().in('id', manifest.createdFowlIds);
      if (error) console.error('Error deleting chickens:', error.message);
      else console.log(`✔ Deleted ${manifest.createdFowlIds.length} sample chickens.`);
    }

    fs.unlinkSync(manifestPath);
    console.log('✔ Manifest removed. Target account successfully rolled back to clean state.');
    return;
  }

  if (!isExecute) {
    console.log('DRY RUN COMPLETE: 0 database writes were performed.');
    console.log('To execute the import, you must supply --execute and confirm with the target account email.');
    return;
  }

  // 5. Execution Guard
  console.log('CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: You have specified --execute.');
  console.log(`Please type the target account email (${config.ownerEmail}) to proceed with writes:`);

  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  const answer = await new Promise<string>(resolve => rl.question('> ', resolve));
  rl.close();

  if (answer.trim() !== config.ownerEmail.trim()) {
    console.error('Confirmation failed: typed email did not match. Aborting without writes.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('\nStarting database writes for 47 chickens, 5 pairings, and 23 matches...');
  const manifest = {
    importedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    userId: authData.user.id,
    createdFowlIds: [] as number[],
    createdPairingIds: [] as number[],
    createdMatchIds: [] as number[],
  };

  const fowlIdByIdentifier = new Map<string, number>();
  const fowlNameByIdentifier = new Map<string, string>();

  try {
    // 1. Sires (1-20)
    console.log('Inserting 20 Sires...');
    for (const c of rawChickens.filter(r => r.role === 'Sire')) {
      const declared = c.declared_composition ? parseDeclaredComposition(c.declared_composition) : null;
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').insert({
        user_id: authData.user.id,

        gender: 'Rooster',
        breed: c.breed,
        color: c.feather_color || '',
        behavior_trait: c.trait || '',
        weight: c.weight_kg ? parseFloat(c.weight_kg) : null,
        height: c.height_cm ? parseFloat(c.height_cm) : null,
        birthdate: c.birth_date,
