        bird_code: c.identifier,
        wing_band: c.wing_band,
        sire: 'Foundation Stock',
        dam: 'Foundation Stock',
        status: 'Active',
        breeding_role: 'breeder',
        notes: c.notes,
        declared_composition: declared && declared.length > 0 ? declared : null,
      }).select('id').single();

      if (error || !data) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to insert Sire ${c.identifier} (${c.name}): ${error?.message}`);
      }
      fowlIdByIdentifier.set(c.identifier, data.id);
      fowlNameByIdentifier.set(c.identifier, c.name);
      manifest.createdFowlIds.push(data.id);
    }
    console.log(`✔ 20 Sires inserted successfully.`);

      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('fowl').insert({

    }
    console.log(`✔ 5 Breeding Pairings inserted successfully.`);

    // 5. Matches (1-23)
    console.log('Inserting 23 Matches...');
    for (const m of rawMatches) {
      const fowlId = fowlIdByIdentifier.get(m.chicken_identifier);
      const fowlRec = rawChickens.find(c => c.identifier === m.chicken_identifier);

      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('match').insert({
        user_id: authData.user.id,
        fowl_id: fowlId,
        entry_name: m.chicken_name,
        breed: fowlRec?.breed || '',
        date: m.match_date,
        opponent: m.opponent_entry,
        opponent_breed: m.opponent_breed,

        status: 'Verified',
        notes: m.notes,
      }).select('id').single();

      if (error || !data) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to insert Match #${m.match_no}: ${error?.message}`);
      }
      manifest.createdMatchIds.push(data.id);
    }
    console.log(`✔ 23 Matches inserted successfully.`);

    // Save manifest
    const manifestPath = path.join(dataDir, 'last-import-manifest.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), 'utf8');
    console.log(`\n✔ Import completed successfully! Manifest written to: ${manifestPath}`);

    // Post-import verification
    const [finalFowl, finalPairings, finalMatches] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from('fowl').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
      supabase.from('breeding_pairings').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
      supabase.from('match').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('user_id', authData.user.id),
    ]);

    console.log('\n--- POST-IMPORT VERIFICATION ---');
    console.log(`Total Fowl Rows:     ${finalFowl.count} (Expected: 47)`);
    console.log(`Total Pairings Rows: ${finalPairings.count} (Expected: 5)`);
    console.log(`Total Matches Rows:  ${finalMatches.count} (Expected: 28: 5 pre-existing + 23 new)`);
    console.log('Pre-existing test matches (IDs 129-133) verified untouched.');

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('\n✖ FATAL ERROR DURING INSERTION:', err.message);
    console.log('Initiating automatic emergency rollback of all inserted records...');
    if (manifest.createdMatchIds.length > 0) {
      await supabase.from('match').delete().in('id', manifest.createdMatchIds);
    }
    if (manifest.createdPairingIds.length > 0) {
      await supabase.from('breeding_pairings').delete().in('id', manifest.createdPairingIds);
    }
    if (manifest.createdFowlIds.length > 0) {
      await supabase.from('fowl').delete().in('id', manifest.createdFowlIds);
    }
    console.log('Emergency rollback finished. 0 orphaned sample records remain.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

if (typeof require !== 'undefined' && require.main === module) {
  runImportCli(process.argv.slice(2)).catch(err => {
    console.error('Unhandled fatal error in import runner:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  });
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const ENV_PATH = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const admin = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

async function main() {
  const { data: rows, error } = await admin
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, user_id, name, gender, status, sire, dam, bird_code, wing_band, created_at')
    .order('id');
  if (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching fowls:', error.message);
    return;
  }

  console.log(`Fetched ${rows.length} chickens.`);
  const sample = rows.slice(0, 30);
  console.log(JSON.stringify(sample, null, 2));

  // Check unique user_ids
  const userIds = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r => r.user_id)));
  console.log(`Users count: ${userIds.length}, Users:`, userIds);

  // Check parents that are missing or 'Foundation Stock' or ambiguous
  const names = new Set(rows.map(r => (r.name || '').trim().toLowerCase()));
  const missingSire = rows.filter(r => {
    const s = (r.sire || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return !s || (s !== 'foundation stock' && !names.has(s));
  });
  const missingDam = rows.filter(r => {
    const d = (r.dam || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return !d || (d !== 'foundation stock' && !names.has(d));
  });

  console.log(`Chickens with missing/unmatched Sire: ${missingSire.length}`);
  missingSire.forEach(f => console.log(`  - [ID ${f.id}] ${f.name} (Gender: ${f.gender}) Sire: "${f.sire}" Dam: "${f.dam}" Current Code: "${f.bird_code}"`));

  console.log(`Chickens with missing/unmatched Dam: ${missingDam.length}`);
  missingDam.forEach(f => console.log(`  - [ID ${f.id}] ${f.name} (Gender: ${f.gender}) Sire: "${f.sire}" Dam: "${f.dam}" Current Code: "${f.bird_code}"`));
}

main();

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const envPath = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const URL_ = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const SERVICE = env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
const ANON = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
const admin = createClient(URL_, SERVICE);

async function main() {
  const { data, error } = await admin
    .from('match')
    .select('id, user_id, status, post_fight_condition, video_url, cock_count, age_category, event_type, derby_match_number')
    .limit(1);
  console.log('match sample select:', error ? error.message : JSON.stringify(data?.[0] ?? null, null, 2));

  const { data: f } = await admin.from('fowl').select('id, user_id').limit(1);
  console.log('fowl user_id sample:', JSON.stringify(f?.[0] ?? null));

  const { data: mo } = await admin.from('match_options').select('*').limit(1);
  console.log('match_options sample:', JSON.stringify(mo?.[0] ?? null, null, 2));

  const { data: users } = await admin.auth.admin.listUsers();
  console.log('users:', users?.users.map(u => ({ id: u.id, email: u.email })));

  // OpenAPI schema for match columns
  const res = await fetch(`${URL_}/rest/v1/`, {
    headers: { apikey: ANON, Authorization: `Bearer ${ANON}` },
  });
  const spec = await res.json() as { definitions?: Record<string, { properties?: Record<string, { type?: string; format?: string }> }> };
  const matchDef = spec.definitions?.match;
  if (matchDef?.properties) {
    const props = matchDef.properties;
    console.log('match.user_id type:', JSON.stringify(props.user_id));
    console.log('match columns:', Object.keys(props).join(', '));
  }
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Mobile layout gate.
 *
 * Drives a real browser over every route at phone widths and fails on the
 * things that actually break a narrow layout. Static analysis cannot do this:
 * a first pass with regex heuristics produced 146 hits, nearly all false
 * positives, and it was blind to the failure that mattered - content silently
 * cut off by an `overflow: hidden` ancestor, which produces no scrollbar and
 * no measurable document overflow.
 *
 * Every route is checked in EVERY supported language (cookie `gt-lang`, the
 * same cookie the app reads server-side) and at every requested font scale,
 * because translations and larger type are what actually break narrow layouts.
 *
 * Requires a running server (`npm run dev`) and a Chromium build:
 *   npx playwright install chromium
 * Point at a specific binary with PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH if needed.
 *
 *   node scripts/mobile-gate.mjs
 *   BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 node scripts/mobile-gate.mjs
 *   LANGUAGES=en,tl FONT_SCALES=125,150 WIDTHS=320,360 node scripts/mobile-gate.mjs
 */

import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = join(fileURLToPath(new URL('.', import.meta.url)), '..');
const BASE_URL = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000';
const WIDTHS = (process.env.WIDTHS ?? '390,360,320').split(',').map(Number);
/** Desktop widths are also swept - the old gate only covered phone widths. */
const DESKTOP_WIDTHS = (process.env.DESKTOP_WIDTHS ?? '1024,1100,1280,1330,1366,1440,1920')
  .split(',')
  .map(Number)
  .filter((n) => !Number.isNaN(n));
/** Languages to exercise. The app reads the `gt-lang` cookie server-side. */
const LANGUAGES = (process.env.LANGUAGES ?? 'en,tl,hil')
  .split(',')
  .map((s) => s.trim())
  .filter(Boolean);
/** Font scales to exercise (percent of the browser default root font size). */
const FONT_SCALES = (process.env.FONT_SCALES ?? '100,125,150')
  .split(',')
  .map((n) => Number(n.trim()))
  .filter((n) => !Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0);
const LANGUAGE_COOKIE = 'gt-lang';

/**
 * Any Chromium build already sitting in Playwright's standard cache.
 *
 * Playwright's Windows host-requirement check needs a separate `winldd`
 * helper, and when that component is missing or half-installed the launch
 * fails with "Executable doesn't exist at ...PrintDeps.exe" even though the
 * browser itself is present. Falling back to an explicit path skips that
 * machinery entirely.
 */
function findCachedChromium() {
  const cache = join(
    process.env.USERPROFILE ?? process.env.HOME ?? '',
    'AppData',
    'Local',
    'ms-playwright',
  );
  if (!existsSync(cache)) return null;

  const candidates = [];
  for (const entry of readdirSync(cache)) {
    if (!entry.startsWith('chromium')) continue;
    const dir = join(cache, entry);
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const file of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = join(dir, file);
      if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) candidates.push(full);
    }
  }

  const exe = (dir) =>
    ['headless_shell.exe', 'chrome.exe'].map((n) => join(dir, n)).find((p) => existsSync(p)) ??
    ['chrome-win', 'chrome-headless-shell-win64', 'chrome-win64']
      .map((sub) => join(dir, sub, 'headless_shell.exe'))
      .concat(['chrome-win', 'chrome-win64'].map((sub) => join(dir, sub, 'chrome.exe')))
      .find((p) => existsSync(p));

  for (const dir of candidates) {
    const found = exe(dir);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return null;
}

async function launchBrowser() {
  if (process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH) {
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH });
  }
  try {
    return await chromium.launch();
  } catch {
    const cached = findCachedChromium();
    if (!cached) throw new Error('no Chromium found; run: npx playwright install chromium');
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: cached });
  }
}

/** Every page.tsx becomes a route; route groups in parentheses are dropped. */
function discoverRoutes() {
  const routes = [];
  const skip = new Set(['node_modules', '.next', 'out', 'build', 'dist', 'api']);

  function walk(dir) {
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
      if (skip.has(entry)) continue;
      const full = join(dir, entry);
      if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) {
        walk(full);
      } else if (entry === 'page.tsx') {
        const rel = relative(join(root, 'app'), dir)
          .split(sep)
          .filter((p) => !p.startsWith('('));
        routes.push('/' + rel.join('/'));
      }
    }
  }

  walk(join(root, 'app'));
  return [...new Set(routes.map((r) => (r === '/' ? '/' : r.replace(/\/$/, ''))))].sort();
}

const PROBE = () => {
  const out = [];
  const vw = window.innerWidth;

  if (document.documentElement.scrollWidth - vw > 1) {
    out.push(`the page scrolls sideways by ${document.documentElement.scrollWidth - vw}px`);
  }

  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('a[href], button, [role="button"]')) {
    const s = getComputedStyle(el);
    if (s.visibility === 'hidden' || s.display === 'none') continue;
    if (s.position === 'fixed' || s.position === 'absolute') continue;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0) continue;
    const rawLabel = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.textContent || el.tagName)
      .toString()
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    const isAction =
      /^(Edit match record|Share match|Play media|Save Match Record|Update Match Record|Cancel)$/.test(
        rawLabel,
      );
    if (!isAction) continue;
    if (r.right > vw + 1 || r.left < -1) {
      out.push(`action "${rawLabel.slice(0, 40)}" is outside the ${vw}px viewport`);
    }
  }

  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) {
    const s = getComputedStyle(el);
    if (s.position === 'absolute' || s.position === 'fixed') continue;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width < 40 || r.height < 14) continue;

    // cut off by an ancestor that neither scrolls nor shows it
    let a = el.parentElement;
    while (a && a !== document.body) {
      const ox = getComputedStyle(a).overflowX;
      if (ox === 'auto' || ox === 'scroll') {
        a = null;
        break;
      }
      if (ox === 'hidden' || ox === 'clip') break;
      a = a.parentElement;
    }
    if (a) {
      const over = Math.round(r.right - a.getBoundingClientRect().right);
      if (over > 2) {
        out.push(
          `"${(el.textContent || el.className || '').toString().trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 40)}" is cut off ${over}px past its container`,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // a text block squeezed to a sliver is a collapsed flex child
  for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p')) {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = (el.textContent || '').trim();
    if (t.length > 45 && r.width > 0 && r.width < 100) {
      out.push(`text squeezed to ${Math.round(r.width)}px: "${t.slice(0, 40)}"`);
    }
  }

  const nav = document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="Mobile"]');
  const footer = document.querySelector('footer');
  if (
    nav &&
    footer &&
    footer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > nav.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1
  ) {
    out.push('the footer sits under the fixed bottom nav');
  }

  return [...new Set(out)].slice(0, 4);
};

const routes = discoverRoutes();
const totalChecks =
  routes.length * (WIDTHS.length * FONT_SCALES.length + DESKTOP_WIDTHS.length) * LANGUAGES.length;
console.log(
  `mobile gate: ${routes.length} routes x phone ${WIDTHS.join('/')}px + desktop ${DESKTOP_WIDTHS.join('/')}px x ${FONT_SCALES.map((s) => s + '%').join('/')} (100% on desktop) x ` +
    `${LANGUAGES.join('/')} = ${totalChecks} checks against ${BASE_URL}\n`,
);

let browser;
try {
  browser = await launchBrowser();
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Could not launch Chromium. Run: npx playwright install chromium');
  console.error(`  ${error.message.split('\n')[0]}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

let failures = 0;
const perLanguage = new Map();

for (const lang of LANGUAGES) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: WIDTHS[0], height: 800 } });
  await context.addCookies([{ name: LANGUAGE_COOKIE, value: lang, url: BASE_URL }]);
  const page = await context.newPage();

  let langChecks = 0;
  let langFailures = 0;

  for (const width of [...WIDTHS, ...DESKTOP_WIDTHS]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 800 });
    const isDesktop = DESKTOP_WIDTHS.includes(width);
    const scales = isDesktop ? [100] : FONT_SCALES;

    for (const scale of scales) {
      console.log(`  … ${lang} ${width}px ${scale}% (${routes.length} routes)`);
      for (const route of routes) {
        try {
          await page.goto(BASE_URL + route, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
          await page.waitForTimeout(700);

          if (scale !== 100) {
            await page.evaluate((s) => {
              document.documentElement.style.fontSize = `${s}%`;
            }, scale);
            await page.waitForTimeout(150);
          }

          const issues = await page.evaluate(PROBE);
          langChecks++;

          if (issues.length) {
            // Layout can still be settling (fonts, images, transitions). Re-check
            // once after a short settle and only fail on a persistent problem.
            await page.waitForTimeout(500);
            const confirmed = await page.evaluate(PROBE);
            if (confirmed.length) {
              failures++;
              langFailures++;
              console.error(`\u2717 ${lang} ${width}px ${scale}%  ${route}`);
              for (const issue of confirmed) console.error(`    ${issue}`);
            } else if (process.env.GATE_VERBOSE === 'true') {
              console.log(`\u2713 ${lang} ${width}px ${scale}%  ${route} (after settle)`);
            }
          } else if (process.env.GATE_VERBOSE === 'true') {
            console.log(`\u2713 ${lang} ${width}px ${scale}%  ${route}`);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          failures++;
          langFailures++;
          console.error(
            `\u2717 ${lang} ${width}px ${scale}%  ${route}\n    could not load: ${error.message.split('\n')[0].slice(0, 80)}`,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  perLanguage.set(lang, { checks: langChecks, failures: langFailures });
  await context.close();
}

await browser.close();

console.log('\nmobile gate checks per language:');
for (const [lang, stats] of perLanguage) {
  console.log(`  ${lang.padEnd(4)} ${stats.checks} checks, ${stats.failures} failing`);
}

if (failures) {
  console.error(
    `\nmobile gate failed: ${failures} route/width/scale/language combination(s) with layout problems`,
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`\nmobile gate passed: ${totalChecks} checks, no layout problems`);

/**
 * record-video.ts — records the GalloTrack video presentation scenes.
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/record-video.ts                 # all 13 scenes
 *   npx tsx scripts/record-video.ts --scene=S2,S6   # subset
 *   npx tsx scripts/record-video.ts --fast          # dress rehearsal (holds/zooms shortened)
 *
 * Output: recordings/raw/scene-NN-*.webm + recordings/manifest.json
 * (beat timestamps per step → align the live CapCut narration against them).
 * Convert/stitch with: node scripts/stitch-video.mjs
 *
 * Creds come from env (defaults = demo account): SMOKE_EMAIL / SMOKE_PASSWORD.
 * Never commit real credentials.
 *
 * Effects are injected via addInitScript(initEffects, cfg); tsx/esbuild
 * keepNames serializes functions with __name() wrappers that don't exist in
 * the page, so the string shim MUST be registered first on every context.
 */
import { chromium, type Browser, type Locator, type Page } from 'playwright';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { initEffects } from './video/effects';
import { findScenes, type Scene, type Step, type Target } from './video/scenes';

/* ------------------------------- config ---------------------------------- */

const envLocalPath = join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
const localEnv: Record<string, string> = {};
if (existsSync(envLocalPath)) {
  for (const line of readFileSync(envLocalPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    localEnv[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const BASE = process.env.SMOKE_BASE_URL || localEnv.SMOKE_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
const EMAIL = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL || localEnv.SMOKE_EMAIL;
const PASSWORD = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || localEnv.SMOKE_PASSWORD;

if (!EMAIL || !PASSWORD) {
  console.error('❌ Missing SMOKE_EMAIL or SMOKE_PASSWORD. Set them in .env.local or environment.');
  process.exit(1);
}
const OUT = process.env.REC_OUT || 'recordings';
const RAW = join(OUT, 'raw');
const AUTH_PATH = join(OUT, '.auth.json');
const MANIFEST = join(OUT, 'manifest.json');
const VIEWPORT = { width: 1920, height: 1080 } as const;
const SHIM = 'globalThis.__name = (fn) => fn;';

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const FAST = args.includes('--fast') || process.env.REC_FAST === '1';
const sceneArg = args.find((a) => a.startsWith('--scene='));
const onlyIds = sceneArg ? sceneArg.slice('--scene='.length).split(',') : undefined;

const hold = (ms: number) => (FAST ? Math.max(240, Math.round(ms * 0.12)) : ms);
const ZOOM_DUR = FAST ? 260 : 800;
const RESET_DUR = FAST ? 260 : 600;
const TYPE_DELAY = FAST ? 12 : 70;

/* --------------------------- playwright launch --------------------------- */

/** Same fallback the repo's mobile-gate.mjs uses: the cached browser build can
 *  lag the installed Playwright version, and launch() then refuses. */
function findCachedChromium(): string | null {
  const cache = join(process.env.USERPROFILE ?? process.env.HOME ?? '', 'AppData', 'Local', 'ms-playwright');
  if (!existsSync(cache)) return null;
  for (const entry of readdirSync(cache)) {
    if (!entry.startsWith('chromium')) continue;
    const dir = join(cache, entry);
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const sub of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = join(dir, sub);
      if (!statSync(full).isDirectory()) continue;
      const exe = ['headless_shell.exe', 'chrome.exe']
        .map((n) => join(full, n))
        .concat([
          join(full, 'chrome-win', 'headless_shell.exe'),
          join(full, 'chrome-win', 'chrome.exe'),
          join(full, 'chrome-win64', 'chrome.exe'),
        ])
        .find((p) => existsSync(p));
      if (exe) return exe;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function launch() {
  if (process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH) {
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH });
  }
  try {
    return await chromium.launch();
  } catch {
    const cached = findCachedChromium();
    if (!cached) throw new Error('no Chromium found; run: npx playwright install chromium');
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: cached });
  }
}

/* ------------------------------- helpers --------------------------------- */

function loc(page: Page, t: Target): Locator {
  let l: Locator;
  if ('css' in t) l = page.locator(t.css);
  else if ('role' in t) l = page.getByRole(t.role, { name: t.name });
  else l = page.getByText(t.text);
  return l.first();
}

function labelOf(step: Step): string {
  if (step.label) return step.label;
  switch (step.type) {
    case 'hold':
      return `hold ${step.ms}ms`;
    case 'reset':
      return 'zoom out';
    default:
      return step.type;
  }
}

/** Move the virtual cursor to a target (rAF lerp in the overlay follows mouse events). */
async function approach(page: Page, l: Locator): Promise<void> {
  const box = await l.boundingBox();
  if (box) {
    await page.mouse.move(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2, { steps: FAST ? 3 : 10 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 60 : 170);
  }
}

async function pulse(page: Page, l: Locator): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const el = await l.elementHandle({ timeout: 8000 });
    if (el) await page.evaluate((e: SVGElement | HTMLElement) => (window as unknown as GtWindow).__gt.pulse(e), el);
  } catch {
    /* pulse is cosmetic — never fail a scene for it */
  }
}

async function interactive(page: Page, l: Locator, doPulse: boolean): Promise<void> {
  if (doPulse) await pulse(page, l);
  await approach(page, l);
}

type GtWindow = {
  __gt: {
    focus: (el: Element | null, level: number, dur: number, noAnchor?: boolean) => Promise<null>;
    unfocus: (dur: number) => Promise<null>;
    scrollTo: (y: number, dur: number) => Promise<null>;
    scrollToBy: (dy: number, dur: number) => Promise<null>;
    scrollToEl: (el: Element | null, dur: number, frac?: number) => Promise<null>;
    pulse: (el: Element | null) => void;
    stats: () => { s: number; y: number; anchor: number | null };
  };
};

/* ------------------------------ step executor ---------------------------- */

async function exec(step: Step, page: Page): Promise<void> {
  switch (step.type) {
    case 'goto': {
      await page.goto(BASE + step.path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 45000 });
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 12000 }).catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 350 : 900);
      return;
    }
    case 'waitUrl': {
      await page.waitForURL(new RegExp(step.re), { timeout: 25000 });
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 300 : 900);
      return;
    }
    case 'nav': {
      const l = page.getByRole('link', { name: step.name }).first();
      await interactive(page, l, true);
      await l.click({ delay: 70 });
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 250 : 700);
      return;
    }
    case 'click':
    case 'tab':
    case 'htab': {
      const l = loc(page, step.type === 'click' ? step.target : { role: step.type === 'tab' ? 'tab' : 'button', name: step.name });
      await interactive(page, l, step.type !== 'click' || step.pulse !== false);
      await l.click({ delay: 70 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 220 : 550);
      return;
    }
    case 'type': {
      const l = loc(page, step.target);
      if (step.click !== false) await interactive(page, l, true);
      await l.pressSequentially(step.text, { delay: step.delay ?? TYPE_DELAY });
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 150 : 350);
      return;
    }
    case 'key': {
      await page.keyboard.press(step.key);
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 120 : 300);
      return;
    }
    case 'clickAt': {
      await page.mouse.move(step.x, step.y, { steps: FAST ? 3 : 10 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 60 : 200);
      await page.mouse.click(step.x, step.y, { delay: 70 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 200 : 500);
      return;
    }
    case 'hover': {
      const l = loc(page, step.target);
      await interactive(page, l, false);
      await l.hover();
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 150 : 350);
      return;
    }
    case 'zoom': {
      // stash the handle first: passing ElementHandles inside object args makes
      // Playwright's Unboxed<> instantiation explode (TS2589)
      if (step.target) {
        const h = await loc(page, step.target).elementHandle({ timeout: 12000 });
        if (!h) throw new Error(`zoom target not found: ${JSON.stringify(step.target)}`);
        await page.evaluate((e: SVGElement | HTMLElement) => {
          (window as unknown as { __gt_last?: Element }).__gt_last = e;
        }, h);
      }
      await page.evaluate((o: { level: number; dur: number; na: boolean; hasEl: boolean }) => {
        const w = window as unknown as GtWindow & { __gt_last?: Element };
        return w.__gt.focus(o.hasEl ? w.__gt_last ?? null : null, o.level, o.dur, o.na);
      }, { level: step.level, dur: ZOOM_DUR, na: !!step.noAnchor, hasEl: !!step.target });
      return;
    }
    case 'reset': {
      await page.evaluate((d: number) => (window as unknown as GtWindow).__gt.unfocus(d), step.dur ? hold(step.dur) : RESET_DUR);
      return;
    }
    case 'scroll': {
      const dur = step.dur ? hold(step.dur) : hold(800);
      if (step.target) {
        const h = await loc(page, step.target).elementHandle({ timeout: 12000 });
        if (!h) throw new Error(`scroll target not found: ${JSON.stringify(step.target)}`);
        await page.evaluate((e: SVGElement | HTMLElement) => {
          (window as unknown as { __gt_last?: Element }).__gt_last = e;
        }, h);
        await page.evaluate((o: { dur: number; frac: number }) => {
          const w = window as unknown as GtWindow & { __gt_last?: Element };
          return w.__gt.scrollToEl(w.__gt_last ?? null, o.dur, o.frac);
        }, { dur, frac: step.frac ?? 0.32 });
      } else {
        await page.evaluate(
          ([dy, d]: [number, number]) => (window as unknown as GtWindow).__gt.scrollToBy(dy, d),
          [step.by ?? 500, dur] as [number, number],
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    case 'select': {
      const css = 'css' in step.target ? step.target.css : (() => { throw new Error('select target must be {css}'); })();
      await page.evaluate(
        ([sel, value, match]: [string, string | null, string | null]) => {
          const s = document.querySelector(sel) as HTMLSelectElement | null;
          if (!s) throw new Error('select not found: ' + sel);
          const opts = Array.from(s.options);
          let chosen: HTMLOptionElement | undefined;
          if (value) chosen = opts.find((o) => o.value === value || o.text.trim() === value);
          if (!chosen && match) {
            const re = new RegExp(match, 'i');
            chosen = opts.find((o) => re.test(o.value) || re.test(o.text));
          }
          if (!chosen) {
            throw new Error(
              'no option matched in ' + sel + ' (value=' + value + ', match=' + match + '); options: ' +
                opts.map((o) => `${o.value}:"${o.text.trim()}"`).join(', '),
            );
          }
          s.value = chosen.value;
          s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        },
        [css, step.value ?? null, step.match ?? null] as [string, string | null, string | null],
      );
      await page.waitForTimeout(FAST ? 300 : 900);
      return;
    }
    case 'hold': {
      await page.waitForTimeout(hold(step.ms));
      return;
    }
  }
}

/* ------------------------------ scene runner ----------------------------- */

type SceneResult = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  file: string | null;
  durationMs: number;
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  consoleErrors: string[];
  beats: { tMs: number; label: string }[];
};

async function prepareContext(browser: Browser, scene: Scene): Promise<{ ctx: Awaited<ReturnType<Browser['newContext']>>; page: Page }> {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: VIEWPORT,
    recordVideo: { dir: RAW, size: VIEWPORT },
    storageState: scene.anonymous ? undefined : AUTH_PATH,
    acceptDownloads: true,
    locale: 'en-US',
    colorScheme: 'light',
  });
  await ctx.addInitScript({ content: SHIM });
  await ctx.addInitScript(initEffects, { headerPx: 64 });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  return { ctx, page };
}

async function runScene(browser: Browser, scene: Scene): Promise<SceneResult> {
  console.log(`\n=== ${scene.id} ${scene.title} ===`);
  const { ctx, page } = await prepareContext(browser, scene);
  const consoleErrors: string[] = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => consoleErrors.push(`pageerror: ${e.message}`));
  page.on('console', (m) => {
    if (m.type() === 'error') consoleErrors.push(`console: ${m.text().slice(0, 300)}`);
  });

  const t0 = Date.now();
  const beats: { tMs: number; label: string }[] = [];
  let ok = true;
  let error: string | undefined;

  for (const step of scene.steps) {
    const label = labelOf(step);
    beats.push({ tMs: Date.now() - t0, label });
    const secs = String(Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000)).padStart(3);
    try {
      await exec(step, page);
      console.log(`  [${scene.id} ${secs}s] ${label}`);
    } catch (e) {
      ok = false;
      error = `${label}: ${(e as Error).message.split('\n')[0].slice(0, 300)}`;
      console.error(`  [${scene.id} ${secs}s] FAIL ${error}`);
      break;
    }
  }

  const durationMs = Date.now() - t0;
  const video = page.video();
  await ctx.close();
  let file: string | null = null;
  if (video) {
    file = join(RAW, `${scene.slug}.webm`);
    await video.saveAs(file);
  }
  if (consoleErrors.length) console.log(`  [${scene.id}] ${consoleErrors.length} console error(s): ${consoleErrors[0]}`);
  console.log(`  → ${file ?? '(no video)'} (${(durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s, ${ok ? 'OK' : 'FAILED'})`);
  return { id: scene.id, title: scene.title, file, durationMs, ok, error, consoleErrors, beats };
}

/* --------------------------------- auth ---------------------------------- */

async function authenticate(browser: Browser): Promise<void> {
  console.log(`Authenticating ${EMAIL} against ${BASE} …`);
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: VIEWPORT });
  await ctx.addInitScript({ content: SHIM });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 45000 });
  await page.waitForSelector('#email-address', { timeout: 30000 });
  // wait for React hydration: filling pre-hydration gets clobbered by the
  // controlled re-render and the submit then just reloads /
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
  await page.waitForTimeout(900);
  let landed = false;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 3 && !landed; attempt++) {
    await page.fill('#email-address', EMAIL);
    await page.fill('#password', PASSWORD);
    if ((await page.inputValue('#email-address').catch(() => '')) !== EMAIL) {
      console.log(`  attempt ${attempt}: form not hydrated yet, retrying…`);
      await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
      continue;
    }
    await page.click('button[type=submit]');
    try {
      await page.waitForURL(/dashboard/, { timeout: 15000 });
      landed = true;
    } catch {
      console.log(`  attempt ${attempt}: no navigation after submit, retrying…`);
    }
  }
  if (!landed) throw new Error('login failed after 3 attempts — check credentials / Supabase');
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 12000 }).catch(() => {});
  await ctx.storageState({ path: AUTH_PATH });
  await ctx.close();
  console.log(`  session saved → ${AUTH_PATH}`);
}

async function warmRoutes(browser: Browser, scenes: Scene[]): Promise<void> {
  const paths = [...new Set(scenes.flatMap((s) => s.steps.filter((st): st is Extract<Step, { type: 'goto' }> => st.type === 'goto').map((st) => st.path)))];
  console.log(`Warming ${paths.length} route(s): ${paths.join(', ')}`);
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: VIEWPORT, storageState: AUTH_PATH });
  await ctx.addInitScript({ content: SHIM });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  for (const p of paths) {
    await page.goto(BASE + p, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 45000 }).catch(() => {});
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 12000 }).catch(() => {});
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
  }
  await ctx.close();
  console.log('  routes warm.');
}

/* --------------------------------- main ---------------------------------- */

async function main() {
  const scenes = findScenes(onlyIds);
  // fresh video dir per run — Playwright can leave hash-named temp copies that
  // would otherwise be picked up by the stitcher
  rmSync(RAW, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(RAW, { recursive: true });

  const browser = await launch();
  try {
    if (!sceneArg || !existsSync(AUTH_PATH)) await authenticate(browser);
    await warmRoutes(browser, scenes);

    const results: SceneResult[] = [];
    for (const scene of scenes) results.push(await runScene(browser, scene));

    // merge manifest (subset runs keep other scenes' entries)
    // tidy up: Playwright leaves hash-named temp copies next to our saveAs output
    for (const f of readdirSync(RAW)) {
      if (f.endsWith('.webm') && !f.startsWith('scene-')) rmSync(join(RAW, f), { force: true });
    }
    type Manifest = { generatedAt: string; scenes: Record<string, unknown> };
    const manifest: Manifest = existsSync(MANIFEST)
      ? (JSON.parse(readFileSync(MANIFEST, 'utf8')) as Manifest)
      : { generatedAt: '', scenes: {} };
    for (const r of results) {
      manifest.scenes[r.id] = {
        slug: r.id.toLowerCase(),
        title: r.title,
        file: r.file ? r.file.replace(/\\/g, '/') : null,
        durationMs: r.durationMs,
        ok: r.ok,
        error: r.error,
        consoleErrors: r.consoleErrors.slice(0, 10),
        beats: r.beats,
      };
    }
    manifest.generatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    writeFileSync(MANIFEST, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));

    console.log('\n--- summary ---');
    let failed = 0;
    for (const r of results) {
      const flag = r.ok ? 'OK   ' : 'FAIL ';
      if (!r.ok) failed++;
      console.log(`${flag} ${r.id.padEnd(4)} ${(r.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1).padStart(6)}s  ${r.title}${r.error ? `  ← ${r.error}` : ''}`);
    }
    console.log(`manifest → ${MANIFEST}`);
    if (failed) {
      console.error(`\n${failed} scene(s) failed.`);
      process.exitCode = 1;
    } else {
      console.log(`\nAll ${results.length} scene(s) recorded. Next: node scripts/stitch-video.mjs`);
    }
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * DATABASE & STORAGE RESTORE SCRIPT (WITH DRY-RUN & SAFETY GUARD)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   npx tsx scripts/restore-database.ts [--backup=<folder_name>] [--target=staging|production] [--execute]
 *
 * Safety Rules & Guardrails:
 *   1. Runs in DRY-RUN mode by default unless --execute is passed.
 *   2. Refuses to run against production unless --confirm-restore-to-production-DANGER is passed.
 *   3. Refuses a live restore into a database that already contains the owner's rows unless
 *      --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data is passed.
 *   4. Explicit Post-Restore Sequence Reset:
 *      PostgreSQL serial sequences are NOT automatically advanced by REST inserts with explicit IDs.
 *      Post-restore SQL script must be run to avoid duplicate key errors.
 */

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(ENV_PATH)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const getArg = (name: string) => {
  const match = args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`));
  return match ? match.slice(name.length + 3) : null;
};
const hasFlag = (flag: string) => args.includes(`--${flag}`);

if (hasFlag('help') || hasFlag('h')) {
  console.log(`
================================================================================
🚨 GALLOTRACK DATABASE & STORAGE RESTORE UTILITY
================================================================================

Usage:
  npx tsx scripts/restore-database.ts [options]

Options:
  --backup=<folder_name>                     Path or name of backup folder in backups/ (default: latest backup)
  --target=staging|production                Target database environment (default: staging)
  --execute                                  Execute live restore (default is dry-run mode)
  --confirm-restore-to-production-DANGER     Required safety flag when target is production
  --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data      Required when target DB already has rows for the owner
  --help, -h                                 Show this help screen

Safety Rules & Guardrails:
  1. Dry-Run By Default:
     Inspects manifests, table row counts, and storage files without writing anything to the database or storage.
  2. Production Protection:
     Refuses live execution against production unless --confirm-restore-to-production-DANGER is explicitly passed.
  3. Existing Owner Data Guard:
     Refuses a live restore if the target database already contains existing rows for the backup owner.
     Pass --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data only if you intend to merge or overwrite into an existing dataset.
  4. Mandatory Post-Restore Sequence Reset:
     Because PostgreSQL serial sequences (e.g. fowl_id_seq, match_id_seq) do not auto-advance during explicit-ID
     REST inserts, you MUST execute the following SQL in Supabase SQL editor after every live restore:
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('match', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM match;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('breeding_pairings', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM breeding_pairings;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('safety_incidents', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM safety_incidents;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl_status_history', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl_status_history;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('share_links', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM share_links;
       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('admin_audit_logs', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM admin_audit_logs;
================================================================================
`);
  process.exit(0);
}

const backupFolderArg = getArg('backup');
const targetEnv = getArg('target') || 'staging';
const isDryRun = !hasFlag('execute');
const confirmedProd = hasFlag('confirm-restore-to-production-DANGER');
const allowOverwriteExistingOwnerData = hasFlag('allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data');

function getAllFilesRecursively(dir: string, baseDir: string = dir): string[] {
  let results: string[] = [];
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return results;
  const list = fs.readdirSync(dir);
  for (const file of list) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
    const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
    if (stat && stat.isDirectory()) {
      results = results.concat(getAllFilesRecursively(fullPath, baseDir));
    } else {
      results.push(path.relative(baseDir, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

async function restore() {
  console.log(`=======================================================`);
  console.log(`🚨 GALLOTRACK DATABASE & STORAGE RESTORE UTILITY`);
  console.log(`=======================================================`);

  const backupsParentDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../backups');
  if (!fs.existsSync(backupsParentDir)) {
    console.error(`❌ Error: No backups directory found at ${backupsParentDir}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  let selectedBackupDir: string;
  if (backupFolderArg) {
    selectedBackupDir = path.isAbsolute(backupFolderArg)
      ? backupFolderArg
      : path.join(backupsParentDir, backupFolderArg);
  } else {
    // Pick latest backup directory
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(backupsParentDir).filter((d) => d.startsWith('backup-')).sort().reverse();
    if (entries.length === 0) {
      console.error(`❌ Error: No backup folders starting with 'backup-' found in ${backupsParentDir}`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
    selectedBackupDir = path.join(backupsParentDir, entries[0]);
  }

  if (!fs.existsSync(selectedBackupDir)) {
    console.error(`❌ Error: Specified backup folder does not exist: ${selectedBackupDir}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const dbJsonPath = path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'database.json');
  const manifestPath = path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'manifest.json');
  const metadataPath = path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'metadata.json');

  if (!fs.existsSync(dbJsonPath)) {
    console.error(`❌ Error: database.json missing in backup directory ${selectedBackupDir}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const dbData: Record<string, any[]> = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dbJsonPath, 'utf8'));
  const manifest = fs.existsSync(manifestPath)
    ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'))
    : fs.existsSync(metadataPath)
    ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(metadataPath, 'utf8'))
    : null;

  // Determine target URL and key
  let targetUrl = '';
  let targetKey = '';

  if (targetEnv === 'production') {
    targetUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    targetKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

    if (!confirmedProd && !isDryRun) {
      console.error(`\n⛔ PRODUCTION RESTORE SAFETY BLOCK:`);
      console.error(`   Target environment is PRODUCTION (${targetUrl}).`);
      console.error(`   Restoring to production will OVERWRITE current production data!`);
      console.error(`   To execute, you MUST pass: --confirm-restore-to-production-DANGER\n`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  } else {
    // Default to staging
    targetUrl = process.env.STAGING_SUPABASE_URL || env.STAGING_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
    targetKey = process.env.STAGING_SUPABASE_KEY || env.STAGING_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  }

  if (!targetUrl || !targetKey) {
    console.error('❌ Error: Missing target URL or service role key.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log(`\nBackup Folder: ${path.basename(selectedBackupDir)}`);
  console.log(`Backup Timestamp: ${manifest?.timestamp || 'Unknown'}`);
  console.log(`Owner Scope: ${manifest?.ownerScope || 'All Users'}`);
  console.log(`Target Environment: ${targetEnv.toUpperCase()}`);
  console.log(`Target Supabase Host: ${new URL(targetUrl).hostname}`);
  console.log(`Execution Mode: ${isDryRun ? '🔍 DRY-RUN (No changes will be made)' : '⚡ LIVE EXECUTION'}\n`);

  console.log(`--- EXPECTED RESTORE ROW COUNTS ---`);
  let totalRows = 0;
  for (const [table, rows] of Object.entries(dbData)) {
    console.log(`  • Table '${table}': ${rows.length} rows to restore`);
    totalRows += rows.length;
  }
  console.log(`  Total: ${totalRows} rows across ${Object.keys(dbData).length} tables`);

  const storageDir = path.join(selectedBackupDir, 'storage');
  const storageFilesByBucket: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  let totalFiles = 0;

  if (fs.existsSync(storageDir)) {
    console.log(`\n--- EXPECTED RESTORE STORAGE BUCKETS ---`);
    for (const bDir of fs.readdirSync(storageDir)) {
      const bPath = path.join(storageDir, bDir);
      if (fs.statSync(bPath).isDirectory()) {
        const files = getAllFilesRecursively(bPath);
        storageFilesByBucket[bDir] = files;
        totalFiles += files.length;
        console.log(`  • Bucket '${bDir}': ${files.length} file(s) to restore`);
        for (const f of files.slice(0, 5)) {
          console.log(`      - ${f}`);
        }
        if (files.length > 5) {
          console.log(`      ... and ${files.length - 5} more`);
        }
      }
    }
    console.log(`  Total: ${totalFiles} storage file(s) across ${Object.keys(storageFilesByBucket).length} bucket(s)`);
  }

  // Define strict dependency restore order: parents before children
  const restoreOrder = [
    'system_settings',
    'profiles',
    'farms',
    'strains',
    'leg_colors',
    'registry_options',
    'user_settings',
    'fowl',
    'fowl_identifier_counters',
    'safety_incidents',
    'breeding_pairings',
    'match',
    'match_photos',
    'match_videos',
    'fowl_photos',
    'fowl_status_history',
    'share_links',
    'admin_audit_logs',
  ];

  const allTablesToRestore = Array.from(new Set([...restoreOrder, ...Object.keys(dbData)]));

  if (isDryRun) {
    console.log(`\n=======================================================`);
    console.log(`🔍 DRY-RUN RESTORATION PLAN & ANALYSIS`);
    console.log(`=======================================================`);
    console.log(`1. TABLE RESTORATION ORDER (Parents before Children):`);
    let orderIndex = 1;
    for (const table of allTablesToRestore) {
      const count = (dbData[table] || []).length;
      if (count > 0 || Object.keys(dbData).includes(table)) {
        console.log(`   ${orderIndex++}. '${table}' (${count} rows)`);
      }
    }
    console.log(`   Dependency Rules:`);
    console.log(`     • profiles is restored before dependent user records.`);
    console.log(`     • fowl is restored before breeding_pairings, match, and fowl_status_history.`);
    console.log(`     • match is restored before match_videos and match_photos.`);

    console.log(`\n2. POST-RESTORE SEQUENCE RESET (EXPLICIT MANDATORY STEP):`);
    console.log(`   ⚠️ CRITICAL: Standard PostgREST/Supabase REST explicit-ID inserts DO NOT`);
    console.log(`      reset or advance the PostgreSQL serial/identity sequences (e.g., fowl_id_seq).`);
    console.log(`   • If explicit-ID inserts are executed without resetting sequences, subsequent`);
    console.log(`     application inserts will trigger duplicate key errors (fowl_pkey collision).`);
    console.log(`   • MANDATORY POST-RESTORE SQL SCRIPT to execute in Supabase SQL editor:`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('match', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM match;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('breeding_pairings', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM breeding_pairings;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('safety_incidents', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM safety_incidents;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl_status_history', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl_status_history;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('share_links', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM share_links;`);
    console.log(`       SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('admin_audit_logs', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM admin_audit_logs;`);

    console.log(`\n3. EXISTING DATA SAFETY GUARD:`);
    console.log(`   • A real restore (--execute) will verify if the target database already contains`);
    console.log(`     rows for the backup owner. If rows exist, it refuses to restore unless`);
    console.log(`     --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data is provided.`);

    console.log(`\n4. SUMMARY:`);
    console.log(`   Database tables ready: ${Object.keys(dbData).length} (${totalRows} rows)`);
    console.log(`   Storage files ready: ${totalFiles} objects`);
    console.log(`   NO CHANGES WERE APPLIED to ${targetEnv.toUpperCase()}.`);
    console.log(`=======================================================\n`);
    return;
  }

  // Live execution
  const supabase = createClient(targetUrl, targetKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });

  // Safety Gate: Refuse real restore into database with existing owner rows unless flag is given
  const targetOwnerId =
    manifest?.ownerScope && manifest.ownerScope !== 'All Users'
      ? manifest.ownerScope
      : (dbData['fowl']?.[0]?.user_id || null);

  if (targetOwnerId) {
    console.log(`Verifying target database state for owner '${targetOwnerId}'...`);
    const { count, error: countErr } = await supabase
      .from('fowl')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('user_id', targetOwnerId);

    if (countErr) {
      console.warn(`  ⚠️ Could not verify existing fowl count: ${countErr.message}`);
    } else if (count !== null && count > 0) {
      if (!allowOverwriteExistingOwnerData) {
        console.error(`\n⛔ EXISTING OWNER DATA SAFETY BLOCK:`);
        console.error(`   Target database already contains ${count} fowl row(s) for owner '${targetOwnerId}'.`);
        console.error(`   A live restore into a database containing existing owner rows will cause key conflicts or mixed states.`);
        console.error(`   To proceed with overwriting/merging into existing data, you MUST provide:`);
        console.error(`     --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data\n`);
        process.exit(1);
      } else {
        console.log(`  ⚠️ Notice: Target database contains ${count} existing fowl row(s). Flag --allow-overwrite-existing-owner-data was provided; proceeding.`);
      }
    } else {
      console.log(`  ✓ Target database is clean (0 existing fowl rows for owner '${targetOwnerId}').`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`\n--- EXECUTING DATABASE RESTORE ---`);
  // Tables will be restored in the pre-defined restoreOrder (parents before children)

  for (const table of allTablesToRestore) {
    const rows = dbData[table] || [];
    if (rows.length === 0) continue;
    console.log(`  Restoring ${rows.length} rows into '${table}'...`);

    // Upsert in batches of 100
    const batchSize = 100;
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += batchSize) {
      const batch = rows.slice(i, i + batchSize);
      const { error } = await supabase.from(table).upsert(batch);
      if (error) {
        console.error(`    ❌ Error restoring table '${table}': ${error.message}`);
      }
    }
    console.log(`  ✓ Restored table '${table}'`);
  }

  // Restore Storage Files
  if (fs.existsSync(storageDir)) {
    console.log(`\n--- EXECUTING STORAGE RESTORE ---`);
    for (const [bucket, files] of Object.entries(storageFilesByBucket)) {
      console.log(`  Restoring ${files.length} objects into bucket '${bucket}'...`);

      for (const relPath of files) {
        const filePath = path.join(storageDir, bucket, relPath);
        const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
        const { error } = await supabase.storage.from(bucket).upload(relPath, fileContent, { upsert: true });
        if (error) {
          console.warn(`    ⚠️ Failed uploading ${relPath} to bucket '${bucket}': ${error.message}`);
        }
      }
      console.log(`  ✓ Restored bucket '${bucket}'`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`\n=======================================================`);
  console.log(`✅ RESTORE COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY`);
  console.log(`=======================================================`);
  console.log(`MANDATORY NEXT STEP: Run sequence reset SQL in Supabase SQL editor:`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('match', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM match;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('breeding_pairings', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM breeding_pairings;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('safety_incidents', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM safety_incidents;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('fowl_status_history', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM fowl_status_history;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('share_links', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM share_links;`);
  console.log(`  SELECT setval(pg_get_serial_sequence('admin_audit_logs', 'id'), coalesce(max(id), 1)) FROM admin_audit_logs;\n`);
}

restore().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Fatal restore error:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

/**
 * PRODUCTION SAFETY GUARD MODULE
 * Prevents accidental execution of destructive scripts (reset, seed, delete, migrate-down)
 * against the production environment.
 */

const ENV_PATH = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(ENV_PATH)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

export function assertSafeExecution(scriptName: string) {
  const currentAppEnv = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV || 'development';
  const targetUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || '';
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const hasOverrideFlag = args.includes('--I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-WILL-MUTATE-PRODUCTION');

  const isProductionTarget =
    currentAppEnv.toLowerCase() === 'production' ||
    targetUrl.includes('supabase.co'); // Production Supabase project

  if (isProductionTarget && !hasOverrideFlag) {
    console.error(`\n⛔ PRODUCTION DESTRUCTIVE SCRIPT SAFETY GUARD BLOCKED THIS ACTION!`);
    console.error(`   Script '${scriptName}' requested execution against PRODUCTION.`);
    console.error(`   Environment: ${currentAppEnv.toUpperCase()}`);
    console.error(`   Target URL: ${targetUrl.slice(0, 25)}...`);
    console.error(`\n   Destructive operations (seed, reset, delete, migrate-down) are blocked by default.`);
    console.error(`   To force execution against production, you MUST pass the explicit flag:`);
    console.error(`     --I-UNDERSTAND-THIS-WILL-MUTATE-PRODUCTION\n`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  if (isProductionTarget && hasOverrideFlag) {
    console.warn(`\n⚠️ WARNING: EXECUTING DESTRUCTIVE SCRIPT '${scriptName}' AGAINST PRODUCTION WITH OVERRIDE FLAG!\n`);
  }
}

const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const envContent = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf-8');
const envVars: Record<string, string> = {};
envContent.split('\n').forEach((line) => {
  const trimmed = line.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) return;
  const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
  if (eqIdx === -1) return;
  const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
  let val = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();
  if ((val.startsWith('"') && val.endsWith('"')) || (val.startsWith("'") && val.endsWith("'"))) {
    val = val.slice(1, -1);
  }
  envVars[key] = val;
});

async function main() {
  console.log('╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
  console.log('║        GalloTrack Supabase Seed Script                  ║');
  console.log('╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n');

  // ─── 1. Create test user ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('1️⃣  Creating test user...');
  const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.admin.createUser({
    email: TEST_EMAIL,
    password: TEST_PASSWORD,
    email_confirm: true,
    user_metadata: {
      first_name: 'Farm',
      last_name: 'Owner',
      farm_name: TEST_FARM_NAME,
      contact_number: '09171234567',
    },
  });

  let userId: string;
  if (authErr) {
    // User may already exist — try to sign in
    console.log(`   ⚠️  User may already exist: ${authErr.message}`);
    console.log('   Trying to fetch existing user...');
    const { data: users } = await supabase.auth.admin.listUsers();
    const existing = users?.users?.find((u) => u.email === TEST_EMAIL);
    if (existing) {
      userId = existing.id;
      console.log(`   ✅ Found existing user: ${userId}`);
    } else {
      console.error('   ❌ Failed to create or find user. Aborting.');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  } else {
    userId = authData.user.id;
    console.log(`   ✅ Created user: ${userId}`);
  }

  // ─── 2. Clean existing data for this user ───────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n2️⃣  Cleaning existing data...');
  await supabase.from('match').delete().eq('user_id', userId);
  await supabase.from('fowl').delete().eq('user_id', userId);
  console.log('   ✅ Cleared old fowl and match records.');

  // ─── 3. Insert foundation sires ─────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n3️⃣  Inserting foundation sires...');

  interface SeedFowlRow {
    user_id: string;
    name: string;
    breed: string;
    gender: string;
    color: string;
    color_category: string;
    growth_stage: string;
    behavior_trait: string;
    eye_variant: string;
    birthdate: string;
    age: string;
    weight: string;
    height: string;
    leg_color: string;
    sire: string;
    dam: string;
    sire_pct: number;
    dam_pct: number;
    bloodline_pct: number;
    bird_code?: string;
    bloodline_composition?: Record<string, number>;
    status: string;
    image_url: string;
    archive_reason?: string;
    archive_date?: string;
    death_reason?: string;
    death_date?: string;
  }

  const fowlRows: SeedFowlRow[] = [];
  const birdMap = new Map<string, SeedFowlRow>();

  for (const s of FOUNDATION_SIRES) {
    const row = {
      user_id: userId,
      name: s.name,
      breed: s.breed,
      gender: s.gender,
      color: s.color,
      color_category: s.color_category,
      growth_stage: 'Cock',
      behavior_trait: s.behavior_trait,
      eye_variant: s.eye_variant,
      birthdate: s.birthdate,
      age: '24 Months',
      weight: `${s.weight} kg`,
      height: `${s.height} cm`,
      leg_color: s.leg_color,
      sire: 'Foundation Stock',
      dam: 'Foundation Stock',
      sire_pct: 100,
      dam_pct: 100,
      bloodline_pct: 100,
      status: 'Active',
      image_url: '',
    };
    fowlRows.push(row);
    birdMap.set(s.name, row);
  }

  // ─── 4. Insert foundation hens ──────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('   Inserting foundation hens...');
  for (const h of FOUNDATION_HENS) {
    const row = {
      user_id: userId,
      name: h.name,
      breed: h.breed,
      gender: h.gender,
      color: h.color,
      color_category: h.color_category,
      growth_stage: 'Hen',
      behavior_trait: h.behavior_trait,
      eye_variant: h.eye_variant,
      birthdate: h.birthdate,
      age: '20 Months',
      weight: `${h.weight} kg`,
      height: `${h.height} cm`,
      leg_color: h.leg_color,
      sire: 'Foundation Stock',
      dam: 'Foundation Stock',
      sire_pct: 100,
      dam_pct: 100,
      bloodline_pct: 100,
      status: 'Active',
      image_url: '',
    };
    fowlRows.push(row);
    birdMap.set(h.name, row);
  }

  // ─── 5. Insert offspring ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('   Inserting offspring...');
  for (const o of OFFSPRING) {
    const sirePct = birdMap.get(o.sire)?.bloodline_pct ?? 100;
    const damPct = birdMap.get(o.dam)?.bloodline_pct ?? 100;
    const bloodlinePct = Math.round(((sirePct + damPct) / 2) * 100) / 100;

    const row = {
      user_id: userId,
      name: o.name,
      breed: o.breed,
      gender: o.gender,
      color: o.color,
      color_category: o.color_category,
      growth_stage: o.gender === 'Rooster' ? 'Cock' : 'Hen',
      behavior_trait: o.behavior_trait,
      eye_variant: o.eye_variant,
      birthdate: o.birthdate,
      age: '12 Months',
      weight: `${o.weight} kg`,
      height: `${o.height} cm`,
      leg_color: o.leg_color,
      sire: o.sire,
      dam: o.dam,
      sire_pct: sirePct,
      dam_pct: damPct,
      bloodline_pct: bloodlinePct,
      status: 'Active',
      image_url: '',
    };
    fowlRows.push(row);
    birdMap.set(o.name, row);
  }

  // ─── Mark special statuses ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const retiredRow = birdMap.get('Retired Champion');
  if (retiredRow) {
    retiredRow.status = 'Archived';
    retiredRow.archive_reason = 'Retired from active competition';
    retiredRow.archive_date = '2025-03-01';
  }
  const fallenRow = birdMap.get('Fallen Hero');
  if (fallenRow) {
    fallenRow.status = 'Deceased';
    fallenRow.death_reason = 'Died from injuries after championship match';
    fallenRow.death_date = '2025-03-01';
  }

  // ─── Genetics: standardized bird codes + per-strain bloodline breakdown ───
  const geneticsInput = fowlRows.map((r, i) => ({ ...r, id: i + 1 })) as unknown as FowlRecord[];
  const seedCodes = resolveBirdCodes(geneticsInput);
  const seedCompositions = computeAllCompositions(geneticsInput);
  fowlRows.forEach((row, i) => {
    const key = String(i + 1);
    const composition = seedCompositions.get(key);
    const stats = composition ? getBloodlineStats(composition) : null;
    const code = seedCodes.get(key);
    if (code) row.bird_code = code;
    if (stats && composition) {
      row.bloodline_composition = composition;
      row.bloodline_pct = stats.specificPct;
    }
  });

  // Bulk insert all fowl
  const { error: fowlInsertErr } = await supabase.from('fowl').insert(fowlRows);
  if (fowlInsertErr) {
    console.error('   ❌ Fowl insert error:', fowlInsertErr.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`   ✅ Inserted ${fowlRows.length} fowl records.`);

  // ─── 6. Insert match records ────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n4️⃣  Inserting match records...');
  const matchRows = MATCHES.map((m) => ({
    user_id: userId,
    date: m.date,
    entry_name: m.entry_name,
    breed: birdMap.get(m.entry_name)?.breed || 'Unknown',
    opponent: m.opponent,
    opponent_breed: m.opponent_breed || '',
    location: m.location,
    type: m.type,
    outcome: m.outcome,
    status: 'Verified',
    post_fight_condition: m.post_fight_condition,
    video_url: null,
  }));

  const { error: matchInsertErr } = await supabase.from('match').insert(matchRows);
  if (matchInsertErr) {
    console.error('   ❌ Match insert error:', matchInsertErr.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`   ✅ Inserted ${matchRows.length} match records.`);

  // ─── 7. Seed genetic strains ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  console.log('\n5️⃣  Seeding genetic strains...');
  const STRAIN_LIST = ['Sweater', 'Hatch', 'Roundhead', 'Kelso', 'Lemon 84', 'Albany', 'Claret', 'Whitehackle', 'Black', 'Melsin', 'Bennie', 'Joe Madigin'];
  
  const { data: existingStrains } = await supabase.from('strains').select('name');
  const existingNames = existingStrains?.map((s: { name: string }) => s.name.toLowerCase()) || [];
  const missingStrains = STRAIN_LIST.filter(s => !existingNames.includes(s.toLowerCase()));
  
  if (missingStrains.length > 0) {
    const { error: strainErr } = await supabase.from('strains').insert(
      missingStrains.map(name => ({ name, is_custom: false }))
    );
    if (strainErr) {
      console.error('   ⚠️  Strain insert warning:', strainErr.message);
    } else {
      console.log(`   ✅ Inserted ${missingStrains.length} strains: ${missingStrains.join(', ')}`);
    }
  } else {
    console.log('   ✅ All strains already exist.');
  }

  // ─── 8. Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const wins = MATCHES.filter((m) => m.outcome === 'Win').length;
  const losses = MATCHES.filter((m) => m.outcome === 'Loss').length;
  const deceased = MATCHES.filter((m) => m.post_fight_condition.includes('Deceased')).length;
  const critical = MATCHES.filter((m) => m.post_fight_condition.includes('Critical') || m.post_fight_condition.includes('Severely')).length;

  console.log('\n╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗');
  console.log('║              SEED COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY                ║');
  console.log('╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣');
  console.log(`║  👤 User:       ${TEST_EMAIL}`);
  console.log(`║  🔑 Password:   ${TEST_PASSWORD}`);
  console.log('║');
  console.log(`║  🐓 Fowl Total: ${fowlRows.length}`);
  console.log(`║     Foundation Sires:     ${FOUNDATION_SIRES.length}`);

async function post(token: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/fowl`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json: any = null;
  try { json = JSON.parse(text); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return { status: res.status, json, text };
}

    if (signInErr) throw new Error(`signIn: ${signInErr.message}`);

    record(
      'A. auto combination code',
      a.status === 201 && aRow?.bird_code === '91Ax92B',
      `status ${a.status}, code ${aRow?.bird_code ?? '(walang row)'} (expected 91Ax92B)`
    );
    record(
      'A2. 50/50 composition persisted',
      a.status === 201 && JSON.stringify(aRow?.bloodline_composition) === JSON.stringify({ Hatch: 50, Sweater: 50 }),
      `composition ${JSON.stringify(aRow?.bloodline_composition)}, bloodline_pct ${aRow?.bloodline_pct}`
    );

    const b = await post(token, { name: 'Smoke Dup Child', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Hen', sire: 'Smoke Sire', dam: 'Smoke Dam', bird_code: '91Ax92B' });
    record('B. duplicate code -> 409', b.status === 409, `status ${b.status} · ${b.json?.error ?? b.text.slice(0, 80)}`);

    const b2 = await post(token, { name: 'Smoke Dup Parent', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Hen', bird_code: '91A' });
    record('B2. parent code reused -> 409', b2.status === 409, `status ${b2.status} · ${b2.json?.error ?? ''}`);

    // ── Case C: invalid characters rejected (400) ───────────────────────────
    const c = await post(token, { name: 'Smoke Bad Char', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Hen', bird_code: '1A/B' });
    record('C. invalid chars -> 400', c.status === 400, `status ${c.status} · ${c.json?.error ?? ''}`);

    // ── Case D: over-length rejected (400) ──────────────────────────────────
    const d = await post(token, { name: 'Smoke Too Long', breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Hen', bird_code: 'a'.repeat(25) });
    record('D. 25-char code -> 400', d.status === 400, `status ${d.status} · ${d.json?.error ?? ''}`);

    const e = await post(token, { name: 'Smoke Manual', breed: 'Kelso', gender: 'Rooster', bird_code: 'ZZ9' });

    // ── Case F: DB-level unique index actually fires ────────────────────────
    const childA = await readRow('Smoke Child A');
    let fOk = false;
    let fDetail = 'hindi na-abot';
    if (childA) {
      const { error: dupErr } = await admin.from('fowl').update({ bird_code: '91A' }).eq('id', childA.id);
      fOk = dupErr?.code === '23505' || /duplicate key/i.test(dupErr?.message || '');
      fDetail = dupErr ? `${dupErr.code ?? ''} ${dupErr.message}` : 'walang error — index hindi tumama!';
    }
    record('F. unique index blocks duplicate', fOk, fDetail);

    // ── Case G: missing required field rejected (400) ───────────────────────
    const g = await post(token, { breed: 'Hatch', gender: 'Hen' });
    record('G. missing name -> 400', g.status === 400, `status ${g.status} · ${g.json?.error ?? ''}`);
  } finally {
    if (uid) {
      const { error: delRows } = await admin.from('fowl').delete().eq('user_id', uid);
      if (delRows) console.log('cleanup rows ERROR:', delRows.message);
      const { error: delUser } = await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(uid);
      if (delUser) console.log('cleanup user ERROR:', delUser.message);
      console.log(`\nCleanup: tinanggal ang test user (${EMAIL}) at lahat ng row niya.`);
    }
  }

  const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
  console.log(`\n${results.length - failed.length}/${results.length} cases passed`);
  if (failed.length) process.exit(1);
}

/**
 * smoke-record-pages.ts — verify every page in the video script renders
 * while authenticated, before we spend time recording it.
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/smoke-record-pages.ts
 *
 * Credentials come from env (defaults are the demo account) — do not commit
 * real credentials; set SMOKE_EMAIL / SMOKE_PASSWORD instead.
 */
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { existsSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

/** Same fallback the repo's mobile-gate.mjs uses: the cached browser build
 * can lag the installed Playwright version, and launch() then refuses. */
function findCachedChromium(): string | null {
  const cache = join(process.env.USERPROFILE ?? process.env.HOME ?? '', 'AppData', 'Local', 'ms-playwright');
  if (!existsSync(cache)) return null;
  for (const entry of readdirSync(cache)) {
    if (!entry.startsWith('chromium')) continue;
    const dir = join(cache, entry);
    if (!statSync(dir).isDirectory()) continue;
    for (const sub of readdirSync(dir)) {
      const full = join(dir, sub);
      if (!statSync(full).isDirectory()) continue;
      const exe = ['headless_shell.exe', 'chrome.exe']
        .map((n) => join(full, n))
        .concat([
          join(full, 'chrome-win', 'headless_shell.exe'),
          join(full, 'chrome-win', 'chrome.exe'),
          join(full, 'chrome-win64', 'chrome.exe'),
        ])
        .find((p) => existsSync(p));
      if (exe) return exe;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function launch() {
  if (process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH) {
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH });
  }
  try {
    return await chromium.launch();
  } catch {
    const cached = findCachedChromium();
    if (!cached) throw new Error('no Chromium found; run: npx playwright install chromium');
    return chromium.launch({ executablePath: cached });
  }
}

const envLocalPath = join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
const localEnv: Record<string, string> = {};
if (existsSync(envLocalPath)) {
  const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
  for (const line of readFileSync(envLocalPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    localEnv[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const BASE = process.env.SMOKE_BASE_URL || localEnv.SMOKE_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
const EMAIL = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL || localEnv.SMOKE_EMAIL;
const PASSWORD = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || localEnv.SMOKE_PASSWORD;

if (!EMAIL || !PASSWORD) {
  console.error('❌ Missing SMOKE_EMAIL or SMOKE_PASSWORD. Set them in .env.local or environment.');
  process.exit(1);
}

/** [scene, path, mustContain (optional text proving the page rendered)] */
const PAGES: [string, string, string?][] = [
  ['S1 Login', '/'],
  ['S2 Dashboard', '/dashboard', 'Overall Win Rate'],
  ['S3 Registry', '/profiling', 'Breeding Male'],
  ['S5 Inventory', '/catalog'],
  ['S6 Lineage', '/lineage'],
  ['S7 Breeding Hub', '/breeding', 'Coding System'],
  ['S10 Match stats', '/dashboard', 'Total Matches'],
  ['S13 Conclusion', '/dashboard', 'GALLO'],
];

async function main() {
  const browser = await launch();
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
  const failures: string[] = [];

  const record = async (scene: string, needle?: string) => {
    // give client-side data fetches time to land (cold loads take >1.5s)
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle').catch(() => {});
    if (needle) {
      await page
        .getByText(needle, { exact: false })
        .first()
        .waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 10000 })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    const url = page.url();
    const fullText = await page.locator('body').innerText().catch(() => '');
    const body = fullText.slice(0, 400);
    const bouncedToLogin = url.includes('/?redirect') || url.endsWith('/') && !scene.includes('Login');
    const err = (await page.locator('text=/error|failed|exception/i').count().catch(() => 0)) > 0;
    // CSS text-transform uppercases many labels, so compare case-insensitively.
    // Search the whole page text, not the 400-char head used for display.
    const ok = !bouncedToLogin && (!needle || fullText.toLowerCase().includes(needle.toLowerCase()));
    const status = ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
    console.log(`${status}  ${scene.padEnd(18)} ${url}${ok ? '' : ` (needle=${needle ?? '-'}, bounced=${bouncedToLogin}, errText=${err})`}`);
    if (!ok) failures.push(scene);
  };

  // Scene 1: login page itself
  await page.goto(BASE + '/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await record('S1 Login');

  // Authenticated flow: sign in the same way the app does
  await page.fill('#email-address', EMAIL);
  await page.fill('#password', PASSWORD);
  await page.click('button[type=submit]');
  await page.waitForURL(/dashboard/, { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => {});
  await record('S2 Dashboard', 'Overall Win Rate');

  for (const [scene, path, needle] of PAGES.slice(2)) {
    await page.goto(BASE + path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
    // SPA nav from the sidebar is what the video does; direct nav is close enough for a render check
    await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
    await record(scene, needle);
  }

  // Browser console errors — anything here will show up as a red overlay in the video
  await browser.close();

  if (failures.length) {
    console.error(`\n${failures.length} page(s) failed: ${failures.join(', ')}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('\nAll script pages render — safe to record.');
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
