#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * The six CI gates from docs/GalloTrack-UI-Standard.html §08.
 *
 * Gates 1-4 are static scans implemented here. Gates 5-6 are real tooling and
 * are invoked by `npm run gate` (eslint with jsx-a11y, then vitest with axe).
 *
 * Every scan is RATCHETED against scripts/standard-gates.baseline.json: the
 * recorded count per file is the ceiling, and the gate fails only when a file
 * gets worse. That lets the gate land mid-migration instead of blocking on the
 * hundreds of pre-existing violations — the baseline shrinks as PR 5 and 6
 * remove them, and it can never grow.
 *
 *   node scripts/standard-gates.mjs            # check against the baseline
 *   node scripts/standard-gates.mjs --update   # re-record the baseline
 */

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = join(fileURLToPath(new URL('.', import.meta.url)), '..');
const baselinePath = join(root, 'scripts', 'standard-gates.baseline.json');
const SCAN_DIRS = ['app', 'components'];
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.next', 'out', 'build', 'dist']);

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = readdirSync(dir);
  } catch {
    return out;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (SKIP_DIRS.has(entry)) continue;
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

function countMatches(source, pattern) {
  const hits = source.match(pattern);
  return hits ? hits.length : 0;
}

function rel(file) {
  return relative(root, file).split(sep).join('/');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ gates */

// Gate 1 — no type below the 12px floor (Std §Typography, finding T6).
function gateSubTwelvePx(files) {
  const violations = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const hits = [...source.matchAll(/text-\[(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)px\]/g)].filter(
      (m) => Number.parseFloat(m[1]) < 12,
    );
    if (hits.length) violations[rel(file)] = hits.length;
  }
  return violations;
}

// Gate 2 — no raw hex in TSX; colour must come from a token (Std §Colour).
function gateRawHex(files) {
  // Exception: app/global-error.tsx renders *instead of* the root layout, so
  // globals.css (and with it every Tailwind colour token) is unavailable there.
  // Inline colours are the only option in that file.
  const exempt = new Set(['app/global-error.tsx']);
  const violations = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!file.endsWith('.tsx')) continue;
    if (exempt.has(rel(file))) continue;
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    // Hex inside an HTML entity (&#9876;) is not a colour.
    const stripped = source.replace(/&#\d+;/g, '');
    const hits = countMatches(stripped, /#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b|#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\b/g);
    if (hits) violations[rel(file)] = hits;
  }
  return violations;
}

// Gate 3 — outline-none is only allowed alongside a replacement (Std §A11y #3).
function gateNakedOutlineNone(files) {
  const violations = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!file.endsWith('.tsx')) continue;
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    let hits = 0;
    for (const match of source.matchAll(/className=(?:"([^"]*)"|\{`([^`]*)`\})/g)) {
      const cls = match[1] ?? match[2] ?? '';
      if (!/(^|\s)outline-none(\s|$)/.test(cls)) continue;
      // A focus/focus-visible ring, or a peer/group focus helper, counts as a replacement.
      if (/focus(-visible)?:/.test(cls)) continue;
      hits += 1;
    }
    if (hits) violations[rel(file)] = hits;
  }
  return violations;
}

// Gate 4 — an icon-only button must carry an accessible name (Std §A11y #1).
function gateUnnamedIconButtons(files) {
  const violations = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!file.endsWith('.tsx')) continue;
    const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    let hits = 0;
    for (const match of source.matchAll(/<button\b[^>]*>/g)) {
      const openingTag = match[0];
      if (/aria-label|aria-labelledby|title=/.test(openingTag)) continue;
      const rest = source.slice(match.index + openingTag.length);
      const close = rest.indexOf('</button>');
      const inner = close === -1 ? rest.slice(0, 300) : rest.slice(0, close);
      const text = inner
        .replace(/\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
        .trim();
      // `{expr}` may well render a label, so only a button with neither literal
      // text nor any expression — i.e. purely icon elements — counts as unnamed.
      const hasExpression = /\{[^}]*\}/.test(inner);
      if (!text && !hasExpression) hits += 1;
    }
    if (hits) violations[rel(file)] = hits;
  }
  return violations;
}

const GATES = [
  { id: 'sub-12px-type', label: 'No sub-12px type', fn: gateSubTwelvePx },
  { id: 'raw-hex', label: 'No raw hex in TSX', fn: gateRawHex },
  { id: 'naked-outline-none', label: 'No naked outline-none', fn: gateNakedOutlineNone },
  { id: 'unnamed-icon-button', label: 'Icon buttons need a name', fn: gateUnnamedIconButtons },
];

/**
 * Documented, visible exceptions with hard caps. This is NOT the ratchet
 * baseline: nothing here can grow over time, every entry is printed on each run,
 * and each one records why a mechanical fix is impossible. Use only for fixed
 * pixel-size layouts and renderers that cannot read CSS variables.
 */
const ALLOWLIST = {
  'sub-12px-type': {
    'components/PedigreeTree.tsx': {
      max: 6,
      reason:
        'Fixed 220x64 pedigree node cards: Not registered / code tag / status chips overflow the node at 12px',
    },
  },
  'raw-hex': {
    'app/layout.tsx': {
      max: 1,
      reason: 'Next.js metadata themeColor cannot reference CSS variables',
    },
    'app/opengraph-image.tsx': {
      max: 10,
      reason:
        'Satori/ImageResponse renders without CSS variables, so hex literals are required for the share card',
    },
    'components/match/MatchActionsRegression.test.tsx': {
      max: 1,
      reason: 'False positive: "#999" is a fowl identifier inside a test string, not a colour',
    },
  },
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- main */

const files = SCAN_DIRS.flatMap((dir) => walk(join(root, dir)));
const current = {};
for (const gate of GATES) current[gate.id] = gate.fn(files);

const update = process.argv.includes('--update');

if (update) {
  writeFileSync(
    baselinePath,
    `${JSON.stringify({ note: 'Ratchet ceiling per file. Regenerate with: node scripts/standard-gates.mjs --update', gates: current }, null, 2)}\n`,
    'utf8',
  );
  console.log('Baseline updated:');
  for (const gate of GATES) {
    const total = Object.values(current[gate.id]).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    console.log(
      `  ${gate.label.padEnd(28)} ${total} in ${Object.keys(current[gate.id]).length} file(s)`,
    );
  }
  process.exit(0);
}

if (!existsSync(baselinePath)) {
  console.error('No baseline found. Run: node scripts/standard-gates.mjs --update');
  process.exit(1);
}

const baseline = JSON.parse(readFileSync(baselinePath, 'utf8')).gates ?? {};
let failed = false;

for (const gate of GATES) {
  const was = baseline[gate.id] ?? {};
  const now = current[gate.id];
  const regressions = [];

  for (const [file, count] of Object.entries(now)) {
    const allow = ALLOWLIST[gate.id]?.[file];
    const ceiling = allow?.max ?? was[file] ?? 0;
    if (count > ceiling) regressions.push(`${file}: ${ceiling} -> ${count}`);
  }

  const nowTotal = Object.values(now).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const wasTotal = Object.values(was).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const improved = wasTotal - nowTotal;

  if (regressions.length) {
    failed = true;
    console.error(`\n✗ ${gate.label} — ${regressions.length} regression(s)`);
    for (const line of regressions) console.error(`    ${line}`);
  } else {
    const delta = improved > 0 ? ` (down ${improved} from ${wasTotal})` : '';
    console.log(`✓ ${gate.label.padEnd(28)} ${nowTotal} outstanding${delta}`);
  }

  for (const [file, allow] of Object.entries(ALLOWLIST[gate.id] ?? {})) {
    const count = now[file] ?? 0;
    if (count > 0) {
      console.log(`    allowlisted: ${file} (${count}/${allow.max}) — ${allow.reason}`);
    }
  }
}

process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * stitch-video.mjs — convert recordings/raw/*.webm → .mp4 and stitch.
 *
 *   node scripts/stitch-video.mjs              # convert + stitch
 *   node scripts/stitch-video.mjs --no-concat   # convert only
 *
 * Output: recordings/scene-NN-*.mp4 + recordings/gallotrack-full.mp4
 * (webm originals kept in recordings/raw/ until you delete them).
 * ffmpeg resolution: PATH → FFMPEG_DIR env → WinGet install locations.
 */
import { execFileSync, execSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const OUT = process.env.REC_OUT || 'recordings';
const RAW = join(OUT, 'raw');
const NO_CONCAT = process.argv.includes('--no-concat');

function walk(dir, name, depth) {
  if (depth > 6 || !existsSync(dir)) return null;
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  for (const e of entries) {
    const full = join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isFile() && e.name.toLowerCase() === name + '.exe') return full;
    if (e.isDirectory() && !e.name.startsWith('.')) {
      const hit = walk(full, name, depth + 1);
      if (hit) return hit;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function findTool(name) {
  if (process.env.FFMPEG_DIR) {
    const p = join(process.env.FFMPEG_DIR, name + '.exe');
    if (existsSync(p)) return p;
  }
  try {
    execSync(`${name} -version`, { stdio: 'ignore' });
    return name;
  } catch {
    /* not on PATH (agent shells cache env) — search WinGet */
  }
  const base = process.env.LOCALAPPDATA;
  const roots = base ? [join(base, 'Microsoft', 'WinGet', 'Links'), join(base, 'Microsoft', 'WinGet', 'Packages')] : [];
  for (const root of roots) {
    const hit = walk(root, name, 0);
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  throw new Error(`${name} not found. Install with: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg (or set FFMPEG_DIR)`);
}

function durationSec(tool, file) {
  try {
    const out = execFileSync(tool, ['-v', 'error', '-show_entries', 'format=duration', '-of', 'csv=p=0', file], {
      encoding: 'utf8',
    });
    return Number.parseFloat(out.trim());
  } catch {
    return NaN;
  }
}

const ffmpeg = findTool('ffmpeg');
const ffprobe = findTool('ffprobe');
console.log(`ffmpeg: ${ffmpeg}`);

if (!existsSync(RAW)) throw new Error(`${RAW} not found — run: npx tsx scripts/record-video.ts`);
// only our named scene files — Playwright can leave hash-named temp copies behind
const webms = readdirSync(RAW)
  .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.webm') && f.startsWith('scene-'))
  .sort();
if (webms.length === 0) throw new Error('no .webm files in ' + RAW);

let total = 0;
const mp4s = [];
for (const f of webms) {
  const src = join(RAW, f);
  const dst = join(OUT, f.replace(/\.webm$/, '.mp4'));
  mp4s.push(dst);
  const needConvert = !existsSync(dst) || existsSync(src) && new Date(src).mtimeMs > new Date(dst).mtimeMs;
  if (needConvert) {
    console.log(`convert ${f} → ${dst}`);
    execFileSync(
      ffmpeg,
      ['-y', '-i', src, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '18', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-an', dst],
      { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'inherit'] },
    );
  } else {
    console.log(`up-to-date ${f}`);
  }
  const d = durationSec(ffprobe, dst);
  total += d;
  console.log(`  ${dst}  ${d.toFixed(1)}s`);
}

if (!NO_CONCAT) {
  const listPath = join(OUT, 'concat.txt');
  // concat demuxer resolves entries relative to the list file's own directory
  writeFileSync(listPath, mp4s.map((p) => `file '${p.split(/[\\/]/).pop()}'`).join('\n') + '\n');
  const full = join(OUT, 'gallotrack-full.mp4');
  console.log(`stitch ${mp4s.length} clip(s) → ${full}`);
  execFileSync(ffmpeg, ['-y', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', listPath, '-c', 'copy', full], {
    stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'inherit'],
  });
  const fullDur = durationSec(ffprobe, full);
  console.log(`  ${full}  ${fullDur.toFixed(1)}s`);
  if (!(Math.abs(fullDur - total) < Math.max(2, total * 0.02))) {
    throw new Error(`stitched duration ${fullDur.toFixed(1)}s != sum of clips ${total.toFixed(1)}s`);
  }
}

console.log(`done — ${mp4s.length} clip(s), ${(total / 60).toFixed(1)} min total.`);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    password: TEST_PASSWORD,

    email: TEST_EMAIL,
    password: TEST_PASSWORD,

    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    body: form,
  });

  console.log('upload body:', JSON.stringify(body, null, 2));

  if (res.ok && body.url) {
    const head = await fetch(body.url, { method: 'HEAD' });
    console.log('public URL HEAD:', head.status);
  }

  await anon.auth.signOut();
  await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(uid);
  console.log('cleaned up');
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const ENV_PATH = new URL('../.env.local', import.meta.url).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const line of fs.readFileSync(ENV_PATH, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
  if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
  const i = line.indexOf('=');
  env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
}

const admin = createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

type Row = { id: number; user_id: string; name: string; bird_code: string | null; bloodline_composition: unknown };

async function main() {
  let ok = true;

  const { data: cols, error: colErr } = await admin.from('fowl').select('bird_code, bloodline_composition').limit(1);
  if (colErr) {
    console.log('❌ Columns missing ->', colErr.message);
    console.log('   Run supabase/migrations/20260925000000_bird_code_and_bloodline_composition.sql in the SQL Editor.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`✅ Columns exist (probe rows: ${cols?.length ?? 0})`);

  const { data: rows, error } = await admin
    .from('fowl')
    .select('id, user_id, name, bird_code, bloodline_composition')
    .order('id');
  if (error) {
    console.log('❌ Select failed ->', error.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const all = (rows ?? []) as Row[];
  const missing = all.filter((r) => !r.bird_code || !r.bird_code.trim());
  console.log(`   fowl rows: ${all.length}`);
  console.log(`   with bird_code: ${all.length - missing.length}/${all.length}`);
  if (missing.length) {
    ok = false;
    console.log(`❌ ${missing.length} row(s) still have no bird_code (backfill did not run):`);
    missing.slice(0, 10).forEach((r) => console.log(`     #${r.id} ${r.name}`));
  }

  const seen = new Map<string, number[]>();
  all.forEach((r) => {
    if (!r.bird_code) return;
    const key = `${r.user_id}|${r.bird_code.trim().toLowerCase()}`;
    seen.set(key, [...(seen.get(key) ?? []), r.id]);
  });
  const dupes = [...seen.entries()].filter(([, ids]) => ids.length > 1);
  if (dupes.length) {
    ok = false;
    console.log('❌ Duplicate bird_code within the same user:');
    dupes.forEach(([key, ids]) => console.log(`     ${key} -> rows ${ids.join(', ')}`));
  } else {
    console.log('✅ No duplicate bird_code per user');
  }

  const withComp = all.filter((r) => r.bloodline_composition && Object.keys(r.bloodline_composition as object).length > 0);
  if (withComp.length !== all.length) {
    ok = false;
    console.log(`❌ Only ${withComp.length}/${all.length} rows have a stored bloodline_composition. Run: npx tsx scripts\\backfill-composition.ts --apply`);
  } else {
    console.log(`✅ All ${withComp.length}/${all.length} rows have a stored bloodline_composition`);
  }

  if (!ok) process.exit(1);
  console.log('✅ Migration verified.');
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

async function checkCounts() {
  console.log('--- PRODUCTION READ-ONLY DATABASE AUDIT ---');

  const tables = [
    'fowl',
    'match',
    'profiles',
    'farms',
    'strains',
    'leg_colors',
    'breeding_pairings',
    // 'marketplace_listings', // DEPRECATED — removed from active tables
    'admin_audit_logs',
    'share_links',
    'system_settings',

      console.log(`Table '${table}': ${count} rows`);
    }
  }

  // Analyze fowl table per user_id

    });

    console.log('\n--- FOWL DISTRIBUTION PER USER_ID ---');
    let idx = 1;
    for (const [uid, cnt] of userMap.entries()) {
      console.log(`User Tenant #${idx++} (${uid.slice(0, 8)}...): ${cnt} chickens`);
    }
  }

  // Storage buckets
  const { data: buckets, error: bErr } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets();
  console.log('\n--- STORAGE BUCKETS ---');
  if (bErr) {
    console.log('Error listing buckets:', bErr.message);
  } else if (buckets) {
    for (const b of buckets) {
      const { data: files } = await supabase.storage.from(b.name).list('', { limit: 1000 });
      console.log(`Bucket '${b.name}' (public: ${b.public}): ${files ? files.length : 0} objects`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * verify-schema-contract.ts — validates that all columns defined in lib/schema-contract.ts
 * exist in the live database schema, and ensures that phantom columns (chicken_code, birth_code, tag_number)
 * do not exist on public.fowl.
 *
 * SAFETY GUARANTEES:
 * - Read-only: executes only SELECT queries with LIMIT 0. Never performs mutations.
 * - Local-only: exits immediately if executed in production/deployment environments (e.g. VERCEL=1).
 * - Never prints secrets: Supabase URLs and API keys are masked or omitted from logs.
 */

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { TABLE_SCHEMAS, TableName } from '../lib/schema-contract';

// Deployment guard: strictly local only
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
  console.log('[verify:schema] Skipped: this verification script runs locally only.');
  process.exit(0);
}

// Load local environment safely without printing credentials
const envPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../.env.local');
const env: Record<string, string> = {};
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  for (const line of fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = line.indexOf('=');
    env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
  console.error('[verify:schema] ❌ Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in environment/.env.local');
  process.exit(1);
}

const client = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
  auth: { persistSession: false },
});

async function runVerification() {
  console.log('[verify:schema] Starting read-only schema contract verification...');
  let hasErrors = false;

  // 1. Verify all allowed columns exist per table by querying select(col).limit(0)
  for (const [tableName, columns] of Object.entries(TABLE_SCHEMAS) as [TableName, readonly string[]][]) {
    const colList = columns.join(',');
    const { error } = await client.from(tableName).select(colList).limit(0);

    if (error) {
      console.error(`[verify:schema] ❌ Table "${tableName}" failed schema check: ${error.message}`);
      hasErrors = true;
    } else {
      console.log(`[verify:schema] ✔ Table "${tableName}" schema contract verified (${columns.length} columns)`);
    }
  }

  // 2. Explicitly assert that phantom columns do NOT exist on public.fowl
  const phantomColumns = ['chicken_code', 'birth_code', 'tag_number', 'trait', 'feather_color'];
  for (const col of phantomColumns) {
    const { error } = await client.from('fowl').select(col).limit(0);
    if (!error) {
      console.error(`[verify:schema] ❌ Phantom column "${col}" unexpectedly exists on table "fowl"!`);
      hasErrors = true;
    } else {
      console.log(`[verify:schema] ✔ Verified phantom column "${col}" does not exist on table "fowl"`);
    }
  }

  if (hasErrors) {
    console.error('\n[verify:schema] ❌ Schema contract verification failed.');
    process.exit(1);
  } else {
    console.log('\n[verify:schema] 🎉 All schema contracts verified successfully.');
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

runVerification().catch((err) => {
  console.error('[verify:schema] Unexpected execution error:', err?.message || err);
  process.exit(1);
});

/**
 * effects.ts — in-page recording effects for the GalloTrack video capture.
 *
 * Provides on `window.__gt`:
 *   focus(el, level, dur, noAnchor)   eased camera zoom onto an element
 *   unfocus(dur)                      eased return to 1.0x
 *   scrollTo(y, dur)                  eased scroll (visual px)
 *   scrollToBy(dy, dur)               eased relative scroll
 *   scrollToEl(el, dur, frac)         ride the page to an element (stays 1.0x)
 *   pulse(el)                         highlight ring around a click target
 *   stats()                           debug snapshot
 * plus always-on overlays: virtual cursor (Playwright video never captures the
 * real one) with click ripple, all inside a counter-zoomed fixed layer whose
 * coordinates are pure visual pixels.
 *
 * Camera model (verified empirically with a headless Playwright geometry probe):
 *   `zoom` on <html> keeps getBoundingClientRect(), mouse clientX/Y and
 *   window.scrollY in uniform *visual* px, with visualTop = docY1 * s - scrollY,
 *   so the camera anchor is: scrollY = docY1 * s - anchorVisualY.
 *   Fixed elements stay viewport-pinned and just scale (browser-zoom look).
 *
 * Injection: page.addInitScript(initEffects, config). tsx/esbuild keepNames
 * wraps named functions in __name(), which does not exist in the page — the
 * driver must first inject the string shim: globalThis.__name = (fn) => fn.
 */

export type EffectsConfig = { headerPx?: number };

export function initEffects(config: EffectsConfig = {}) {
  const HEADER: number = config.headerPx ?? 64;
  const gw = window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (gw.__gt) return;

  /* --------------------------- cursor + ripple ---------------------------- */
  let mx = -200;
  let my = -200;
  let cx = -200;
  let cy = -200;
  let seen = false;
  let pressed = false;

  document.addEventListener(
    'mousemove',
    (e) => {
      mx = e.clientX;
      my = e.clientY;
      seen = true;
    },
    true,
  );
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { pressed = true; }, true);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { pressed = false; }, true);

  /* -------------------------------- camera -------------------------------- */
  const cam = { s: 1, docY1: null as number | null, anchor: null as number | null, raf: 0 };
  let layer: HTMLElement | null = null;
  let cur: HTMLElement | null = null;

  function ease(t: number): number {
    return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 5);
  }

  function apply(): void {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    html.style.setProperty('zoom', String(cam.s));
    if (layer) layer.style.setProperty('zoom', String(1 / cam.s));
    if (cam.docY1 !== null && cam.anchor !== null) {
      const max = Math.max(0, html.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
      const y = cam.docY1 * cam.s - cam.anchor;
      window.scrollTo(0, Math.min(Math.max(y, 0), max));
    }
  }

  /** overlay needs <html>/<head>; init scripts run at document creation, so
   *  wait for DOMContentLoaded when it isn't parsed yet. */
  function installDom(): void {
    if (!document.documentElement || !document.head) return;
    if (layer) return;

    const css = document.createElement('style');
    css.textContent = `
      #__gt_layer, #__gt_layer * { pointer-events: none !important; }
      #__gt_layer { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 2147483646; overflow: visible; }
      #gt_cur { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px;
        transform-origin: 1px 1px; opacity: 0;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45)); }
      #gt_cur svg { display: block; }
      .gt-ripple { position: absolute; width: 76px; height: 76px; margin: -38px 0 0 -38px;
        border: 3px solid rgba(16,185,129,.9); border-radius: 9999px;
        transform: scale(.14); animation: gt-rip 550ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards; }
      @keyframes gt-rip { to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0; } }
      .gt-pulse { position: absolute; border: 3px solid rgba(16,185,129,.95); border-radius: 10px;
        animation: gt-puls 900ms ease-in-out forwards; }
      @keyframes gt-puls { 0% { opacity: .2; } 45% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(css);

    layer = document.createElement('div');
    layer.id = '__gt_layer';
    cur = document.createElement('div');
    cur.id = 'gt_cur';
    cur.innerHTML =
      '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20">' +
      '<path d="M1 1 L17 11 L10 11.8 L7.2 18.6 Z" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
    layer.appendChild(cur);
    document.documentElement.appendChild(layer);
    apply(); // re-sync counter-zoom with current camera state

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      (e) => {
        if (!layer) return;
        const r = document.createElement('div');
        r.className = 'gt-ripple';
        r.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
        r.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
        layer.appendChild(r);
        window.setTimeout(() => r.remove(), 700);
      },
      true,
    );

    const tick = () => {
      if (seen && cur) {
        cx += (mx - cx) * 0.32;
        cy += (my - cy) * 0.32;
        cur.style.opacity = '1';
        cur.style.transform =
          'translate3d(' + cx.toFixed(1) + 'px,' + cy.toFixed(1) + 'px,0) scale(' + (pressed ? 0.8 : 1) + ')';
      }
      window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  if (document.head && document.documentElement) installDom();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', installDom);

  function animate(to: number, dur: number): Promise<null> {
    installDom(); // lazy guard — page scripts may have replaced the DOM
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(cam.raf);
      const from = cam.s;
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const step = (now: number) => {
        const t = dur <= 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur);
        cam.s = from + (to - from) * ease(t);
        apply();
        if (t < 1) {
          cam.raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          cam.s = to;
          apply();
          resolve(null);
        }
      };
      cam.raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }

  function scrollTo(target: number, dur: number): Promise<null> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      window.cancelAnimationFrame(cam.raf);
      const from = window.scrollY;
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const step = (now: number) => {
        const t = dur <= 0 ? 1 : Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur);
        const max = Math.max(0, document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
        const v = from + (target - from) * ease(t);
        window.scrollTo(0, Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), max));
        if (t < 1) {
          cam.raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          resolve(null);
        }
      };
      cam.raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }

  /** Eased camera zoom that keeps the target's box anchored on screen.
   *  With a null element the viewport center becomes the anchor (pure camera push).
   */
  async function focus(el: Element | null, level: number, dur: number, noAnchor?: boolean): Promise<null> {
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    if (!el) {
      // targetless zoom: pin whatever is at the screen center right now
      cam.docY1 = (window.scrollY + vh / 2) / cam.s;
      cam.anchor = vh / 2;
      return animate(level, dur);
    }
    if (noAnchor) {
      cam.docY1 = null;
      cam.anchor = null;
      return animate(level, dur);
    }
    const r0 = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (cam.s === 1 && (r0.bottom < 60 || r0.top > vh - 80)) {
      // element off-screen: ride the page to it at 1.0x first
      await scrollTo(r0.top + window.scrollY - (HEADER + 56), 700);
    }
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const docY1 = (r.top + window.scrollY) / cam.s;
    const hNew = (r.height / cam.s) * level;
    const minTop = HEADER * level + 16;
    let anchor = r.top;
    if (hNew > vh - minTop - 24) {
      anchor = minTop;
    } else {
      if (anchor + hNew > vh - 24) anchor = vh - 24 - hNew;
      if (anchor < minTop) anchor = minTop;
    }
    cam.docY1 = docY1;
    cam.anchor = anchor;
    return animate(level, dur);
  }

  /** Eased return to 1.0x, keeping the last anchor so the subject stays put. */
  function unfocus(dur: number): Promise<null> {
    return animate(1, dur);
  }

  function scrollToEl(el: Element | null, dur: number, frac?: number): Promise<null> {
    if (!el) return Promise.resolve(null);
    const f = frac ?? 0.32;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return scrollTo(r.top + window.scrollY - window.innerHeight * f, dur);
  }

  function pulse(el: Element | null): void {
    if (!el || !layer) return;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'gt-pulse';
    box.style.left = r.left - 3 + 'px';
    box.style.top = r.top - 3 + 'px';
    box.style.width = r.width + 6 + 'px';
    box.style.height = r.height + 6 + 'px';
    layer.appendChild(box);
    window.setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 1000);
  }

  gw.__gt = {
    focus,
    unfocus,
    scrollTo,
    scrollToBy: (dy: number, dur: number) => scrollTo(window.scrollY + dy, dur),
    scrollToEl,
    pulse,
    stats: () => ({ s: cam.s, y: window.scrollY, anchor: cam.anchor }),
  };
}

/**
 * scenes.ts — declarative shot list for the GalloTrack video presentation.
 * One entry per script scene (docs/VIDEO_RECORDING_PLAN.md §6). The driver
 * (scripts/record-video.ts) executes steps in order and writes a beat
 * timestamp per step into recordings/manifest.json for CapCut narration sync.
 *
 * Targets: { css } → page.locator(css)  |  { role, name } → getByRole (name may
 * be a RegExp)  |  { text } → getByText (string or RegExp). Locators are
 * always narrowed with .first().
 *
 * Pacing (approved): natural speed, 3–4 s holds after each action so the live
 * narration can be recorded over the clips in CapCut later.
 *
 * Camera rule (v2, per client feedback): the camera NEVER moves for decoration.
 * A crop (zoom) opens only when an ACTION needs it — typing into a form/search,
 * the export menu — and snaps back to full view ('reset') the moment the action
 * group ends. Everything else (tabs, cards, nav, tables) plays at full view with
 * the virtual cursor pointing at the target; clicks get the green pulse ring.
 */

export type Target = { css: string } | { role: AriaRole; name: string | RegExp } | { text: string | RegExp };

// Narrow alias so role targets stay type-safe without importing playwright types.
type AriaRole = 'link' | 'button' | 'tab' | 'searchbox' | 'textbox' | 'combobox' | 'heading' | 'menuitem' | 'table';

export type Step =
  /** Full page load (first step of every scene). */
  | { type: 'goto'; path: string; label?: string }
  /** SPA navigation via the sidebar link (pulse + cursor + click). */
  | { type: 'nav'; name: string | RegExp; label?: string }
  | { type: 'click'; target: Target; label?: string; pulse?: boolean }
  /** Click an ARIA tab (Registry, Lineage) — Breeding Hub tabs are plain buttons. */
  | { type: 'tab'; name: string | RegExp; label?: string }
  /** Click the plain button used as a tab by BreedingHub. */
  | { type: 'htab'; name: string | RegExp; label?: string }
  /** Focus a field (click) then type character-by-character. */
  | { type: 'type'; target: Target; text: string; delay?: number; click?: boolean; label?: string }
  | { type: 'key'; key: string; label?: string }
  /** Raw viewport-coordinate click (e.g. close a menu by clicking its backdrop). */
  | { type: 'clickAt'; x: number; y: number; label?: string }
  | { type: 'hover'; target: Target; label?: string }
  /** Eased camera zoom onto a target; target optional (keeps viewport center). */
  | { type: 'zoom'; target?: Target; level: number; noAnchor?: boolean; label?: string }
  /** Eased return to 1.0x. */
  | { type: 'reset'; dur?: number; label?: string }
  /** Smooth scroll: by = relative px (negative = up), target = element ride. */
  | { type: 'scroll'; target?: Target; by?: number; frac?: number; dur?: number; label?: string }
  | { type: 'hold'; ms: number; label?: string }
  | { type: 'waitUrl'; re: string; label?: string }
  /** Native <select> fuzzy-set: value first, else first option matching regex. */
  | { type: 'select'; target: Target; value?: string; match?: string; label?: string };

export type Scene = {
  id: string; // 'S1'..'S13'
  slug: string; // output filename: scene-01-intro
  title: string; // human title for the manifest
  anonymous?: boolean; // record without auth (Scene 1 shows the login page)
  steps: Step[];
};

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

function getDemoCreds() {
  const envPath = join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  const env: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (existsSync(envPath)) {
    for (const line of readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)) {
      if (!line.includes('=') || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
      const i = line.indexOf('=');
      env[line.slice(0, i).trim()] = line.slice(i + 1).trim();
    }
  }
  const email = process.env.SMOKE_EMAIL || env.SMOKE_EMAIL || '';
  const password = process.env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || env.SMOKE_PASSWORD || '';
  return { email, password };
}

const { email: DEMO_EMAIL, password: DEMO_PASSWORD } = getDemoCreds();

export function findScenes(ids?: string[]): Scene[] {
  if (!ids || ids.length === 0) return SCENES;
  const wanted = ids.map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/^SCENE-?/, '').replace(/^S?(\d+)$/, 'S$1'));
  const picked = SCENES.filter((s) => wanted.includes(s.id));
  const missing = wanted.filter((w) => !SCENES.some((s) => s.id === w));
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`Unknown scene id(s): ${missing.join(', ')} (valid: ${SCENES.map((s) => s.id).join(', ')})`);
  return picked;
}

# GalloTrack Internationalization (i18n) Glossary

This document establishes the canonical terminology and translation standards across English (`en`), Tagalog (`tl`), and Hiligaynon (`hil` - Beta).

---

## 1. Domain Terminology Matrix

| English Concept | Canonical DB Value (Never Translate) | Tagalog Display Label | Hiligaynon Display Label (Beta) | Notes & Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sire** | `'Sire'` | Sire | Sire | Canonical gamefowl term: keep "Sire" in English in all three languages (no "Ama" or "Amay" as UI label; native glosses in tooltips only) |
| **Dam** | `'Dam'` | Dam | Dam | Canonical gamefowl term: keep "Dam" in English in all three languages (no "Ina" or "Iloy" as UI label; native glosses in tooltips only) |
| **Parents** | — | Sire at Dam | Sire kag Dam | Breeder-approved phrasing (consultant wrote "sire kag dam") |
| **Offspring (Tab / Filter)** | `'Offspring'` | Offspring | Offspring | Tab & filter label kept as "Offspring" across all three languages |
| **Offspring (Plural noun in text)** | — | mga anak | mga bata | Native consultant approved: "mga bata" in Hiligaynon, "mga anak" in Tagalog. Use only where a plural noun is required; never as a label |
| **Cock** | `'Cock'` | Cock | Cock | Mature male gamefowl (2+ years) |
| **Bull Stag** | `'Bull Stag'` | Bull Stag | Bull Stag | Young adult male gamefowl (12–24 months) |
| **Stag** | `'Stag'` | Stag | Stag | Young male gamefowl (6–11 months) |
| **Pullet** | `'Pullet'` | Pullet | Pullet | Young female gamefowl (6–11 months) |
| **Hen** | `'Hen'` | Hen | Hen | Mature female bird (12+ months) |
| **Chick** | `'Chick'` | Chick (Sisiw) | Chick | Tagalog keeps a gloss after the canonical term; Hiligaynon keeps the canonical term only until a native reviewer confirms a gloss |
| **Active** | `'Active'` | Aktibo | Aktibo | Status: In active yard |
| **Archived** | `'Archived'` | Naka-archive | Naka-archive | Status: Retained in records |
| **Deceased** | `'Deceased'` | Pumanaw | Napatay | Status: Dead |
| **Sold** | `'Sold'` | Naibenta | Nabaligya | Status: Transferred/sold |
| **Quarantined** | `'Quarantined'` | Naka-quarantine | Naka-quarantine | Status: Isolation pen |
| **Purebred** | `'Purebred'` | Purebred | Purebred | Breeding Type: 100% single bloodline |
| **Crossbred** | `'Crossbred'` | Crossbred | Crossbred | Breeding Type: Hybrid multiple bloodlines |
| **Unverified Lineage** | `'Unverified'` | Unverified Lineage | Unverified Lineage | Breeding Type: Unverified lineage |
| **Outcross** | `'Outcross'` | Outcross | Outcross | Relatedness category (Close Breeding, Line Breeding, Outcross) — **never** a Breeding Type |
| **Close Breeding** | `'Close'` | Close Breeding | Close Breeding | Relatedness category |
| **Line Breeding** | `'Line'` | Line Breeding | Line Breeding | Relatedness category |
| **Inbreeding** | `'Inbreeding'` | Inbreeding | Inbreeding | Relatedness: Closely related pairing |
| **Win** | `'Win'` | Panalo | Daug | Match result |
| **Loss** | `'Loss'` | Talo | Pildi | Match result |
| **Draw** | `'Draw'` | Tabla | Tabla | Match result |
| **No Contest** | `'No Contest'` | Walang Laban | Wala Laban | Canceled or abandoned |

### 1.1 Breeding Type vs Relatedness (do not mix up)

| Dimension | Allowed values | Where it appears |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Breeding Type** | Purebred · Crossbred · Unverified Lineage (+ "All") | `registry.breedingTypeLabel` filter on the Chicken Registry / Inventory |
| **Relatedness** | Close Breeding · Line Breeding · Outcross | Relatedness badge / bloodline report |

`Outcross` is **not** a breeding type. The breeder-side filter offers only
`All Breeding Types`, `Purebred`, `Crossbred`, `Unverified Lineage` in every
language, and the Outcross label is only reachable through the relatedness
dimension (`domain.relatednessOutcross`).

### 1.2 Growth stages (all six are always offered)

The stored `growth_stage` values are canonical and never translated:
`Chick`, `Stag`, `Bull Stag`, `Pullet`, `Cock`, `Hen`.
Every filter that offers a stage must offer **all six**, in this order,
regardless of which stages happen to exist in the current flock.

---

## 2. Platform & App Shell Terminology

| Concept | English (`en`) | Tagalog (`tl`) | Hiligaynon (`hil` - Beta) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Dashboard | Dashboard | Dashboard | Dashboard |
| Chicken Registry | Chicken Registry | Rehistro ng Manok | Listahan sang Manok |
| Breeding Hub | Breeding Hub | Sentro ng Pagpapalahi | Sentro sang Pagpaliwat |
| Match History | Match Logs | Talaan ng Laban | Listahan sang Hampang |
| Analytics | Analytics | Pagsusuri | Pagsusuri |
| Settings | Settings | Mga Setting | Mga Kahusayan |
| Preferences | Preferences | Mga Kagustuhan | Mga Pinasahi nga Gusto |
| Log In | Sign In | Mag-sign In | Mag-sulod |
| Log Out | Log Out | Mag-log Out | Mag-gwa |
| Create Account | Create Account | Gumawa ng Account | Maghimo sang Account |
| Save Changes | Save Changes | I-save ang mga Pagbabago | Tipigan ang mga Ginbag-o |
| Cancel | Cancel | Kanselahin | Kanselahon |
| Delete | Delete | Burahin | Panason |
| Today | Today | Ngayong Araw | Subong nga Adlaw |
| Last 7 Days | Last 7 Days | Huling 7 Araw | Nagligad nga 7 ka Adlaw |
| Last 30 Days | Last 30 Days | Huling 30 Araw | Nagligad nga 30 ka Adlaw |
| This Month | This Month | Ngayong Buwan | Subong nga Bulan |
| All Time | All Time | Lahat ng Oras | Halin Sang Una |
| Custom Range | Custom Range | Pasadyang Saklaw | Imo Pili nga Petsa |

---

## 3. Translation Principles

1. **Gamefowl Integrity Rule:**
   International gamefowl breeding terms (e.g., *Sweater, Kelso, Hatch, Albany, Roundhead, Derby, Cock, Stag, Sire, Dam*) are standard technical terms used nationwide by breeders in the Philippines. They must not be forced into obscure or artificial dialect equivalents.

2. **Display vs Storage Separation:**
   Database records store exact canonical English strings (`'Active'`, `'Sold'`, `'Win'`, `'Sire'`). Localized text is strictly applied at the presentation boundary via `translateStatus()`, `translateRole()`, etc.

3. **Pluralization:**
   Tagalog and Hiligaynon do not use English-style `s` / `es` suffixes. Instead, they use markers like `"mga"` or numbers with ligatures (`"7 ka adlaw"`). Reusable plural helpers in `lib/i18n/formatters.ts` (`pluralize()`) format these expressions correctly.

4. **No invented words:**
   Every Tagalog and Hiligaynon string must either be a standard word in that
   language, a canonical gamefowl term kept in English, or a gloss attached to
   a canonical English term. If a translation is uncertain, keep the English
   term, do not guess, and record the uncertainty in
   [`docs/i18n-review.md`](./i18n-review.md). Hiligaynon in particular is
   **unreviewed** until a native Ilonggo speaker signs off.

5. **Labels vs plural nouns:**
   `Offspring` stays the tab and filter label in all three languages. Use
   `mga anak` (Tagalog) / `mga bata` (Hiligaynon) only where the sentence
   actually needs a plural noun ("Mga Bata ni Juan", "Mga Anak ng Juan").

6. **Growth stages are always complete:**
   Filters that offer a growth stage must offer all six stored values
   (`Chick`, `Stag`, `Bull Stag`, `Pullet`, `Cock`, `Hen`) so that a stage can
   never silently disappear from the list depending on the current flock.

# GalloTrack Internationalization (i18n) Review & Workflow Guide

## 1. Overview
GalloTrack uses a zero-dependency, strongly-typed custom dictionary system supporting:
- `en` — English (Canonical source of truth)
- `tl` — Tagalog (Natural Filipino)
- `hil` — Hiligaynon / Ilonggo (Western Visayas dialect, currently marked **Beta**)

---

## 2. Hiligaynon (Beta) Status & Limitations
- **Beta Banner:** Whenever Hiligaynon is selected, a subtle `[Beta]` chip is displayed in the switcher, and a notice appears in Settings › Preferences.
- **Unreviewed by default:** **Every** Hiligaynon string that is not a preserved canonical English term is exported with `hil_status = unreviewed` and the note *"Hiligaynon (Beta): not yet confirmed by a native Ilonggo speaker."* Nothing in `hil` may be promoted to `reviewed` without a native Ilonggo speaker's sign-off.
- **Intl API Fallback:** `Intl.DateTimeFormat` and `Intl.NumberFormat` in V8/Node.js and modern browsers return empty arrays for `supportedLocalesOf(['hil'])`. GalloTrack automatically falls back to `fil-PH` / `en-PH` for numeric and peso formatting, while using an explicit Hiligaynon dictionary for month and weekday names (`HIL_MONTHS`, `HIL_WEEKDAYS`).
- **Breed & Bloodline Preservation:** Bloodline names (*Sweater*, *Kelso*, *Roundhead*) and cockfighting classifications (*Cock*, *Stag*, *Sire*, *Dam*, *Derby*) remain in English across all dialects as per standard Philippine cockfighting practice.

---

## 3. How to Add New Translation Keys Safely

### Step 1: Update `lib/i18n/types.ts` (if adding a new category)
If you are introducing a whole new dictionary section, declare it in `AppTranslations`. If adding keys to an existing category, TypeScript will infer the key paths from `en.ts`.

### Step 2: Add Keys to `lib/i18n/en.ts`
Add the key and its canonical English translation with any interpolation placeholders (e.g. `{count}`, `{name}`):
```ts
export const en = {
  // ...
  mySection: {
    welcome: 'Welcome, {name}!',
  },
} as const;
```

### Step 3: Implement Translations in `lib/i18n/tl.ts` and `lib/i18n/hil.ts`
Both `tl.ts` and `hil.ts` are typed with `: AppTranslations`. If you miss any key or introduce mismatched placeholders, `npm run typecheck` will immediately fail.

### Step 4: Run the Audit Script
```bash
npm run i18n:audit
```
This verifies key parity, checks placeholder consistency, and reports any issues.

### Step 5: Export to CSV for Translator Review
```bash
npm run i18n:export
```
This outputs `docs/i18n-review/translations.csv` and `locales/{en,tl,hil}.json`.

### Step 6: Record why a string is uncertain
Add an entry to `scripts/i18n-review-notes.ts`:
```ts
'mySection.myKey': { tl: 'Why the Tagalog wording is uncertain.', hil: 'Why the Hiligaynon wording is uncertain.' },
```
The exporter writes those reasons into the `tl_note` / `hil_note` CSV columns.

---

## 4. Phase 2, Feature 1 — Review Findings

### 4.1 "Mga Tindig" for Offspring — **not present in the codebase**
The reviewer flagged *"Mga Tindig"* as the Hiligaynon label for Offspring. That string does **not** exist in GalloTrack:

| Where searched | Result |
| :--- | :--- |
| `lib/i18n/{en,tl,hil}.ts` (working tree) | no match |
| `locales/{en,tl,hil}.json` (generated) | no match |
| `docs/i18n-glossary.md`, `docs/i18n-review.md`, `docs/i18n-review/translations.csv` | no match |
| Every tracked file in the repo (full-text scan) | no match |
| Git history (`git log -S "Tindig" --all`) | no match (the string was never committed) |
| Prior session artefacts under `scratch/` | no match |

The Hiligaynon Offspring wording in the code is **"mga bata"** (plural noun) with
**"Offspring"** kept as the tab/filter label, exactly as the breeder consultant
wrote it. The review did change the *remaining* inconsistencies (see 4.2).

### 4.2 Offspring wording changes made in this review

| Key | Tagalog before → after | Hiligaynon before → after | Reason |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `registry.awaitingParents` | `Naghihintay ng Magulang` → `Naghihintay ng Sire at Dam` | `Nagahulat sang Ginikannya` → `Nagahulat sang Sire kag Dam` | Glossary: Parents = "Sire at Dam" / "Sire kag Dam" (consultant's own wording) |
| `registry.awaitingParentsStatus` | same as above | same as above | Same rule |
| `registry.offspringBreedingClassAria` | `...ng pampalahing offspring` → `...ng pampalahi para sa mga anak` | `...sang pampalahi nga offspring` → `...sang pampalahi para sa mga bata` | Plural noun must be "mga anak"/"mga bata" |
| `registry.categoryBreedingStockTooltip` | `Mga offspring na ...` → `Mga anak na ...` | `Mga offspring nga ...` → `Mga bata nga ...` | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.noBreedingStockDesc` | `Walang offspring na ...` → `Walang anak na ...` | `Wala sang offspring nga ...` → `Wala sang bata nga ...` | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.noNonBreedingDesc` | `Walang offspring na ...` → `Walang anak na ...` | `Wala sang offspring nga ...` → `Wala sang bata nga ...` | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.noOffspringDesc` | `Walang nakitang mga manok na offspring sa rehistro.` → `Walang nakitang mga anak sa rehistro.` | unchanged (`mga bata nga manok`) | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.noOffspring` | unchanged (`Walang Offspring`, label usage) | `Wala sang Bata` → `Wala sang mga Bata` | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.existingOffspringSiblings` | `Mga Kasalukuyang Offspring at Kapatid` → `Mga Kasalukuyang Anak at Kapatid` | `Mga Yara nga Offspring kag Utod` → `Mga Yara nga Bata kag Utod` | Plural noun rule ("Yara" still flagged) |
| `registry.viewChildrenTitle` | `Tingnan ang {count} inakay ng {name}` → `Tingnan ang {count} na anak ng {name}` | `Tan-awa ang {count} ka pisu sang {name}` → `Tan-awa ang {count} ka bata sang {name}` | Plural noun rule; "pisu" was inconsistent with "mga bata" |
| `registry.offspringOf` | `Mga Offspring ng {name}` → `Mga Anak ng {name}` | `Mga Offspring sang {name}` → `Mga Bata sang {name}` | Plural noun rule |
| `registry.sortOffspring` | unchanged (`Pinakamaraming anak`) | unchanged (`Pinakadamo nga bata`) | Already compliant |

Sire and Dam stay in English in all three languages where they mean parent
roles (`roleSire: 'Sire'`, `roleDam: 'Dam'`). The Gender Class options use sex
labels instead (`cockOption: 'Cock'`, `henOption: 'Hen'`), while the stored
values remain `Rooster` and `Hen`. There is no "Ama/Ina" or "Amay/Iloy" label
anywhere in the dictionaries; native glosses are tooltip-only.

---

## 5. Strings that are NOT fully confirmed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Never mark Hiligaynon strings as "reviewed" without confirmation from a native Ilonggo speaker familiar with cockfighting/farming vocabulary.

### 5.1 Hiligaynon — blanket status: **unreviewed**

All 396 translated Hiligaynon strings carry `hil_status = unreviewed` in
`docs/i18n-review/translations.csv` and the blanket reason *"Hiligaynon (Beta):
not yet confirmed by a native Ilonggo speaker."* The table below lists the
strings with a **specific** reason (word choice that I could not verify, a
domain coinage, or a change made during this review). The complete
key-by-key enumeration with status and reason is the CSV.

| `common.close` | Close | Isira | Bare infinitive; the imperative form may read better on a button. |

| `common.delete` | Delete | Panason | Standard Hiligaynon, but the English loan "delete" is equally common. |
| `common.previous` | Previous | Nagligad | "Nagligad" actually means "recent/past"; "Kaagi" (before) may be better for the Previous control. |
| `common.no` | No | Indi | Tagalog loan. Hiligaynon normally uses "Hui" for "no" - needs confirmation next to "Huo" (yes). |

### 5.3 Known gaps (not fixed in Feature 1)

- `components/modals/ParentSelector.tsx` still hardcodes English section labels
  ("Breeding Males (Sires)", "Breeding Females (Dams)") instead of using the
  dictionary. This is untranslated UI inside a migrated feature and is a
  candidate for Feature 2.
- `components/RelatednessBadge.tsx` renders the relatedness labels that come
  from `lib/relatedness-classification.ts` (Close Breeding / Line Breeding /
  Outcross). The dictionary now owns the canonical wording
  (`domain.relatednessClose`, `domain.relatednessLine`,
  `domain.relatednessOutcross`, `domain.relatednessUnknown`), but the badge
  has not been switched over yet.
- `lib/i18n/index.ts` exposes `translateRelatedness()` for that switch; the
  badge migration is Feature 2 work.

---

## 6. Review CSV Export

Run `npm run i18n:export` to generate `docs/i18n-review/translations.csv`
(tracked in git; it contains no credentials).

**CSV columns:** `key`, `en`, `tl`, `tl_status`, `tl_note`, `hil`, `hil_status`, `hil_note`

**Status values:**
- `reviewed` — value is a preserved English gamefowl term or confirmed equivalent
- `unreviewed` — translated but awaiting native consultant confirmation
- `needs_change` — missing or blank value (should never appear after `npm run i18n:audit` passes)

**Note columns:** `tl_note` / `hil_note` carry the reason a string is not
confirmed. Curated reasons live in `scripts/i18n-review-notes.ts`; every
remaining unreviewed Hiligaynon row gets the blanket reason automatically.

**Latest export counts** (457 keys, regenerated with `npm run i18n:export`):
| Language | Reviewed | Unreviewed | Needs Change |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Tagalog (tl) | 61 | 396 | 0 |
| Hiligaynon (hil) | 61 | 396 | 0 |

---

## 7. Glossary Reference
See [`docs/i18n-glossary.md`](./i18n-glossary.md) for the canonical terminology matrix.

**Key rules from the glossary (summary):**
1. Sire and Dam: kept as English in all three languages — no "Ama/Ina" or "Amay/Iloy" as UI labels. Native glosses only in tooltips.
2. Offspring (tab/filter): kept as "Offspring" in all three languages.
3. Offspring (plural noun in text): "mga anak" in Tagalog, "mga bata" in Hiligaynon (breeder-approved).
4. Breeding Type filter: Purebred / Crossbred / Unverified Lineage (+ All) — **not** Outcross (which belongs to the Relatedness dimension: Close Breeding, Line Breeding, Outcross).
5. Growth stages (all six stored values, always offered): Chick, Stag, Bull Stag, Pullet, Cock, Hen.
6. Never invent words: keep the English term and flag the uncertainty here instead.

---

## 8. Review Guidelines for Translators
1. **Never translate canonical database stored values:** Do not translate `'Active'`, `'Cock'`, `'Sire'`, `'Win'`, etc. when stored in the database.
2. **Preserve placeholders:** Text like `{count}`, `{expected}`, `{days}` must be kept exactly as `{placeholder}` inside the translation string.
3. **Keep Tone Professional:** GalloTrack is used by farm managers and gamefowl breeders; avoid overly casual internet slang while maintaining natural regional phrasing.
4. **Hiligaynon is Beta:** Mark every new Hiligaynon string as "unreviewed" in `docs/i18n-review.md` until a native consultant approves it.
5. **Record the reason:** when you flag a string, add the reason to `scripts/i18n-review-notes.ts` so the CSV explains itself.

import nextVitals from 'eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals';
import nextTs from 'eslint-config-next/typescript';
import jsxA11y from 'eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y';

const eslintConfig = defineConfig([
  ...nextVitals,
  ...nextTs,
  // Override default ignores of eslint-config-next.
  globalIgnores([
    // Default ignores of eslint-config-next:
    '.next/**',
    'out/**',
    'build/**',
    'next-env.d.ts',
    'scripts/**',
  ]),
  {
    rules: {
      // Gate 5 (Std §08): the full jsx-a11y recommended rule set as real tooling.
      // eslint-config-next already registers the plugin, so only the rules are
      // merged here — adding its flat config would re-register and throw.
      ...jsxA11y.flatConfigs.recommended.rules,
      // The default search depth of 2 cannot see a label whose copy sits at
      // label > div > span > text, which is exactly the toggle-row pattern.
      // Raising it only widens the *text* search; the association check
      // (htmlFor must be present) stays strict.
      'jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control': ['error', { assert: 'either', depth: 4 }],
      'react-hooks/rules-of-hooks': 'error',
      'react-hooks/set-state-in-effect': 'warn',
      '@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'warn',
      '@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars': [
        'warn',
        {
          argsIgnorePattern: '^_',
          varsIgnorePattern: '^_',
          destructuredArrayIgnorePattern: '^_',
        },
      ],
    },
  },
]);

export default eslintConfig;

import { sanitizeRedirectPath } from '@/lib/auth-redirect';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

export const PUBLIC_PATHS = new Set(['/', '/login', '/register', '/design-kit']);
export const PUBLIC_PREFIXES = ['/auth', '/share', '/api', '/_next'];

const STATIC_EXTENSIONS = [
  'svg', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'avif', 'ico', 'css', 'js',
  'mjs', 'map', 'woff', 'woff2', 'ttf', 'otf', 'txt', 'xml', 'webmanifest',
];

export function isStaticAsset(pathname: string): boolean {
  const lastSegment = pathname.slice(pathname.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
  const dotIndex = lastSegment.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (dotIndex > 0) {
    const extension = lastSegment.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    if (STATIC_EXTENSIONS.includes(extension)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function isPublicPrefixOrStatic(pathname: string): boolean {
  if (isStaticAsset(pathname)) return true;
  return PUBLIC_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`));
}

function redirectTarget(request: NextRequest, destination: string, search = ''): NextResponse {
  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
  url.pathname = destination;
  url.search = search;
  return NextResponse.redirect(url);
}

/**
 * Server-side route guard for GalloTrack.
 *
 * - Unauthenticated requests to protected screens are sent to `/login` with a sanitized `?redirect=` param.
 * - Logged-in users visiting `/login` or `/register` are redirected to `/dashboard`.
 * - Public routes (`/`, `/design-kit`, `/auth/*`, `/share/*`, `/api/*`, static assets) remain accessible.
 * - `/admin/*` is additionally restricted to admin profiles.
 */
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;

  // 1. Static assets and public prefix routes (/auth, /share, /api, /_next) bypass auth guards
  if (isPublicPrefixOrStatic(pathname)) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  // 2. Public landing pages (/ and /design-kit) accessible without redirection for both guests and authenticated users
  if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/design-kit') {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });

  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
        setAll: (cookies) => {
          cookies.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
          response = NextResponse.next({ request });
          cookies.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => response.cookies.set(name, value, options));
        },
      },
    });

    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    const isAuthenticated = !error && !!data?.user;

    // 3. Auth entry routes (/login, /register)
    if (pathname === '/login' || pathname === '/register') {
      if (isAuthenticated) {
        // Authenticated users must not be bounced to the landing page; send to /dashboard
        return redirectTarget(request, '/dashboard');
      }
      // Unauthenticated visitors reach /login or /register on first click
      return response;
    }

    // 4. Protected routes: unauthenticated users get sent to /login with sanitized redirect param
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      const sanitizedBackPath = sanitizeRedirectPath(pathname + search, '/dashboard');
      return redirectTarget(request, '/login', `?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(sanitizedBackPath)}`);
    }

    // 5. Admin-only routes
    if (pathname === '/admin' || pathname.startsWith('/admin/')) {
      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('role, is_admin')
        .eq('id', data.user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (profile && profile.is_admin !== true && profile.role !== 'admin') {
        return redirectTarget(request, '/dashboard');
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[proxy] auth check failed:', err);
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
}

export const config: ProxyConfig = {
  matcher: [
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon\\.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|avif|ico|css|js|mjs|map|woff|woff2|ttf|otf)$).*)',
  ],
};
